title: ICT Project Manager - Federal Government
description:
APG Workforce is seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to support a major Federal Government client in Canberra.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to contribute to complex ICT projects that support critical government services used by millions of Australians.

About the Role:
As an ICT Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning, managing and delivering projects across the full project lifecycle. Working under broad direction, you will ensure projects are delivered to a high standard, on time and within budget.
You will work closely with business areas, technical teams, senior executives, vendors and external stakeholders to deliver project outcomes and support successful implementation.

Key responsibilities:
  • Deliver complex ICT projects from planning through to implementation.
  • Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, risks and dependencies.
  • Manage stakeholders across business, technical and executive levels.
  • Prepare project documentation, reports, briefs and governance materials.
  • Monitor scope, quality, milestones, budget and project outcomes.
  • Manage procurement, contracts and project expenditure.
  • Lead project teams and support continuous improvement and change.
Essential experience:
  • Demonstrated delivery of complex ICT projects.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across all levels.
  • Excellent organisation and time management, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing project plans, schedules and status reports.
  • Proven project budget and financial management experience.
  • Strong knowledge of project/program management frameworks.
Desirable: Federal Government or large, highly regulated environment experience.

Please note: Candidates may submit an application through one agency only. Duplicate applications through multiple agencies will not be accepted.

Canberra-based hybrid role and is not a fully remote position.
Candidates must live within reasonable commuting distance and be able to attend the Canberra office at short notice when required.

Apply today to be considered for this opportunity!

title: Supervisor, Trust Safety (Audit and Compliance)
description:
The Law Society of Alberta (Law Society) regulates the legal profession in the public interest.

In alignment with the Law Society’s mandate, vision, and strategic priorities, the Trust Safety department delivers a program that protects the public by helping ensure lawyers manage client trust funds responsibly. This includes evaluating lawyers' (and law firms’) compliance with the Rules of the Law Society, setting standards for trust accounting, requiring financial reporting, offering guidance and education and taking appropriate steps where concerns are identified. The Supervisor, Trust Safety, is responsible for supporting the delivery of Trust Safety programs through operational leadership, compliance oversight, risk assessment, stakeholder engagement, vendor management, continuous improvement initiatives, and the effective delivery, quality, and integrity of the Trust Safety audit function. The position supervises staff, contributes to department planning, supports regulatory decision-making, and helps ensure the consistent application of Trust Safety processes and standards.

The Supervisor works closely with the Manager, Trust Safety, and partners with other regulatory departments to identify emerging risks, prioritize oversight activities, support strategic initiatives, leverage analytics to enhance oversight, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of Trust Safety programs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Compliance and Risk Oversight

  • Support the administration of Trust Safety compliance programs.
  • Review information obtained through financial reporting, monitoring activities, and other regulatory sources to identify emerging risks and trends.
  • Assess risk indicators and recommend appropriate follow-up activities.
  • Support enhanced monitoring activities and compliance interventions where required.
  • Participate in the development and implementation of risk-based approaches to Trust Safety oversight.

Enhanced Analytics and Program Intelligence

  • Lead and support initiatives that leverage data analytics, technology, and automation to improve regulatory effectiveness.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and risk indicators that may require further assessment or action.
  • Support the development of dashboards, metrics, and reporting tools that inform departmental decision-making.
  • Monitor program outcomes and recommend opportunities for improvement.

Vendor Management and External Relationships

  • Oversee relationships with external service providers and consultants supporting Trust Safety programs.
  • Monitor vendor performance, deliverables, timelines, and contractual obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and program effectiveness through external partnerships.
  • Collaborate with internal departments regarding procurement, contract management, and vendor oversight.

Leadership and Staff Development

  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.
  • Assist with onboarding, training, and professional development activities.
  • Support performance management initiatives and employee development planning.

Program Development and Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of Trust Safety programs.
  • Participate in policy, procedure, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support implementation of strategic and operational priorities.
  • Monitor program metrics and prepare reports for management.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build effective working relationships with lawyers, law firms, internal stakeholders, regulators, and external partners.
  • Support communications, education, and outreach activities.
  • Participate in meetings, presentations, and other stakeholder engagement opportunities.
  • Liaise with other Regulation Department operational units regarding law firm risk and compliance with the Rules, including participating in hearings or proceedings as an expert witness or technical resource, as required.

Audit Program Responsibilities:

  • Support the Trust Safety audit function through coordination, planning, resource allocation, and quality initiatives as required.
  • Participate in audit program improvement activities and risk-based planning.
  • Assist with audit-related projects and departmental priorities.
  • Perform other duties related to auditing and compliance oversight as assigned.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Prepare clear, concise, and professional reports, briefing materials, and correspondence for management, committees, and other regulatory forums.
  • Remain flexible and capable of assuming additional responsibilities as the Trust Safety program evolves.
  • Work independently under general supervision with considerable latitude for initiative and independent judgment.
  • Assist the Manager, Trust Safety and perform other duties and projects as assigned.Provide day-to-day supervision, coaching, and support to the compliance team.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
  • Professional certifications such as the Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation and/or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) are required. Certification in progress will be
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in compliance, regulatory oversight, auditing, risk management, investigations, financial services, or related environments.
  • 2+ years of supervisory or people leadership experience or demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
  • Demonstrated leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement capability.
  • Experience operating within a regulatory, compliance, governance, or oversight environment.
  • Familiarity with law firm trust accounting and regulatory compliance is an asset.
  • Experience using data analytics or audit automation tools to inform risk‑based oversight is an asset.
  • Exposure to fraud risk, misconduct investigations, or AML/financial integrity frameworks is an asset.
  • Experience with data analytics, business intelligence tools, or regulatory technology solutions
  • Experience managing external vendors, consultants, or service providers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical findings into clear regulatory conclusions.
  • High level of integrity, discretion, and professional maturity.

title: Kardiologian erikoislääkäri, Kemi
description:
Pohjoisessa työ ja elämä kulkevat samaa latua. Lapin hyvinvointialueella tulet osaksi tiivistä työyhteisöä, jossa hommat hoidetaan titteleihin katsomatta ja yhteen hiileen puhaltaen. Lapin upea luonto, ainutlaatuiset maisemat ja mahdollisuudet urakehitykseen antavat elämään huippuhetkiä. Me annamme tilaa ja tukea, jotta sinä voit kulkea itsesi näköisen polun.

Lapin hyvinvointialue hakee kardiologian erikoislääkäriä vakituiseen virkasuhteeseen Länsi-Pohjan sairaalaan. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Meidän tiimi koostuu huippukollegoista ja Suomen parhaasta hoitohenkilökunnasta. Kardiologian erikoisala kuuluu sisätautien klinikkaan ja meillä on edustettuna kaikki suppeat sisätautien erikoisalat. Konsultointi ja yhteistyö on klinikassamme helppoa.

Keskeisimmät työtehtävät:
- Monipuolisesti kardiologisten potilaiden noninvasiiviseen, polikliiniseen ja osastohoitoon osallistuminen sekä kardiologisena konsulttina toimiminen.

Erikoislääkärin virkaan tuleva voi halutessaan osallistua vapaamuotoiseen sisätautien takapäivystysrinkiin Lapin keskussairaalassa. Osa-aikaisuus ja muut erityistoiveet otetaan huomioon. Työnkuvaa saa muokata myös osittaiseen sisätautiosastosijoitukseen ja soveltuvin osin etätyöskentelyyn. Koulutuksiin osallistuminen on itsestäänselvyys ja myös toivottavaa.

Kelpoisuusehtona on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) 4 §:n mukainen laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä, sekä kardiologian erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä.

Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Lääkärisopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa. Tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Henkilöstön rokotussuojan osalta noudatamme työn ja tartuntatautilain edellyttämää rokotussuojaa.

Tule meille huippuhommiin hakemalla tehtävään Kuntarekry-palvelussa 22.10.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä!

title: Mission Systems Trainer
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**About us**

L3Harris Technologies is an agile global aerospace and defence technology innovator, delivering end-to-end solutions that meet customers’ mission-critical needs. We provide advanced defence and commercial technologies across the air, land, sea, space and cyber domains.

L3Harris Australia (operating as Integrated Mission Systems Australia) has provided advanced technology solutions to the Australian Defence Force and commercial customers for over 25 years. As a government partner of choice, L3Harris brings speed, innovation and flawless execution together with our commitment to make the world safer and more secure.

Our values of Integrity, Excellence and Respect are at the core of everything we do and inspire our team members around the globe.

**About the role**

Based out of RAAF Base Edinburgh we are seeking a Mission SystemsMaintenance Trainer to support training of the mission systems for the program. As a member of the Squadron, the Mission Systems Trainer will work closely with the squadron key stakeholders to ensure seamless operations, including operational readiness and contributing to the overall success of the program.

Your duties will include coordinating with existing squadron representatives to provide courseware support training on the platform – including conducting reviews of maintenance training, development and review of courseware, providing feedback and support to students and delivery of maintenance training.

For the first year there will be 10% travel required.

**About you**

To be successful in this role and to best leverage opportunities that L3Harris will provide, some of the skills & qualifications ideal applicants will bring include.

- Prior experience within the aerospace or Defence industry
- B2 Military Aircraft Maintenance Licence or Equivalent Cert 4 - **Mandatory**
- Demonstrated competency of development and delivery of courseware
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to conduct courseware reviews, process student feedback, and update training courseware where required.
- You will have the ability to hold and maintain a PV Australian Defence Security Clearance

**What we offer**

Working at L3Harris offers various benefits including;

- A dynamic and inclusive working environment
- An additional week of leave per annum plus the option to buy or sell up to 2 weeks additional annual leave
- Flexible working arrangements and a commitment to work life balance
- Professional development programs, supported by the company
- Salary continuance insurance
- Novated leasing
- Retail Reward programs: Discounts across shopping, entertainment, insurance, leisure, health & wellbeing
- Health insurance discounts
- Purchased leave options

**Want to explore further?**

Contact our Talent Acquisition team by email on [HR.IMSA@L3Harris.com](mailto:HR.IMSA@L3Harris.com) for a confidential discussion.

L3Harris respectfully requests no agency submissions at this time.

**_All applicants must be eligible to obtain and hold a PV Australian Defence Security Clearance._**

_Eligibility and clearance process information can be found at;_

_https://www.defence.gov.au/security/clearances/about/overview_

As an equal opportunities employer, L3Harris is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and does not condone discrimination on the basis of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Data Platform Engineer

Newcastle (2 days per week in office) | £73,000 - £84,000 + Benefits

Are you a hands-on Data Platform Engineer who enjoys combining technical ownership with platform strategy? This is an opportunity to join a growing data and innovation function where you will play a key role in shaping and scaling a modern Azure-based data platform that supports advanced analytics and AI initiatives across the business.

The Company

They are a large international organisation investing heavily in their data and AI capabilities. Their newly established innovation and data team is focused on delivering data-driven products, improving business decision-making, and enabling future AI solutions.

You will join a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment where Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, and Product teams work closely together. The culture is hands-on, delivery-focused, and offers the opportunity to influence technical direction while working alongside experienced leaders in data and technology.

The Role

As a Data Platform Engineer, you will take ownership of the overall health, scalability, and performance of the data platform while remaining hands-on with technology and operational delivery.

Responsibilities include:

  • Managing and enhancing a modern Azure-based data platform
  • Ensuring platform reliability, security, governance, and operational excellence
  • Supporting and optimising services across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and related technologies
  • Working closely with infrastructure, networking, architecture, and security teams
  • Enabling Data Engineers to build and deploy scalable data solutions efficiently
  • Driving platform improvements, monitoring, observability, and automation initiatives
  • Supporting release management, CI/CD practices, and infrastructure-as-code frameworks
  • Investigating performance issues, troubleshooting technical challenges, and implementing sustainable solutions
  • Contributing to platform architecture decisions and clearly communicating technical rationale to stakeholders
  • Promoting best practice across support, governance, documentation, and operational readiness

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience supporting cloud-based data platforms within Azure environments
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, or similar modern data platform technologies
  • Knowledge of platform architecture, scalability, performance optimisation, and operational support
  • Understanding of CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Git, and deployment automation
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, observability, and incident management processes
  • Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code approaches such as Terraform
  • Scripting experience using technologies such as Python or PowerShell
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across networking, security, storage, identity, and integration layers
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly

What They Offer

  • Opportunity to influence the direction of a growing enterprise data platform
  • Exposure to cutting-edge data and AI projects
  • Collaborative culture with strong technical leadership
  • Clear opportunities for professional growth and technical development

How to Apply

To find out more about this Data Platform Engineer opportunity, please submit your CV for a confidential discussion.

title: Myyntijohtaja, Masino Industry
description:
Masino Industry on laadukkaiden putkistotuotteiden kotimainen valmistaja. Ylöjärven tehtaalla suunnitellaan ja valmistetaan asiakkaiden tarpeisiin räätälöityjä metallipaljetasaimia ja kokometalliletkuasennelmia. Oma tuotanto yhdistyy sitä täydentävään välitystuotevalikoimaan. Yritys palvelee asiakkaita muun muassa meri-, energia- ja prosessiteollisuudessa.

Masino Industry on osa Masino Groupia, joka on suomalainen yritysryhmä, joka palvelee muun muassa metalli-, kaivos- ja rakennusteollisuuden tarpeita laajalla asiantuntemuksella ja monipuolisella tuote- ja palveluvalikoimalla. Edustustuotteiden lisäksi on omaa tuotantoa, loppukokoonpanoa sekä sopimusvalmistajilla valmistettavia tuotteita. Masino Groupin liikevaihto on noin 80 M€ ja henkilöstöä on noin 180.

Etsimme nyt MYYNTIJOHTAJAA vakituiseen tehtävään Ylöjärvelle.

Myyntijohtajana saat kokonaisvastuun myynnin johtamisesta ja kehittämisestä. Masino Industryn liikevaihtoennuste on tälle vuodelle 15M€ ja henkilöstöä on noin 60. Johdat 8 hengen myyntitiimiä ja vastaat myynnin strategiasta, tavoitteista, aktiivisuudesta sekä prosessien kehittämisestä. Kompaktissa tiimissä olet myös itse lähellä asiakkaita ja osallistut myyntityöhön. Kasvua haetaan uusista asiakkuuksista, nykyisten asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä viennistä, samalla kannattavuutta vahvistaen. Saat vahvan tuen ja toimintatavat Masino-konsernista, mutta pääset itse rakentamaan arjen käytännöt, joilla tavoitteet muutetaan tuloksiksi. Raportoit Masino Industryn toimitusjohtajalle ja kuulut Masino Industryn johtoryhmään.

Vastuullasi ovat muun muassa:

  • myynnin kokonaisuus, strategia ja tavoitteiden saavuttaminen

  • myyntitiimin johtaminen, aktiivisuuden varmistaminen ja tuloksellisen myyntikulttuurin rakentaminen

  • uusasiakashankinnan vahvistaminen sekä nykyisten asiakkuuksien kasvattaminen

  • myynnin prosessien ja toimintatapojen kehittäminen

  • kannattavan myynnin johtaminen sekä keskeisten tunnuslukujen ja myyntikatteen seuranta

  • viennin kasvattaminen ja uusien kaupallisten mahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen

  • aktiivinen myyntityö ja asiakaskäynnit yhdessä vastuumyyjien kanssa

  • yhteistyö konsernin myyntijohtajien ja markkinointitiimin kanssa

Myyntijohtajana johdat tekemistä tavoitteiden ja mittareiden kautta. Seurannassa ovat muun muassa myyjien asiakastapaamisten määrä, uusasiakashankinta, asiakkuuksien kasvu, tilauskanta, asiakastyytyväisyys sekä budjetin toteutuminen. Samalla vastuullasi on myyntitiimin tunnelman ja myyntikulttuurin rakentaminen. Etsimme johtajaa, joka osaa asettaa selkeän suunnan, saa ihmiset mukaan ja uskaltaa myös puuttua epäkohtiin silloin, kun tekeminen ei etene tavoitteiden mukaisesti.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • kokemusta tuloksellisesta B2B-myynnistä ja myynnin johtamisesta

  • kykyä johtaa myyntiä tavoitteiden, aktiivisuuden ja numeeristen mittareiden kautta

  • näyttöä kasvun, uusasiakashankinnan ja asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä

  • ymmärrystä kannattavuudesta ja myyntikatteen muodostumisesta

  • kykyä kehittää myynnin prosesseja ja toimintatapoja

  • aktiivista ja käytännönläheistä johtamisotetta sekä valmiutta osallistua itse asiakastyöhön

  • kokemus teollisuudesta ja esimerkiksi teollisuuden putkistoista tai vastaavasta teknisestä toimintaympäristöstä katsotaan eduksi

  • kokemus viennistä tai vientimyynnin kasvattamisesta katsotaan eduksi

  • suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, muut kielet katsotaan eduksi

Miksi tämä tehtävä on kiinnostava?

Saat keskeisen roolin kasvua tavoittelevassa liiketoiminnassa ja pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan siihen, miten myyntiä johdetaan ja kehitetään. Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvät strateginen myynnin johtaminen, tiimin kehittäminen ja käytännön asiakastyö. Saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa vahvempaa ja aktiivisempaa myyntikulttuuria, kehittää myynnin prosesseja sekä hakea kasvua niin nykyisistä ja uusista asiakkuuksista kuin viennistäkin. Päätoimipiste sijaitsee Ylöjärvellä, ja myyntijohtajana työskentelet pääosin toimistolla lähellä tiimiäsi. Tehtävä sisältää myös jonkin verran matkustamista.

Jos myynnin kasvattaminen, ihmisten johtaminen ja entistä tuloksellisemman myyntikulttuurin rakentaminen kuulostavat sinun seuraavalta tehtävältäsi, jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 22.10.2026.

title: Määräaikainen koulunkäynninohjaaja
description:
Haemme Lopen kunnan perusopetukseen Läyliäisten kouluun koulunkäynninohjaajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 26.10.2026-5.6.2027. Työaika on 30 h/vk. Määräaikaisuuden perusteena on koulunkäynnin ja oppimisen tuen määräaikaiset järjestelyt.

Haemme vaihtoehtoisesti koulunkäynninohjaajan tutkinnon, lähihoitajan tutkinnon tai työkokemuksella osoitetun pätevyyden omaavaa oma-aloitteista ja yhteistyökykyistä koulunkäynninohjaajaa.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan sekä lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Koeaika on kolme (3) kuukautta.

Alkuperäiset tutkintotodistukset pyydetään nähtäväksi haastatteluun kutsuttavilta.

Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen yleisen työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (KVTES) mukaisesti. Kunnassamme on tehty työn vaativuuden arviointi, johon tehtäväkohtainen palkka perustuu.

Lopen kunta käyttää sähköistä rekrytointijärjestelmää, joten hakemus tulee tehdä osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakemuksen liitteeksi tutkintotodistukset.

title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant (German-speaking)
description:
At Machine Learning Architects Basel (MLAB), we assist and empower people and organizations in designing, building, and operating reliable data and machine learning solutions. In doing so, our data and AI journeys and effective solution patterns enable our customers to operationalize, scale, and continuously deliver data and AI products beyond the pilot and prototype stages. These patterns and frameworks revolve not only around the latest technologies but also consider role, skills, and process adjustments. We thereby:

  • Help our customers realize the full potential of data and AI solutions, from use case identification, over data, and ML platform implementation to integration and testing operation of ML models, LLMs, and other GenAI solutions.
  • Design, test, integrate and operate data, model and code pipelines, and end-to-end data/ML/LLM systems (DataOps, MLOps & DevOps).
  • Enable technical and non-technical teams and individuals to leverage data science and management, data, ML, and reliability engineering in an end-to-end fashion.

Aufgaben

Do you want to contribute to our dynamic and growing services company with your Machine Learning, AI, and Software Engineering knowledge? Do you want to act as a thought leader and trusted advisor in the field of Data Products and Data Mesh?

We are looking for a German-speaking Senior Data Engineering Consultant who will be involved in the whole lifecycle of projects, both internally and externally:

  • Consulting, Engineering & Training: You perceive data, software, and AI engineering as key capabilities for mastering the challenges of our clients' digital transformations, want to help them understand both their potential and their limitations, and deliver impactful, valuable services.
  • Requirement Analysis: You analyze customer requirements and identify and define best-fit solutions.
  • Implementation of Data Pipelines and Platforms, ML/LLM Integrations, Reliability Engineering & Operationalization: You understand how to successfully deliver data projects from the prototype or pilot phase into production, design, build, integrate and test data pipelines and platforms, and implement engineering best practices such as traceability, reliability, scalability, measurability, and automation within a demanding project and technology environment.
  • Concept Development: You contribute to our solution blueprints and concepts (e.g., our journey for ‘Reliable Data Products & Efficient Data Meshes’).
  • Expertise & Thought Leadership: You strive to become an expert and a trusted advisor in the field of Data Platforms, Data Products, and DataOps
  • Ownership, Communication, Knowledge Sharing & Teamwork: You take ownership of your work, present your results to various stakeholders, share your knowledge, and collaborate (pro-)actively with our and your client’s teams.

Qualifikation

  • Professional experience (minimum 5 years) as a Data or Software Engineer with a focus on data and ML systems.

  • Experience with and, ideally certified in major data and AI platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, MS Fabric).

  • Familiarity with data analytics and DataOps best practices, as well as topics such as Data Mesh, Data Lake/Warehouses, and Reliability Engineering.

  • Understanding and strong interest in the end-to-end life cycle of projects, code, model, and data pipelines, and working with various stakeholders.

  • Technical, hands-on experience with at least some of the following:

  • Programming languages

  • Distributed systems (Hadoop, Spark) and data structures.

  • SQL and NoSQL databases.

  • Cloud Services.

  • REST API and microservices.

  • Docker and knowledge of Kubernetes.

  • Agile development methods and CI/CD.

  • Experience working in a client-facing or consulting role.

  • Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).

  • Swiss passport or a valid EU/EFTA work permit.

Benefits

  • A young and dynamic services company with an experienced, knowledgeable, and passionate team.
  • An entrepreneurial environment and the chance to have a real impact on the company’s development and growth.
  • Work on cutting-edge data, AI, and analytics topics that have a real impact across industries.
  • A culture that is both performance-oriented and customer-driven and at the same time team-oriented, friendly, and supportive, incl. regular knowledge-sharing sessions and team events
  • A hybrid working model with flexibility as long as both client (of which most require onsite presence) and internal commitments (i.e., one team office day per week) are met.

title: PAT Tester
description:

  • 27k basic salary – realistic OTE of 38-40k OTE
  • Bonus scheme for the amount of items tested per day–15p, 25p or 35p per test after daily targets are hit
  • Travel pay
  • Company share ownership scheme after 12 months

  • Van, phone, fuel card, electrical testing equipment

They pride themselves on their engineers’ skills as well as always being one step ahead of the ever changing electrical regulations.They are NICEIC, CHAS, Safe Contractor and BAFE compliant and take their service very seriously to make sure their clients always come back in the future.


They are recruiting for Portable Appliance Testers (PAT), you will be:-

title: Lapsiperheiden kotipalvelytyöntekijä (4)
description:
Haemme neljää (4) lapsiperheiden kotipalvelutyöntekijää Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialueelle - työt alkavat heti tai sopimuksen mukaan, hae pian!

Kotipalvelutyöntekijöiden tehtävät sijoittuvat:

- Kuopion alue: kolme (3) sijaisuutta 31.12.2026 asti

- Iisalmen alue: yksi sijaisuus 28.2.2027 asti

Lapsiperheiden kotipalvelussa pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten ja perheiden arjen tukena. Työssä yhdistyvät itsenäinen työskentely perheissä, tavoitteellinen asiakastyö sekä yhteistyö oman tiimin ja perheiden muun verkoston kanssa. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja kutsumme sopivia hakijoita haastatteluun joustavasti haun edetessä!

Keitä olemme ja millaiseen tehtävään etsimme sinua?

Yksikkömme on osa perheiden sosiaalityön ja -ohjauksen toimintayksikköä. Lapsiperheiden kotipalvelu on tarkoitettu Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialueella asuville lapsiperheille. Palvelua myönnetään perheille, joissa on alle 18-vuotias lapsi, ja työskentelyn painopisteenä ovat alle kouluikäisten lasten perheet.

Asiakasprosessit suunnitellaan yhdessä asiakasperheen, sosiaalityöntekijän ja tarvittaessa perheen muun verkoston kanssa. Lapsiperheiden kotipalvelutyö on tavoitteellista ja suunnitelmallista työtä, jolla tuetaan perheen arkea ja vahvistetaan perheen hyvinvointia.

Työskentelymme perheissä sijoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin klo 7–18 välille. Joustamme kuitenkin tarvittaessa ja työskentelemme myös klo 18 jälkeen perheen yksilöllinen tuen tarve huomioiden. Työ tarjoaa näin pääsääntöisesti säännöllisen arkirytmin ja ennakoitavat työajat, mutta mahdollistaa samalla perheiden tilanteiden edellyttämän joustavuuden.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Mahdollisuuden kehittää itseäsi ja ammattitaitoasi monipuolisessa lapsiperheiden kotipalvelutyössä. Työsi tukena ovat osaava tiimi ja palveluesihenkilö.

Työhyvinvointisi tueksi tarjoamme työyhteisön ja esihenkilön tuen, säännölliset tiimit, työnohjausta ja työterveyshuollon palvelut.

Olisitko sinä uusi kotipalvelutyöntekijämme?

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on sosiaali- ja terveysalan perustutkinto tai muu vastaava aikaisempi tutkinto (laki sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä 2005/817, 3 §; laki terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä 1994/559, 2 §) sekä rekisteröityminen Lupa- ja valvontaviraston ylläpitämään sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilörekisteriin.

Odotamme sinulta hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ihmissuhdetaitoja sekä rohkeutta ottaa asioita avoimesti puheeksi. Tehtävässä tarvitset kykyä rakentaa toimivia yhteistyösuhteita niin perheiden kuin muiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Arvostamme kokemusta ja osaamista lasten ja lapsiperheiden kanssa tehtävästä suunnitelmallisesta ja tavoitteellisesta työstä.

Muuta huomioitavaa

- Noudatamme tartuntatautilain 48 §:n säännöksiä ja suosittelemme kaikille asiakastehtävissä työskenteleville työntekijöillemme lain mukaista rokotussuojaa.

- Ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikostaustaote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

- Tehtävässä noudatetaan koeaikaa, joka on enintään puolet sijaisuuden kestosta.

- Asiakasperheemme asuvat Kuopion seudulla ja Ylä-Savossa. Liikkuminen on arkeamme ja tämän vuoksi ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.

Lisätietoja antaa: palveluesihenkilö Marja Granlund, p. 040 559 1612, marja.granlund@pshyvinvointialue.fi

Tule mukaan tekemään merkityksellistä työtä pohjoissavolaisten lasten ja perheiden hyväksi. Yhtä joukkuetta, Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialue!


Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialue

Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialue vastaa alueensa sosiaali-, terveys- ja pelastustoimen palveluista. Kuopion yliopistollinen sairaala tarjoaa erikoissairaanhoitoa ja vastaa noin miljoonan ihmisen vaativasta hoidosta itäisessä suomessa. Meillä yli 12 000 ammattilaista tekee työtä vastuullisesti yhteisen tavoitteen eteen – Pohjois-Savon ja sen ihmisten hyväksi.

Teemme työtä yhdessä, yhtenä joukkueena arvojemme mukaan
Ihminen - Tärkein
Vastuullisesti - Totta kai
Yhteistyöllä - Aina

Hyveemme – arkijärkisyys, avuliaisuus, huumorintajuisuus, joukkuehenkisyys, joustavuus, keskustelevuus, luotettavuus, oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja ystävällisyys – ohjaavat meitä rakentamaan Pohjois-Savoon parasta mahdollista hyvinvointia, joka näkyy arjen teoissa.

Sähköposti: rekry@pshyvinvointialue.fi

title: SOCIAL WORK/COUNSELOR IV-CoT-CMHHIP
description:
Department Information




This recruitment is only open to current Colorado Residents Only
This posting may be used to fill multiple vacancies.


Colorado Mental Health Hospital in Pueblo (CMHHIP)
Social Work/ Counselor IV

As a cornerstone of the Pueblo community for over a century, Colorado Mental Health Hospital in Pueblo (CMHHIP) is a leading employer, provider of quality mental health services, and a community partner. CMHHIP is a 24 hour behavioral health acute care facility that is intended to provide a safe, secure, and therapeutic setting for patients with both psychiatric and medical issues. The services provided include evaluation and treatment for patients who are severely mentally ill, and the goal of this facility is to return patients to their optimal level of functioning and assist them in returning to the community as appropriate.

The purpose of the Continuity of Treatment (CoT) Department at the Colorado Mental Health Hospital in Pueblo (CMHHIP) is to enhance, support, and maintain therapeutic integrity and active treatment programming across all inpatient units. The department delivers evidence-based clinical treatment, psychotherapy, rehabilitative programming, and specialized substance use disorder (SUD) assessment, evaluation, and education.

To facilitate patient stabilization, behavioral rehabilitation, and discharge readiness, CoT strategically manages hospital-wide clinical staff deployment, scheduling, and backfilling to minimize therapeutic group and activity cancellations. Additionally, the department develops and maintains high-volume deployment tracking systems, analyzing call-off data, backfill trends, and group compliance to ensure strict adherence to federal Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and Joint Commission "Active Treatment" standards. The target patient population includes forensic and civil individuals with severe and persistent mental illness, cognitive impairments, and complex legal statuses (e.g., incompetent-to-proceed, not guilty by reason of insanity, and civil commitments).

Description of Job

You are required to work at your assigned work location during your scheduled work times.

Full-Time, 100% In-Person Position

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8 am - 5 pm

Work Location: 1600 W. 24th Street, Pueblo, CO 81003

Please note: Work arrangements are subject to change at any time.


About the Position:

This position serves as the Clinical Supervisor and programmatic authority for the CoT unit. It provides full supervision and performance management to a multidisciplinary team. The position is responsible for the oversight of clinical liaison processes, ensuring that all clinical recommendations and interdepartmental communications provided by CoT staff to Unit Treatment Teams meet professional standards. While maintaining a caseload of high-acuity psychotherapy groups for modeling, the primary focus is personnel management, quality assurance, and clinical system oversight.


Clinical Supervision and Personnel Management

  • Functions as the formal supervisor

  • Responsible for the full cycle of supervision, including hiring, performance planning, and administering corrective/disciplinary actions

  • Determines staff competencies and authorizes specific unit assignments based on an assessment of staff expertise and current hospital-wide patient acuity

  • Responsible for ensuring assigned subordinates provide high-quality groups/activities within their scope of practice to the CMHHIP patients

  • Collaborates with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., social workers, recreational and physical therapists, administrative assistants and nursing) to obtain feedback on subordinate job performance and responsibilities

Programmatic Quality Assurance and Auditing

  • Conducts systematic, data-driven audits of the work unit’s clinical output to ensure compliance with Joint Commission, CMS, and hospital standards

  • Conducts Chart Audits, In-Person Schedule Audits, and In-Person Group Audits

  • Analyzes data to identify systemic trends and develops formal "Plans of Action to Prevent Recurrence" (PAPR) to report to the Hospital Quality Council


Group Facilitation and Clinical Modeling

  • Serves as the primary facilitator for a focused caseload of individual and group therapy sessions

  • Facilitates high-acuity groups that require a superior level of clinical expertise and licensure, serving as a model for subordinate staff in the application of evidence-based theories and trauma-informed interventions

  • Will transport patients to and from groups, both on and off campus, at times utilizing a state vehicle


Liaison Oversight and Clinical System Consultation

  • Provides oversight and validation of the liaison duties performed by subordinate Social Worker/Counselor IIIs

  • Serves as the clinical authority and mediator for the relationships between the CoT unit and the Unit Treatment Teams

  • Validates clinical recommendations made to units, resolves high-level interdepartmental conflicts, and ensures that CoT staff are integrated effectively into the hospital's multidisciplinary treatment structure

Professional and Other Duties as Assigned

  • Participates in orientation, educational workshops, discipline meetings, and training to assure and maintain competency in the provision of their license and treatment services

  • Provides consultation and training regarding clinical issues on a functional basis with clinical staff and discipline members

  • Participates in clinical and administrative supervision to enhance, ensure, and confirm skills, knowledge, competency, and understanding of assigned cases and team, discipline, and hospital processes

  • Participates in various hospital projects or committees to enhance project success by providing expert insight and knowledge of specialized topics

  • Responsible for the performance of assigned tasks and duties within the scope of practice for this position that do not fall within the realm of duty statements above

Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights

Minimum Qualifications:

Current, valid Colorado Licensure as a:

  • Licensed Social Worker (LSW) OR
  • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) OR
  • Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) OR
  • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
  • Licensed Addiction Counselor (LAC)

And two (2) years of licensed experience based on the work assigned to the position.

Applicants for supervisory positions must have licensure that meets the legal requirements to perform supervisory responsibilities.


Preferred Qualifications:
  • Two plus (2+) years of facilitating psychotherapy/psychoeducation groups
  • Two plus (2+) years of working in a locked or high-acuity unit
  • Two plus (2+) years working with a forensic population
  • Two plus (2+) years of documented supervisory experience

Conditions of Employment:

  • Full background check and reference check required

  • This position requires State of Colorado residency at the time of application (unless otherwise identified in the posting), and residency within the state throughout the duration of employment in this position

  • Motor Vehicle Check , if the employee will drive a state-owned vehicle, either in an on-going capacity while performing their normal day-to-day job duties OR on occasion for training/meetings/client visits/etc

  • Must possess a valid, non-restricted Colorado Driver’s License or an non-restricted U.S. Driver's License for positions within 30 miles of the CO state border

  • Out-of-State Driver’s License holders must obtain a valid, non-restricted Colorado Driver’s License within 30 days of employment start date

  • Other Conditions of Employment specific to Program

  • Former State employees who were disciplinarily terminated or resigned in lieu of termination must:

  1. Disclose that information on the application.

  2. Explain why the prior termination or resignation should not disqualify you from the current position.

  3. Provide your employee number from your prior State employment. Absent extraordinary circumstances, prior disciplinary termination or resignation in lieu of termination and failure to provide this information will disqualify the applicant from future State employment with CDHS.

  • Shall not initiate or engage in sexual, social, personal or financial relationships with patients either during or any time after hospitalization, even if the patient requests or initiates such a relationship. All relationships with current or former patients must be disclosed on your application

  • Successfully pass all modules of the CMHIP New Employee Orientation core curriculum to include English reading comprehension, relevant competency assessments and written/practical exams in Defensive Tactics
  • Possess the physical ability to successfully complete hospital-adopted physical interventions (MANDT) and CPR
  • Lift arms above head and kick as high as own waist
  • Stabilize another person to accomplish a controlled containment to the floor
  • Withstand impact on own body using an ASP shield
  • Rotate body 90 degrees with feet planted for using a defensive tactic
  • Kneel on one or both knees and stand up again with multiple repetitions
  • Must be able to see and hear in order to observe, address and respond to potential breaches in safety
  • Seize, hold, control or subdue violent or assaultive persons and defend oneself or others to prevent injury
  • Demonstrate body agility, strength of all four limbs and the ability to walk and climb stairs consistently
  • Work in situations involving assaultive behavior, physical control of another person and/or restraint situations
  • Ability to read and comprehend the English language; effectively and fluently communicates in English, both verbally and in writing
  • Work in an environment with fluctuating noise and temperature (hot and cold) which may include working outdoors in inclement weather and/or concrete floor/wall work settings
  • Willing and able to travel
  • May be required to work evening or weekend shifts, holidays, voluntary or mandatory overtime in on patient units throughout CMHHIP
  • 2-step TB (tuberculosis) screening
  • Influenza vaccination
  • Other vaccinations as required by the State of Colorado

CDHS Selection Process Explanation

Employment history is calculated on a full-time basis (40/hrs per week). Part-time employment is calculated on a prorated basis to determine qualifications. Be sure your application specifically addresses your qualifications, experience, work products, and accomplishments as they relate to the position and minimum requirements.

  • Preferred Qualifications & Competencies:

    • Relevant years of state service experience.

Minimum Qualification Screening Process

A Human Resources Analyst will review the work experience/job duties sections of the online job application to determine whether your experience meets the minimum qualifications for the position. You must complete the official State of Colorado online application. Cover letters and resumes WILL NOT be reviewed during the minimum qualifications screening process. You must specifically document your work experience and qualifications in the application form. Do not use "see resume" or "see attached."


You must meet the minimum qualifications to continue in the selection process. Part-time work experience will be prorated.


Comparative Analysis Process – Structured Application Review

After minimum qualification screening, the comparative analysis process will involve reviewing and rating of all the information you submit. The comparative analysis step may also include your results from standardized testing.


Your Work Experience/Job Duties

Document your work experience/job duties to the extent to which you possess the skills, education, experience, minimum qualifications, and preferred qualifications.

If listed, answer all supplemental questions as your answers to these questions will be evaluated during this phase. Provide at least 4-8 sentences for each supplemental question.


Supplemental Questions

Answer the supplemental questions completely and thoughtfully. We will rate your answers based on the content of your response and your writing skills (spelling, grammar, and clarity of your writing).


Appeal Rights

You may file an appeal with the State Personnel Board or request a review by the State Personnel Director if your application is eliminated. You will find the appeals process, the official appeal form, and how to deliver it on the State Personnel Board website.


  • You or your representative must sign and submit the official appeal form for review.

  • You can find the official appeal form here.

  • You must be deliver the official appeal form to the State Personnel Board:

    • By email (dpa_state.personnelboard@state.co.us), or

    • Postmarked in US Mail to(1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver CO 80203, or

    • Hand delivered (1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver CO 80203), or

    • Faxed (303.866.5038) within ten (10) calendar days from your receipt of notice or acknowledgement of the department’s action.


Contact the State Personnel Board for assistance:

  • At (303) 866-3300, or

  • Refer to the Colorado Code of Regulations (CCR) 801-1, State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, Chapter 8, Resolution of Appeals and Disputes, within the Rules webpage.

title: Rebar Worker
description:
INTECH Process Automation is looking for an experienced Rebar Worker to join our Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team. The successful candidate will be responsible for cutting, bending, assembling, and fixing steel reinforcement for foundations, equipment bases, supports, and other civil structures. Ensure reinforcement is installed in accordance with approved drawings, bar schedules, specified spacing, cover, and quality requirements.

﻿Key Responsibilities:

  • Cut, bend, place, and fix reinforcing steel bars according to approved drawings and bar bending schedules.
  • Prepare reinforcement cages and assemblies for foundations, equipment bases, plinths, trenches, and supports.
  • Verify bar sizes, quantities, spacing, lap lengths, bends, and positioning against approved drawings.
  • Maintain specified concrete cover using approved spacers, chairs, and supports.
  • Tie reinforcement securely using approved binding wire and appropriate tools.
  • Install reinforcement while maintaining required alignment, dimensions, levels, and clearances.
  • Support installation of reinforcement around embedded items, anchor bolts, sleeves, and openings.
  • Check reinforcement condition and report damaged, corroded, incorrectly sized, or nonconforming bars.
  • Assist with reinforcement inspections and rectify identified defects before concrete placement.
  • Coordinate with Civil Supervisors, Concrete Workers, Carpenters, Masons, and other trades.
  • Handle, store, and stack reinforcement safely to prevent damage, contamination, and obstruction.
  • Maintain reinforcement tools and equipment in safe and serviceable condition.
  • Follow approved drawings, method statements, inspection requirements, and supervisor instructions.
  • Maintain good housekeeping and keep reinforcement work areas clear of scrap and binding-wire waste.
  • Comply with PTW, HSE, PPE, manual-handling, lifting, and Company requirements.

Requirements

To Be Successful in This Role, You Must Have:

  • Helper/Laborer

title: Electronics Test Engineer
description:
MERITUS are recruiting for a Electronics Test Engineer to join our client on an initial 12 month contract from their major site in Bolton. PLEASE NOTE: You must be able to evidence a HNC or HND in order to apply for this role.

ELECTRONICS TEST ENGINEER - INSIDE IR35 - £34 / £37 PER HOUR - SC CLEARED (OR WILLING TO UNDERGO) - SC ELIGIBLE - 12 MONTHS - BOLTON - SECTOR: DEFENCE

Hours: 37 Hours

As a Production Test Engineer - Electronics, you will play a vital role in supporting testing and diagnostics of electrical/electronic sub-systems and circuit cards during the production phase of the product lifecycle. You will use your experience to provide technical support to the manufacturing test capability, to ensure programme targets are met to agreed time, cost and quality requirements.


Responsibilities:

You will be working with a small team of dedicated engineers in a fast-paced but friendly and inclusive manufacturing environment, carrying out the following:

  • Providing test engineering support to operators on the shopfloor, including supporting the introduction of new test equipment.
  • Testing and diagnosing complex electrical/electronic systems, sub-assemblies and circuit cards down to component level.
  • Generating test specifications, operator instructions and technical reports - based on higher-level requirements and information.
  • Promptly identifying remedial and corrective actions to allow Manufacturing to continue in line with the programme, following production test failures.
  • Supporting meetings with Quality and Operations to provide status updates on Test Engineering actions and investigations.


Skillset/experience required:

Essential:

  • Minimum HNC level of Engineering qualifications or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of digital and analogue electronic measurement and test principles, and fault diagnosis techniques, with demonstrable experience down to component level.
  • Awareness of electrical/electronic sub-system and system design, integration and test principles.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills, including generation of test specifications, operator instructions and technical reports.
  • Ability to plan and organise one's work according to assigned priorities.

Advantageous:

  • Knowledge of RF and Microwave technology at the subsystem level.
  • Experience in operating manual and automated test equipment in an Electronics Manufacturing environment.

title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

  • Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

  • Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

  • Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

  • Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

  • Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

  • Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

  • You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

  • Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

  • You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

  • You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

  • Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

  • Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

  • Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

  • Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

  • Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

  • Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

* Metalli- tai konealan koulutusta
* Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen tuotantolaitoksista
* Valmius tehtävän edellyttämään laajaan työhöntulotarkastukseen

* Kokemusta komponenttien asennuksesta
* Teknisen alan koulutus

* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa
* Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä edellytykset, että onnistut työtehtävässä
* Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
* Työtehtävän mukaiset hyvät työvaatteet ja muut tarvittavat varusteet
* Luotettavan ja rehdin työnantajan, sekä vakavaraisen asiakasyrityksen
* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisesti eri kohteissa ja eri tehtävissä

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.


Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead assigned programs through all APQP phases, from RFQ and program award through prototype, validation, PPAP, launch and run-at-rate, ensuring each gate's deliverables are met.
  • Serve as the primary customer interface for program status, timing, engineering changes, quality concerns and commercial issues.
  • Develop and maintain the master program timing plan; track milestones, identify risks early and drive recovery plans when programs fall behind.
  • Lead regular cross-functional program team meetings and hold team members accountable for open actions and deliverables.
  • Manage program budgets, including capital, tooling, prototype and engineering spend; track actuals against plan and report variances.
  • Support new business quoting with Sales and Estimating, including RFQ responses, cost inputs, timing proposals and business case reviews.
  • Manage the engineering change process: evaluate cost, timing and quality impacts, obtain customer approvals and secure commercial recovery where applicable.

Preferred

Travel is needed based on project and product development demands, including technical exchanges, on-site work at customer sites, regional technical centers, supplier facilities and including occasional international travel.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen avustajan sijaisuus / Teeriniemen päiväkoti
description:
Varhaiskasvatuksen avustajan tehtävä on osa-aikainen 25 h/ viikko ja sijoittuu 5-vuotiaiden ryhmään. Työ saattaa jatkua kevätkaudella.

Teeriniemen päiväkodissa toimii kahdeksan lapsiryhmää tarjoten varhaiskasvatusta 0-5 -vuotiaille ja esiopetusta 6-vuotiaille lapsille. Päiväkodissa on uudet ja modernit toimitilat, jotka mahdollistavat pienryhmätoiminnan ja monipuolisen pedagogiikan toteuttamisen.

Varhaiskasvatuksen avustajan tehtäviin sisältyy lapsen päivittäisten toimien tukeminen kaikissa arjen tilanteissa.

Voit olla alalla jo työskennellyt, alan opintoja suunnitteleva tai muutoin sopiva työskentelemään päiväkodissa. Kiinnostuneisuus ja mahdollinen kokemus lapselle annettavan tuen toteuttamismuodoista katsotaan eduksi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva alan koulutus tai opintoja, esimerkiksi varhaiskasvatuksen ammattitutkinto tai kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perustutkinto, tai alan työkokemus.

Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä suomen kielen taito.

Edellytämme halua ja kiinnostusta lasten parissa työskentelyyn. Lapsen tukeminen arjessa mahdollistaa lapsen tasavertaisen osallistumisen ryhmän toimintaan, yhdessä tiimin opettajan ja lastenhoitajan kanssa.

Arvostamme joustavuutta ja vuorovaikutustaitoa, kykyä kohdata jokainen lapsi yksilönä.

Tarjoamme mukavan ja välittävän työtiimin sekä mahdollisuuden käyttää omia vahvuuksia työssä.

Lisäksi tarjoamme etuja kaupungin palveluihin, työsuhdepyöräedun sekä e-passin liikunta-, kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaedun.

Palkka tässä tehtävässä on 2233,58 € / kk.
Palkka määräytyy KVTES:n tasopalkkajärjestelmän mukaisesti.

Koeaika on yksi kuukausi.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työn alkamista esitettävä lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Tartuntatautilaki (55 §) velvoittaa alle kouluikäisten kanssa työskentelevien tuberkuloositartuntariskin selvittämisen. Tuberkuloosikyselynä käytetään Työterveyslaitoksen laatimaa kyselyä ja tulkintaohjetta.

Haastattelut pidetään viikolla 43.
Haastatteluun kutsutut ottavat mukaansa alkuperäiset tutkinto- ja työtodistukset.

title: Engineer - Instrumentation
description:
Responsibilities :

  • Review and verify the thermal design of the boiler to assure all process guarantees are incorporated in the design cases for specifying instrumentation.
  • Determine from the process conditions supplied by the Mechanical Engineer the designing cases (min/max flows, design temperature, etc.) for the instrumentation.
  • Prepare bills of material, instrument specifications, and cost estimates for instrumentation and trim, to support the sales and applications group. Verify that selected components and designs meet with all code requirements (ASME/ANSI, NEC, UL, ISA, NFPA, etc.)
  • Review project documents: Technical proposal, SOR, and customer specifications.
  • Interface with internal and external customers for project review and technical assistance.
  • Provide technical support for field personnel for trim, and instrument, related issues.
  • Create the Instrument Bill of Materials for the job Review vendor drawings for trim, instruments, and related auxiliary equipment.
  • Create the specification sheets for the Instrument Bill of Material items that require detailed descriptions and process conditions (control valves, desuperheaters, flow elements, etc.)
  • Work with Trim Specialist to incorporate the Instrument Bill of Materials into the PID.
  • Check/Verify the Engineering Piping Specification Line List created by the Trim Specialist. Verify all design pressures/temperatures. Check the PID to ensure the line list is correctly referred to on the PID.
  • Check the PID, Trim Bill of Material, and drum trim drawings created by the Trim Specialist meet all job and code requirements.
  • Check/Verify the drum trim drawings created by the Trim Specialist are correct to drum instrumentation specified.
  • Create the Trim Nameplate Code Stamp sheet from the Mechanical Engineer’s performance runs. Specify relief valve capacities/setpoints and complete specification sheets.
  • Verify the customer supplied pump curves meet all design requirements of the boiler. Work with the mechanical engineer to ensure all Deltak supplied pumps meet process requirements. Use the pump curves to develop design process conditions for affected instrumentation.
  • Assist in the development of new standards that can be used in the trim and instrument group.
  • Assist in the training and development of the Trim specialist in the trim and instrument group.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or equivalent combination of experience and education at discretion of Management
  • Technical experience in Heat Transfer, Fluid flow, or related area.
  • Understanding of ASME code – Section I and Section VIII/Division I, preferred.
  • Good communication and organizational skills.
  • Conduct self in professional manner and applies active communication skills.
  • Provide fast, accurate and complete customer service at all times with all employees and management; build strong customer relationships.
  • Reason and apply principles of logic to a wide range of practical problems utilizing techniques to systematically break down multi-dimensional problems or processes.
  • Apply strong attention to detail and organizational skills to meet simultaneous project deadlines; ability to maintain accurate and easily accessible records.
  • Exercise strong problem-solving skills and apply appropriate resolutions.
  • Handle sensitive information in a confidential manner.
  • Identify opportunities for continual process improvements in performing essential job functions and meeting realistic business requirements.
  • Minimal travel required, may be either domestic or international.

Salary:

$80,000 - $115,000

title: Salaojamyyjäksi Varsinais-Suomeen
description:

Mitä salaojamyyjän työ pitää sisällään?

Salaojamyyjänä toimit asiakkaidemme kanssa heidän kodeissaan ja autat heitä löytämään oikean ratkaisun salaojien ja kiinteistön kosteudenhallinnan tarpeisiin.

Työssäsi pääset:

* tapaamaan asiakkaita ja kartoittamaan heidän tarpeitaan

* tekemään kohdekartoituksia ja suunnittelemaan asiakkaalle sopivia ratkaisuja

* tekemään tarjouksia ja viemään myyntiprosesseja itsenäisesti eteenpäin

* hankkimaan uusia asiakkaita eri kanavia hyödyntäen

* rakentamaan pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita

* kehittämään jatkuvasti omaa myynti- ja tuotetuntemustasi.


Millainen tekijä sopii heille?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea ennakkoluulotonta, aktiivista ja asiakaslähtöistä myyjää, jolla on halu oppia ja kehittyä.

Aikaisempi myyntikokemus on eduksi, mutta emme edellytä pitkää kokemusta juuri salaojamyynnistä. Tärkeintä on oikea asenne, halu tehdä tulosta ja kyky kohdata erilaisia asiakkaita luontevasti.

Arvostamme erityisesti:

* hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja

* tavoitteellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

* rohkeutta tarttua asiakkaisiin ja myyntitilanteisiin

* halua oppia uutta ja kehittää omaa osaamista

* kykyä toimia itsenäisesti, mutta myös osana tiimiä

title: Payload Systems Architect
description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and Geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,000 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

Are you ready to launch the next stage of your career in the new space economy? We would love to hear from you!

We’re on the hunt for a Payload Systems Architect within the Systems Engineering Team.

MDA’s international footprint in the UK creates opportunities to work with some of the most exciting space industrial players in the country. Delivering all three business area capabilities in Geointelligence, Robotics & Space Operations, and Satellite Systems, our UK team provides support to our European-based customers while specializing in the development of advanced space sensors for exploration missions as well as space-based communication technology. As our presence grows overseas, so does our need for new ambitious team players to help us advance our place in the Universe and beyond.

Role:

MDA-UK is looking for a Payload Systems Architect to work on the design, integration and test of future satellite communications systems for LEO, GEO, and Lunar environments. In this position, you will be responsible for system level analysis and definition of the payload and, where necessary, the corresponding ground segment. Using your experience and knowledge of state-of-the-art solutions you will recommend the implementation and validation of solutions that meet customer needs. You will ascertain the issues that need to be addressed the associated standards to support these use cases and engage with the standardisation bodies accordingly.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop a system and satellite payload concept of operations and architecture with particular focus on the radio frequency and physical layer aspects.
  • Generate system level requirements, specifications and interface definitions.
  • Perform system design trade-offs.
  • Analyse system level performance requirements to allocated sub-system/component requirements.
  • Develop requirements for antenna and on-board processing functions.
  • Enable technology maturation and risk reduction plans for critical system elements including ground infrastructure and satellite subsystems.
  • Support business development and proposal activities for multiple customers and partners.
  • Conduct specification trade-off negotiations with customers, partners, engineers and working groups.

Qualifications, Experience and Competencies

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in communications system engineering.
  • Proven capability in developing wireless communications systems from the physical layer processing in the digital domain down to RF and the antenna(s).
  • Experience in performance analysis of wireless communications systems.
  • Experience in simulation/modelling of wireless communication systems.
  • Understanding of digital signal processing.
  • Ability to develop and analyse E2E system requirements, perform trade studies (e.g., link budgets and capacity analysis) breaking down the complete system into the constituent parts and solutions.
  • Ability to write proposals to RFI/RFP’s, including developing presentations to describe the technical approach in a clear manner.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including a demonstrated ability to interact effectively with customers, management, and peers.

Desirable:

  • Understanding of 5G New Radio and/or NTN.
  • Experience in the space industry.
  • Experience in communications satellite design.
  • Experience of working with multiple customers/partners and building win-win themes and scenarios.
  • Background in working with government departments/agencies and groups (e.g. ESA).
  • Experience with phased array antennas and on-board processing technology.

We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are constantly looking for others to join #TeamMDA to ignite new and innovative approaches to problem-solving that push us forward to improve life on and above Earth. If you’re excited to expand our place in space and driven to inspire the next generation, we’ll take you there.

We have entered a new era of exploration and development, and MDA welcomes all who yearn to suit up and be part of it. An equal opportunity employer prizing diversity, integrity and collaboration, we are committed to growing MDA’s leadership in this next golden age.

Comments/Special Considerations:

We are required to conduct a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) screening in which we will check your:

  • Right to work: To confirm that you are entitled to take up the position as well as check your nationality and immigration status
  • Identity: Full ID check
  • Criminal records: Basic Disclosure
  • Employment history check: Confirmation of past three years of employment (minimum) history/activity
  • Reference checks

Benefits statement:

MDA provides competitive compensation and benefits packages for its employees at all locations. As a team member of MDA, you and your qualified dependents are eligible to participate in a benefit plan that ensures a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care including; private healthcare, disability income protection, life insurance, pension plan; and an employee assistance program. We also have a Hybrid work model in place, for a better work/life balance.

Equal opportunity statement:

MDA is an equal opportunity employer prizing diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity. If you require assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please feel free to notify us.

Accommodations

MDA Ltd. is proud to provide accommodation(s) during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodations, please indicate this on your application/cover letter and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

title: Kardiologian osastonylilääkäri, Kemi
description:

Lapin upea luonto, ainutlaatuiset maisemat ja mahdollisuudet urakehitykseen antavat elämään huippuhetkiä. Me annamme tilaa ja tukea, jotta sinä voit kulkea itsesi näköisen polun.

Lapin hyvinvointialue hakee osastonylilääkäriä vakituiseen virkaan kardiologian poliklinikalle Länsi-Pohjan sairaalaan Kemiin. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.

Meidän tiimi koostuu huippukollegoista ja Suomen parhaasta hoitohenkilökunnasta. Kardiologian erikoisala kuuluu sisätautien klinikkaan ja meillä on edustettuna kaikki suppeat sisätautien erikoisalat. Konsultointi ja yhteistyö on klinikassamme helppoa.

Keskeisimmät työtehtävät:
- Kardiologisen poliklinikan toiminnan johtaminen ja kehittäminen.
- Monipuolisesti kardiologisten potilaiden noninvasiiviseen polikliiniseen ja osastohoitoon osallistuminen sekä kardiologisena konsulttina toimiminen.

Virkaan tuleva voi halutessaan osallistua vapaamuotoiseen sisätautien takapäivystysrinkiin Lapin keskussairaalassa. Osa-aikaisuus ja muut erityistoiveet otetaan huomioon. Työnkuvaa saa muokata soveltuvin osin etätyöskentelyyn. Koulutuksiin osallistuminen on itsestäänselvyys ja myös toivottavaa.

Kelpoisuusehtona on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) 4 §:n mukainen laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä sekä kardiologian erikoislääkärin pätevyyttä.

Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Lääkärisopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa. Tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Henkilöstön rokotussuojan osalta noudatamme työn ja tartuntatautilain edellyttämää rokotussuojaa.
