title: Volunteer Firefighter
description:
The Strathroy-Caradoc Fire Department

Volunteer Firefighter

The Strathroy-Caradoc Fire Department is a volunteer-based service that provides a range of programs to protect the lives and properties of the inhabitants of the Municipality from the adverse effects of fires, sudden medical emergencies, or exposure to dangerous conditions created by man or nature.

The Strathroy-Caradoc Fire Department maintains a proud tradition and is a highly respected emergency service organization in the community. Should you be accepted, you will be joining a long line of individuals who have demonstrated dedication, training commitment, compassion, and integrity in the protection of life and property in our municipality. Participation as a volunteer firefighter will bring personal rewards, satisfaction and give you a tremendous sense of accomplishment knowing that your efforts are in fact making a difference.

The Strathroy-Caradoc Fire Department operates three fire stations located in Strathroy, Mount Brydges, and Melbourne. The Administration Office for the department is located in Strathroy.

Strathroy-Caradoc... Urban Opportunity, Rural Hospitality.

The Municipality of Strathroy Caradoc is currently accepting applications for volunteer firefighters at Station 1, 2 and 3.

Position Summary:

The Volunteer Firefighter will perform a number of tasks including fire protection and rescue services, fire inspection and public education within established policies and guidelines.

Goal Statement:

As a member of the Municipal team, each employee is responsible for serving the citizens of Strathroy-Caradoc by meeting the ratepayers’ needs and expectations, as articulated by Council, by striving to be the best in everything we do through attitude, training and creativity, and for representing the Municipality as a strong, integrated organization dedicated to quality, sustainable and viable services.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Accountability (Risk)

  • Respond to fire, rescue, hazardous material emergencies, and other emergencies assigned to their station.
  • Drive fire apparatus as assigned.
  • Enter burning or contaminated buildings, structures and other areas to fight fires and/or perform rescue while wearing required personal protective equipment.
  • Provide first aid to injured persons.
  • Performs salvage work at fire and emergency scenes.
  • Assist in maintaining/cleaning firefighting and rescue equipment and apparatus.
  • Attends regular training sessions to practice existing procedures and to learn and practice new fire-fighting and rescue methods.
  • Cleans and maintains areas of the fire station used by the members as scheduled.
  • Assists with the fire prevention program.
  • Other duties as assigned by the District Chief or Captain.

Financial

  • Advises the Captain and/or (Deputy) District Chief of any repairs necessary to maintain the vehicles, equipment and stations.

Supervision

  • Supervises the fire ground to ensure officers and firefighters operate in a manner consistent with established policies, procedures and accepted firefighting methods until a more senior firefighter/officer is on scene.

Policies and Procedure

  • Understands and adheres to all Standard Operating Guidelines and Policy Directives.

Contacts- Internal/External

  • Frequent contact with the public; requires appropriate tact in order to obtain co-operation and approval of action.

Availability for Training

  • The Strathroy/Caradoc Fire Department has established that a minimum of twenty (20) regularly scheduled training sessions shall be conducted in each 12 months. All personnel are obligated to maintain a minimum of 70% attendance for training during the previous 12 continuous month period.
    • Failure to be available to attend 70% of the required assigned training for any 12-month period may result in recommendation to the Fire Chief for termination of service.

Emergency Response Attendance

    • The Strathroy-Caradoc Fire Department has established that to be an effective member of a cohesive emergency response team, a minimum attendance to emergency responses shall be a 50% of the assigned Stations call volume for any 12-month period.
      • Failure to be available to respond to 50% of the assigned stations paged calls for any 12-month period may result in recommendation to the Fire Chief for termination of service.

      Qualifications:

      Education and Experience

      • Ontario Secondary School Graduation Diploma or equivalency preferred.
      • Must be able to attend a minimum 70% of training sessions and meetings.
      • Must have valid or be willing to obtain First Aid/CPR and S-AED certification.
      • Must have already acquired or complete during probational period (1 year): NFPA 1001 Levels 1 and 2.
      • Must be at least 18 years old.
      • Legally eligible to work in Canada.
      • Provide a satisfactory Criminal Record Check.
      • Must reside within the Strathroy-Caradoc response area (see Map in Recruitment Guide)
      • Must have a valid or be willing to obtain DZ driver's license.
      • A valid Ontario Driver's License, with a class G license or higher for a minimum of 2 years.
        • Applications will be rejected if the applicant has 7 or more demerit points on their license in the past 3 years.

      Complexity/Problem Solving

      • Possesses knowledge of the Strathroy-Caradoc area and types of buildings within the Municipality.
      • Ability to get along well with others in a team environment.

      Mental, Physical, and Dexterity Efforts

      • Must pass a medical examination before becoming a member of the fire department and as required but the Director of Fire and Emergency Services.
      • Must pass the physical assessment test for firefighters as set out from time to time by Strathroy-Caradoc Fire Department.
      • Physical skills, stamina and effort to climb ladders, enter into restrictive or confined spaces and conduct other activities which may require some level of physical hazard to the health and safety of the individual.
      • Carries out tasks requiring significant concentration on a variety of activities, some of which involve the assessment of a considerable number of options and occasionally require the use of complicated analytical methods.
      • Exposure to outdoor elements, unpleasant but not hazardous chemicals, use of power tools, unhygienic and related conditions.
      • Ability to perform tasks that require accurate co-ordination of fine movements, where speed is a secondary consideration.

      Application Details

      Please ensure to upload a resume or complete your online profile with previous work experience including your current role and work schedule. Upload any certificates or relevant training to your profile.

      Posting Type: Existing Vacancy

      Closing Date: October 30, 2026 @ 4:00PM

      Only applicants submitted through the Municipality's online job board by the deadline noted above will be accepted.

      We thank all applicants but only those selected for an evaluation will be contacted. Personal information is collected in accordance with the Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act and will be used only for employment purposes. The Municipality of Strathroy-Caradoc is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodations are available for all parts of recruitment process. Applicants need to make their needs know in advance.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:
Olemme vahvasti kasvava, mutta työntekijöistämme huolehtiva henkilöstöalan yritys. Missionamme on rakentaa kestävää työelämää sekä työntekijöille että työnantajille. Toimimme usealla alueella Suomessa ja pääkonttorimme sijaitsee Tampereella.

Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme:

Kunnossapitoasentajaa

Tunnet teollisen ympäristön vaatimukset ja osaat toimia turvallisesti eri olosuhteissa. Mekaaniset työt, mutta etenkin erilaiset hydrauliset järjestelmät ja niiden asennukset sekä huollot ovat tuttuja. Ymmärrät myös eri ohjausjärjestelmien päälle, etkä hätkähdä sähkömoottoreiden äärellä.

Työturvallisuus on lähellä sydäntä, samoin kuin tarkkuus ja jousto. Työtehtävät ovat osin soveltavia, etkä jäädy muuttuvien tilanteiden äärellä vaan sinulla on maalaisjärkeä ja ongelmaratkaisukykyä. Omaat terveet elämäntavat ja sinulla on mahdollisuus reissuhommiin, joilla välillä saatetaan olla useampi päivä kerrallaan. description:

description:
Etsimme hyvinvointialan ammattilaista Fysiomekan Seppälänkankaan toimipisteelle!

Meillä on laaja ja vakiintunut asiakaskunta ja useita toimipisteitä ympäri Suomen. title: Keittiömestari, Airpro Premium Catering, Kittilä
description:
Keittiömestari, haluatko tehdä jotain muuta kuin tavallista ravintolatyötä?

Kuvittele työpäivä, jossa valmistat catering-kokonaisuuksia kansainvälisten yksityislentojen matkustajille, kehität uusia tuotteita premium-asiakkaille ja työskentelet keskellä Lapin vilkkainta matkailusesonkia. Jos laadukas ruoka, vastuullinen rooli ja ainutlaatuinen toimintaympäristö motivoivat sinua, voit olla etsimämme henkilö.

Etsimme nyt keittiömestaria Pure Catering by Airpro Premium -tiimiin Kittilän lentoasemalle.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset ottamaan vastuuta keittiön päivittäisestä toiminnasta sekä kehittämään korkeatasoisia catering-palveluita yksityisilmailun, VIP-vieraiden ja muiden premium-asiakkaiden tarpeisiin. Keittiömestarina toimit pienen, tiiviin tiimin vetäjänä.

Tässä työssä pääset

- valmistamaan laadukkaita catering-tuotteita yksityislentojen matkustajille, loungevieraille ja premium-asiakkaille
- suunnittelemaan ja koordinoimaan päivittäistä tuotantoa
- vastaamaan hankinnoista, tilauksista ja varastonhallinnasta
- vaikuttamaan tuotteisiin, toimintatapoihin ja palvelukonseptien kehittämiseen
- hyödyntämään osaamistasi kustannuslaskennassa ja toiminnan kehittämisessä
- työskentelemään yhteistyöverkoston kanssa lentoasemaympäristössä
- rakentamaan asiakkaille elämyksiä, joissa yksityiskohdilla on merkitystä.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Toivomme, että sinulla on jonkin verran jo kokemusta ammattikeittiöstä sekä aito halu ottaa vastuuta ja kehittää toimintaa. Tärkeää on, että haluat kehittyä, tarttua asioihin oma-aloitteisesti ja viedä toimintaa eteenpäin yhdessä tiimin kanssa.

Odotamme sinulta:

- soveltuvaa alan koulutusta tai vahvaa käytännön osaamista
- kokemusta ravintola-, catering- tai ammattikeittiöympäristöstä
- hygieniapassia
- hyvää englannin kielen taitoa, suomen kielen taito eduksi
- kustannustietoista ja järjestelmällistä työotetta
- erinomaisia yhteistyötaitoja
- joustavuutta vaihteleviin tilanteisiin
- B-ajokorttia, oman auton käyttömahdollisuus majoituksen sijainnin vuoksi.
Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen catering-toiminnasta, tapahtumista, premium-palveluista tai kansainvälisestä asiakastyöstä.

Miksi tähän tehtävään kannattaa hakea?

Tämä ei ole tavallinen keittiömestarin tehtävä.

Saat mahdollisuuden työskennellä ympäristössä, jossa asiakkaat saapuvat ympäri maailmaa, tilaukset vaihtelevat päivästä toiseen ja oma kädenjälkesi näkyy aidosti toiminnan kehityksessä. Pääset mukaan kasvavaan liiketoimintaan, jossa laatua arvostetaan ja uusia ideoita kuunnellaan.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- kilpailukykyisen palkan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan
- majoituksen tarvittaessa
- kattavan perehdytyksen lentoasemaympäristöön ja Pure Cateringin konseptiin
- vastuullisen ja itsenäisen roolin
- mahdollisuuden kehittää toimintaa ja jättää oma kädenjälkesi palvelukonseptiin
- ainutlaatuisen työympäristön Lapin matkailun ytimessä
- mahdollisuuden jatkaa tehtävässä myös sesongin jälkeen.

Työsuhde:

Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan loka-marraskuussa 2026 ja jatkuu alustavasti maalis-huhtikuuhun 2027 saakka. Työ on pääosin päivätyötä, mutta tehtävässä tarvitaan joustavuutta asiakkaiden tilausten ja toiminnan tarpeiden mukaan. Tavoitteena on löytää pitkäaikainen tekijä, joten tehtävässä on mahdollisuus jatkoon sesongin päättymisen jälkeen.

Valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan asiakasyrityksen palvelukseen. Haku toteutetaan yhteistyössä Baronan kanssa.

Työskentely lentoasema-alueella edellyttää hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä, kulkuoikeuksien saamista sekä vaadittujen turvallisuuskoulutusten suorittamista.Lisäksi valitun henkilön tulee esittää hyväksytty huumausainetestitulos osana työhöntulotarkastusta.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä hakemuksesi Barona Careersiin. Käymme hakemuksia läpi hakuaikana ja etenemme rekrytoinnissa heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Susanna Pohjanen, puh +358 44 480 8165 /susanna.pohjanen@barona.fi

Tule mukaan rakentamaan Lapin korkeatasoisimpia catering-elämyksiä ja tekemään työpäiviä, joita ei löydy mistään muualta.

title: C++ Developer - Amsterdam / London- Global Prop Fund
description:

title: Leader In Training (Part-Time)
description:
Summary

The Leader in Training (LIT) and Floor Leader position’s primary responsibility is to fulfill our mission statement: “To create the most enjoyable shopping experience possible for our Guests.” The LIT and Floor Leader performs a variety of sales, merchandising and operational tasks assigned by store management (e.g. cashiering, merchandise display and pulls, register procedures, and routine cleaning of facilities). Works directly with the Store Manager and Leadership Team to develop sales, recruit new Teammates and provide leadership.

Compensation & Benefits:

Pay range: $17-$20/hr

The estimated range is the budgeted amount for this position. Final offers are based on various factors, including skill set, experience, location, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

For sales positions, Buckle pays a base rate plus commission on sales. The range listed is the estimated base rate plus commission for Teammates in this position.

Full-Time Teammate Benefits:

Health

Your physical well-being matters. We provide health options that empower you to take control of your care and make informed decisions for you and your family.

Medical Coverage Choose between two comprehensive plans. Preventive care is covered at 100%, and all plans include access to virtual care.

Dental and Vision Insurance Preventive and routine dental and vision care to support your everyday health.

Virtual Care 24/7 access to general, behavioral, and dermatology consultations.

Mental Health Resources Through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), teammates have access to free confidential counseling, wellness coaching, and self-care tools.

Wealth

We are committed to helping you build financial security, recognize your contributions, and invest in your future.

401(k) with Company Match Start planning for the future with traditional and Roth options. Teammates may contribute after meeting eligibility requirements. To further support Teammates, Buckle provides discretionary matching contributions to qualifying Teammates.

Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Pre-tax options for qualified medical and dependent care expenses. Buckle contributes to your HSA if enrolled in the high-deductible medical plan.

Performance Bonuses Eligible teammates may earn incentive-based bonuses in recognition of their performance.

Teammate Discount 40% off Buckle products and 25% off Buckle gift cards to support your personal style.

Peace of Mind

We recognize the importance of stability, security, and time to recharge.

Time Off Vacation time is earned on a progressive schedule based on your role and years of service, starting at 80 hours or 120 hours, depending on employment status and prorated for the first partial year. Teammates earn 40 hours of sick time per year (or more where required by law), prorated for the first partial year; up to 80 hours of sick time may be carried over from one year to another with a maximum of 80 hours of sick time per year including carryover. Teammates also receive one floating holiday and up to three days of bereavement leave. Salaried teammates receive one paid volunteer day.

Income Protection Buckle provides company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance, with options to add Teammate-paid supplemental life and disability plans (short term and long term), helping to protect your income if you are unable to work.

Leave of Absence Support Paid and unpaid time away is available for qualifying situations, with guidance from our Benefits Team to help navigate your options. Salaried teammates who meet eligibility requirements are eligible for medical leave pay, which can be used as paid parental leave for qualifying Teammates.

Supplemental Insurance Options Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage is available for added financial protection.

Additional Benefits Legal services, identity theft protection, and pet insurance are available to eligible teammates.

Part-Time Teammate Benefits

We value every teammate and offer meaningful benefits—even for those working fewer hours.

Teammate Discount 40% off Buckle products and 25% off Buckle gift cards to support your personal style.

Medical Plan Access Eligible part-time teammates may choose between two comprehensive medical plans. Preventive care is covered at 100%, and all plans include access to virtual care.

401(k) with Company Match Start planning for the future with traditional and Roth options. Teammates may contribute after meeting eligibility requirements. To further support Teammates, Buckle provides discretionary matching contributions to qualifying Teammates.

Mental Health Resources Through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), teammates have access to free confidential counseling, wellness coaching, and self-care tools.

Paid Leave in Applicable States Paid leave accrues where required by law; one hour of leave is accrued for every 30 hours worked.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
This description intends to describe the general nature and level of work performed by Teammates assigned to this job. It is not intended to include all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Sales Generation and Guest Service

  • Greet Guests with a friendly, engaging attitude, and is consistently prepared to provide legendary service to each Guest
  • Answer questions regarding the store and its merchandise
  • Recommend, select, and help locate or obtain merchandise based on Guest needs and desires
  • Anticipate and fulfill Guest’s needs by suggesting additional items and creating a wardrobing experience
  • Demonstrate product utilizing product knowledge and sales education, consistently sharing that knowledge and education with Team
  • Maintain and share knowledge of current sales and promotions, policies regarding payment and exchanges, and security practices
  • Remain consistent on personal sales, as well as looking for opportunities to impact Teammates’ presentations with the Sales Presentation Guide (SPG)
  • Achieve personal sales-per-hour, average sales and total net sales goals set by Store Management
  • Provide legendary service throughout the store in these top four areas: Front 5, sales floor, fitting rooms, and the register area
  • Knowledgeable of all exchange and return procedures for Guests and exhibit the ability to turn into a showmanship opportunity
  • Fill out and effectively use the Sales Presentation Guide (SPG) daily to accomplish goals
  • Meets or above performance standards in all Buckle business builders and guest loyalty including fit appointments, Buckle credit card and guest connect.
  • Investigate and navigate how to expand Guest selection through inventory Manager, advanced product search, iPad apps, etc.
  • Maintain and build good Guest relationships to develop a client based business
  • Lead by example with a high level of showmanship, excellent customer service and attentiveness
  • Recognize and communicate Guest Levels with the Team
  • Passion to ask business driven and showmanship questions often to Manager, Team Leaders and all Teammates
  • Coachable – allows Manager to educate them in their sales presentation
  • Consistently perform leadership actions and maintain high standards, whether or not the Manager is present

Teammate Recruiting, Training and Development

  • Consistently recognize recruiting opportunities by utilizing Jobs & Careers cards, email referrals and Teammate Recommend
  • Develop skills and assist in leading, directing, motivating and educating new Teammates to meet and achieve Buckle’s accountability, shift orientation, Loss Prevention and sales presentation standards on a daily basis
  • Maintain a positive attitude at all times creating a positive floor culture
  • Demonstrate personal dress code to encourage and coach the latest fashion in all Teammates and Team Leaders
  • Participate effectively in daily setup, training, impacting and reviewing while effectively utilizing the Performance Tracker
  • Motivate Teammates to initiate and complete daily tasks
  • Personal passion to demonstrate, coach, and influence results of denim showmanship and denim fit cards through Teammates and Guests
  • Create and develop results in your department and balance all DM actions within your segment as well as completing the mid-week check in
  • Demonstrate leadership actions during segment:
    • Awareness of Guests in the store and ensure they are being helped
    • Demonstrate how to get the Guest involved with product
    • Be vocal and continuously update fellow leader and Team
    • Responsible for getting Guest names
    • Understanding and working guys side/gals side to benefit both Teammates and Guests

Visual Merchandise Management

  • Own and influence product through zone ownership:
    • Product knowledge, placement, passion, preference
    • Weekly Checklist
    • Life cycle of product
    • Track Results
  • Be able to recognize and assign Zones and projects to Teammates daily with a specific learning goal in mind
  • Confirm Teammates are following through with Visual Standards, Visual library and Weekly Visual Checklist throughout their shift with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Ability to execute and demonstrate all new tools and videos that apply to zone ownership and take initiative in knowing and executing zone ownership questions
  • Show aptitude in recognizing merchandising opportunities from freight to floor and life cycle of product, communicating recommendations and solutions to Store Manager
  • Give informational and influential store tours
  • Ensure sales floor is consistently sized and new freight is appropriately displayed

Operations

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, which may include mornings, evenings, and weekends, and the day of/day after Thanksgiving and Christmas, based upon store and business needs
  • Understand and utilize planner including completion of Opening and Closing Checklists
  • Watch for and recognize security risks and thefts, and know how to prevent or handle these situations
  • Follow all Loss Prevention guidelines, including daily bag and purse checks
  • Ability to execute and teach all Point of Sale (“POS”) procedures
  • Appropriately handle calls from Corporate Office
  • Know Buckle guidelines when handling returns and exchanges
  • Maintain positive attitude when dealing with challenging situations that involve Guests or Teammates
  • Understand and execute all policies regarding payments, exchanges and Loss Prevention practices
  • Ability to navigate and execute all tools on the home page
  • Knowledge and ability to give guidance and feedback to all non-sales positions
  • Complete all scheduled shifts and cover shifts when needed
  • Provide feedback to Store Manager and Leadership Team regarding merchandise handling concerns
  • Communicate any policy violations and Teammate or Guest concerns to Store Manager, District Manager, and/or Human Resources in a timely, confidential manner

title: Operations & Logistics Internship MXP5 - Castel San Giovanni
description:
****This position could be based in MXP5-Castel San Giovanni. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided. Applying to the talent pool is non-binding and does not guarantee a specific start date or offer.****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.


About the team
Intern Community:
• As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
Support:
• The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
Learning Sessions:
• Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
Opportunities:
• Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.
Internship Start Dates across the year:
• We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through July 2027. Each month, we'll hold 1-2 onboarding days for new hires.

title: Inžinierius (-ė) - Technologas (-ė) | Elektronikos gamyba
description:
Ieškome Inžinieriaus (-ės) – technologo (-ės) prisijungti prie mūsų augančios komandos, dirbančios Vilniuje, Svylos g. 16, papildymui ir sustiprinimui.

Teltonikos elektronikos gamybos padaliniuose kuriami ir surenkami mūsų įrenginiai – nuo prototipų iki didelės apimties serijinės gamybos. Pasitelkdami pažangią automatizaciją ir robotiką, bet kokią sudėtingą idėją paverčiame pilnai išvystytu produktu.

Kiekvienam darbuotojui sudarome visas reikiamas sąlygas tobulinti įgūdžius, įgyti išsamių žinių apie gaminamus produktus ir visokeriopai augti profesinėje srityje.

Šioje pozicijoje Jūs:

  • Būsite atsakingas (-a) už robotinių sistemų stabilų ir efektyvų darbą.
  • Analizuosite robotinių sistemų veikimą (ciklo laiką, sustojimus, kokybės nuokrypius), inicijuosite bei diegsite atnaujinimus ir modifikacijas.
  • Analizuosite pasikartojančių robotinių sistemų gedimų priežastis ir įdiegsite prevencinius sprendimus.
  • Dalyvausite inicijuojant ir įgyvenant naujus automatizacijos ir robotizacijos projektus nuo idėjos iki paleidimo.
  • Dalyvausite priimant ir paleidžiant naują įrangą (FAT/SAT).
  • Bendrausite su esamais ir naujais robotikos bei automatizacijos įrangos tiekėjais.
  • Rengsite robotinių sistemų profilaktikos planus, instrukcijas ir kritinių atsarginių dalių sąrašą.
  • Teiksite techninę pagalbą techninės priežiūros komandai šalinant sudėtingesnius gedimus ir atliekant profilaktiką.
  • Konsultuosite ir apmokysite gamybos bei inžinerijos komandą įrangos naudojimo ir priežiūros klausimais.
  • Bendradarbiausite su kitais inžinieriais, meistrais ir gamybos darbuotojais.

Ko tikimės iš Jūsų:

  • Aukštojo arba aukštesniojo išsilavinimo mechanikos, elektros, elektronikos, automatikos ar gamybos inžinerijos srityje.
  • Patirties techninės priežiūros / įrenginių remonto / robotikos srityje (gamybinė patirtis – didelis privalumas).
  • Elektros sistemų, mechanikos ir (ar) pneumatikos pagrindų išmanymo.
  • Gebėjimo skaityti technines schemas ir dokumentaciją.
  • Analitinio mąstymo ir problemų sprendimo įgūdžių.
  • Gebėjimo planuoti laiką ir prioritetus dinamiškoje aplinkoje.
  • Komandinio darbo įgūdžių ir atsakingo požiūrio.
  • Anglų kalbos žinių (ne mažiau kaip B2), techninės anglų kalbos supratimo.
  • Kompiuterinio raštingumo (MS Office; patirtis su techninėmis sistemomis – privalumas).
  • Patirties projektų valdyme.
  • Noro mokytis ir tobulėti.

Ką siūlome:

  • Rūpinamės emocine ir fizine savijauta, suteikdami papildomą sveikatos draudimą.
  • Švenčiame pasiekimus ir linksminamės kartu per komandos formavimo renginius, vasaros festivalius ir kitas mums svarbias progas.
  • Dalyvaujantiems rekomendacijų programoje siūlome solidžias premijas.
  • Apdovanojame už ilgametį darbą kartu.
  • Džiuginame laisva diena gimtadienio proga.
  • Dovanojame dovanas Teltonikos gimtadienio proga.
  • Mėgaujamės vaisiais.

Atlyginimas:
Vertiname kiekvieno pastangas ir patirtį, tad siūlome patrauklų atlyginimą, atitinkantį Jūsų įgūdžius ir kompetenciją. Šios pozicijos darbo užmokestis yra nuo 16 Eur/val. iki 24 Eur/val. (~2688 Eur – 4032 Eur) neatskaičius mokesčių, priklausomai nuo patirties ir kompetencijos.

  • Darbo sutartyje nurodomas fiksuotas valandinis atlyginimas neatskaičius mokesčių.

title: Lumityöntekijöitä sesonkiin!
location: Kangasala, Lempäälä, Nokia, Pirkkala, Tampere, Ylöjärvi, Finland
description:
Töitä tarjolla ahkerille ja reippaan työotteen omaaville lumityöntekijöille asiakkaamme palveluksessa talvikaudella 2026.

Etsimme nyt käsilumityöntekijöitä asiakasyrityksemme palvelukseen Tampereelle ja lähialueille. Työssäsi tulet työskentelemään työparin kanssa erilaisten kohteiden mm. tehdasalueet, parkkipaikat yms, lumitöiden parissa. Lumitöitä tehdään pääasiassa lumikolaa ja -lapiota hyödyntäen.

Työ vaatii 18-vuoden ikää, hyvää fyysistä kuntoa sekä B-luokan ajokorttia kohteissa kulkemista varten. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on työllistymisen edellytys, sillä se helpottaa töissä kulkemista. Työn aloitus heti ensimmäisten lumisateiden alkaessa ja työtä on tarjolla myös viikonloppuisin. Töitä tehdään aamu-, päivä-, ilta- ja yövuorossa lumisateista riippuen.

Toivomme hakijalta aikaisempaa kokemusta kiinteistöjen lumitöistä, intoa fyysiseen työskentelyyn sekä joustavuutta. Olethan lisäksi tunnollinen ja luotettava työntekijä, joka haluaa hoitaa työtehtävänsä kunnialla.

Palkkaus kiinteistöpalvelualan TES mukaan aikaisempi osaaminen ja kokemus huomioiden.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemus aikailematta, sillä hakemusten läpikäynti aloitetaan jo hakuaikana. Odotamme kuulevamme sinusta ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa WorkPowerin HR-konsultti Katja / katja.kalviainen@workpower.fi.

Avainsanat: lumityöt, kiinteistöjen lumityöt, sesonki, kausityö, talvi 2026, avoimet työpaikat, Tampere, Pirkanmaa.

title: Clinical Scheduler
description:
SUMMARY

Reporting to the Clinical Services Coordinator, the Clinical Scheduler is responsible for facilitating effective individual and group clinical consults for community telemedicine sites. The Clinical Scheduler is the point of contact for Ontario Telemedicine Network (OTN). S/he consults with the Clinical Services Coordinator on clinical issues and works closely with OTN on scheduling matters. S/he maintains the master record of clinical telemedicine events for KO eHealth Services.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Works collaboratively with all staff and partners to ensure a high-quality telemedicine delivery.
  • Schedules and facilitates clinical consults.
  • Keeps accurate records of clinical consults.
  • Uses TSM to search for unscheduled, pending and confirmed events on a regular basis.
  • Cancels unconfirmed events within 48 hours of event.
  • Updates patient profiles and regularly monitors profiles in TSM
  • Ensures proper documentation notes in Ncompass event log.
  • Ensures requests for nursing protocols is faxed to nursing station.
  • Participates in annual performance evaluation as required.
  • Collects and processes confidential data and information according to PHIPA guidelines.
  • Participates in training and education session to staff team.
  • Reports to Clinical Services Coordinator when scheduling department is not notified of consult request.
  • Facilitates ongoing technical support to ensure videoconferencing equipment is always functional, reports technical issues to the OTN and KNET service desk.
  • Notifies Healthcare Providers by telephone and email when there is a cancellation.
  • Demonstrates commitment to staff team by participating in staff meetings and regional clinical meetings.
  • Maintains good communication links with the communities to facilitate effective telemedicine activities.
  • Participates in training and updating activities as required.
  • Undertakes special projects and research as required.
  • Assist with data collection and reconciliation regarding activity logs. S/he will provide a clerical role to KO e-Health services and support data transmission to Health Canada.
  • Collects and monitors incoming data and investigates missing data through communication with staff located in remote First Nations.
  • Other duties as assigned by the Director and Clinical Services Coordinator, eHealth.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES

  • Minimum Grade 12 or equivalent; preferably post-secondary education.
  • First Nations community-based experience is preferred; administrative experience in a health or social service field is an asset.
  • Experience working with diverse partners; familiarity with health system in the district
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communications skills, both oral and written.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and as part of a team.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced work environment and complete work on schedule
  • Proficiency in computer programs such as M/S Word, Excel, and the use of email; ability to learn communications technology and systems software quickly.
  • Knowledge and understanding of Aboriginal culture and values, and of the geographical and health care challenges of First Nations in the Sioux Lookout district.
  • Dedication to service excellence.

title: Management Trainee Program
description:
Summary

The Management Trainee position’s primary responsibility is to fulfill our mission statement, “to create the most enjoyable shopping experience possible for our Guests.” Additionally, Management Trainees perform a variety of sales, merchandising and operational tasks assigned by store management (e.g. cashiering, merchandise display and pulls, register procedures, and routine cleaning of facilities). Work directly with Store Manager to develop sales, recruiting and leadership skills in order to become a Store Manager. The Management Trainee will also share responsibility for training and motivating Teammates and act as the Store Manager in their absence.

Compensation & Benefits:

Pay range: $20-$24/hr

The estimated range is the budgeted amount for this position. Final offers are based on various factors, including skill set, experience, location, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

For sales positions, Buckle pays a base rate plus commission on sales. The range listed is the estimated base rate plus commission for Teammates in this position.

Full-Time Teammate Benefits:

Health

Dental and Vision Insurance Preventive and routine dental and vision care to support your everyday health.

Virtual Care 24/7 access to general, behavioral, and dermatology consultations.

We recognize the importance of stability, security, and time to recharge.

Time Off Vacation time is earned on a progressive schedule based on your role and years of service, starting at 80 hours or 120 hours, depending on employment status and prorated for the first partial year. Teammates earn 40 hours of sick time per year (or more where required by law), prorated for the first partial year; up to 80 hours of sick time may be carried over from one year to another with a maximum of 80 hours of sick time per year including carryover. We value every teammate and offer meaningful benefits—even for those working fewer hours.

title: Supply Chain Specialist - Projects
description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The global MDA Space team of more than 3,800 space experts has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there. For more information, visit .

MDA Space’s international footprint in the UK creates opportunities to work with some of the most exciting space industrial players in the country. Delivering all three business area capabilities in Geointelligence, Robotics & Space Operations, and Satellite Systems, our UK team provides support to our European-based customers while specializing in the development of advanced space sensors for exploration missions as well as space-based communication technology. As our presence grows overseas, so does our need for new ambitious team players to help us advance our place in the Universe and beyond.

We're on the hunt for a Supply Chain Specialist / Project Manager

Responsibilities:

The Supply Chain Project Manager is responsible for leading and managing supply chain activities across assigned programmes and projects, ensuring that third-party suppliers and subcontractors are selected, contracted and managed to deliver the required cost, quality, schedule and technical requirements.

The role will provide an integrated supply chain interface between Project Management, Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Commercial, Finance and suppliers. The post holder will ensure that supply chain activities are aligned with the overall project strategy, customer requirements and contractual obligations.

The role will cover the complete supply chain lifecycle, from bid and procurement strategy through supplier selection, contract placement, delivery, performance management and subcontract closure.

Key Responsibilities

Supply Chain Strategy & Project Planning

  • Develop and maintain project-specific supply chain and procurement strategies in conjunction with the Project/Bid Manager and relevant functional stakeholders.
  • Identify long-lead items, critical suppliers and supply chain dependencies that could affect programme delivery.
  • Ensure procurement and subcontract activities are appropriately integrated into the overall project schedule.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce cost, risk and lead time while maintaining technical and quality requirements.
  • Ensure supply chain risks are identified early and incorporated into the project risk and opportunity management process.

Bid & Business Development Support

    • Provide supply chain input during the bid and business development lifecycle.
    • Support Bid/No-Bid reviews by identifying supply chain requirements, risks and opportunities.
    • Develop supplier strategies to support competitive and deliverable bids.
    • Identify and assess potential suppliers, taking account of technical capability, commercial position, quality performance, capacity and previous performance.
    • Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and proposals.
    • Ensure supplier proposals remain valid and appropriately aligned with the proposed programme schedule.
    • Identify commercial and supply chain assumptions that need to be reflected within the bid.
    • Provide supply chain cost, resource and risk inputs into the bid cost model.
    • Support the development of teaming arrangements, NDAs, framework agreements and other pre-contractual arrangements where required.

    Supplier Selection & Due Diligence

      • Lead or coordinate supplier selection activities as part of a cross-functional project team.
      • Ensure supplier selection considers technical, commercial, quality, delivery and performance criteria.
      • Coordinate supplier due diligence and onboarding activities.
      • Ensure appropriate NDAs and contractual arrangements are in place before confidential information is released.
      • Evaluate existing supplier performance and capability when considering future opportunities.
      • Manage competitive RFP/RFQ processes in accordance with the agreed procurement strategy.
      • Ensure appropriate evaluation criteria are established and documented.
      • Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Commercial, Legal and Procurement to reach robust supplier selection decisions.

      Contract & Subcontract Management

      • Coordinate the development of the contractual baseline for assigned suppliers.
      • Ensure contractual deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria and reporting requirements are clearly defined.
      • Coordinate the resolution of supplier deviations, assumptions and areas of non-compliance.
      • Support contract negotiations with suppliers in conjunction with Commercial and Legal.
      • Ensure contractual changes are formally controlled.
      • Maintain accurate subcontract records and project documentation.

      Supplier Delivery & Performance Management

      • Take ownership of the day-to-day project management of key suppliers and subcontractors.
      • Establish effective supplier relationships based on clearly defined requirements, outcomes, KPIs and delivery expectations.
      • Establish appropriate supplier review cadence, including regular progress meetings and formal reporting.
      • Monitor supplier schedules and identify potential delays at the earliest opportunity.
      • Challenge supplier schedule slippage and ensure appropriate recovery plans are developed where required.
      • Escalate significant supplier risks and performance issues to the appropriate project and functional stakeholders.
      • Maintain visibility of supplier critical paths, long-lead items and key programme dependencies.

      Project Reporting & Governance

      • Establish and maintain effective supplier reporting and governance arrangements.
      • Coordinate weekly supplier progress reviews where required.
      • Review monthly supplier reports and ensure actions are captured and followed through.
      • Provide clear and timely reporting to Project Managers and programme stakeholders.
      • Ensure supply chain information is incorporated into overall programme reporting.

      Technical, Quality & Programme Interface

      • Work closely with Engineering and Technical Leads to ensure suppliers understand and deliver the required technical baseline.
      • Coordinate with Product Assurance / Quality to ensure supplier quality requirements are established and monitored.
      • Ensure supplier documentation requirements are clearly defined and tracked.
      • Ensure supplier deliverables are available to support project milestones and internal activities.

      Risk, Compliance & Customer Requirements

      • Proactively identify and manage supply chain risks throughout the project lifecycle.
      • Ensure customer contractual requirements are appropriately flowed down into supplier arrangements.
      • Support management of financial and non-financial supply chain risks.
      • Consider export control requirements when sourcing from suppliers outside the UK.
      • Support major programme reviews throughout the project lifecycle
      • Ensure appropriate consideration is given to controlled or classified programmes.
      • Work with Legal and Commercial teams on contractual flow-down requirements, including relevant DEFCON/DEFFORM requirements where applicable.
      • Ensure supplier arrangements remain commercially viable while recognising the particular risks and capabilities of SME suppliers.

      Delivery & Acceptance

      • Coordinate supplier delivery activities against agreed contractual milestones.
      • Ensure delivery schedules are aligned with internal project, manufacturing and AIT requirements.
      • Track supplier documentation and hardware deliverables.
      • Coordinate readiness for delivery and acceptance activities.
      • Ensure open actions are closed and required documentation is available before final acceptance.
      • Support the project team through final supplier acceptance and completion.
      • Ensure subcontract closure is formally recorded once hardware, documentation and contractual actions are complete.

      Qualifications, Experience and Competencies:

      Essential Experience

      • Proven experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Subcontract Management or Supply Chain Project Management.
      • Experience managing suppliers within complex project or programme environments.
      • Demonstrable experience managing suppliers against cost, quality, schedule and technical requirements.
      • Experience of developing and managing procurement or supply chain strategies.
      • Experience of supplier selection, RFP/RFQ processes and commercial evaluation.
      • Experience of supplier performance management and resolving delivery issues.
      • Strong project management capability, including planning, risk management, action tracking and reporting.
      • Experience working across multiple functions and managing conflicting priorities.
      • Strong commercial awareness and ability to understand the impact of supplier decisions on project cost, margin, schedule and risk.
      • Experience of working with contractual requirements and supplier terms and conditions.

      Desirable Experience

      • Experience within the aerospace, space, defence, electronics, engineering or high-technology sectors.
      • Experience managing development and qualification programmes.
      • Experience working with long-lead, technically complex or high-value products/services.
      • Knowledge of customer contractual flow-down requirements.
      • Experience working with UK Government / MOD requirements, DEFCONs and DEFFORMs.
      • Understanding of export control requirements, including ITAR considerations.
      • Experience working with SME and specialist technology suppliers.
      • Experience of supplier quality and Product Assurance requirements.

      Skills & Competencies

      Project Management

      • Strong planning and organisational skills.
      • Ability to manage multiple projects, suppliers and competing priorities.
      • Strong understanding of project schedules, milestones, dependencies and critical paths.
      • Ability to identify issues early and drive recovery actions.

      Supply Chain & Commercial

      • Strong understanding of supply chain management and supplier lifecycle management.
      • Commercially astute with the ability to balance cost, risk, quality and delivery.
      • Confident negotiating with suppliers and challenging supplier performance.
      • Ability to develop practical and commercially viable supply solutions.

      Stakeholder Management

      • Strong communication and influencing skills.
      • Ability to operate effectively with technical, commercial and senior stakeholders.
      • Comfortable working across organisational boundaries.
      • Able to establish constructive but appropriately challenging supplier relationships.

      Problem Solving

      • Structured and analytical approach to identifying and resolving supply chain problems.
      • Comfortable working with incomplete or changing information.
      • Able to assess risk and make evidence-based recommendations.
      • Persistent in driving actions through to completion.

      Personal Attributes

      The successful candidate will be:

      • Proactive and delivery focused.
      • Commercially aware.
      • Structured and organised.
      • Comfortable challenging suppliers and internal stakeholders where required.
      • Collaborative and relationship focused.
      • Resilient when dealing with complex or high-pressure programmes.
      • Able to work independently while operating effectively within a wider project team.
      • Detail conscious without losing sight of the wider programme objectives.
      • Comfortable working in a technically complex and changing environment.
      • Successful delivery and acceptance of supplier deliverables.
      • Effective closure of subcontract and supplier activities.

      We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are constantly looking for others to join #TeamMDA to ignite new and innovative approaches to problem-solving that push us forward to improve life on and above Earth. If you’re excited to expand our place in space and driven to inspire the next generation, we’ll take you there.

      We have entered a new era of exploration and development, and MDA Space welcomes all who yearn to suit up and be part of it. An equal opportunity employer prizing diversity, integrity and collaboration, we are committed to growing MDA Space’s leadership in this next golden age.

      Comments/Special Considerations:

      We are required to conduct a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) screening in which we will check your:

      • Right to work: To confirm that you are entitled to take up the position as well as check your nationality and immigration status
      • Identity: Full ID check
      • Criminal records: Basic Disclosure
      • Employment history check: Confirmation of past three years of employment (minimum) history/activity
      • Reference checks

      Benefits statement:

      MDA Space provides competitive compensation and benefits packages for its employees at all locations. As a team member of MDA, you and your qualified dependents are eligible to participate in a benefit plan that ensures a comprehensive level of protection through competitive health care including; private healthcare, disability income protection, life insurance, pension plan; and an employee assistance program. We also have a Hybrid work model in place, for a better work/life balance.

      Equal opportunity statement:

      MDA Space is an equal opportunity employer prizing diversity and inclusion. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity. If you require assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please feel free to notify us.

      Accommodations

      MDA Space is proud to provide accommodation(s) during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodations, please indicate this on your application/cover letter and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

title: Vastuumyyjä, S-market Naantali, Turun Osuuskauppa
description:
Primary location:
NAANTALI

Etsimme VASTUUMYYJÄÄ S-market Naantaliin!
Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen 37,5h/vko. Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.

Vastuumyyjänä varmistat kaupan arjen sujuvuuden ja asiakastyytyväisyyden yhdessä marketpäällikön ja apulaispäällikön kanssa. Maito-osasto toimii yhtenä keskeisenä vastuualueena, mutta lopullinen päävastuuosastosi määräytyy osaamisesi ja toimipaikan tarpeiden mukaan. Työskentelet päivittäin myös muilla osastoilla monipuolisissa työtehtävissä. Työssä huolehdit vastuualueesi tuoteryhmien saatavuudesta, tuotteiden tuoreudesta ja osaston siisteydestä. Hyödynnät tehtävässäsi raportteja ja järjestelmiä muun muassa tilauksiin sekä saldojen ja hävikin hallintaan.

Toimit arjen esimerkkinä muulle tiimille kaikissa kaupan työtehtävissä, ja varmistat työvuorolle asetettujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen sekä priorisoit ja organisoit työtehtäviä. Viestit oman vastuualueesi asioista sekä huolehdit osaltasi sujuvasta tiedonkulusta. Lisäksi perehdytät uusia työntekijöitä, jaat osaamistasi sekä autat tiimiä onnistumaan päivittäisessä työssä. Työaika sijoittuu arkisin ja viikonloppuisin klo 5.30–23.10 välille.Varmistathan, että sinulla on mahdollisuus kulkea toimipaikkaan kaikkina kaupan aukioloaikoina.

Millaista tyyppiä etsimme?

Vastuumyyjänä onnistut tehtävässä, jos olet asiakaslähtöinen, helposti lähestyttävä ja toimeen tarttuva. Haluat olla luomassa onnistuneita asiakaskokemuksia ja toimit jokaisessa asiakaskohtaamisessa esimerkkinä muulle tiimille. Sinulla on positiivinen työskentelyote sekä hyvät viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot myös muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Pystyt ohjaamaan osaston toimintaa, johtamaan työvuoroa sekä antamaan palautetta. Lisäksi sinulle sopii fyysinen vuorotyö, jossa työskentelet vaihtelevissa vuoroissa ja työtehtävissä, sekä kohtaat satoja ihmisiä päivässä. Vastuumyyjältä edellytämme aikaisempaa työkokemusta myyjän tehtävistä, ja eduksi katsomme kokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.

Vastuumyyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen palkkaluokkaan B sekä tehtäväkohtaiseen vaativamman työn lisään. Tuntipalkka on koulutuksesta ja kokemusvuosista riippuen 2 214,00 €–2 517,48 €/h. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:

Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa

Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet

Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 18.10. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞 Lisätietoja antaa marketpäällikkö Sari Niemi. Sarin tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 9–15 numerosta 010 7644844.

Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600 ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

title: Software Development Engineer Intern
description:
Pactorize is an early-stage technology company building the capability layer for the AI era — helping people and organizations turn knowledge into learning, action, and measurable capability.

We are a small, engineering-driven team where interns work on real products and challenging engineering problems, rather than isolated academic projects. This is an opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers and gain hands-on experience building production-oriented AI software.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer Intern who is curious about AI, enjoys building software, and wants to learn how modern intelligent applications are designed and engineered.

You will contribute to real product development across areas such as:

  • AI/LLM-powered applications
  • Backend services, APIs, and databases
  • Data and knowledge processing
  • AI agents and intelligent workflows
  • Evaluation and reliability of AI systems
  • Cloud-based application development
  • Testing, debugging, and improving production software

The exact projects and responsibilities will evolve as the company and products grow.

What We Look For

  • Strong programming fundamentals and problem-solving ability
  • Good understanding of data structures and algorithms
  • Familiarity with web development, APIs, databases, or software engineering projects
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies
  • Ability to learn independently and work in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong ownership, curiosity, and attention to engineering quality
  • Good communication and willingness to ask questions and learn

Prior experience with LLMs, AI applications, cloud platforms, Git, React, Node.js, Python, or PostgreSQL is a plus, but not required.

Internship Structure — Graduates

The internship is for 6 months. Candidates who have completed their studies are expected to work 40 hours per week throughout the internship.

Internship Structure — Current Students

Phase 1 — Part-Time: 15–20 hours/week

Flexible scheduling designed to accommodate college classes, assignments, and examinations.

Phase 2 — Full-Time: 40 hours/week

Transition to a full-time internship schedule, with reasonable consideration for the candidate's final-semester academic and project requirements, where applicable.

Stipend

A stipend will be provided throughout the internship and will be based on the applicable part-time or full-time engagement.

Opportunity for Full-Time Employment

The internship is designed to provide an opportunity to grow with Pactorize. Depending on business needs and available full-time positions, interns who demonstrate strong performance, ownership, and a good fit with the team would be considered for a full-time role upon completion of the internship.

Why Join Pactorize?

  • Work directly with a small, experienced engineering team
  • Build real AI-powered products, not just prototypes or academic exercises
  • Gain hands-on experience across modern software and AI technologies
  • Take meaningful ownership early in your career
  • Learn how products are designed and built in an early-stage technology company
  • Opportunity for full-time conversion based on performance

If you enjoy building, learning quickly, and want to be part of the next generation of AI software, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Laboratory Supervisor
description:
The International Institute of Tropical Agriculture seeks suitable Nigeria nationals for the position below at the Institute’s Headquarters in Ibadan.

Position: Laboratory Supervisor

Contract: 6-month renewable contract

Location: Ibadan

Closing Date: 15 October 2026

DUTIES

· Perform nematode extraction using the specified methodology

· Identify different nematode species in samples for laboratory analysis and diagnostic testing

· Establish and maintain IITA mandate crops in the screen house and field for nematode activities

· Culture nematodes on carrots and plants

· Identify plant, root and tuber nematode symptoms

· Regulate nematode population, water, monitor, and maintain the screen house, micro plots and field plants to ensure optimal growth and health throughout the diagnosis period

· Handling of various microscopes for nematode identification

· Collecting, recording, organizing, cleaning, validating, and securely storing laboratory and field research data

· Analyzing data using statistical analysis

· Ensuring proper labelling, tracking, storage, cleanliness, safety, and organization of laboratory samples, workspaces, and equipment

· Perform any other duty as may be assigned by the unit manager/scientist.

Requirements

QUALIFICATION

BSc/HND in Agriculture, Biological Sciences, Plant Science, Crop Science, or a related field, with relevant practical experience in field and laboratory activities.

COMPETENCIES

The ideal candidate must have:

· Ability to identify nematodes, handling of microscope, maintain laboratory equipment, and follow standard operating procedures.

· Experience in research, survey implementation, monitoring and evaluation.

· Experience in agricultural or research-related projects and knowledge of data collection processes.

· Good interpersonal and communication skills.

Benefits

REMUNERATION:

We offer highly competitive salary with equally attractive benefits and excellent working conditions in a pleasant campus environment.

METHOD OF APPLICATION:

Interested applicants should complete the online application by attaching a detailed cover letter and curriculum vitae saved with their names in Microsoft Word format to the IITA website: no later than One Week from the date of this publication.

IITA is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse workforce, particularly welcoming applications from women. While all applications will be acknowledged, please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Lehtori: äidinkieli ja kirjallisuus, Jätkäsaaren peruskoulu
description:
Haemme äidinkielen ja kirjallisuuden lehtoria Jätkäsaaren peruskouluun ajalle 16.11.2026 - 5.6.2027. Tehtävän opetustunnit sijoittuvat luokille 7.-9.

Jätkäsaaren peruskoulu on vuosiluokkien 1-9 yhtenäinen peruskoulu eteläisessä Helsingissä.
Koulussa on lukuvuonna 2026-2027 noin 860 oppilasta kahdessa toimipisteessä. Toimimme joustavissa ja toimivissa oppimisen tiloissa. Arvojamme ovat yhteisöllisyys ja inklusiivisuus.

Toteutamme ilmiökokonaisuuksia osana pedagogiikkaa ja yhteinen oppiminen ja osallisuus ovat meille tärkeitä. Työyhteisön vavhuutena on samat arvot: yhdessä tekeminen ja ratkaisujen löytäminen erilaisiin tilanteisiin onnistuu parhaiten tiimeissä ja työpareina.

Miksi meille töihin?

Meille on tärkeää, että voit tehdä vaikuttavaa työtä hyvän helsinkiläisen elämän eteen. Haluamme, että onnistut ja innostut työssäsi. Helsingin kaupungilla palkitsemme hyvin tehdystä työstä esimerkiksi kertapalkkioilla. Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä ammattilaisena. Tuoreimman henkilöstökyselyn mukaan meillä viihdytään ja työ koetaan mielekkääksi!

Lue lisää henkilöstöeduistamme ja tutustu Helsingin kaupunkiin työnantajana osoitteessa: https://www.hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille

Jäikö jokin askarruttamaan? Ole meihin rohkeasti yhteydessä! Odotamme hakemustasi!


Kelpoisuusehto:

Kelpoisuus määräytyy asetuksen 986/1998 mukaan. Määräaikaisissa tehtävissä kelpoisuusvaatimukset täyttävien hakijoiden puuttuessa myös vaadittavaa kelpoisuutta vailla olevat hakijat otetaan huomioon.

Määräaikaiseen virkasuhteeseen otettavan tulee toimittaa itseään koskeva lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.

Luemme eduksi kokemuksen äidinkielen ja kirjallisuuden opettajan tehtävistä peruskoulussa.

title: Systems Engineer - Optics / Sensors
description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and Geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The MDA Space team of more than 3,000 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

Are you ready to launch the next stage of your career in the new space economy? We would love to hear from you!

We’re on the hunt for a Systems Engineer.

MDA’s international footprint in the UK creates opportunities to work with some of the most exciting space industrial players in the country. Delivering all three business area capabilities in Geointelligence, Robotics & Space Operations, and Satellite Systems, our UK team provides support to our European-based customers while specializing in the development of advanced space sensors for exploration missions as well as space-based communication technology. As our presence grows overseas, so does our need for new ambitious team players to help us advance our place in the Universe and beyond.

Role:

MDA-UK is looking for a Systems Engineer to work on the design, integration and test of sensor and communication payload products for LEO, GEO, and Lunar satellite systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing a technical interface to customers and subcontractors
  • Capturing, deriving, and managing engineering requirements
  • Developing system architecture and concept of operations
  • Producing system budgets (power, mass, link, etc.) and interface definition
  • Analyzing performance & justifying design choices
  • Assessing reliability, availability, and maintainability (including FDIR and FMECA)
  • Planning test campaigns
  • Providing oversight and supervision to different engineering disciplines during design, integration and test
  • Troubleshooting hardware and software
  • Analyzing test data and writing test reports
  • Delivering verified flight equipment compliant to customer requirements

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer, AI

title: Kirjastonhoitaja Vimpelin kunnankirjastoon
description:
Kirjastonhoitajalla on päävastuu kirjaston koko toiminnasta ja kehittämisestä. Tehtävänkuvaan kuuluu kirjaston kokoelmatyö ja kaikenikäisten asiakkaiden asiakaspalvelu sekä tietopalvelu. Kirjastonhoitaja osallistuu kirjaston tapahtumien järjestämiseen ja kirjaston viestintään. Kirjastonhoitajalle kuuluu myös hallinnollisia tehtäviä mm. verkkopalvelujen ylläpito, laskujen asiatarkistus ja vastuuviranhaltijoiden kokoukset sekä laaja-alainen yhteistyö muihin kirjastoihin ja toimijoihin.
Edellytämme hyviä asiakaspalvelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja, aktiivista ja itsenäistä työotetta sekä suomen kielen hyvää osaamista.
Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta ja asiakaspalvelumyönteisyyttä, rohkeutta ideointiin sekä joustavuutta ja valmiutta heittäytyä. Kirjaston aineistojen hyvä tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.
Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävänkuvan, jossa pääset itse kehittämään uusia toimintatapoja ja palveluja vuosi sitten valmistuneessa uudessa kirjastossa.
Tehtävään valittavalta edellytetään tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa, johon sisältyvät tai jonka lisäksi on suoritettu vähintään 60 op:n (35 ov:n) laajuiset korkeakoulutasoiset kirjastoalan opinnot.
Palkka määräytyy KVTES:n mukaisesti.
Työaika on 36,25 tuntia viikossa. Työ on kaksivuorotyötä sisältäen iltavuoroja ja satunnaisia viikonlopputöitä. Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Tehtävään valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan. Olemme savuton työpaikka.
Paikkaa haetaan Kuntarekryn kautta sähköisesti viimeistään 11.11.2026. Haastatteluun kutsuttavien tulee esittää alkuperäiset opinto- ja työtodistukset haastattelussa.

title: Primary Care Dietitian - Temporary Full Time
description:
PRIMARY CARE DIETITIAN - Temporary Full-Time

Status: Temporary full-time (1.0 FTE) - Contract duration : ending on or before October 18, 2027.

Reporting To: Registered Dietitian & Kinesiologist Supervisor

Date Available: Negotiable

Shift Pattern: Days

Hours of Work: 7.75 hours per day, 38.75 hours per week

Program: Prevention and Promotion

Classification: Dietitian

Exempt/Non-Exempt: Non-Exempt

Salary Range: $40.29 - $53.56 per hour

Closing Date: October 16, 2026

About Us

Mosaic Primary Care Network (PCN) provides a wide range of primary health care services in the northeast and southeast Calgary communities in partnership with a group of family doctors. Our talented interdisciplinary health care teams work together to provide services that best support patient needs.

We want YOU to bring your expertise to our growing team as we continue to develop solutions to meet the needs of our local community. If you have initiative, are resourceful, engage easily in teamwork, and most importantly, want to make a difference in healthcare, we want to hear from you!

Position Summary

The Primary Care Dietitian works within a team-based environment in Mosaic PCN clinics and physician offices. The primary purpose of the role is to provide nutritional expertise to address the needs of patients experiencing nutrition-related conditions/diseases. The Primary Care Dietitian strives to improve health through nutrition strategies consistent with population health promotion. The focus is on achieving outcomes to meet the Mosaic PCN objectives.

The Primary Care Dietitian assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates appropriate and optimal nutritional care with the goal to improve nutritional and health status. The role consults with patients both one on one and in group settings.

Key Responsibilities

Assessment

  • Assesses the nutritional status of individuals, families, and communities through screening, data collection, ongoing monitoring, and reassessment.

Intervention

  • Educates individuals, families, and communities to assist in applying nutrition principles to improve overall health status using motivational interviewing and behavioural change management.
  • Provides clinical services using a patient centred approach in both one to one and group settings.
  • Identifies priorities, target dates, and strategies, together with the patients, which contribute to individualized treatment plans and goals.
  • Evaluates the extent to which outcomes have been achieved and recommends alternative treatments as necessary.
  • Consults directly with family physicians and provides referring physicians with concise verbal or written feedback in a timely manner.
  • Develops and delivers nutrition education and health promotion programs targeting populations of concern.

Inter-professional Collaboration

  • Works collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patients’ needs to ensure they receive appropriate and optimal care.
  • Mentors colleagues and dietetic interns in areas of expertise and seeks mentorship to achieve full potential in professional development.

Documentation

  • Documents all phases of patient care in the appropriate Electronic Medical Record (EMR) to maintain accurate and timely records, as well as recording the details of clinical interactions in MPCN evaluation systems.

Community Engagement

  • Participates in community activities within the Mosaic PCN catchment area, including health fairs, conferences, and other community events to promote Mosaic programs and services.

Professional Development

  • Identifies and works to achieve own professional development needs which support goals set in performance reviews.

Population Health Programming

  • Participates in and informs the ongoing operation, planning, and evaluation of community-based population health programs.

Other responsibilities as required.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required Education & Licenses

  • Bachelors’ degree in nutrition.
  • Licensed within the College of Dietitians of Alberta (CDA).

Required Experience

  • A minimum of one (1) to three (3) years of relevant experience, ideally in public health, health promotion or community-based nutrition.
  • Experience working with ethnically diverse, vulnerable, and high risk populations.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability in planning, developing, implementing, and evaluating nutrition strategies that is consistent with population health promotion.
  • Knowledge of nutrition recommendations and concepts.
  • Effective communication skills both verbally and written in English.
  • Computer knowledge literacy including MS Office and Outlook/Calendar management.
  • Sound judgment and ability to develop collaborative working relationships.
  • Self-directed, flexible, and displays initiative.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

Assets

  • Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE) certificate.
  • International Board-Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) certificate.
  • Pediatric counseling experience.

    Competencies

    The Core Competencies listed below are identified by Mosaic PCN leadership and should be demonstrated by all employees across the organization:

    Practice Communication Excellence (Communication)

    • Plan and deliver oral and written communications respectfully and tactfully to make an impact and persuade an intended audience.

    Build Community-Feeling (Teamwork)

    • Able to share due credit with coworkers, display enthusiasm, and team spirit and promote a friendly group working environment.

    Advocate for Patient/Client (Patient/Client-Centricity)

    • Able to demonstrate a high level of patient/client service delivery in a respectful and caring manner.

    Understand Values of Change (Adaptability)

    • Openness to different and new ways of doing things; willingness to modify one’s preferred way of doing things with a positive attitude.

    Embrace Culture and Diversity (Cultural Competency)

    • Developing positive attitudes towards diverse populations; gaining knowledge of different life practices and world views.

    Act with Professionalism (Personal Effectiveness)

    • Takes personal responsibility for the quality and timeless or work and achieves results with little oversight.

    Working Conditions

    • Occasional evening and weekend hours required.
    • Ability to travel on public transportation or valid drivers license with access to own car in good repair is required.

    OHS & PRIVACY

    • Adhere to Mosaic PCN's Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) policies and
      procedures.
    • Manage information in accordance with legislation and internal policies.
    • Maintain the confidentiality, privacy, and security of information and access it only as
      authorized work purposes.

    Why Mosaic PCN

    We provide a competitive benefits package for eligible employees including: comprehensive health and dental coverage, Health Spending Account (HSA) / Wellness Account (WA), a group RRSP matching program, professional development opportunities, generous vacation and other paid time off, and more!

    Conditions of Employment

    Successful applicants must provide proof of qualifications and a current police information check (PIC) at the applicant’s expense. The results of the PIC may alter or revoke any offer made by Mosaic PCN.

    We would like to thank all applicants for their interest and resumes. Please note, only those candidates chosen to proceed through the selection process will be contacted. No phone calls or emails please.

    If you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by emailing HR@mosaicpcn.ca

    This position is part of the bargaining unit covered by a collective agreement with Health Sciences Association of Alberta (HSAA).

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
