title: Sairaalafyysikko (sairaalafysiikan yksikkö, Sairaala Nova, Jyväskylä)
description:
Etsimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen sairaalafysiikan yksikköön kehitysmyönteistä ja osaavaa sairaalafyysikkoa.

________________________________________________

Mihin tulet töihin?

Tehtävä sijoittuu sairaalafysiologian toimipisteeseen, jossa työtehtävät sijoittuvat ensisijaisesti kliinisen neurofysiologian erikoisalalle. Sairaalafysiologian yksikköön kuuluvat myös kliininen fysiologia ja isotooppilääketiede, joilla toimivan osastonylifyysikon sijaistaminen (ml. STV-, STA- & LFA-vastuut) kuuluu tehtävänkuvaan.

Kliinisellä neurofysiologialla toimit vastuufyysikkona tarjoten lääketieteellisen fysiikan asiantuntemusta EEG-, ENMG-, herätepotentiaali-, aktigrafia- sekä uni- ja vireystilatutkimuksissa (PSG, Pol-Amb, MWT). Sinulla on myös aktiivinen rooli rTMS:ssä sekä potilastoiminnassa että laite- ja hoitoteknisenä asiantuntijana. Sairaalassa on valmius selkäortopedian IOM-toimintaan.

Olennaisena osana tehtävääsi kuuluu tutkimusmenetelmien ja toiminnan kehittäminen omalla vastuualueella. Tärkeänä osana työtä on myös henkilökunnan koulutus sekä osallistuminen asiantuntijana erilaisiin projekteihin ja hankintoihin.

________________________________________________

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?

Keski-Suomen Sairaala Nova on Suomen suurin keskussairaala. Sairaala on otettu käyttöön vuonna 2021 ja laitekantaa on modernisoitu aktiivisesti. Henkilöstötilanne on hyvä: yksikössä on kaksi vakituista KNF-erikoislääkäriä ja erikoistuva lääkäri sekä osaavat ja aktiiviset hoitajat.

Sairaalafysiologialla tehdään potilaan diagnostiikkaan, hoitoon ja seurantaan tarvittavia tutkimuksia monipuolisesti ja ammattitaidolla. Teemme myös aktiivista yhteistyötä laitetoimittajien kanssa. Sairaala Novan sairaalafysiikan yksikössä työskentelee yhteensä 9 sairaalafyysikkoa.

Työhösi saat vahvan esihenkilötuen ja lähikollegaksesi kokeneen KNF-fyysikon, joka perehdyttää sinut syvällisesti tehtävään. Järjestämme sinulle perehdytyssuunnitelman, jossa on huomioitu aikaisempi osaamisesi ja työhistoriasi. Tiimimme kokeneet ja ammattitaitoiset kollegat ovat myös tukenasi aina tarvittaessa.


Tiimin terveiset

Tässä tehtävässä pääset rakentamaan KNF:n toimintaa haluamaasi suuntaan yhdessä moniammatillisen tiimin kanssa. Nykyistä toimintaympäristöä rakentanut lähikollega tukee sinua aina tarvittaessa, joten yksin et jää. Hyvä ryhmädynamiikka, yhteishenki ja kaverin auttaminen ovat työyhteisömme tunnistettuja vahvuuksia. Sairaalafysiikan yksikkö on tiivis yhteisö, johon toivotamme sinut lämpimästi tervetulleeksi.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka 5585,87 €/kk. Tehtäväkohtaisen palkan lisäksi maksamme työkokemuslisää 5 vuodesta 3 % ja 10 vuodesta 8 %. Huomioithan myös julkisen sektorin hyvät työehdot esimerkiksi lomapäivien osalta. Lomapäivien kertymä määräytyy työkokemuksesi perusteella - mitä enemmän kokemusta, sitä enemmän ansaittuja lomapäiviä.

________________________________________________

Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on sairaalafyysikon pätevyys. Tehtävää täytettäessä voidaan huomioida myös erikoistumisen loppuvaiheessa oleva erikoistuva fyysikko.

Arvostamme tehtävässä kliinisen neurofysiologian laajaa ja syvällistä tuntemusta. Erityisen tärkeinä näemme hyvät työyhteisö- ja yhteistyötaidot sekä oma-aloitteisuuden ja ongelmanratkaisukyvyn.

Edellytämme tehtävässä tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista soveltuvuutta (vesirokko ja tuhkarokko). Influenssa- ja hinkuyskärokotuksen osalta työnantaja määrittää tarpeen.

Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen mukaisesti (SOTE-sopimus). Työsuhteessa noudatetaan koeaikaa.

title: Research Assistant (Website, Communication, & Research) Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North
description:
The Faculty of Law at the University of Lapland is recruiting a Research Assistant for the Arctic Transitions, Energy and Climate Governance Horizons in the Far North project.

The aim of the Arctic Transitions (AT) project is to critically examine how rapidly changing climatic conditions and a race to extract rare and valuable earth materials have made Arctic regions the focus of new extractive possibilities, as well as a laboratory for testing who controls these possibilities.

To meet this aim, the AT project is hiring a team to conduct comparative multidisciplinary research at locations across Arctic nations to explore:

- How and why changing climatic conditions and new resource demands are shaping extraction activities, infrastructures, security configurations, and governance arrangements.

- The impact of these activities and arrangements on the people and communities who live in these regions.

- How and why energy security and energy transition narratives are being mobilised, by whom, and to what end.

- How and why these activities, infrastructures, configurations and arrangements are connected to, and entangled with, international legal provisions and flows of capital.

This is an exciting and unique opportunity to be a core member of a cutting-edge research team, in an area of research that is fast-moving and of geopolitical significance.

This is a 12-month position, based in Rovaniemi, with the possibility of remote working.

The prospective start date is as soon as possible.

Work Tasks

The successful candidate will be a core and active member of the Arctic Transitions team. The central tasks of the successful candidate will be:

- To create and update a captivating and dynamic project website.

- To promote the projects international digital presence.

- To create and promote digital and social media content for the project.

Additionally, the successful candidate will also:

- Find, aggregate, and organise research articles and books using the University of Laplands library resources and cognate search engines as assigned by the employer.

- Find, aggregate, and organise current affairs and media reports using the University of Laplands library resources and cognate search engines as assigned by the employer.

- Contribute to AT project administration.

- Participate in other duties related to the role assigned by the employer.

Competence

Prospective candidates must:

- Have experience with website construction and design, digital media, and social media content creation.

- Be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking English at an academic level.

Prospective candidates should:

- Be pursuing a bachelor's or masters degree.

Previous research assistant experience will be considered a merit.

What we offer

- An opportunity to work within a multidisciplinary team within the Faculty of Law.

- Interesting work tasks as part of an international university community

- Modern work equipment and facilities.

- A stable organisation to work in.

- Opportunities for professional development.

- Extensive occupational health services.

- Sport, culture, and wellbeing benefits.

Application

Prospective candidates should submit their application via the Universitys electronic application form below. Applications must include:

- Cover letter (maximum 1 page)

- Curriculum vitae (cv)

Examples of previous digital and web projects are strongly encouraged.

Short-listed candidates selected for an interview will be contacted by email. Interviews will be conducted online in October/November 2026.

Information

For further information about the position, please contact Sean Field, Principal Investigator at firstname.lastname@ulapland.fi and +358 4014 95972.


Workplace address: Yliopistonkatu 8, 96300 ROVANIEMI
Duration of employment: 12 months starting in November or December 2026
Work hours: full-time employment
Trial period: 6 months
Salary: The universitys salary system is made up of a task-specific salary component namely the demand level and a personal salary component namely the performance percentage. The task-specific salary for research assistant is demand level 1 (2 120,11 €/ month). The personal salary component can typically range from 19,1% to 30%. The starting salary for Research Assistant is 2 525,05 € / month (demand level 1, performance 19,1%).

title: Manufacturing Technologist
description:
About Us

At Longboard Architectural Products, we change the face of architecture by designing and manufacturing premium aluminum solutions. Our innovative products set industry standards for durability, aesthetics, and sustainability. We take pride in transforming commercial and residential spaces into stunning, sustainable environments. Recognized as one of the Great Places to Work and Canada's Top Small & Medium Employers in 2026, and Best Places to Work in BC 2026, we offer professional growth opportunities, comprehensive benefits, and a workplace culture where people come first.

About the Role

As a Manufacturing Technologist, you will provide mechanical design and technical drafting support for manufacturing process improvements, equipment, tooling, and production solutions.

During the first 6 to 12 months, the role will be heavily focused on CAD design and documentation, with approximately 80% of your time dedicated to CAD work and 20% to hands-on manufacturing support, including taking measurements, validating designs, and supporting implementation on the production floor.

Within the CAD portion of the role, approximately 75% of the work will be completed in SolidWorks and 25% in AutoCAD. Your primary focus will be on developing manufacturing and process-related mechanical solutions, including jigs, fixtures, production aids, equipment modifications, and plant layouts.

The focus is on supporting manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturability.

As you build familiarity with Longboard's manufacturing processes, equipment, and operations, the role is expected to gradually evolve toward a more balanced combination of CAD design support and Continuous Improvement activities.

Reporting to the CI Manager, you will receive technical direction and work closely with Operations and other internal teams to translate identified manufacturing needs and proposed solutions into accurate, practical, and manufacturable designs.

About You

You are a technically strong manufacturing or mechanical technologist with advanced CAD capabilities and experience creating detailed mechanical models, drawings, layouts, and manufacturing documentation.

You are comfortable spending a significant portion of your day working in SolidWorks and AutoCAD and enjoy translating concepts, measurements, sketches, and technical direction into accurate designs that can be implemented on the production floor.

You understand that this role is focused on manufacturing processes rather than product design and are interested in using your CAD expertise to improve how products are manufactured.

You are also comfortable working on the production floor when required to take measurements, understand equipment and processes, validate designs, and support implementation.

What You Will Do

  • Apply engineering and Design for Manufacturability principles to develop mechanical solutions that improve manufacturing processes, safety, repeatability, and operational efficiency.
    • Translate conceptual ideas, sketches, measurements, and technical direction into detailed 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.
    • Create and update technical drawings and schematics using primarily SolidWorks and AutoCAD.
    • Design manufacturing aids such as jigs, fixtures, and related process solutions.
    • Support implementation and validation through measurements, testing, and hands-on work on the production floor.
  • Plan, develop, and maintain detailed plant and equipment layout drawings.
    • Review equipment positioning, space utilization, and material flow to support layout improvements.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure layouts align with operational requirements.
    • Consider health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements during layout planning.
    • Support capital projects by documenting space, utility, equipment, and infrastructure requirements.
  • Provide CAD and technical support for Continuous Improvement initiatives led by the CI Manager and Operations teams.
  • Support the implementation of improved manufacturing methods through engineering analysis, CAD design, measurements, and hands-on validation.
  • Collaborate with Product Design and Production teams to improve manufacturability and support production testing of new products, configurations, tools, and equipment.
  • Gather technical information and measurements from production equipment, manufacturing areas, and team members and incorporate those requirements into designs and drawings.
  • Communicate technical information and design intent to production employees and internal teams as required.
  • Prepare technical reports and manufacturing data to support Continuous Improvement activities.
  • Assist the CI Manager with coordination and tracking of assigned CI projects and activities.
  • Other duties and projects as assigned by your manager.

Qualifications & Experience

    • Diploma or degree in Manufacturing Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in SolidWorks, including experience creating detailed 3D models, assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.
  • Strong working knowledge of AutoCAD, particularly for 2D drawings and plant or equipment layouts.
  • 5 to 8 years of experience in a manufacturing environment involving mechanical design, CAD documentation, manufacturing engineering, manufacturing technology, or Continuous Improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience creating mechanical designs for manufacturing applications, including jigs, fixtures, production aids, or similar solutions.
  • Experience applying Design for Manufacturability principles in a production environment.
  • Strong ability to interpret and create technical drawings and specifications.
  • Experience taking physical measurements and translating manufacturing requirements or conceptual sketches into accurate CAD designs.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing equipment, machinery, fabrication, and assembly methods.
  • Knowledge of ergonomics, industrial safety, and regulatory considerations related to plant and equipment layout.
  • Understanding of Lean manufacturing, Kaizen, process mapping, workflow analysis, and work measurement techniques.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and manufacturability.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with manufacturing, engineering, production, and Continuous Improvement teams.
  • Basic understanding of rapid prototyping and 3D printing.
  • Mechatronics knowledge, including pneumatics, hydraulics, sensors, and interlocks, is considered an asset.

Benefits And Compensation

  • Salary Range: $75,000 – $90,000 CAD annually, based on experience.
  • Profit Sharing Program: Rewarding your contribution to Longboard’s success.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health Spending and Lifestyle Spending Accounts, catastrophic coverage, travel insurance, and more.
  • RRSP Matching: Up to 4% of your annual salary from Day 1
  • People-First Culture: A collaborative environment that supports professional growth, work-life balance, and continuous development.

Equal Opportunity

Longboard Architectural Products is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strongly believe that a diverse team is key to our success, and we make hiring decisions based solely on your skills, experience, and alignment with our core values. We warmly welcome applications from everyone, regardless of age, gender, disability, race, religion, or beliefs.

By submitting your resume and application information, you consent to Longboard Architectural Products storing and sharing your data within our recruitment systems as required to assess your qualifications for current or future opportunities.

title: Varhaisjakaja sijaisuus - Perniö, Salo
description:
Etsimme varhaisjakajan sijaista Perniöön, autojakeluun 2.11 - 15.12.

Etsitkö työtä, joka jättää päiväsi vapaaksi opiskelulle, harrastuksille, perheelle tai muille menoille? Työ sopii erinomaisesti esimerkiksi opiskelijoille, lisäansioita etsiville tai henkilöille, jotka arvostavat itsenäistä työskentelyä.

Nyt avoinna olevassa tehtävässä työskennellään vakituisen jakajan sijaisena. Työt sijoittuvat 2.11. - 15.12. välille. Työsuhteen vakinaistaminen voi tilanteen salliessa tulla kyseeseen myöhemmin.

- Työ tehdään työnantajan tarjoamalla autolla Perniön kirkonkylällä sekä ympäristössä.
- Työvuorokierto 6+2.
- Palkkaus määräytyy Teollisuusliiton ja Medialiiton välisen työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.
- Uuden jakajan keskimääräinen tuntiansio lisineen on noin 12-13 €/h.

- Saat palkallisen perehdytyksen päiväsaikaan sekä käytännön opastuksen omalle jakelureitillesi yöaikaan.

Millaista työ on?

Varhaisjakajana työskentelet noin 5 tuntia yössä, yleensä klo 01.30-06.30 välisenä aikana.

Työ sisältää sanomalehtien, aikakauslehtien ja osoitteellisen postin jakelua ennalta määritellyllä reitillä. Työvuororytmi on kuusi työyötä ja kaksi vapaayötä, mikä tarjoaa säännöllisen rytmin ja helpottaa oman arjen suunnittelua.

Varhaisjakaja työskentelee, kun muut ihmiset vielä nukkuvat. Varhaisjakelussa työskentelevänä olet jo oman työvuorosi tehnyt, kun muut vasta heräävät ja voit viettää päiväsi, miten ikinä haluat.

Varhaisjakajana työskentelet tärkeänä osana sanomalehtien tuotantoprosessia. Asiakkaamme odottavat saavansa lehden oikeaan aikaan ja oikeaan paikkaan. Työ on hyvin itsenäistä ja vaatii oma-aloitteisuutta, hyvää peruskuntoa ja -terveyttä sekä yötyön takia vähintään 18 vuoden ikää. Työssä tarvitaan suomen kielen taitoa. Tehtävä soveltuu parhaiten sinulle, joka olet työssäsi vastuullinen, tarkka ja reipas. Jakopiirit jaetaan työantajan jakeluautolla. (Vaatimuksena B-ajokortti.)

Lisätietoja antaa jakeluesimies Mika Orakoivu p. 02–269 3971 arkisin klo 12–15 välisenä aikana. (mika.orakoivu@tietojakelu.fi). WhatsApp 0400 964989.

title: Laitosmies
description:
LAITOSMIEHEN TOISTAISEKSI VOIMASSA OLEVA TOIMI
Perhon kunta hakee laitosmiestä teknisen toimen kiinteistöhuoltotiimiin. Tiimin lähiesimiehenä toimii rakennustarkastaja. Työtehtävät koostuvat monipuolisista vesi- ja viemärilaitoksen ylläpito-, korjaus- ja uudisrakentamistöistä sekä kiinteistönhuollon tehtävistä. Työhön sisältyy myös muissa teknisen osaston työtehtävissä avustamista sekä etenkin talvisin ulkoilualueiden hoitotehtäviä.
Työ on liikkuvaa ja edellyttää liikkumista eripuolilla kuntaa. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B-luokan ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttämistä.
Työ vaatii tekijältään oma-aloitteisuutta. Työhön kuuluu vesi- ja viemärilaitoksen hoitajan lomien sijaistamista, jolloin sinun tulee kyetä hoitamaan vesihuoltolaitoksen työtehtäviä luotettavasti ja itsenäisesti sekä kantaa vastuu omasta työstäsi. Työssäsi asioit paljon asiakkaiden ja kunnan muiden työntekijöiden kanssa, mikä vaatii sinulta vuorovaikutustaitoja ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä. Työtehtävään kuuluu suorittavan työn lisäksi jonkin verran toimistotyöskentelyä. Tietokoneen peruskäytön tulee olla hallussasi, samoin halu ja kiinnostus oppia uusien ohjelmien käyttöä.
Pääasiallisia työtehtäviäsi ovat vesijohto- ja jätevesiverkoston kunnossapito- ja uudisrakentamistyöt sekä kiinteistönhuoltotehtävät. Tehtävien jakautuminen painottuu pääasiassa 50 % vesi- ja viemärilaitoksen tehtäviin ja 50 % kiinteistönhuoltotehtäviin. Vesi- ja viemärilaitoksen hoitajan poissa ollessa tehtäviin kuuluu lisäksi jätevedenpuhdistamon hoitaminen ja valvonta sekä vesilaitoksen hoitaminen ja valvonta. Talvella tehtäviin kuuluu tarvittaessa avustaminen ulkoilualueiden hoitajan tehtävissä mm. latujen tekoa moottorikelkalla yms.
Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu kiertävä päivystysvuoro kunnan kiinteistöjen, sekä vesi- ja viemärilaitoksen asioissa. Päivystyksen aikana edellytämme työntekijän olevan 30 min varoitus ajalla kunnan keskustan alueella olevassa kohteessa.
Toimeen valittavalta emme edellytä koulutusta mutta arvostamme kiinteistöhuollon ja/tai LVI-alan koulutusta. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus vesi- ja viemärilaitoksen infratöistä sekä kiinteistönhuollosta. Järjestämme asianmukaisen perehdytyksen ja koulutamme valitun henkilön tehtävään. Odotamme valittavalta innostunutta ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta, kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja vastuunottamista tehtävässään. Arvostamme lisäksi hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä joustavaa ja kustannustietoista palveluasennetta.
Tehtävässä noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Tehtävä sijoittuu KT-TS palkkaryhmään 1 ja hinnoittelutunnus 5 01 04 01 8. Yleistyöaika 38 h 15 min/vko (+30 min/pv ruokatauko). Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2548,80 €/kk +KT-TS mukaiset lisät.
Toimeen valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan. Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva toimi täytetään 14.12.2026 alkaen tai erikseen sovittuna ajankohtana.
Hakemukset ensisijaisesti Kuntarekryn kautta osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakemuksen voi vaihtoehtoisesti toimittaa myös sähköpostitse kirjaamo@perho.com. Hakemukseen tulee merkitä Laitosmiehen toimi. Hakemuksiin tulee liittää cv ja selvitys hakijan kelpoisuudesta.
Hakuaika toimeen päättyy torstaina 1.11.2026. Myöhässä tulleita hakemuksia ei oteta huomioon. Haastattelut järjestetään viikon 46 aikana.

title: Contract Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Contract Quality Assurance Engineer - 12-Month Contract | Hounslow (50/50 Hybrid) | Up to £380 per day

Every time an aircraft pushes back from the stand, software has already optimised the load, calculated weight and balance, produced a compliant load sheet and absorbed every last-minute change. You could be the engineer who makes sure that software is right, every single time.

This QA role sits within Agile product teams building mission-critical flight management solutions used by airlines worldwide. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, Engineers, domain experts, and airline customers, validating complex workflows across multiple systems, integrations, and operational domains. If you want your testing to matter - safety, compliance, on-time performance - this is it. You'll also be encouraged to use AI-assisted tooling for test design, automation, defect investigation and documentation.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Analysing requirements and workflows to define test approaches, and producing test plans, test cases, automation assets and quality reports
  • Designing, implementing and maintaining automated tests that lift regression coverage and delivery efficiency
  • Executing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression and exploratory testing
  • Validating workflows, integrations, APIs and data flows across interconnected products and services
  • Supporting CI/CD through automated testing and quality validation
  • Investigating defects, carrying out root cause analysis and driving issues to resolution
  • Collaborating across product, engineering and domain teams to ensure solutions are testable
  • Championing improvements in quality, automation maturity and engineering practice, including AI-assisted tools

What You'll Bring

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field
  • 3+ years in QA, Software Testing or Quality Engineering within Agile product development
  • Proven experience building and maintaining automated testing for enterprise software, integrated into CI/CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of APIs, integrations, data models, and distributed applications, with experience of complex, interconnected systems
  • Self-sufficiency to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
  • Confidence using AI-assisted tools across test design, automation, and defect investigation (AI-Driven SDLC awareness a plus)
  • Desirable: airline or airport operations knowledge (flight ops, weight and balance, load control, baggage or ramp); safety-critical or regulated systems; Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework, Cypress, Karate or Appium; Postman or SOAP UI; Jenkins and GitHub; JSON, SQL, Kafka or Grafana; performance, resilience or security testing; Python or Java; ISTQB; testing AI-powered or agentic capabilities

Ready to Apply?

If you want your automation to protect real flights, real passengers and real operational deadlines, apply now with your CV. We're reviewing candidates on a rolling basis, so early applications are encouraged.

Keywords: QA Engineer, Quality Engineer, Test Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, SDET, Senior QA Analyst, API Test Engineer, Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Robot Framework, Karate, Appium, Postman, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Python, Java, SQL, Kafka, ISTQB, Agile testing, regression testing, airline operations, load control, weight and balance, aviation software, safety-critical systems.

title: Huollon työntekijä
description:
Huoltopesti avoinna Vantaalla

Peukalo harvoin keskellä kämmentä, hoksottimet aina pelikunnossa? Vatupassin Vantaan vuokraamolle etsitään rakennuskoneiden korjaamiseen perehtynyttä huollon työntekijää!

Yleiskonevuokraamo Vatupassin Vantaan toimipisteelle haetaan käsistään kätevää ja nopeilla hoksottimilla varustettua huollon tekijää kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Korjaamomme ja huollon työntekijöidemme käsien läpi kulkee vuodessa satoja Vatupassin vuokrauskalustoon kuuluvia rakennuskoneita (mm. erilaisia nostimia, maantiivistimiä, kuukulkijoita ja monia erilaisia pienkoneita). Jos vempaimien vikojen diagnosointi, korjaus ja määräaikainen huolto luonnistuu sinulta ilman, että peukalo karkaa keskelle kämmentä, hae hommiin!

Mitä odotamme hakijalta:

  • Monipuolista aiempaa kokemusta rakennuskoneiden huollosta ja korjauksesta

  • Tietotaitoa sähkö- ja/tai hydrauliikkatekniikasta

  • Täsmällistä ongelmanratkaisu- ja oivalluskykyä

  • Eduksi katsotaan tehtävään soveltuva tekninen koulutus (esim. raskaskoneasentaja tai ajoneuvoasentaja)

Vastineeksi tarjoamme rehtiä palkkaa ja minimaalisen vähän nipottamista ja turhantärkeilyä. Emme ole (vielä) Suomen suurin konevuokraamo, mutta haluamme olla paras – ja sehän lähtee mahdollisimman hyvinvoivasta henkilöstöstä. Laajojen työterveyspalveluiden ja työkykyvakuutuksen lisäksi tarjoamme kaikille työntekijöillemme sähköpyöräedun, myynti-, kunto- ja tupakoimattomuusbonusta sekä panostamme reiluuteen ja työssä viihtymiseen.

Mikä Vatupassi?

Vatupassi on perheomisteinen konevuokraamoyritys, jonka toimipisteet sijaitsevat Joensuussa, Jyväskylässä, Kuopiossa, Nurmeksessa, Oulussa, Tampereella, Turussa sekä Vantaalla. Olemme osa kansainvälistä Avesco Groupia, joka toimii Suomen lisäksi kotimaassaan Sveitsissä, Itävallassa sekä Baltian maissa.

Vatupassilaista kulttuuria leimaa perheomisteisen yrityksen reiluus, joustavuus ja oikeudenmukaisuus. Meillä omista pidetään huolta. Ja se tarkoittaa sitä, että vastuuta kannetaan yhdessä, luotetaan toinen toisiimme ja autetaan työkaveria ilman mikromanageerausta.

Hakeminen ja hakuaika

Haku on käynnissä 25.10.2026 saakka, mutta pesti täytetään heti sopivan tyypin löydyttyä. Älä siis jää empimään, vaan laita hakemusta heti tulemaan!

Lisätietoja pestistä antaa meidän Panu: Panu Mustonen, panu.mustonen@vatupassi.fi, p. 045 631 2826

title: Karjanhoitaja, Paasonmäki Oy
description:
Viihdytkö eläinten parissa, tykkäät käytännön tekemisestä ja haluat työssäsi myös vastuuta? Jos kyllä, meillä voisi olla sinulle sopiva paikka.

Paasonmäki Oy etsii karjanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Meillä työ ei ole pelkkää robottinavetan hoitamista, vaan päivät koostuvat monipuolisesti eläinten hoidosta, navetan töistä ja tilan muusta arjesta.

Mistä työpäivät koostuvat?

Tilallamme on neljä lypsyrobottia ja niiden ympärillä paljon muutakin tekemistä. Työpäivään voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

  • robottinavetan päivittäiset työt ja robottien hallinta

  • vasikoiden juotto ja hoito

  • eläinten hyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen ja puhtaanapito

  • mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös lihakarjan ja hiehojen parissa työskentelyä

Työssä käytetään myös tilan kalustoa, kuten pienkuormaajaa. Jos koneen käyttö ei ole vielä tuttua, ei haittaa, sillä sen oppii kyllä tässä työssä.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Tärkeintä meille on huolellinen ja vastuullinen työote sekä hyvä karjasilmä. Haluat pitää eläimistä hyvää huolta ja pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti. Arvostamme myös joustavuutta, sillä maatilan arjessa päivät eivät aina mene aivan samalla kaavalla.

Alan koulutus tai aiempi kokemus karjanhoidosta on eduksi, mutta kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Työssä tarvitaan suomen kielen taitoa, jotta päivittäinen yhteistyö ja työtehtävien hoitaminen sujuvat.

Millainen työpaikka sinua odottaa?

Haluamme löytää toimivan rytmin sekä tilan että työntekijän kannalta. Työpäivä voi olla yksi- tai kaksiosainen, ja työajoista sekä vapaapäivistä voidaan sopia joustavasti.

Tilalla työskentelee neljä vakituista työntekijää, ja kesäisin mukana on lisäksi opiskelijoita ja sesonkityöntekijöitä. Myös yrittäjät itse ovat täysipäiväisesti mukana tilan arjessa.

Palkka asettuu noin 12–17 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, ja tarvittaessa työntekijälle on mahdollista järjestää asunto.

Tila sijaitsee keskellä maaseudun rauhaa, mutta keskellä aktiivista kylää ja sopivan matkan päässä lähitaajamien palveluista ja erilaisista harrastus- ja kulttuurimahdollisuuksista.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Jos eläinten kanssa työskentely, monipuolinen maatilan arki ja itsenäinen tekeminen kuulostavat omalta jutultasi, laita hakemus rekrytointijärjestelmäämme. Jos tehtävästä jäi jotain kysyttävää, niin laita viestiä Töitä Suomesta Oy:n Hennamarille (hennamari.toiviainen@toitasuomesta.fi).

title: Team Lead Software Engineer
description:
About Us

At Longboard Architectural Products, we change the face of architecture by designing and manufacturing premium aluminum solutions. Longboard is seeking an experienced Team Lead Software Engineer with strong Python expertise to lead a small team of developers supporting our manufacturing and business operations. Reporting to the Business Systems Manager, this role plays a critical part in designing, building, and maintaining software solutions that power inventory management, factory workflow, shipping processes, ERP synchronization, and customer-facing applications.

You are collaborative, investigative, technically strong, adaptable, and solutions-oriented. You are comfortable working across technical and non-technical teams, communicating technical guidance, listening to team feedback, and developing solutions that meet evolving business needs.

title: Director, Enterprise AI Governance and Strategy
description:
Company Information
Clinical Ink is the global life science company that brings data, technology, and patient science together to unlock clinical discovery. Our deep therapeutic-area expertise, coupled with Direct Data Capture, eCOA, eConsent, telehealth, neurocognitive testing, and digital biomarkers advancement, drive the industry standard for data precision and usher in a new generation of clinical trials. With offices in the United States and Denmark, Clinical Ink is rewriting the clinical development experience.

Job Description
Clinical Ink is seeking a Director, Enterprise AI Governance and Strategy to to join our AI Enablement team based in the United States. The Director, Enterprise AI Governance and Strategy leads Clinical Ink's AI governance program end to end - chairing our AI Governance Council, running the AI Champions Network, and serving as the operational owner of the SOP-AI suite. This role turns governance from a compliance checkbox into a living system: one that gives leadership, customers, and regulators confidence, while giving internal teams clear, usable guardrails instead of friction. The Director, Enterprise AI Governance and Strategy's responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  • AI Governance, Principles & Risk Management
    • Own and evolve Clinical Ink's AI governance framework and supporting standard operating procedures (SOP) suite, AI tools listing, ensuring they stay current with ISO 42001, EU AI Act, and relevant GxP requirements (21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11).
    • Manage the associated SOP resources, e.g. AI System Management.
    • Chair the AI Governance Council; drive intake, review, and approval of new AI use cases and tools.
    • Partner with Legal, Regulatory Compliance, and other internal stakeholders to manage AI-related risk across sponsor contracts (MSA AI-data-rights clauses, disclosure obligations) and ensure governance steps are actually followed in practice, not just documented.
    • Own sponsor- and regulator-facing AI disclosure and approval artifacts (e.g., pilot notices, technology disclosures).
  • Leadership & Enablement Networks
    • Direct the AI Governance Council and the AI Champions Network - setting agendas, driving decisions, and turning both into functioning operational bodies rather than standing meetings.
    • Identify training gaps across the organization and ensure team members have access to the AI education and enablement they need to work safely and effectively with AI tools.
    • Serve as the primary internal and external voice for "how Clinical Ink governs AI" - building and maintaining communication artifacts for leadership, sponsors, and prospective partners.
  • Insights, Tooling & Oversight
    • Own visibility into enterprise AI usage: token consumption, spend by team/product, model adoption trends, and emerging agentic workflow patterns.
    • Translate usage data into decisions - flagging misuse, informing model-selection policy, and surfacing cost/ROI insights to leadership.
    • Maintain the tools and reporting infrastructure that make this visibility possible (dashboards, usage reports, spend analysis).
    • Manage registration and access to approved AI connectors/tools.
  • Strategy & Cross-Functional Planning
    • Partner with key AI Enablement team members on roadmapping and planning for AI&I team initiatives, ensuring governance and infrastructure priorities move in lockstep.
    • Partner with the R&D Director to ensure the AI-SDLC is well-supported by governance processes, and that agentic strategy execution stays aligned with overall Enterprise AI strategy.
    • Represent governance considerations in AI investment planning, M&A technical diligence, and connected-device/data-partner evaluations as needed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, AI/ML, or a related field preferred.
  • 2+ years in technology governance, risk/compliance, or AI/data strategy roles, with at least 1–2 years focused specifically on AI governance or responsible AI programs.
  • 8-10 years in technology innovation, including developing AI/ML models and/or contributing to or leading AI, data, or engineering teams and/or strategy.
  • Experience in life sciences, clinical trials, or another GxP-regulated industry (21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, ICH E6) preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in awareness of, building or operating governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act) in a regulated or high-scrutiny environment.
  • Experience running cross-functional councils or working groups - able to drive decisions, not just facilitate discussion.
  • Strong ability to translate technical AI/ML concepts (model behavior, agentic workflows, token economics) into risk and business language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working directly with Legal/Regulatory Compliance on contract language and disclosure obligations.
  • Familiarity with enterprise LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, AWS Bedrock, or similar) and usage/cost analytics preferred.
  • Experience/awareness of deploying solutions to cloud environments (Amazon, Microsoft, Google, etc.) preferred.
  • Experience supporting or governing agentic AI systems and SDLC processes for AI-assisted development preferred.
Additional Information
Clinical Ink is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, age, sex, marital status, national origin, disability or handicap, or veteran status.
Personal data submitted in connection with this position will be processed by Clinical Ink Denmark ApS and Clinical Ink, Inc. for recruitment and hiring purposes. Paycor Recruiting is used to collect and manage applications; please review the Clinical Ink Privacy Policy and Paycor Privacy Policy for additional information. ​

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
This description intends to describe the general nature and level of work performed by Teammates assigned to this job. It is not intended to include all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Sales Generation and Guest Service

title: Intermediate DevOps Developer - Remote/Hybrid (Canada)
description:
Info-Tech Research Group delivers impartial, highly pertinent IT research, enabling CIOs and IT leaders to make well-informed, strategic decisions. We are currently serving over 30,000 professionals and collaborate closely with IT teams, equipping them with actionable tools and expert guidance to drive measurable results and enhance technology initiatives and organizational processes.

Why join us?

  • We pride ourselves on consistent year-on-year growth, with double-digit growth even during a global pandemic.
  • We are in the Top 3 on LinkedIn's Top Companies List in Canada.
  • Info-Tech fosters a growth-focused, entrepreneurial culture with unlimited opportunities for professional growth and development.

About The Role

The Intermediate DevOps Developer is responsible for supporting and improving the tools, processes, and infrastructure that enable the development, deployment, and ongoing operation of applications. Working closely with development teams and managers, this role helps automate and streamline software delivery processes and ensures application environments and deployment pipelines are reliable and efficient.

The DevOps Developer will contribute to the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, automation, infrastructure-as-code, and application configuration. The role may also involve making updates to application code and troubleshooting issues across development and production environments.

This position requires a strong working knowledge of application deployment processes, cloud infrastructure, security, and DevOps automation tools. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently on day-to-day technical activities while collaborating with more senior technical resources when required.

The majority of work will be performed during normal business hours, although occasional after-hours support may be required for application or infrastructure downtime, deployments, or maintenance.

Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain application infrastructure, cloud environments, and deployment processes across the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling to automate and streamline software delivery.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation solutions to improve consistency, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Work with AWS cloud infrastructure to support application development, deployment, and ongoing operations.
  • Support and maintain application environments across Windows and Mac platforms.
  • Work with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve application, infrastructure, deployment, and environment-related issues.
  • Support databases and data stores, including configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance considerations.
  • Contribute to reliability, observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery practices, including tracking system health and understanding where potential issues or risks may arise.
  • Support application updates and, where required, contribute to application code and configuration changes.
  • Collaborate with developers, technical stakeholders, and senior technical resources to improve development and deployment processes.
  • Participate in deployments, maintenance, and occasional after-hours support when required.

Required Experience

  • Hands-on experience working with AWS and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling.
  • Experience working with databases and data stores, including but not limited to MySQL 8, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server, and SQLite.
  • Several years of experience working with the Microsoft Data Platform.
  • Experience working across Windows and Mac environments.
  • Practical understanding of reliability, observability, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience troubleshooting issues across application, infrastructure, deployment, and development environments.
  • Ability to work independently on day-to-day technical activities while knowing when to collaborate with or escalate to more senior technical resources.
  • Solid understanding of software development and deployment processes across the software development lifecycle.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and the ability to understand and work within Azure environments.
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails or MVC application development frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of application and cloud security principles, including authentication, authorization, access controls, and SAML/SSO.
  • Working knowledge of Python, APIs, and web services, with an understanding of how they support automation, application integration, and DevOps processes.
  • Experience supporting or contributing to application code.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and experience using AI-powered tools to support software development, automation, or DevOps workflows is an asset.

description:

- Asiakaspalvelupisteessä aktiviteettien myynti ja ohjeistus



- Kahvila- ja matkamuistotuotteiden myynti



- Varausjärjestelmän käyttö, majoitusten, aktiviteettien ja kuljetusten varaukset



- Yhteydenpito ja asiakasviestintä asiakkaiden kanssa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työn, joissa työn jälki näkyy: sinun ideasi voivat vaikuttaa Enjoy Laplandin ja Northern Lights Parkin brändiin ja tarjontaan



- Määräaikaisen työsuhteen talvikauden ajaksi



- Hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviin



- Kokoaikaisen työn ja paljon kokemusta matkailualalta!


Toivomme sinulta:

- Englannin kielen taitoa, muut kielet luetaan eduksesi



- Innokkuutta tehdä lisämyyntiä



- Huolellista työotetta

- Ajokorttia ja autoa töissä kulkemiseen

Bondata Lapland

title: Floor Leader (Full-Time)
description:
Summary

The Leader in Training (LIT) and Floor Leader position’s primary responsibility is to fulfill our mission statement: “To create the most enjoyable shopping experience possible for our Guests.” The LIT and Floor Leader performs a variety of sales, merchandising and operational tasks assigned by store management (e.g. cashiering, merchandise display and pulls, register procedures, and routine cleaning of facilities). To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.   • Fill out and effectively use the Sales Presentation Guide (SPG) daily to accomplish goals

  • Personal passion to demonstrate, coach, and influence results of denim showmanship and denim fit cards through Teammates and Guests

    • Be vocal and continuously update fellow leader and Team
    • Responsible for getting Guest names
    • Understanding and working guys side/gals side to benefit both Teammates and Guests

Visual Merchandise Management

    • Product knowledge, placement, passion, preference
    • Weekly Checklist
    • Life cycle of product
    • Track Results
  • Be able to recognize and assign Zones and projects to Teammates daily with a specific learning goal in mind
  • Confirm Teammates are following through with Visual Standards, Visual library and Weekly Visual Checklist throughout their shift with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Ability to execute and demonstrate all new tools and videos that apply to zone ownership and take initiative in knowing and executing zone ownership questions
  • Show aptitude in recognizing merchandising opportunities from freight to floor and life cycle of product, communicating recommendations and solutions to Store Manager
  • Give informational and influential store tours
  • Ensure sales floor is consistently sized and new freight is appropriately displayed

Operations

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, which may include mornings, evenings, and weekends, and the day of/day after Thanksgiving and Christmas, based upon store and business needs
  • Understand and utilize planner including completion of Opening and Closing Checklists
  • Watch for and recognize security risks and thefts, and know how to prevent or handle these situations
  • Follow all Loss Prevention guidelines, including daily bag and purse checks
  • Ability to execute and teach all Point of Sale (“POS”) procedures
  • Appropriately handle calls from Corporate Office
  • Know Buckle guidelines when handling returns and exchanges
  • Maintain positive attitude when dealing with challenging situations that involve Guests or Teammates
  • Understand and execute all policies regarding payments, exchanges and Loss Prevention practices
  • Ability to navigate and execute all tools on the home page
  • Knowledge and ability to give guidance and feedback to all non-sales positions
  • Complete all scheduled shifts and cover shifts when needed

  • Consistently maintain a clean, organized, and shoppable store to fulfill Buckle’s mission statement

title: Drone Programmer
description:
Location: Innovation Park Muscat
Experience: 2+ years

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Drone Programmer to join our team in developing innovative drone applications. You will design, develop and implement software that enables drones to operate autonomously, integrating hardware and software components seamlessly. The role sits at the intersection of aviation technology, robotics and software engineering, building cutting-edge drone systems for a wide range of applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Algorithm Development & Prototyping: Design and develop algorithms for autonomous flight, including sensing and perception, path planning and decision-making.
  • Software Simulation: Use simulation environments such as Gazebo or Unreal Engine to test and validate autonomous flight algorithms.
  • Hardware Implementation & Testing: Deploy software on autopilots (e.g. PX4) or onboard computers (e.g. NVIDIA Jetson), and run thorough hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Communication Protocols: Develop and integrate protocols such as MAVLink or ROS for seamless data exchange between drones and ground control systems.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver a cohesive drone ecosystem.
  • Staying Current: Keep up with the latest advances in drone technology and robotics.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field.
  • Proficiency in C/C++, Python and/or Java.
  • At least 2 years of software development experience for robotics or autonomous systems, preferably drones.
  • Strong experience with the Robot Operating System (ROS or ROS 2).
  • Familiarity with sensor integration and data-processing techniques.
  • Experience with debugging tools and techniques for robotic systems.
  • Experience with drone platforms such as PX4, DJI SDK or ArduPilot.
  • Familiarity with computer-vision libraries such as OpenCV.

Nice to Have

  • Contributions to open-source robotics projects.
  • A remote pilot certificate (e.g. FAA Part 107 or an equivalent licence).
  • A collaborative team with opportunities for professional growth.
  • Access to cutting-edge drone technology and tools.
  • Flexible work arrangements with a focus on innovation and creativity.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
PROFILE

TriMech is investing in a modern enterprise data platform — built on Microsoft Fabric — to create a trusted, scalable foundation for reporting, analytics, AI, and data-driven decision-making across the group. This role sits at the heart of that programme.

As Senior Data Engineer / Data Scientist, you will design, build, and operate the group's data ecosystem: integrating data from our core business systems, developing robust pipelines, establishing quality and governance standards, and delivering the advanced analytics and AI capabilities that shape strategic and operational decisions.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will work directly with executive leadership, business teams, and IT to turn raw data from platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, marketing systems, and bespoke applications into secure, governed, and genuinely useful insights. You will also help set the engineering standards, deployment practices, and support processes for the platform as it scales.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Data platform engineering

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines, ingestion, transformation, and orchestration processes on Microsoft Fabric.
  • Develop the enterprise lakehouse architecture and data models that serve analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
  • Integrate data across multiple applications via APIs and ETL tooling.
  • Optimise performance, reliability, and cost, and embed CI/CD and DevOps practices for platform deployments.

Business intelligence & analytics

  • Translate business requirements into analytical datasets, semantic models, and Power BI reporting across Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations and more.
  • Build executive and board-level reporting datasets, and champion self-service analytics adoption.
Data science & AI
  • Develop forecasting, statistical, and predictive models using enterprise data assets.
  • Support AI and machine-learning initiatives and evaluate emerging technologies for practical business value.
Governance & quality
  • Implement data quality monitoring, validation, and master data management practices.
  • Establish cataloguing, lineage, and metadata management through Microsoft Purview, and support security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Stakeholder partnership
  • Work with leadership and data owners to improve definitions, consistency, and measurement frameworks.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years experience in a relevant field, flexible for the right candidate.
  • A strong track record designing and running enterprise-scale data pipelines and integrations across multiple applications.
  • Deep SQL expertise, data warehousing, and dimensional modelling, with experience of lakehouse and modern data architecture patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (or equivalent platform), or a strong Azure data estate (e.g. Azure Data Factory, Synapse) with the appetite to specialise in Fabric.
  • Power BI development, including semantic models.
  • Python and/or R for analytics and automation, plus source control and DevOps practices.
  • Applied experience in at least one of: predictive modelling, statistical analysis, forecasting, machine learning, or AI solution development.
  • Experience with business platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, and CRM/ERP integration patterns.
  • Microsoft, Azure, Fabric, or data engineering certifications.
  • Highly analytical and naturally curious, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear data requirements and solutions
  • Comfortable moving between deep technical work and business conversations.
  • Able to work independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate with impact.
  • Passionate about data quality, governance, and continuous improvement.

COMPENSATION

  • OTE $154k - 165k per annum

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Hybrid Work Arrangements
  • Flex PTO
  • Competitive Group Benefits Plan
  • Perkopolis Membership Access – Employee perk and discount programs.
  • Wellness Program
  • Social Events

This opportunity is to fill an existing vacancy

TriMech is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity and sexual orientation), disability, age, national origin, or protect veteran status or any other protected status.

title: Internal Systems Project Consultant
description:
Internal Systems Project Consultant

Salary: £40,000 + benefits

Location: Hybrid / Remote must be able to travel to the Midlands on occasion

Hours: 37.5 hours per week

Job Type: Permanent

About the Role

We are working with an established and growing technology-focused business that is looking to appoint an Internal Systems Project Consultant to help drive improvements across its internal systems, processes and technology.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining business analysis, project coordination, systems improvement, functional testing, stakeholder engagement and emerging AI technology.

You will work closely with senior management to understand business requirements, investigate problems, identify practical solutions and take improvements through to implementation and adoption.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems rather than simply identifying them, and who wants to play a key role in improving how a business operates through technology, automation and AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate business requirements, existing processes and user needs to understand the underlying problems and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business requirements into practical system and process improvements.
  • Evaluate potential solutions and make recommendations based on evidence and business requirements.
  • Take ownership of smaller projects from initial brief through to implementation, testing and review.
  • Conduct functional testing, including creating test scenarios, acceptance criteria, recording bugs and validating solutions.
  • Work with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure proposed solutions meet the needs of the business.
  • Work closely with developers and technical specialists, asking the right questions and challenging assumptions where appropriate.
  • Review technical and AI-generated information for accuracy, completeness and suitability.
  • Help introduce and embed automation and AI-enabled solutions into business processes.
  • Monitor implementation and adoption, gathering feedback and recommending further improvements where required.
  • Maintain project plans, action logs, progress records, milestones and risk registers.
  • Coordinate internal resources and provide regular project updates.
  • Produce clear documentation, including requirements, process maps, user guides, test evidence and training materials.
  • Provide support to senior management with the coordination of priorities, actions and deadlines.
  • Ensure relevant project and business systems are kept accurate and up to date.


About You

  • We are looking for a proactive, organised and solution-focused individual who enjoys taking ownership and seeing projects through to completion.
  • You will be comfortable working across both business and technology, with the ability to understand technical concepts without necessarily being a developer.
  • You should be confident dealing with different stakeholders, asking challenging questions when necessary and translating technical information into something clear and understandable for users.
  • You will also need to be comfortable managing several priorities at once while maintaining excellent attention to detail.

Essential Experience

  • Experience of understanding business processes and translating requirements into practical system or process improvements.
  • Experience independently delivering smaller projects from initial objective through to implementation and review.
  • Strong hands-on functional testing experience, including test scenarios, acceptance criteria, bug recording and validation.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder discussions or workshops.
  • Experience working with developers and/or technical specialists.
  • Strong organisational and project coordination skills.
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills.
  • A practical, problem-solving approach with the ability to investigate root causes and identify solutions.


Desirable Experience

Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous: Business Analyst, Business Systems Consultant, Functional Consultant, Systems Project Consultant, Project Coordinator / Project Manager, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Microsoft Power Platform, Workflow automation, Artificial Intelligence / AI-enabled business solutions

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a forward-thinking organisation where technology, automation and AI are increasingly central to improving the way the business operates.

You will have genuine scope to influence processes, introduce improvements and develop your knowledge across business systems, automation, AI and project delivery.

The company offers: circa £40,000 salary, Hybrid / remote working, Private Health Insurance, Death in Service – 4 x salary, Employee Assistance Programme, Generous annual leave, Additional holiday opportunities, Learning and development opportunities, Supportive and collaborative working environment, Career development opportunities

Interested?

If you are a Business Analyst, Business Systems Consultant, Functional Consultant or Project Consultant who enjoys getting to the root of problems and turning business requirements into practical technology solutions, we would be keen to hear from you.

Apply now with your CV for a confidential discussion.

hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:

Ihan tavallisia töitä erityisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakua täältä.

Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. title: Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja
description:
TULE LASTENHOITAJAKSI HERTTONIEMENRANNAN MONTESSORIIN

Työsi tapahtuu leikkikoulumme 1-6 -vuotiaiden lasten parissa. Työssäsi huolehdit lasten kasvatuksen ja hoivan lisäksi arjen askareista.

Meillä pääset osallistumaan montessoripedagogiikkaa toteuttavien päiväkotien arkeen. Työskentelet laaja-alaisen eri ammattiryhmistä koostuvan asiantuntija työyhteisön jäsenenä. Helsingin Montessorilla on yli 40 vuoden kokemus palveluntuottajana, jolla on nykyisin kahdeksan päiväkotia.

Arvostamme kokemusta montessoripedagogiikasta.

Etsimme sinua toimimaan Helsingin Herttoniemenrannassa sijaitsevaan päiväkotiimme. Herttoniemenrannan Montessori-leikkikoulussa on 1 - 6-vuotiaita lapsia kahdessa ryhmässä.

Lastenhoitajana pääset toteuttamaan montessoripedagogista varhaiskasvatusta. Arvostamme sensitiivistä suhtautumistasi lapsiin sekä heidän kasvatukseensa ja huolenpitoonsa. Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajana huolehdit tiimisi kanssa varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman tavoitteiden suunnittelusta ja totetumisesta. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on jatkuva arviointi ja työn kehittäminen.

Työ edellyttää varhaiskasvatuslain mukaista ammatillista tutkintoa.

title: Project Manager, Environmental Scientist
description:
Ontario - Environmental Project Manager or Senior Project Manager

Site Assessment, Remediation and Reclamation

Locations: Ontario
Employment Type: Full-time, permanent
Work Arrangement: Office-based or hybrid, with fieldwork and travel based on project requirements
Experience Level: Intermediate to Senior

Build Your Career. Lead Meaningful Environmental Work.

Are you looking for an opportunity to manage environmental projects that move sites from assessment through remediation, reclamation, redevelopment, and closure?

MEMS is seeking an Environmental Project Manager (s) to join our growing team in the Ontario market. This opportunity can be tailored to an experienced Project Manager ready to expand their technical and leadership capabilities to a Senior Project Manager who can lead complex portfolios, strengthen client relationships, and mentor developing professionals.

You will work with multidisciplinary teams on environmental site assessment, contaminated-site remediation, reclamation, risk assessment, construction support, and regulatory closure projects throughout Canada. Depending on your experience, you may lead a portfolio of projects independently or manage complex, multi-site programs involving technical specialists, field teams, subcontractors, regulators, and client representatives.

At MEMS, project management is more than tracking schedules and budgets. It is about understanding the environmental challenge, building the right team, helping clients make informed decisions, and delivering technically sound, commercially responsible, and defensible outcomes.

The Work You Will Lead

Your project portfolio may include:

  • Phase I, II, and III environmental site assessments;
  • Contaminated-site investigation and conceptual site model development;
  • Remediation planning, implementation, and performance monitoring;
  • Risk assessment and risk-based site management strategies;
  • Brownfield redevelopment and site-closure planning;
  • Pre-reclamation assessments and detailed site assessments;
  • Reclamation, revegetation, vegetation monitoring, and site maintenance programs;
  • Reclamation certificate and Certificate of Restoration support;
  • Construction environmental monitoring and contractor coordination;
  • Regulatory submissions, database reporting, and project closeout; and
  • Multi-site environmental portfolios for energy, industrial, commercial, infrastructure, government, and other clients.

What You Will Accomplish

Deliver Successful Projects

  • Translate client objectives and contractual commitments into practical scopes, work plans, budgets, schedules, milestones, and resource plans.
  • Lead projects through planning, execution, monitoring, change management, reporting, and closeout.
  • Coordinate technical specialists, field personnel, subcontractors, suppliers, and other contributors so that responsibilities and timelines are clear.
  • Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and client expectations.
  • Identify emerging issues early and implement or recommend practical recovery strategies.
  • Ensure deliverables are technically sound, complete, consistent, and defensible.

Lead Environmental Programs

  • Interpret historical, published, regulatory, and site-specific information to develop a clear understanding of site conditions.
  • Develop and communicate conceptual site models, key environmental issues, data gaps, and recommended next steps.
  • Plan and oversee site assessment, remediation, reclamation, monitoring, and closure activities.
  • Compile, interpret, and communicate technical findings through reports, presentations, work plans, and regulatory submissions.
  • Develop practical, risk-informed environmental management and remedial strategies appropriate to the site and client objectives.
  • Review technical deliverables and regulatory submissions at a level appropriate to your experience and professional qualifications.

Manage Financial and Commercial Performance

  • Develop realistic estimates, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, and cost-to-complete projections.
  • Track actual costs, commitments, progress, accruals, milestones, and project risks.
  • Work collaboratively with Finance and operational leaders to support accurate billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting.
  • Manage scope changes through timely documentation, client communication, authorization, and implementation.
  • Contribute technical and project-delivery insight to proposals, fee estimates, work plans, and contract reviews.

Build Trusted Client Relationships

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for assigned clients and stakeholders.
  • Understand client priorities, success measures, decision-making requirements, and communication preferences.
  • Provide clear, timely updates on progress, risks, financial position, decisions, changes, and upcoming milestones.
  • Build trust through responsive service, sound judgment, technical credibility, and consistent follow-through.
  • Identify opportunities to provide additional value and support the development of recurring client relationships.
  • At the senior level, contribute to client growth plans, networking, proposal strategy, and the development of new business opportunities.

Strengthen the Team

  • Create clarity within project teams by confirming responsibilities, priorities, decision rights, and deadlines.
  • Provide practical coaching and technical or project-management guidance to developing professionals.
  • Promote respectful communication, knowledge sharing, teamwork, and early escalation of capacity or competency concerns.
  • At the senior level, mentor Project Managers and technical staff, support competency development, and provide oversight across complex or multi-site portfolios.
  • Share lessons learned and help improve MEMS’ project tools, estimating practices, reporting, workflows, and quality controls.

The Level of the Role

We recognize that strong candidates may bring different combinations of technical knowledge, client experience, and project leadership. The successful candidate may be hired as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager based on demonstrated capability.

Salary range for this position in Ontario is $96,000.00 to 150,000.00 depending on experience and level.

title: Project Manager (Highway Infrastructure)
description:
An exciting opportunity exists for a motivated and results-driven Project Manager to join our team based out of either our Calgary, Camrose, Ponoka or Red Deer offices. This full-time salaried position plays a key role in supporting the future growth and operational success of our highway maintenance contracts.

We’re looking for a self-starter with a strong background in highway maintenance, construction, and/or engineering, who brings technical skills, business acumen, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Mainroad Alberta Contracting manages four long-term highway maintenance contracts (CMAs 512, 513, 515 & 516). These contracts cover over 9,200 kilometres of provincial highways and 160+ bridges across the counties of Camrose, Flagstaff, Strathcona, Beaver, Wainwright, Vermilion River, Red Deer, Lacombe, Ponoka, and Wetaskiwin. Mainroad Chinook Contracting delivers highway maintenance services on the Calgary South East Stoney Trail (SEST) urban freeway.

As part of the Mainroad Group—an employee-owned company and a recognized leader in innovative, safe, and reliable infrastructure services across Canada—you’ll work in a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will be offered a competitive compensation package including comprehensive health and dental benefits, performance-based bonus, paid vacation, auto allowance, RRSP plan, and share purchase plan!

The successful candidate shall have the following qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in highway maintenance, civil construction, infrastructure and/or engineering.
  • Professional designations such as P.Eng., E.I.T., C.E.T., and/or PMP is considered an asset.

  • Valid Class 5 Driver’s License with a satisfactory driver’s abstract.

This role combines project management, estimating, client relations, operational leadership, and continuous improvement responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Estimating, Bidding & Contract Management

  • Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotations, proposals, and tender submissions for bridge, paving, line painting, traffic control, and highway maintenance projects.

Project Management & Client Relations

  • Develop project execution plans, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, and performance objectives.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship
description:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.


About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

title: Senior Building Surveyor
description:
About the Opportunity
This is a strong move for a Chartered Building Surveyor who wants the variety and backing of a major consultancy with a culture of collaboration and knowledge-sharing.
A globally renowned multidisciplinary consultancy are growing their Bristol Building Surveying team and are looking for a Senior Building Surveyor who wants proper client exposure, technical breadth and a visible role within a collaborative local setup. You would be joining the Buildings and Places business, working closely with surveyors, designers, engineers, consultants and project managers.
The work spans refurbishment, improvement and modernisation projects across high-profile public and private sector clients, while still offering a strong mix of professional Building Surveying duties.
Alongside delivery, there is scope to manage client relationships, support bids, mentor junior surveyors and help shape the growth of the Bristol team. For someone looking for progression, profile and a broader platform, it is a strong opportunity.

Responsibilities of the Role

The role combines project work, professional services, client management, team support and commercial input. Responsibilities are likely to include:

  • Leading refurbishment, improvement and modernisation projects across varied client portfolios
  • Preparing feasibility studies, specifications, estimates, statutory approvals and technical documentation
  • Administering contracts using JCT, NEC and other standard forms
  • Delivering surveys, inspections, schedules and wider professional Building Surveying advice
  • Managing regional schemes and coordinating multiple live projects
  • Developing client relationships and contributing to bids and new business opportunities
  • Mentoring and line managing junior Building Surveyors, including APC support


About You
This will suit a technically confident Building Surveyor who wants more profile, influence and room to progress. You will ideally bring:

  • A RICS-accredited Building Surveying degree or similar qualification
  • Chartered status, or strong post-qualification experience at senior level
  • Strong technical knowledge across project-led and professional Building Surveying services
  • Confidence managing clients, workloads, programmes and competing priorities
  • Commercial awareness, including bids, profitability and business development
  • Experience producing specifications, feasibility studies, asset reviews and client requirements
  • Good understanding of Health and Safety, statutory compliance and quality-led delivery
  • Exposure to Dilapidations, Party Wall, Fire Risk or Access Assessments would be useful
  • Strong document production skills, with AutoCAD, NBS or Revit experience an advantage



What's on Offer?
The main draw is the balance: national consultancy backing, high-quality project exposure and a growing Bristol team where your contribution should still be visible. It offers the scale and career infrastructure of a global business, with the chance to play a meaningful role locally.
The package includes:

  • £55,000 to £65,000 per annum
  • Hybrid working and flexible holiday allowances
  • Tailored health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle benefits
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Progression within a forward-thinking global consultancy
  • The chance to mentor others, build client relationships and strengthen your profile in the Bristol market



Ready?

If you are doing good work where you are, but feel the next move needs to offer more variety, stronger client exposure and a clearer route forward, this is worth a conversation.

The role gives you the backing of a major multidisciplinary consultancy, interesting public and private sector work, and a growing Bristol team where a Senior Building Surveyor can have genuine influence.


Your point of contact for this role is Jonny Warman
