title: Endokrinologian erikoislääkäri, Kemi
description:
Pohjoisessa työ ja elämä kulkevat samaa latua. Lapin hyvinvointialueella tulet osaksi tiivistä työyhteisöä, jossa hommat hoidetaan titteleihin katsomatta ja yhteen hiileen puhaltaen. Lapin upea luonto, ainutlaatuiset maisemat ja mahdollisuudet urakehitykseen antavat elämään huippuhetkiä. Me annamme tilaa ja tukea, jotta sinä voit kulkea itsesi näköisen polun.

Lapin hyvinvointialue hakee endokrinologian erikoislääkäriä vakituiseen virkasuhteeseen Länsi-Pohjan sairaalaan. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan

Sisätautien poliklinikalla on erinomainen moniammatillinen tiimi, johon kuuluu edustus jokaiselta suppealta sisätautien erikoisalalta ja kokeneet hoitajat. Konsultaatiot onnistuvat nopeasti ja helposti. Yhteishenki on erinomainen.

Erikoislääkärin virkaan tuleva voi halutessaan osallistua vapaamuotoiseen sisätautien takapäivystysrinkiin Lapin keskussairaalassa. Osa-aikaisuus ja muut erityistoiveet otetaan huomioon. Työnkuvaa saa muokata myös osittaiseen sisätautiosastosijoitukseen ja soveltuvin osin etätyöskentelyyn. Koulutuksiin osallistuminen on itsestäänselvyys ja myös toivottavaa.

Kelpoisuusehtona on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) 4 §:n mukainen laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä sekä endokrinologian erikoislääkärin pätevyys tai sisätautien erikoislääkärin pätevyys ja endokrinologian ja/tai diabeteksen hoidon erikoisosaaminen. Myös loppuvaiheen endokrinologiaan erikoistuvat lääkärit huomioidaan haussa.

Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Lääkärisopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa. Tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Henkilöstön rokotussuojan osalta noudatamme työn ja tartuntatautilain edellyttämää rokotussuojaa.

Tule meille huippuhommiin hakemalla tehtävään Kuntarekry-palvelussa 5.11.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä!

title: Osa-aikainen sisällöntuottaja, K-Citymarket Helsinki Malmi
description:
Sykkiikö sydämesi lyhytvideoille? Pysytkö kärryillä siitä, mikä TikTokissa, Reelsissä ja YouTube Shortsissa trendaa juuri nyt? K-Citymarket Malmi etsii innokasta ja näkemyksellistä sisällöntuottajaa tuomaan kauppamme arjen, tuotteet ja kampanjat eloon sosiaalisen median kanavissamme.

Malmi on monikulttuurinen, värikäs ja eläväinen alue. Haluamme, että somesisältömme puhuttelee ja tavoittaa kauppamme koko asiakaskuntaa raikkaalla otteella!

Mitä tehtävään kuuluu?
- Lyhytvideoiden suunnittelu, kuvaaminen ja editointi (TikTok, Instagram & Facebook, YouTube). - Trendien tunnistaminen ja pikaisten, ajankohtaisten videoiden tekeminen kaupan arjesta. - Kaupan henkilökunnan ja tuotteiden esitteleminen rennolla ja innostavalla otteella. - Sisällön mukauttaminen eri kohderyhmille ja eri kielillä toimivaksi.
Mitä toivomme sinulta?
- Kokemusta lyhytvideomuodoista ja niiden editoinnista älypuhelimella tai editointisovelluksilla. - Erinomaisia viestintätaitoja ja rohkeutta esiintyä tai heittäytyä videoiden tekemiseen. - Monipuolista kielitaitoa: Suomen kielen lisäksi laaja muu kielitaito katsotaan suureksi eduksi, sillä haluamme luoda sisältöä, joka puhuttelee Malmin monimuotoista asiakaskuntaa. - Aikaansaavaa ja itsenäistä työotetta - tunnistat hyvät sisällönaiheet heti myymälässä liikkuessasi.
Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Innostavan ja näkyvän roolin yhdessä pääkaupunkiseudun vilkkaimmista K-Citymarketeista. - Joustavat työajat: Tehtävä sopii erinomaisesti esimerkiksi opintojen oheen. - Jatkomahdollisuudet: Hyvälle tekijälle on tarjolla mahdollisuus sesonki- ja kesätöihin sekä jatkoon talon sisällä. - Perehdytyksen ja tuen kaupan tiimiltä, jotta pääset toteuttamaan omia ideoitasi matalalla kynnyksellä
Työaika ja palkkaus

Työsuhde on osa-aikainen ja sopii joustavasti erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin. Viikkotunnit ja palkkaus sovitaan tapauskohtaisesti kandidaatin kokemuksen, osaamisen ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?

Älä lähetä meille pelkkää perinteistä ansioluetteloa, sillä haluamme nähdä kädenjälkesi!

Lähetä hakemus ja lyhyt näytevideosi/työnäytteesi/linkki sosiaalisen median profiiliisi, jossa näkyy tyylisi ja videontekotaitosi.

Hae pian, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

Voit näyttää meille, että olet valmis oppimaan ja tarttumaan uusiin mahdollisuuksiin. Suorita maksuton LET'S K! Duunitaidot -koulutus ja liitä suoritusmerkintä hakemukseesi. Koulutuksesta saat käytännön vinkkejä työnhakuun, oman suunnan löytämiseen ja työelämään. Koulutuksen löydät osoitteesta kesko.fi/duunitaidot.

Rekrytointiin liittyvän tietosuojaselosteen saat rekrytoivasta kaupasta.

Me K-ryhmässä arvostamme monimuotoisuutta ja uskomme, että erilaiset taustat ja näkökulmat ovat avain menestykseen. Pyrimme luomaan työympäristön, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus kehittyä. Yhdenvertaisuus, syrjimättömyys ja oikeudenmukaisuus ovat keskeisiä periaatteitamme rekrytoinnissa, palkitsemisessa ja urakehityksessä.

title: Junior Art Director (m/w/d)
description:
As one of Europe’s most recognized streetwear brands, 6PM stands out not only through our designs and unique vibe, but above all through our community. Whether it’s pop-up tours, our own record label, or collaborations – we don’t just make fashion. We create culture.

And now, we’re looking for you!

6PM grew through culture, not ad spend. Our founder's voice, viral moments and drops built the brand, and every campaign has to feel like it came from the same place. As Junior Art Director, you work directly with our Brand Director to turn ideas into campaign concepts and visual stories that land with our audience across DACH and our new European markets.

This is a hands-on role. You'll pitch ideas, build mood boards, shape shoots and make

sure what we put out looks and feels unmistakably 6PM.

Aufgaben

  • Develop campaign concepts and visual storytelling for drops, collaborations and brand moments, together with the Brand Director
  • Translate briefs into mood boards, key visuals, treatments and shot lists
  • Support on shoots and productions, working with photographers, stylists and videographers
  • Keep visual consistency across social, e-commerce, OOH, retail and events
  • Hand over clear creative direction to the Marketing team (Social, Creative Marketing, Performance) so activation stays on brand
  • Stay close to streetwear, music, sports and youth culture and bring references into the team before they go mainstream

Qualifikation

  • 2 to 4 years in art direction or design, at a brand, agency or creative studio
  • A portfolio that shows concept thinking, not just execution
  • Strong eye for typography, composition, photography and motion
  • Confident in Adobe CC; Figma and basic motion/video editing are a plus
  • Genuine connection to streetwear and youth culture
  • Comfortable in a fast, founder-led environment where ideas move quickly and not everything is structured yet
  • Fluent English; German is a plus

Why 6PM

Real creative ownership early in your career, direct exposure to the Brand Director and

founder, and the chance to help define how the brand shows up as it expands across

Europe.

Benefits

  • Modern office in Berlin, complimentary drinks & work-from-home Fridays
  • Contribution towards a gym membership as well as various mobility benefits
  • Individual training and development opportunities to support your professional and personal growth
  • Regular team events and incentives
  • Flexible working hours based on trust within a young, motivated team
  • Attractive salary package with a variable compensation component

Want to be a part of 6PM? We'd love to hear from you!

title: End User Computing Senior Engineer
description:
About the role

FDM is a global business and technology consultancy seeking an End User Computing Senior Engineer to work within the insurance sector.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract, based in London, with a salary of £70,000 per annum. The role requires regular attendance at a London office, particularly to support hardware testing and other activities that need to be completed on site.

You will join an End User Computing team responsible for maintaining reliable EUC services and supporting business-as-usual operations, continuous improvement and project delivery.

This is a hands-on technical role involving the resolution of third-line escalations, the delivery of internal changes and contributions to wider projects. You will also help develop the organisation’s EUC strategy, designing and implementing solutions that improve services and the overall end-user experience.

Responsibilities
  • Resolve third-line EUC escalations and support the continued operation of end-user computing services, minimising disruption to users.
  • Deliver small changes, continuous improvement initiatives and technical activities across internal and external projects.
  • Design and implement effective EUC solutions that support the organisation’s technology strategy and future requirements.
  • Communicate technical solutions clearly to senior stakeholders and wider project teams, including colleagues without a technical background.
  • Maintain accurate and accessible EUC documentation, assess the impact of proposed changes and produce clearly documented change requests.
About You
  • Proven experience working as an EUC Engineer or Senior Engineer in a comparable environment, including acting as Technical Lead on EUC-related projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including the management of Windows, Android, iOS and macOS devices.
  • Practical knowledge of Windows Autopilot, Windows 11, Windows Autopatch, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365 and Windows 365.
  • Experience producing low-level and high-level technical designs, supported by strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a proactive and adaptable approach to managing priorities and working both independently and collaboratively.

Desirable experience:

  • Conditional Access
  • Microsoft Defender XDR
  • Microsoft Defender for Identity
  • Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365
  • Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps

FDM is an award-winning global leader in tech and business talent solutions, backed by more than 35 years of industry experience. We have centres across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 2,500 employees.

FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer, currently listed on the FTSE4Good Index and as a 2026 Financial Times UK ‘Best Employer’.

FDM Group is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, provincial or local laws.

Why join us
  • Career coaching, mentoring and access to upskilling throughout your entire FDM career
  • Assignments with global companies and opportunities to work abroad
  • Opportunities to reskill and upskill, develop non-linear career paths and build expertise within your field
  • Annual leave
  • Workplace pension

title: Assembler B
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

_**Job Title:  Assembly B**_

_**Job Code** **: 45342**_

_**Job Location:** **Gardena, CA**_

_**Schedule: 9/80:  Employees work 9 out of every 14 days- totaling 80 hours worked- and have every other Friday off**_

**Job Description:**

Under close supervision of the Lead and/or Production Supervisor, the Assembler B position is responsible for simple and repetitive job assignments, consisting of both Magnetic and Electro Mechanical assembly work ranging from simple to semi-complex in accordance with work order instructions, Engineering Drawings and Manufacturing Process Specifications. Due to the varying production requirements at the time of hire, this position may require soldering skills to Military specifications or ANSI-J-STD-001 in addition to mechanical/assembly skills or may require only mechanical/assembly skills.  This is to be determined by the Manager/Supervisor based on the tasks and production needs.

**Essential Functions:**

- Assemble Magnetic assemblies through all stages of the process, from core and coil assembly to final assembly.
- Basic understanding of standard hardware installation sequence.
- Ability to read hardware descriptions on Engineering BOM and physically identify the characteristics of the hardware.

**Qualifications:**

- Requires a High School Diploma or equivalent and a minimum of 4 years of prior relevant experience or 2 years post-Secondary/Associates Degree with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience.
- Minimum 2-5 years ’experience assembling electro/mechanical hardware as stated above, preferably to military requirements and specifications.
- Ability to pass soldering test and be certified ANSI-J-STD-001 and/or IPC610 as required.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Perform varnish and heat treat operations for all products as required
- Perform simple to semi-complex cable assembly per shop order instructions and engineering drawing.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California is $39,500 - $73,500. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

title: Regional Director
description:
Why Join Info-Tech?

· Flexible hybrid working, built on trust, autonomy, and accountability

· The opportunity to work with CIOs and senior executives across some of Western Australia's most influential organisations.

· A highly competitive base salary with uncapped earning potential.

· Comprehensive benefits and ongoing investment in your professional development.

· Annual global recognition trips for top performers (past destinations have included Turkey, the Dominican Republic, and Mexico).

· You’ll be part of one of Info-Tech's highest-performing teams, where people, culture, and collaboration are every bit as important as results.

What You'll Do

As a Regional Director, you'll own and grow a strategic territory across Western Australia, partnering with technology and business leaders to help them solve complex organisational challenges.

You'll be responsible for:

· Developing new executive relationships and growing Info-Tech's presence across the NSW market.

· Managing the full sales lifecycle—from strategic prospecting through to negotiation, close, and ongoing account growth.

· Leading consultative, value-based conversations with CIOs, CDOs, CISOs, CFOs, and other senior executives.

· Identifying client priorities and aligning Info-Tech's research, advisory, consulting, and diagnostic services to deliver measurable business outcomes.

· Building and managing a healthy pipeline through proactive business development, referrals, networking, marketing campaigns, and executive engagement.

· Delivering compelling executive presentations tailored to each client's strategic priorities.

· Collaborating closely with our analysts, executive advisors, and subject matter experts to bring the right expertise to every client engagement.

· Maintaining accurate pipeline management and forecasting through Salesforce.

· Contributing market insights and client feedback to continuously improve our products, services, and go-to-market approach.

· Continuing to develop professionally through coaching, collaboration, and ongoing learning.

What Success Looks Like

You'll thrive in this role if you:

· Build trusted relationships that position you as a strategic advisor rather than a traditional salesperson.

· Enjoy creating opportunities, navigating complex organisations, and winning executive-level engagements.

· Take ownership of your territory and consistently generate new business while growing existing strategic partnerships.

· Balance commercial drive with genuine curiosity about your clients' businesses and challenges.

· Work collaboratively, celebrate team success, and contribute positively to a high-performing culture.

What You'll Bring

· A proven track record of success in enterprise B2B sales, strategic account management, consulting, or business development, with at least 10 years' experience working with complex organisations.

· Demonstrated success building trusted relationships with CIOs, senior technology leaders, and executive stakeholders, ideally across the Western Australian market.

· A consultative, outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to understand business priorities, challenge thinking constructively, and connect technology initiatives to measurable organisational outcomes.

· Strong commercial acumen and executive presence, with the confidence to engage in strategic conversations while remaining authentic, approachable, and client-centric.

· A genuine sense of ownership and accountability—you take responsibility for your territory, your clients, and your results.

· Intellectual curiosity and a desire to continually learn, ask thoughtful questions, and deepen your understanding of technology, business, and leadership.

· Resilience, adaptability, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles with patience, persistence, and professionalism.

· A collaborative mindset and a low-ego approach. You enjoy sharing ideas, celebrating team success, supporting your colleagues, and contributing to a positive, high-performing culture.

· A growth mindset with a willingness to seek feedback, embrace coaching, and continuously develop both professionally and personally.

· Experience using CRM platforms such as Salesforce and the Microsoft 365 suite.

· A current Australian driver's licence and unrestricted Australian working rights.

· A tertiary qualification in business, technology, or a related discipline is advantageous but not essential.

If you're looking to join a high-performing team that believes exceptional results and exceptional culture go hand in hand, we'd love to hear from you.

#LI-MP1

title: Document Controller
description:
Document Controller / Construction Administrator - High-End Residential
Location: Farnham, Surrey, with site visits to Godalming
Salary: £40,000-£45,000 per annum, dependent on experience, plus package
Working arrangement: Flexible working between home, Farnham office and project site in Godalming.

A well-established super prime residential main contractor is looking for an organised Document Controller / Construction Administrator to join its team in Farnham.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with construction document control experience who enjoys keeping projects organised and using technology to improve how information is managed. You will initially support the wider business, with the potential to take responsibility for document control and administration on a large residential project near Godalming.

What's in It for You?
  • Salary of £40,000-£45,000, depending on experience
  • Competitive benefits package
  • Working from home available
  • Opportunity to take ownership of document control on a major super prime residential scheme
  • High-quality projects close to home, without the daily London commute
  • Supportive, professional and sociable working environment
  • A business keen to use modern software and AI to improve day-to-day working
  • Strong pipeline of secured projects
The Role
As Document Controller / Construction Administrator, you will help ensure project information is accurate, organised and readily available. Working closely with office and site teams, your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing construction drawings, specifications and project documents
  • Maintaining document registers, revision records and clear filing systems
  • Issuing and tracking information so teams have access to current documents
  • Using the company's Smartsheet-based document control system
  • Coordinating information between project teams, consultants and subcontractors
  • Monitoring outstanding information and following up with the relevant people
  • Supporting project administration, correspondence and meeting records
  • Using Claude and other digital tools to streamline appropriate administration tasks
  • Visiting the Godalming project to support the site team
About the Company
The employer is the countryside division of an established luxury residential construction group with nearly 30 years' experience. Based in Farnham, it delivers bespoke private homes across the southern counties, providing a complete service from pre-construction through to finished homes.

Projects include prestigious new-build country houses and the restoration and refurbishment of existing properties, including listed homes. The business works closely with clients, architects and specialist trades, with a strong focus on craftsmanship, attention to detail and high-quality finishes.

About You
To be considered for this Document Controller / Construction Administrator position, you should have:
  • Previous document control or site admin experience within construction industry
  • Excellent organisational skills and close attention to detail
  • Strong computer literacy and confidence learning new software
  • Familiarity with AI tools and an interest in using them in your daily work
  • The ability to learn the company's Smartsheet system and use Claude effectively
  • Confidence communicating with office teams, site staff and external contacts
  • A proactive approach and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Easy access to Farnham and Godalming, ideally living in Surrey, Hampshire or West Sussex
  • Flexibility to work from the office and visit sites
Previous experience with Smartsheet or Claude would be useful, but the ability to learn quickly is more important.

Apply Today
If you are a Document Controller or Construction Administrator looking for a well-paid role with a growing residential contractor, apply now through CV-Library.

Alternatively, send your CV to or contact Alex Wallace on LinkedIn for a confidential discussion.

Whether you're actively seeking a new opportunity or just exploring your options, feel free to get in touch—I'd love to help you take the next step in your career.

title: Physiotherapist
description:
Make a difference at a growing, innovative mental health and addiction organization recognized as a centre of excellence in people-centred care. Join a team of supportive colleagues who are passionate about improving lives and committed to quality, collaboration, and continuous learning.

In this unique role, you'll work alongside physicians, nurse practitioners, and a broad interdisciplinary team to provide comprehensive musculoskeletal assessments, evidence-based treatment, and chronic pain management and education for patients receiving in-patient care for mental health and addiction. You'll have the opportunity to treat both new and pre-existing MSK conditions while contributing to a holistic model of recovery that addresses the whole person; physical and mental health together.

This contract opportunity is ideal for a physiotherapist looking to diversify or grow their practice, deepen their experience in chronic pain care, and make a meaningful contribution to patient recovery in a truly integrated care setting.

What you'll be doing:

  • Conduct thorough assessments of patients' physical conditions and functional status
  • Develop individualized treatment plans that integrate physical therapy techniques to improve mobility and enhance overall function
  • Implement evidence-based interventions including therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, and other specialized techniques, tailored to the unique needs of patients managing pain alongside mental health concerns
  • Collaborate closely with physicians, nurse practitioners, registered massage therapists, and other healthcare professionals to ensure a fully integrated approach to patient care
  • Educate patients on self-management strategies and the role of physical activity in pain management, fostering empowerment and active participation in their own recovery
  • Monitor patient progress, adjust treatment plans as needed, and maintain accurate, detailed records in compliance with healthcare regulations and HHC documentation standards
  • Contribute to a positive, supportive clinic culture grounded in compassion, understanding, and empathy for patients navigating both chronic pain and mental health challenges

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physiotherapy from an accredited institution
  • Registered and in good standing with the College of Physiotherapists of Ontario
  • Demonstrated experience assessing and treating a broad range of musculoskeletal conditions, both acute and chronic
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with patients, their families, and interdisciplinary healthcare teams
  • Empathy, compassion, and a trauma-informed approach to care, emphasizing the importance of the mind-body connection in the treatment of pain
  • Proven organizational skills and the ability to manage a diverse caseload efficiently
  • Dedication to ongoing professional development and a commitment to staying informed about the latest developments in the field of physiotherapy
  • Commitment to timely, accurate clinical documentation in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards
  • Adherence to privacy legislation and organizational policies regarding the use and access of patient health information

Why work with us

Homewood Health is Canada’s largest and leading service provider for medically focused, evidence-based treatment of mental health and addiction disorders. Our organizational culture values service excellence, integrity, collaboration and innovation. Our people make a difference!

  • In-house client base waiting for you when you start
  • Highly competitive 75/25 fee-split an Independent Contractor
  • Flexible working hours
  • Reception services and full billing support
  • On-site fitness facility and physiotherapy equipment
  • Continuing Education Opportunities
  • Amazing opportunity to build a practice

As an equal-opportunity employer, Homewood Health is committed to employment accessibility, diversity, equity, and inclusion. For this reason, we encourage applications from members of equity-seeking groups including women, racialized and indigenous communities, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities/expressions.

Join us at Homewood Health™ and be part of a diverse team helping Canadians live healthier, more productive, and fulfilling lives.

Please apply online or email your resume and cover letter directly to Rebecca Thompson, Manager of Recreation and Integrated Health; rthompson@homewoodhealth.com

title: Varastotyöntekijä, Turku
description:
Varastotyöntekijä Turun telakalle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Keitä asiakkaamme on?

Asiakkaamme on varasto- ja logistiikkapalveluja tarjoava yritys, joka huolehtii asiakkaidensa varastojen ja myymälöiden tavaravirroista. Palveluihin kuuluvat:

- Tuotteiden vastaanotto ja purku: toimitetut tuotteet vastaanotetaan ja puretaan asiakkaan varastossa tai myymälässä.

- Lajittelu ja tarkistus: tuotteet lajitellaan, ja niiden kunto ja määrä tarkistetaan.

- Hyllytys: tuotteet hyllytetään oikeille paikoilleen sovitun hyllytysjärjestelmän mukaisesti.

- Siisteys ja järjestys: hyllyt pidetään siisteinä ja järjestyksessä, jotta varasto on aina edustava.

- Varastonhallinta: hoidetaan inventointi ja varastotilan optimointi

- Raportointi: työstä ja havaituista ongelmista, kuten puuttuvista tai vioittuneista tuotteista, raportoidaan säännöllisesti.

Viihdytkö vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä, jossa päivät eivät ole koskaan samanlaisia? Hoidatko hommat huolellisesti silloinkin, kun kiirettä riittää? Silloin sinua saatamme etsiä!

Missä ja mitä?

Työpaikkasi sijaitsee Turun telakan alueella. Työ on hektistä: varastossa käy päivittäin asentajia noutamassa varaosia, ja liikenne on vilkasta. Sinä pidät huolen siitä, että oikeat osat löytyvät oikeaan aikaan ja varasto pysyy järjestyksessä.

Työhösi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- varaosien ja tavaroiden vastaanotto, hyllytys ja keräily

- asentajien palveleminen ja varaosien luovutus

- trukilla ja siirtopinkkarilla työskentely

- varaston järjestyksestä, siisteydestä ja turvallisuudesta huolehtiminen

Saat työhön hyvän perehdytyksen talon kokeneilta ammattilaisilta.

Keneltä tämä työ luonnistuu?

Toivomme sinulta:

- alan tutkintoa tai vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta varastotehtävistä

- trukin ja siirtopinkkarin käyttötaitoa

- vastuullisuutta, huolellisuutta ja kykyä pitää langat käsissä kiireenkin keskellä

- hyviä tiimityötaitoja ja palvelualttiutta

- englannin kielen taitoa, joka katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä

Pyydämme sinua esittämään todistukset aiemmista työsuhteistasi sekä mahdollisen suosittelijan yhteystiedot.

Mitä tarjoamme?

- vakituisen työsuhteen ja säännöllisen päivätyön

- hyvän perehdytyksen ja kokeneen työyhteisön tuen

- palkkauksen PAM:n työehtosopimuksen mukaan (varastotyöntekijät)

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si hakuportaalimme kautta. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

title: Manuaalikoneistaja, Akaa
description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista manuaalikoneistajaa Akaaseen konepajateollisuuteen. Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten koneistus- ja metallialan töiden parissa osana ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä.

Etsimme ennen kaikkea käytännön osaajaa, jolla on kokemusta manuaalikoneistuksesta ja varma ote itsenäiseen työskentelyyn. Tässä tehtävässä tarkkuus, huolellisuus ja laadukas työnjälki ovat tärkeässä roolissa.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Työskentelet perinteisessä konepajaympäristössä manuaalisten työstökoneiden parissa. Työtehtäviin kuuluu kappaleiden valmistamista ja muokkaamista piirustusten mukaisesti sekä koneistusprosessin eri vaiheita.

Työpäiviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

* manuaalikoneistusta sorvilla ja jyrsimellä

* kappaleiden valmistamista teknisten piirustusten mukaan

* kappaleiden mittaamista ja laadunvarmistusta

* työstömenetelmien ja työkalujen valitsemista

* materiaalien ja kappaleiden käsittelyä

* valmiiden kappaleiden viimeistelyä

* koneiden ja oman työpisteen asianmukaisesta kunnosta ja siisteydestä huolehtimista.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on aikaisempaa kokemusta manuaalikoneistuksesta ja riittävä osaaminen itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.

Tehtävässä tarvitset:

* kokemusta manuaalisorvauksesta ja/tai manuaalijyrsinnästä

* teknisten piirustusten lukutaitoa

* mittavälineiden hyvää hallintaa

* materiaalien ja koneistusmenetelmien tuntemusta

* tarkkaa ja huolellista työskentelyotetta

* valmiutta työskennellä itsenäisesti

* riittävää suomen kielen taitoa työohjeiden ymmärtämiseen ja turvalliseen työskentelyyn.

Kone- ja metallialan koulutus antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan, mutta käytännön koneistusosaaminen ja aikaisempi työkokemus ovat tehtävässä tärkeimmässä roolissa.

MILLAISTA TYÖ ON KÄYTÄNNÖSSÄ?

Työskentelet konepajaympäristössä, jossa valmistetaan ja muokataan erilaisia metallikappaleita teollisuuden tarpeisiin. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja vaihtelevaa, ja pääset näkemään konkreettisesti oman kädenjälkesi valmistettavissa tuotteissa.

Tehtävässä korostuvat huolellinen työskentely, mittatarkkuus ja kyky hahmottaa kappaleiden valmistaminen kokonaisuutena. Arvostamme oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta sekä halua tehdä työ laadukkaasti loppuun asti.

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja pitkäaikaisen manuaalikoneistajan työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään koneistusosaamistasi osana ammattitaitoista konepajaympäristöä.

Työpaikka sijaitsee Akaassa. Tehtävän tarkemmista työajoista ja palkkauksesta sovitaan osaamisen ja aikaisemman kokemuksen perusteella.

Saat ympärillesi työyhteisön, jossa tekemistä riittää ja jossa ammattitaitoisella manuaalikoneistajalla on tärkeä rooli tuotannon onnistumisessa.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos manuaalikoneistus on sinulle tuttua, osaat lukea piirustuksia ja mittavälineiden käyttö on sinulle luonteva osa työtä, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian – sopivan osaajan löydyttyä etenemme rekrytoinnissa nopeasti.

WORKNOW OY TYÖNANTAJANA

* Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi

* Pidämme sinut ajan tasalla koko prosessin ajan

* Lakisääteistä kattavampi työterveys alusta alkaen

* Luotettava työnantaja – asiat hoidetaan kuten sovitaan

Meille tärkeintä on, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt ja onnistut.

title: Logistics Operator
description:
WHAT TO EXPECT DAY TO DAY

The Logistics Operator is responsible for preparing orders for delivery, ensuring products are packed securely, and maintaining the smooth flow of goods from warehouse to customer. This includes processing and checking shipments, labelling packages, ensuring accurate documentation, and meeting deadlines.

RESPONSIBILITES / WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Accurately pick, pack, and label products for both internal and external customers.
  • Ensure that all orders are completed on time to meet customer expectations.
  • Prepare and load products for delivery.
  • Perform regular stock checks to confirm that inventory levels are accurate.
  • Assist with stock replenishment and rotation.
  • Inspect products for any damage or defects during picking and receiving processes.
  • Ensure that orders are completed accurately with no discrepancies.
  • Address and resolve any issues related to order mistakes or damaged goods.
  • Accurately prepare shipping labels, bills of lading, and other relevant documentation.
  • Coordinate with couriers or drivers to ensure timely collection and delivery of goods.
  • Maintain accurate records of all dispatch activities.
  • Follow all safety procedures in line with company policies and legal requirements
  • Ensure a clean, organised, and safe working environment
  • Ensure all material shortages or discrepancies are recorded and escalated appropriately
  • Ensure goods are ordered in a timely manner
  • Ensure all goods received from suppliers are damage free, and comply with the supporting paperwork.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

Experience: Previous experience in warehouse, logistics, or retail roles is an advantage but not essential.

Attention to Detail: Accuracy in order picking, packing, and documentation.

Organisational Skills: Ability to manage multiple orders and prioritise tasks efficiently.

Communication: Good verbal and written communication skills.

  • We work together
  • We believe in people
  • We won’t accept the ‘way it has always been done’

  • We’re trying to do the right thing

title: Security and Information Risk Advisor
description:
Are you ready to drive effective information security risk management for a vital public service? Join us as a Security and Information Risk Advisor within our Digital Risk & Security branch, where your expertise will guide our commitment to protecting Social Security Scotland. If you are passionate about cyber security and have a keen interest in safeguarding critical information, apply now to join our talented team and take the next step in your career.

As a Security and Information Risk Advisor, you will play a pivotal role in providing advice and guidance on the effective specification, implementation, and operation of cyber security controls. Collaborating closely with various stakeholders, you will conduct security risk assessments, investigate major breaches, and contribute to the development of information security policies, standards, and guidelines. This is a key technical position within Digital Risk & Security, focusing on ensuring compliance with legislation, regulation, and relevant standards.

Typical role level expectations:

- Provide advice and guidance on security strategies to manage identified risks and ensure adoption and adherence to standards.
- Obtain and act on vulnerability information and conduct security risk assessments and business impact analyses on complex information systems.
- Investigate major security breaches and recommend appropriate control improvements.
- Contribute to development of information security policy, standards and guidelines.
- Interpret information assurance and security policies and apply these to manage risks.
- Use control testing information to support information assurance assessments.

**Responsibilities**

- Conduct risk-based assurance reviews of internal solutions and third-party suppliers, assessing control effectiveness, identifying risks and vulnerabilities, and recommending remediation activities to support compliance and informed risk-based decision-making.
- Manage complex risks, issues, remediation activities, and lessons learned, applying appropriate risk methodologies and advising on risk impact, tolerance, and mitigation strategies.
- Design and review secure system architectures, applying architectural principles, patterns, and appropriate levels of rigour to deliver effective business outcomes.
- Assess the impact of vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and developments in security technologies on existing and future systems, recommending appropriate responses and controls.
- Build and maintain effective stakeholder relationships, managing expectations, resolving issues, and facilitating discussions on complex or high-risk matters, often within challenging timescales.
- Represent the security profession and communicate complex technical and risk concepts to a wide range of audiences, both internally and externally.
- Apply knowledge of systems, security, policy, business architecture, and legal or regulatory requirements to develop secure technical solutions and controls.

**Success Profiles**

We use an assessment framework called ‘Success Profiles’ which lists the elements we test and provides detailed descriptions of each. Find out more about the framework [here](https://www.gov.scot/publications/success-profiles-candidate-guide/).

For this post, the following Success Profile elements will be assessed:

**Experience:**

1. Knowledge of information security standards like ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST SP 800-53, combined with understanding of current legislation such as DPA 2018 and GDPR. Proven ability to interpret and apply these standards and legal requirements to ensure compliance and integrate best practices into organisational operations.
2. Demonstrable ability to evaluate the effectiveness of technical, physical, procedural, and personnel controls, recommend improvements, and work with stakeholders to implement proportionate risk mitigation measures that strengthen the organisation's overall security posture.

**Behaviours:**

- Communicating and Influencing (Level 3)
- Delivering at Pace (Level 3)


You can find out more about Success Profiles Behaviours [here](https://www.gov.scot/publications/success-profiles-candidate-guide/pages/behaviour-levels/).

**Technical / Professional Skills:**

This role is aligned to **Security and Information Risk Advisor** within the Government Digital and Data Profession.

These skills will be tested during the Technical Assessment if you are successful at sift stage. They will not be assessed at application stage.  Please review the following to understand the skill expectations: [Security and information risk - Information Assurance and Security: Security and information risk - gov.scot](https://www.gov.scot/publications/information-assurance-security-and-risk/pages/security-and-information-risk/#_Security_and_information_1)

**How to Apply**

Apply online, **you must provide a CV and Supporting Statement** (of no more than **750 words**) which provides evidence of how you meet the Experience and Behaviours listed in the Success Profiles above.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools can be used to support your application, but all statements and examples provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, and presented as your own) applications will be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action.

Please see our [candidate guidance](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/introduction/) for more information on acceptable and unacceptable uses of AI in recruitment.

Should a large number of applications be received, an initial sift may be conducted using the CV and Supporting Statement on the first Experience cirteria.  Candidates who pass the initial sift will have their applications fully assessed.

There may be a telephone interview prior to the final interview stage.

Candidates who are successful at sift stage will be invited to an interview which will assess the Experience and Behaviours, and a technical assessment comprising a scenario based task exercise which will assess the Technical Skills.

Full details of the interview and assessment process will be shared with shortlisted candidates once the sift has been completed.

We aim to provide feedback on request. However, if we receive a large number of applications it may not be possible for us to provide specific feedback on your application. We will provide feedback on request to candidates who attend an interview/assessment.

**Information Session**

We are holding a candidate information session for this role to provide you with information about the application and interview process as well as further information on the role and team. We will be talking about:

- The Security and Information Risk Advisor role and Digital Risk and Security team
- About Social Security Scotland

Social Security Scotland is an Executive Agency of the Scottish Government. Our benefits help people from all walks of life in Scotland. We offer rewarding careers and employ people across Scotland in a wide range of professions and roles. **Working Pattern**

We embrace a hybrid working style where all colleagues will spend time in either our Glasgow or Dundee offices. There is an expectation of a minimum 2 days per week in your assigned location, which will be either Glasgow or Dundee.  If you have specific questions about the role you are applying for, please contact us.

**Security checks**

Successful candidates must complete the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS), before they can be appointed. BPSS is comprised of four main pre-employment checks – Identity, Right to work, Employment History and a Criminal Record check (unspent convictions).

You can find out more about BPSS on the [UK Government website](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard), or read about the different levels of security checks in our [Candidate Guide](https://www.gov.scot/publications/recruitment-candidate-guide/pages/introduction/).

title: Environmental Project Manager
description:
Build Your Career. Lead Meaningful Environmental Work.

Are you looking for an opportunity to manage environmental projects that move sites from assessment through remediation, reclamation, redevelopment, and closure?
MEMS is seeking an Environmental Project Manager (s) or Senior Project Manager (s) to join our growing team in Alberta or British Columbia.

This opportunity can be tailored to an experienced Project Manager ready to expand their technical and leadership capabilities or to a Senior Project Manager who can lead complex portfolios, strengthen client relationships, and mentor developing professionals.
You will work with multidisciplinary teams on environmental site assessment, contaminated-site remediation, reclamation, risk assessment, and regulatory closure projects

The Project Manager may manage multiple low- to moderate-complexity projects or contribute project management leadership to more complex, multidisciplinary work under appropriate senior oversight. The role also supports client relationships, proposal development, project team effectiveness, mentorship, and continuous improvement of MEMS’ project delivery practices.

The Work You Will Lead

Your project portfolio may include:
• Phase I, II, and III environmental site assessments;
• Contaminated-site investigation and conceptual site model development;
• Remediation planning, implementation, and performance monitoring;
• Risk assessment and risk-based site management strategies;
• Brownfield redevelopment and site-closure planning;
• Pre-reclamation assessments and detailed site assessments;
• Reclamation, revegetation, vegetation monitoring, and site maintenance programs;
• Reclamation certificate and Certificate of Restoration support;
• Construction environmental monitoring and contractor coordination;
• Regulatory submissions, database reporting, and project closeout; and
• Multi-site environmental portfolios for energy, industrial, commercial, infrastructure, government, and other clients.
What You Will Accomplish

Deliver Successful Projects

• Translate client objectives and contractual commitments into practical scopes, work plans, budgets, schedules, milestones, and resource plans.
• Lead projects through planning, execution, monitoring, change management, reporting, and closeout.
• Coordinate technical specialists, field personnel, subcontractors, suppliers, and other contributors so that responsibilities and timelines are clear.
• Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and client expectations.
• Identify emerging issues early and implement or recommend practical recovery strategies.
• Ensure deliverables are technically sound, complete, consistent, and defensible.

Lead Environmental Programs

• Interpret historical, published, regulatory, and site-specific information to develop a clear understanding of site conditions.
• Develop and communicate conceptual site models, key environmental issues, data gaps, and recommended next steps.
• Plan and oversee site assessment, remediation, reclamation, monitoring, and closure activities.
• Compile, interpret, and communicate technical findings through reports, presentations, work plans, and regulatory submissions.
• Develop practical, risk-informed environmental management and remedial strategies appropriate to the site and client objectives.
• Review technical deliverables and regulatory submissions at a level appropriate to your experience and professional qualifications.

Manage Financial and Commercial Performance

• Develop realistic estimates, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, and cost-to-complete projections.
• Track actual costs, commitments, progress, accruals, milestones, and project risks.
• Work collaboratively with Finance and operational leaders to support accurate billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting.
• Manage scope changes through timely documentation, client communication, authorization, and implementation.
• Contribute technical and project-delivery insight to proposals, fee estimates, work plans, and contract reviews.

Build Trusted Client Relationships

• Serve as a reliable point of contact for assigned clients and stakeholders.
• Understand client priorities, success measures, decision-making requirements, and communication preferences.
• Provide clear, timely updates on progress, risks, financial position, decisions, changes, and upcoming milestones.
• Build trust through responsive service, sound judgment, technical credibility, and consistent follow-through.
• Identify opportunities to provide additional value and support the development of recurring client relationships.
• At the senior level, contribute to client growth plans, networking, proposal strategy, and the development of new business opportunities.

Strengthen the Team
• Create clarity within project teams by confirming responsibilities, priorities, decision rights, and deadlines.
• Provide practical coaching and technical or project-management guidance to developing professionals.
• Promote respectful communication, knowledge sharing, teamwork, and early escalation of capacity or competency concerns.
• At the senior level, mentor Project Managers and technical staff, support competency development, and provide oversight across complex or multi-site portfolios.
• Share lessons learned and help improve MEMS’ project tools, estimating practices, reporting, workflows, and quality controls.

The Level of the Role
We recognize that strong candidates may bring different combinations of technical knowledge, client experience, and project leadership. The successful candidate may be hired as a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager based on demonstrated capability.

Project Manager
You may be a strong fit at the Project Manager level if you:
• Have approximately three or more years of relevant environmental consulting or project-delivery experience;
• Can independently manage multiple projects of low to moderate complexity;
• Have experience developing work plans, budgets, schedules, reports, and regulatory submissions;
• Can coordinate field programs, subcontractors, technical contributors, and project financial information; and
• Are ready to expand your client-management, commercial, and leadership responsibilities.

Senior Project Manager
You may be a strong fit at the Senior Project Manager level if you:
• Have approximately five or more years of progressively responsible environmental consulting and project-management experience;
• Can lead moderately complex to complex projects, multi-site programs, or significant client portfolios;
• Have demonstrated success managing project financial performance, contracts, risks, quality, and client expectations;
• Can provide technical and project-management oversight with limited senior direction;
• Have experience developing trusted client relationships and identifying opportunities for repeat or expanded business; and
• Can mentor others, review deliverables, and strengthen the capability of a multidisciplinary team.

title: Sairaanhoitajan sijaisuus, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Kuntouttava arviointiyksikkö, Turku
description:
Työskentelet sairaanhoitajana kuntoutus- ja arviointiyksikkö Kurjensiipi 2:ssä, joka on 35-paikkainen yksikkö ikääntyneiden asiakkaiden lyhytaikaiseen kuntouttavaan arviointiin. Asiakkaat tulevat jaksoille joko sairaalasta tai kotoa palvelutarpeen arvioinnin kautta, ja työn tavoitteena on tukea heidän turvallista kotona asumistaan.

Vastaat asiakkaan kuntoutumista edistävän hoitotyön ja palveluiden suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista. Huolehdit yksilöllisen hoito- ja kuntoutussuunnitelman toteutumisesta sekä osallistut yksikön lääkehoidon suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja arviointiin yhdessä vastaavan sairaanhoitajan kanssa. Työssä korostuvat hoitotyön asiantuntijuus, kokonaisvaltainen toimintakyvyn arviointi sekä kuntoutumisen aktiivinen seuranta.

Toimit osana moniammatillista tiimiä, johon kuuluvat esihenkilö, lääkäri, vastaava sairaanhoitaja, sairaanhoitajat, lähihoitajat, sosionomi, fysioterapeutti, toimintaterapeutti, virikeohjaaja ja hoiva-avustaja. Yhteistyötä tehdään tiiviisti myös asiakkaan muun palveluverkoston kanssa.

Tehtävässäsi hyödynnät toimintakyvyn arvioinnin mittareita (mm. RAI) ja osallistut uusien työntekijöiden, resurssipoolin työntekijöiden sekä opiskelijoiden perehdytykseen ja ohjaukseen. Työssä korostuvat aktiivinen kuntouttava työote sekä aito läsnäolo asiakkaan arjessa. Asiakas- ja työturvallisuus ovat keskiössä, ja työssä hyödynnetään teknologisia ratkaisuja sekä ergonomisia apuvälineitä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle työn, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan asiakkaan mahdollisuuksiin jatkaa turvallista arkea kotona. Työ on monipuolista ja vastuullista, ja se antaa mahdollisuuden hyödyntää sekä kehittää omaa asiantuntijuuttasi kuntouttavassa hoitotyössä.

Moniammatillinen toimintaympäristö tarjoaa näkökulmia ja tukea eri ammattiryhmiltä, ja työssä pääset osallistumaan asiakkaan kokonaistilanteen selvittämiseen sekä kuntoutumisen edistämiseen lyhytaikaisilla jaksoilla. Työssä yhdistyvät kliininen osaaminen, arviointityö ja ohjausosaaminen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta vahvaa hoitotyön osaamista sekä kiinnostusta kuntouttavaan arviointityöhön ikääntyneiden parissa. Työssä tarvitset kykyä hallita useita tehtäväalueita samanaikaisesti sekä arvioida asiakkaan kokonaistilannetta ja toimintakykyä itsenäisesti ja yhteistyössä tiimin kanssa.

Arvostamme osaamista lääkehoidosta ja sen kokonaisprosessista sekä valmiuksia hyödyntää toimintakyvyn arvioinnin mittareita hoidon suunnittelussa. Lisäksi tehtävässä korostuvat ohjaus- ja perehdyttämistaidot sekä kyky toimia osana moniammatillista yhteistyötä. Työ edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Eduksi katsomme voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan, RAI-arviointimittariston tuntemuksen ja hyvät tietotekniset taidot sekä ruotsin kielen taidon.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.

Hae tehtävään ja tule mukaan rakentamaan kuntoutumista tukevaa arkea Kurjensiipi 2:een!

Etsimme kokenutta työterveyspsykologia lähivastaanottotyöhön Lappican toimipisteisiin 1.1.2027 alkaen (kilpailutusvaihe). Työtä on tarjolla alueesta riippuen:

Kemi, Simo, Tervola, Tornio & Ylitornio: noin 2,5 pv/vko
Sodankylä, Ivalo, Utsjoki, Kittilä, Kolari, Muonio & Enontekiö: noin 2,5 pv/vko

Työ sisältää monipuolista työterveyspsykologin työtä, kuten vastaanottoja, työkyvyn arviointia ja tukemista, työterveysneuvotteluja, työpaikkaselvityksiä, työterveysyhteistyötä sekä moniammatillista työskentelyä. Työ tehdään pääsääntöisesti Lappican toimipisteissä.

Psykologin pätevyyttä
Vähintään 15 op työterveyshuoltoon pätevöittävää koulutusta

Vahva tuki ja yhteisö – Et jää yksin! Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, sekä kannustavan ja osaavan työyhteisön ympärillesi
Hyvä ja motivoiva palkka – Panostamme reiluun ja motivoivaan palkkaukseen

Mikä on Solo Health / Punos Psykologit?
Punos Psykologit on kotimainen psykologipalveluiden edelläkävijä, jonka vahvuus on osaavissa ja sitoutuneissa yhteistyöpsykologeissa. Punos on rakentanut luotettavaa kumppanuutta kuntien, hyvinvointialueiden ja muiden toimijoiden kanssa vuodesta 2020, tuottaen laadukkaita ja asiakaslähtöisiä mielenterveyspalveluita eri-ikäisille asiakkaille.

Vuonna 2025 Punos Psykologit liittyi osaksi Solo Health -konsernia. Yhdistymisen myötä syntyi vahva ja monipuolinen toimija, joka yhdistää psykologiset ja psykiatriset palvelut uudella tavalla. Vuonna 2019 perustettu Solo Health on Suomen nopeimmin kasvava sote-alan toimija, ja työllistimme vuonna 2024 jo yli 500 ammattilaista eri puolilla maata.

Yhdessä Punos ja Solo pystyvät tarjoamaan asiakaslähtöisiä kokonaisuuksia sekä laajentamaan psykologien työmahdollisuuksia eri rooleissa ja toimintaympäristöissä.

Heräsikö kysyttävää?
Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työhön liittyen, ota rohkeasti yhteyttä:

Saara Iiskola

title: Guidance and Control Hardware Engineer
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical Control Systems Division**, which is responsible for technology development, advanced concepts, design, development, delivery, integration and test, verification and validation, and operation of complex Mechanical, Thermal, Propulsion, Robotics, and Guidance and Control (G&C) systems.

As a _Guidance and Control Engineer_ in the **Guidance, Navigation and Control (GN&C) Sensors, Actuators, Payloads, and Field Test Group**, you will be working for JPL’s **Guidance and Control Section**. We do system engineering, design and analysis, hardware development, procurement, testing, and operations support in G&C areas for unique deep-space/earth-orbiting/astrophysics missions. We also do world class research and technology development in autonomous guidance, navigation and control systems including pin-point and safe landing, space rendezvous, formation flying, and precision pointing, among others.

**Responsibilities:**

The Guidance and Control Engineer is responsible for the procurement or design, development, integration and flight qualification of sensor systems for flight missions (including inertial and optical based GN&C sensors). In this role, you will also independently propose and develop new sensor technologies for on-board spacecraft GN&C systems, secure funding for technology development and lead effort to develop technology for infusion into future flight projects.

**Qualifications Required:**

- This position requires a Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering or related technical discipline with a minimum of 6 years of related experience, a Master’s degree in a technical discipline with a minimum of 4 years of related experience, or a PhD in a technical discipline with a minimum of 2 years
- Knowledge in one or more of the following GN&C sensor areas: inertial sensors or optical sensors, such as lidars, star trackers, sun sensors, formation flying sensors, pin point and safe landing sensors, space rendezvous sensors, precision pointing sensors etc.
- Experience leading hands-on hardware development or complex hardware test beds to characterize functionality and performance
- Experience leading field testing of prototype hardware in relevant environments, such as dynamic test beds, aerial vehicles, rovers, etc…

**Preferred experience and skills include:**

- Knowledge of applicable industry and/or academic practices and standards in spacecraft guidance navigation and control and spacecraft sensor systems
- Experience and proven track record developing new technology for GN&C sensors
- Experience with contract technical management
- Proven ability to acquire new funding for technology development
- Advanced knowledge of applicable Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations
- Experience with development of integrated GN&C hardware and software systems.
- Experience with flight qualification of spacecraft sensor systems
- Familiarity with FPGAs and embedded electronics

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description:
## **Job Details**

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Wanted: Computer Vision (CV) and Machine Learning (ML) Engineer to join the Navigation and Mapping group in the Guidance and Control Section.

This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical Control Systems Division**, which is responsible for technology development, advanced concepts, design, development, delivery, integration and test, verification and validation, and operation of complex Mechanical, Thermal, Propulsion, Robotics, and Guidance and Control (G&C) systems.

As a member of the Navigation and Mapping group, you will investigate, design, and implement advanced capabilities in image-based mapping and navigation. You will use your expertise in CV/ML to design novel solutions to novel problems in map-relative localization, hazard detection/avoidance, illumination invariance, 3D structure recovery, and integration of vision into end-to-end guidance and control solutions for autonomous spacecraft navigation. Ultimately, your work will bridge foundational research and the implementation of mature flight software for JPL missions.

Your work will directly impact the engineering design of JPL’s terrestrial, lunar, Mars-centric and outer planets missions. At the same time, you will continue to advance the state of the art and engage with JPL’s Science community to understand their unique needs and foster collaboration between the engineering and science disciplines. You will be expected to actively seek out opportunities for funding to support your own research agenda in concert with overall Section objectives.

**List of Responsibilities:**

- Mapping and map-relative navigation for Moonfall, Skyfall, SOLO

- Collaboration with commercial partners on Artemis/HLS for vision-based solutions to lunar landing

- Application of ML expertise to partner with scientists on ROSES (Research Opportunities in Space and Earth Sciences) opportunities


**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Physics, Computer Science, related field with a minimum of 6 years of experience, a Master's degree with a minimum of 4 years of experience, or a Ph.D. with a minimum of 2 years related experience.

- Extensive understanding and wide application of principles, theories, concepts, and techniques in Machine Learning and Computer Vision

- Proven ability to adapt theoretical ML models to unique CV problems and develop novel training architectures.

- Strong software skills in C++ and Python.

- Track record of working independently with significant technical latitude to deliver functional capabilities.


**Desired Qualifications:**

- Experience with proposal development

- Publication record in high impact journals and conferences in relevant ML, CV, or aerospace navigation domains.

- Background in estimation or control theory.

- Experience with participating in multidisciplinary teams.

- Strong presentation skills.

title: PhD Student - DNA Break Signature in Cancers
description:
***The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.***

***The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.***

***Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.***

The Junior Research Group "**Brain Mosaicism and Tumorigenesis**", headed by Dr. Pei-Chi Wei, is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a PhD Student - DNA Break Signature in Cancers.

The Brain Mosaics and Tumorigenesis Laboratory at the DKFZ investigates how the genome is shaped, maintained, and disrupted in health and disease. We are particularly interested in how replication stress, transcription–replication conflicts, and DNA repair pathways influence the formation of double-strand breaks, copy-number alterations, and other structural genome changes.

Our group combines cutting-edge genome biology approaches with quantitative, multi-omics analyses to uncover the mechanisms that generate and resolve DNA damage. We have developed and routinely apply high-resolution mapping technologies — including LAM-HTGTS for direction-resolved DNA break mapping, Hi-RepliSeq for replication timing and directionality, GRO-seq for nascent transcription, and DRIP-seq for R-loop detection. These methods allow us to integrate replication, transcription, and DNA repair features at nucleotide resolution across large genomic datasets.

We focus on cancer models (osteosarcoma, breast cancer, leukemia) and on neural progenitor cells to understand how genome instability contributes to tumor initiation, therapy resistance, and disease progression. By pinpointing cell-type-specific vulnerabilities in the genome, we aim to identify novel therapeutic targets and inform personalized treatment strategies.

Our research environment is highly collaborative and interdisciplinary, spanning genome biology, computational analysis, and translational cancer research. Members of the lab gain expertise in next-generation sequencing, genome-wide data integration, statistical modeling, and hypothesis-driven experimental design, preparing them for leadership roles at the interface of molecular biology and data science.

**Project Description:**

Replication stress (RS) disrupts DNA replication and is a hallmark of cancer. RS often leads to DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs), which can fuel genomic instability but also reveal therapeutic vulnerabilities. In collaboration with the Aqeilan Lab (Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel), we aim to map RS-mediated and naturally occurring DSBs in cancer cells at nucleotide resolution.

Using advanced sequencing technologies, we will characterize DSB landscapes across osteosarcoma, breast, and leukemia cell lines and compare them with in vivo tumor models. This multi-omics approach will pinpoint cancer-specific DNA break hotspots and their association with transcription, replication dynamics, and RNA:DNA hybrid formation.

**Goals of the PhD Project:**

  • Map and classify RS-mediated and naturally occurring DSBs in distinct cancer cell types
  • Integrate multi-omics datasets (DSB maps, replication timing/direction, transcription orientation, and R-loop profiles) to identify cancer-type-specific vulnerabilities
  • Generate engineered cancer cell lines (in collaboration with a technician) and design hypothesis-driven analyses to identify targetable mechanisms of genomic instability
  • Contribute to developing reverse-translational strategies for therapeutic interventions in osteosarcoma and breast cancer

**Future Perspective:**

The project offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of cancer genomics using cutting-edge sequencing and integrative computational analyses. The successful candidate will gain expertise in multi-omics data integration, statistical and computational methods, and translational cancer research. Results from this work are expected to reveal new mechanisms of genome instability, inform RS-targeting therapies, and open avenues for personalized treatment strategies.

**Your Profile:**

  • Major in biology, bioinformatics, or related fields (genetics, genomics, bioengineering, applied mathematics)
  • Master’s degree or expected master’s degree in the above-mentioned fields
  • (For biologists) Intermediate programming skills in R or Python, as well as prior experience analyzing omics datasets, are advantageous
  • (For bioinformatic-mathematic traits) Good performance in biology courses at university
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written)
  • Self-motivation, commitment, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Interested candidates should submit a CV, a cover letter, academic transcripts, and contact details of two references via the application portal. Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled.

**We Offer**

  • Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
  • Access to international research networks
  • Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits
  • 30 days of vacation per year
  • Flexible working hours
  • Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
  • Family-friendly working environment
  • Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
  • Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service
  • Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

**Are you interested?**

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

**Contact:**

Dr. Pei-Chi Wei

Phone: +49 6221/42-3251

​**Duration**: The position is initially limited to 3 years with the possibility of prolongation.

**Application Deadline**: October 28, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

**Notice**: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

title: Account Director - IT Services (Remote)
description:
Own the Relationship. Drive the Growth.

About The Role

The Account Director owns a portfolio of existing Info-Tech Research Group member accounts and is accountable for one thing above all: growing the value of that portfolio through renewal, upsell, and cross-sell. You are not prospecting cold; you are deepening relationships with leaders who already trust Info-Tech, uncovering where our research, diagnostics, advisory services, software, and experts can solve their next problem.

This is a consultative, commercially minded account management role. You will retain more than 85% of your portfolio and grow it to 120% of prior-year contract value by understanding each member's priorities deeply enough to know what they need before they ask.

Why Join Info-Tech Research Group?

  • Robust onboarding and training: designed to give you the product knowledge, practical skills, tools, and confidence to succeed in the role.
  • Ongoing coaching and support: from experienced sales and account leaders as you apply your learning, strengthen your capabilities, and build momentum.
  • Clear career growth: opportunities to take on new challenges and pursue advancement as the business continues to expand.
  • A collaborative culture: where team members share knowledge, support one another, and celebrate individual and collective wins.
  • Meaningful client relationships: the opportunity to build lasting partnerships with member organizations and help them address real business challenges and impact individual careers.
  • The scale of a global research and advisory firm: the broader resources, career paths, and internal expertise that come with being part of Info-Tech Research Group.

What Do We Offer?

Compensation & Rewards

  • Competitive compensation with strong earning potential and uncapped commissions.
  • President's Club recognition, awards, and trips.
  • RRSP matching.

Health & Time Off

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Generous time off, summer hours, and soft-close days.

Growth & Recognition

  • Employee recognition, career development, and financial support for professional training.

Culture & Perks

  • “Buy a Book” program, pet-friendly offices, on-site gym, virtual yoga, rooftop patio, company fun days, and more.

What You Will Do

  • Own and grow your portfolio. Manage a defined book of existing member accounts with a relentless focus on renewal and expansion.
  • Find the next right offer. Continuously map each member's priorities and stakeholders to identify concrete cross-sell and upsell opportunities across our research, diagnostics, advisory, and software offerings.
  • Build account plans that convert. Develop and execute strategic account plans that tie member engagement directly to renewal and growth targets.
  • Lead the renewal conversation early. Get ahead of contract cycles, surface risk before it becomes churn, and build the business case for expansion well before the renewal date.
  • Run a disciplined member cadence. Maintain a consistent rhythm of proactive outreach, account reviews, and follow-up across your portfolio.
  • Connect members to real expertise. Translate complex member needs into clear next steps and route them to the right internal resource or subject-matter expert.
  • Keep the data honest. Maintain accurate, current account, activity, pipeline, and forecast information in the CRM; your numbers should tell the true story of your portfolio.
  • Work the goals, not just the activity. Track progress against retention, growth, and activity targets, and apply coaching and feedback to keep improving.

What You Bring

  • Three or more years of B2B account management, client success, relationship management, or consultative sales experience, with a track record of retaining and growing client relationships.
  • Experience owning a portfolio, territory, or book of business against clear renewal and growth targets.
  • Strong discovery and active-listening skills: you ask the questions that surface the next opportunity, not just the ones that confirm satisfaction.
  • The ability to translate complex information into a clear, commercially relevant conversation.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and follow-through across a varied and competing set of accounts.
  • Comfort working in a CRM and keeping account information accurate and current.
  • A collaborative approach and the judgment to bring in internal experts when it will move the account forward.
  • Post-secondary education or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

How You Will Succeed

  • You build trust through curiosity, responsiveness, and reliable follow-through.
  • You balance genuine client-service instincts with commercial awareness: you see growth opportunities without ever feeling transactional.
  • You turn member feedback and business needs into clear, actionable next steps.
  • You manage your time independently and stay focused across a varied portfolio.
  • You take ownership of your goals, monitor your own progress, and raise risks early rather than let them surface at renewal.
  • You stay open to coaching and feedback, and you keep developing.
  • You bring sound judgment, resilience, and a solutions-first mindset to every conversation.

A Remote Role That Keeps You Connected

This particular role can be performed remotely from within Canada. Remote does not mean working alone. You will be part of an engaged sales team with regular opportunities to collaborate, learn, share ideas, and connect with colleagues and leaders across the business.

For employees who enjoy an office environment or want occasional in-person connection, our London and Toronto offices are available as an optional place to work. You can benefit from the flexibility of remote work while still having access to the energy, relationships, and resources of an office when it works for you.

We hold company-wide in-person training once a month in Toronto and London, and employees located within 120 km of either office are expected to attend in person.

Our Interview Process -

From initial screening through to the final round, every interview is conducted by a member of our Talent Acquisition or leadership team. You can engage in genuine conversation, ask questions, and learn about the role, team, and Info-Tech Research Group.

We do not use AI interviewers or automated screening bots to conduct interviews. We believe hiring is personal, and every candidate deserves the opportunity to connect directly with the people they may ultimately work with.

Ready to Grow What's Already Working?

If you want a role where success is measured in renewed and expanded relationships, not cold pipeline, and where coaching, structure, and real career growth come standard, we would like to hear from you. Apply to join Info-Tech Research Group and take ownership of a portfolio built to grow.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodation

 Info-Tech Research Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. To that end, upon request, ITRG will ensure, to the extent possible, that accommodation be made available to applicants throughout the recruitment and hiring process.

title: Software Engineer

The Software Engineer develops embedded software for electronic control units used in BWI braking systems (Brakes division) and suspension systems (Suspension division), following automotive software development processes.
