title: Sustainability Data, Reporting & Compliance Project Manager
description:
Role Description

Under the direction of the Head of Sustainability, EMEA and a dotted line to the Head of Sustainability for UK & Ireland, the Sustainability Data, Reporting & Compliance Project Manager will facilitate the ongoing development and implementation of a sustainability disclosure program for Live Nation EMEA and UK & Ireland, laying the foundation for other required and voluntary ESG (environmental, social, and governance) disclosures currently and in coming years (e.g. CSRD, TCFD, ISSB, etc.).


This role will lead annual environmental data collection for the disclosure of internal and external LNE's ESG reports. You will work with and coordinate a diverse group of stakeholders across North America, UK, and European markets. You will have experience in corporate and/or event sustainability reporting and are familiar with ESG disclosures, including but not limited to CSRD, TCFD, ISSB, SECR, ESOS, EPR, etc. You are comfortable working with and validating quantitative and qualitative data and bring an acute sense of judgement and tact when navigating competing agendas and priorities.


What we can offer you


Live Nation offers impressive employee benefits including tickets to shows and festivals and unlimited annual leave. The Farmiloe Building in Farringdon, London is a beautiful office to work in. Staff can enjoy use of arcade games in the basement games room, onsite gym equipment plus fitness and meditation classes. In addition to this, the office has a fully stocked complimentary coffee bar with barista to serve you your favourite coffee as you walk into the office and offers heavily subsidised lunch options. We hold regular staff events in our atrium stage space including hosting speakers and open mic nights to showcase Live Nation employee talent.


Who you are


Competencies / Skills / Knowledge / Experience


  • Proven experience and knowledge of ESG reporting including CSRD, TCFD, SECR, ESOS, EPR, etc.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Comfortable working with quantitative and qualitative data, proven experience in data validation.
  • Proficient in Excel spreadsheets, Tableau, AI-driven database management systems, and analysis via various platforms and software.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills across international markets.
  • Excellent written and spoken English is mandatory, and proficiency in another European language is desirable.
  • Knowledge of energy markets and procurement methodologies is desirable.


Behaviours


The following attributes determine how the role will be carried out and are required to be a success


  • Self-motivated, pro-active, and able to work independently as well as in a team environment across multiple markets.
  • Ability to maintain discretion with sensitive and confidential information.
  • Ability to work with cross functional stakeholders in large global environment spanning multiple time-zones to meet organisational goals within deadlines.
  • Flexibility and ability to successfully navigate ambiguity and succeed in a fast-paced organisation.


What the role includes


Program Delivery

  • Coordinate and work with internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to finance, compliance, legal, HR, regional and global sustainability teams to implement a robust ESG Data Collection & Reporting program.
  • Oversee internal data collection outreach and ensure environmental data consistency across the business.
  • Work with business stakeholders to identify gaps in data collection and data quality, and develop solutions that are replicable, scalable, and aligned with reporting requirements.
  • Ensuring data readiness reviews, auditable processes, and controls for environmental data collection, validation, and reporting.
  • Establish a reusable reporting infrastructure and/or integrate with existing systems for data collection and management and evaluate opportunities for improvements to streamline efforts.
  • Maximise internal engagement, educate, and guide business data owners.
  • Prepare reports on market sustainability progress, and biannual/ annual reports as required to meet the needs of different stakeholders within the business.
  • Stay on top of regulatory requirement changes, project timeline and reporting deadlines in partnership with the global Compliance team and market Heads of Sustainability.
  • Research and project management of sustainable projects as required.
  • Manage energy procurement activities for the UK market.

title: Training and Enablement Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage logistics, scheduling, and execution of onboarding programs to facilitate a smooth transition and effective ramp-up into their sales roles.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to new hires, identifying skill gaps and offering resources and support to help them reach full productivity.

  1. Sales Training Content & Curriculum Development
  • Design, develop, and maintain sales training curricula, learning materials, and tools that support sales enablement goals.
  • Partner with sales leaders, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to build engaging, effective learning content grounded in instructional design best practices and aligned with the sales process.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve existing sales training programs based on feedback, performance data, and evolving sales methodologies.

  1. Support Execution of Quarterly Sales Enablement Plans
  • Help implement and execute quarterly learning and development plans aligned with sales organization priorities and broader business goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, and other departments to deliver training, coordinate learning activities, and drive measurable outcomes.

  1. Support Sales Enablement Program & Project Rollout
  • Lead or support the rollout of sales enablement programs and initiatives, including new tools, processes, or methodologies.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and project teams to ensure programs are delivered on time, within budget, and meet defined objectives.

Success Metrics –

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on measurable improvements to sales team performance and enablement outcomes, including:

  • Time to productivity: Reduction in ramp time for new sales hires to reach quota or target performance.
  • Onboarding effectiveness: new hire completion rates, satisfaction scores, and early performance benchmarks.
  • Training engagement & completion: Participation and completion rates across required and optional training programs.
  • Knowledge & skill retention: Improvement in assessment scores, certification pass rates or observed skill application post-training.
  • Sales performance impact: Correlation between enablement initiatives and key sales outcomes (e.g., quota attainment, win rates, deal cycle time).
  • Stakeholder feedback: Satisfaction ratings from sales leaders and reps on the relevance and quality of training and enablement support.
  • Program delivery: On-time, on-budget execution of quarterly plans and enablement project rollouts.

Qualifications -

  • Bachelor’s degree in education, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in learning and development, training, instructional design, or sales enablement.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and sales processes.
  • Excellent content creation, curriculum design, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience managing learning programs or projects, with the ability to handle multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across sales and other departments.
  • Proficiency with learning management systems (LMS) and other training/development tools.

title: Lastenohjaaja
description:
Etsimme joukkoomme osa-aikaista lastenohjaajaa 7.1.2027 - 18.6.2027 väliselle ajalle.

Tarjoamme työtehtävä itsessään on laaja-alaista varhaiskasvatusta ja perhetoimintaa. Osa tehtävistä sijoittuu säännölliseen viikkotoimintaan mm. päiväkerhot, perhekerhot ja pikkukoululaisten kerhot sekä erilaisista lapsille ja perheille suunnatuista tapahtumista. Työ saattaa sisältää myös ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä, sekä leirityötä. Haettava tehtävä on 80 %.

Odotamme sinulta rohkeaa, innostunutta ja joustavaa työotetta sekä organisointikykyä ja kutsumusta kirkon kasvatustyöhön. Arvostamme työkokemusta seurakunnan varhaiskasvatuksesta ja perhetoiminnasta, sekä kristillisen kasvatuksen ja perhetyön taitoja. Sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja loistat niiden avulla sekä ryhmän edessä toimiessasi että huoltajien kanssa kahden kesken keskustellessasi. Hyödynnät vuorovaikutustaitojasi myös työtiimin hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi, mm. ottamalla asioita rohkeasti, mutta rakentavasti esiin. Näiden taitojesi avulla selviät myös muuttuvista tilanteista hyvällä asenteella.
Etenevässä määrin haluamme näkyä myös erilaisissa sosiaalisenmedian kanavissa. Tehtävässä tarvitsetkin sujuvaa someosaamista perinteisemmän varhaiskasvatustyön osaamisen lisäksi.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona 180 osaamispisteen laajuinen Kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perustutkinto (lastenohjaaja), joka sisältää Suomen evankelisluterilaisen kirkon seurakunnan lastenohjaajan tehtävässä tarvittavan erityisosaamisen tai myös muu soveltuva tutkinto, jota on täydennetty riittävillä varhaiskasvatuksen ja perhetoiminnan tutkinnonosilla ja joka sisältää seurakunnan lastenohjaajan tehtävässä tarvittavan erityisosaamisen. Tehtävään kelpoisiksi katsotaan myös kirkon säädöskokoelman nro 137 ja 139 päätösten mukaiset kelpoisuusehdot täyttävät hakijat (nuorisotyönohjaaja ja varhaiskasvatuksen ohjaaja).

Tehtävä sijoittuu kirkon vaativuusryhmään 402 (2434,28 euroa). Lisäksi voidaan maksaa Kirkon työ-ja virkaehtosopimuksen mukaista kokemuslisää.

Ennen tehtävässä aloittamista valitun tulee esittää nähtäväksi RRL 6 § 2 mom. mukainen rikosrekisteriote (Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä §3). Tehtävään valittavan on oltava Suomen ev.lut. kirkon konfirmoitu jäsen.

Lempäälässä työskennellessäsi tarvitset ehdottomasti myös omaa autoa, koska välimatkat kunnan sisällä ovat pitkät ja välillä siirryt päivän aikana toimipisteestä toiseen.

Hakemukset tulee toimittaa sähköisesti KirkkoRekry -järjestelmän kautta 8.11.2026 klo 12.00 mennessä. Hakemukset käsitellään ja haastatteluajat ilmoitetaan haastatteluun kutsuttaville viimeistään 11.11.2026.
Haastattelut pidetään 17.11.2026, Vanhassa pappilassa, Rovastintie 3, 37500 Lempäälä.

title: Production Planning Analyst, EU Supply Chain
description:
At Amazon, customer success drives our mission. The Production Planning Team optimizes capacity across Fulfillment Centers through innovative solutions planning. We seek diverse perspectives and experiences to strengthen our global operations and customer experience.

This role requires expertise to develop network-wide strategies and drive operational excellence. Collaborate with multiple business teams including FC operations, HR, finance , supply chain, transportation, work force staffing and others.


Key job responsibilities
* Develop and execute short/medium/long-term operational plans to optimize staffing costs.
* Supporting with warehouse staffing/capacity metrics forecasting using data modeling to drive a collaborative decision-make.
* Responsible for warehouse processing capacity planning data to identify trends and improvement opportunities; focus on understanding data deviations, their root causes, and driving forward-looking opportunities
* Analyze capacity planning data to identify trends and improvement opportunities and be able to present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with global teams across Europe.
* Support Production planning and cost optimization initiatives.

A day in the life
This role follows a weekly cadence: working with Operations, Finance, and HR stakeholders, consuming demand signals, and working out the best staffing approach for fulfillment centers across multiple European countries. Early in the week you shape assumptions on productivity, attendance, and hiring; midweek you translate these into labor plans; by week's end those plans are presented to regional directors for approval. Alongside this rhythm, you lead a team of 12-15 planners on continuous improvement, making our processes leaner, more accurate, and less error-prone, while respecting the upstream and downstream constraints that shape what fulfillment centers can realistically deliver.

ABOUT HY-TECH

Hy-Tech Drilling is an innovative, capable, and accountable diamond drilling partner for the leading mining companies in the Americas and Europe, enabling our clients to reach critical minerals more quickly with less environmental impact. This supports a global transition to a more sustainable future. We seek win/win/win solutions for our people, our customers, and the communities we support.

Established in 1991, Hy-Tech has grown to a fleet of 60 drills operating throughout Canada, USA, Chile, and Europe. We take pride in the success we’ve had working with our clients to develop innovative solutions for their project challenges and believe in our team’s strength and effectiveness in tackling challenges that may arise.

THE JOB

Reporting to the Foreman, the Driller sets up and operates drilling equipment in a safe and efficient manner to maximize core recovery. Daily responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Being responsible for the set-up, repair & maintenance, and safe operation of all drilling-related equipment.
  • Supervising the Driller’s Helper by being a safety leader; sets expectations for safety and quality standards.
  • Ensuring the safety of themselves, their Driller’s Helper and other crew on site.
  • Ensuring the organization and cleanliness of the drill and drill site location.

THE PERKS

  • Competitive hourly wage.
  • Increased salary through meter-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive 100% Employer Paid Benefits Program (Employee & eligible Spouse/Dependents).
  • Employer-matched RRSP Program.
  • Flights, Accommodations and Meals provided for.
  • Paid travel days.
  • On the job training: Earn qualifications to operate equipment from industry leading professionals.
  • Being a part of a dynamic, driven team that has a priority and focus towards career development.

THE SETTING

You’ll work on drill sites for mineral exploration across Canada, where your “office” could be the rugged mountains of BC, the forests of Northern Saskatchewan, or an underground mining tunnel in Ontario. Wherever you may be, you’ll experience unique terrain many people never get a chance to see.

THE SCHEDULE

Work hard and have quality time off. The typical field-operations schedule is 4 weeks on and 2 weeks off. Scheduled days off leave plenty of time for travel or other pursuits. You will alternate between day shift and night shift each time you get sent out on a job. Field-operation roles require 12-hour workdays while living in a camp environment. Hy-Tech Drilling covers most costs associated with travel and accommodation(s).

WHAT YOU NEED

To be considered for this role, you must have direct diamond drilling experience, a minimum of 2 years operating diamond drilling equipment in Underground or Surface Drilling Operations. To be eligible for employment, you must:

title: Data Lead
description:
Sedric is the AI compliance platform for financial services. Our agentic AI automates oversight across customer communications and marketing — real-time guardrails on calls, pre-approval review on every marketing asset, and post-publication monitoring across partners and channels. Because every customer gets a dedicated compliance model, accuracy goes up, false positives go down, and compliance teams move faster without taking on more risk.

Our data lives in silos — Postgres, Snowflake, product usage, customer interactions, billing, infrastructure costs. Each one tells part of the story. Nobody sees the whole picture. When leadership asks “why did our cloud costs jump 30%?” or “which customers are actually driving growth?”, we spend days stitching together an answer that should take an hour. That gap slows down the decisions that matter most.

We’re hiring our first Data Lead to close it. This is an engineer who thinks like an operator: you’ll build the foundation — architecture, pipelines, models — and then use it to connect product behavior, customer outcomes and business performance into one view that drives strategy. No inherited warehouse, no dashboard graveyard, no analyst backlog. A blank page, and a company that needs you to fill it.

The Data Lead reports to our VP Product, is based in Tel Aviv (hybrid), and works daily with Product, Engineering, Operations (GTM) and Finance.


What You’ll Own

The full data lifecycle — from raw data and modeling to insight, recommendation and measurable impact. You build the infrastructure, but the job is the decisions it enables. You go from data to analysis to action, and you own the outcome.

  • Data architecture — design and evolve the stack connecting Postgres, Snowflake, product usage, customer interaction, billing and infrastructure cost data into one source of truth
  • Pipelines and models — build and maintain production-grade ETL pipelines and clean, reusable data models in Snowflake and dbt
  • Data quality — set up checks and monitoring so nobody has to wonder whether a number is right
  • Product KPIs — define the metrics that matter across product, operations and the business, with one shared definition per metric
  • Strategic analysis — connect product usage, customer behavior, revenue and costs to answer the questions leadership is actually asking: where we grow, where we leak margin, what to build next
  • Product enablement — give Product the usage, adoption and retention insight it needs to prioritize, and make our own AI measurable: model accuracy, false positives, customer outcomes
  • Business operations enablement — give GTM and Finance self-serve dashboards, alerting and analysis on pipeline, revenue, unit economics and cloud costs
  • Impact — turn findings into initiatives with Product, Operations, Engineering and Finance, then measure whether they worked
  • AI-driven execution — use AI tools to write, review and debug SQL and dbt faster, so your time goes into judgment, not boilerplate


Requirements

You’re a fit if…

You bring a data engineer’s foundation, an analyst’s business instinct, and the judgment to know when a simple query beats a sophisticated pipeline.

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, with real exposure to business analytics
  • Your SQL is strong — this is a must — and you have deep experience with relational databases
  • You’ve built production-grade ETL pipelines and data models, not one-off scripts — ideally on Snowflake and dbt, with Python where it’s needed
  • You’ve built BI dashboards (Looker, Tableau, Omni or similar) and defined KPIs people actually trust
  • You connect the dots across domains — product usage to revenue, customer behavior to cost — and turn to an ambiguous question like “why did costs go up?” into a validated answer and a recommendation
  • You explain complex analysis clearly to engineers and executives, and you use it to move decisions, not just inform them
  • You’re skeptical of numbers that don’t add up, and won’t ship a dashboard you don’t trust yourself
  • You’ve been the first or only data person somewhere before, or you’re ready to be
  • Bonus: experience with product analytics or customer interaction data (calls, chats, messages), early-stage high-growth startups, or AI-driven products

You’re probably not a fit if…

  • You want a fully built warehouse and a backlog of tickets waiting for you
  • You’d rather build the perfect pipeline than answer the business question in front of you
  • You’re a pure analyst who hands off the moment data needs engineering — or a pure engineer who stops at the pipeline
  • You need someone else to tell you which metrics matter
  • You see BI as a reporting function, not a decision-making one
  • You’re uncomfortable being the only data person in the room


What Success Looks Like

Day 30 — Mapped every data source across product, customer interactions, billing and infrastructure, and shipped a data quality audit flagging the biggest gaps and inconsistencies.

Day 60 — Shipped the core data models and the first set of high-value product and business dashboards, with KPI definitions every team has signed off on.

Day 90 — Delivered a data roadmap, moved at least one core metric from disputed to trusted, and brought leadership a data-driven recommendation that changed a decision.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary aligned with industry standards
  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth compliance AI company
  • Direct access to leadership — no bureaucracy between you and impact
  • Flexible, output-first culture — we care what you ship, not when you log on
  • Work on problems that matter in an industry that’s ready to change

title: Financial Planner
description:
You've learned how to advise. Now imagine being taught how to build a business.

Most planners are taught how to look after clients.

Far fewer are shown how to win them, develop introducer relationships, build recurring revenue and ultimately create a successful advice business of their own.

This role is about that next step.

This is a new financial planning venture being launched by the founder of a highly successful private wealth business.

He previously built around £600m of assets over five years at a major private bank, before launching his own firm and growing it from zero to around £285m AUM in two years, largely through referrals.

Now he wants to find someone he can help develop into much more than a good employed financial planner.

The long-term opportunity is to become the lead planner, take a genuine stake in the business and potentially become its CEO.


WHAT’S THE OPPORTUNITY?

This is an employed role from day one, with a basic salary of up to £75,000 and revenue share on top.

You won’t need to bring clients with you.

There is already warm referral flow available, typically involving clients with around £500,000–£2m to invest, so there will be genuine opportunities from the outset.

But the point of the role is not to spend the next ten years servicing somebody else’s client bank.

You’ll work closely with the founder and learn how he has built businesses through referrals, introducers, strong client relationships and commercial judgement.

Over time, you’ll be expected to originate more of your own opportunities, take increasing responsibility for the firm and move towards a contractual equity stake.

The ambition is not for you to become a slightly more experienced adviser.
It is for you to become someone capable of building and eventually running the business.

WHAT DO YOU GET?

The security of an employed role, but with significantly more upside than a conventional adviser position.
  • Up to £75,000 basic
  • Revenue share
  • Warm client flow from day one
  • No requirement to bring a client bank
  • A contractual route to equity
  • Direct mentoring from someone with a proven record of building substantial AUM
  • Support in learning how to self-source and develop introducer relationships
  • Flexible working
  • Strong compliance and operational infrastructure, including an administrator
  • AI paraplanning tools
  • The chance to help shape a new business rather than simply inherit somebody else’s model
The business is being built from scratch, with a lean structure and heavy use of technology and AI.

The target is to build around £400,000 of ongoing revenue within 24 months, but this is not a sink-or-swim sales role. The idea is to build it properly, and the founder knows it takes time to judge whether that is working.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

This is not a trainee role.

You’ll need to be CAS, with at least 2–3 years’ advice experience behind you.

Beyond that, pedigree matters much less than potential and character.
You might come from an independent firm, a national advice business, a private bank or an academy environment.

What matters is whether you look like someone capable of considerably more than your current role allows.

You’ll probably be:
  • Commercially sharp
  • Proactive
  • Tenacious
  • Credible and polished with clients
  • Comfortable taking responsibility
  • Curious about how businesses actually grow
  • Confident enough to back yourself
  • Humble enough to learn
  • Comfortable with business development
  • Self-motivated without needing to be chased
You may already have thought about running your own firm one day.

You may even know that is where you want to end up, but have no idea where to start or do not want to take all of the financial and regulatory risk on your own.

That is probably the sweet spot.

WHO THIS ISN’T FOR

If what you really want is a good client bank to service, a clear corporate ladder and a well-defined role that stays broadly the same, this probably is not for you.

Likewise, if the idea of business development makes you uncomfortable, the longer-term opportunity will not suit.

The founder will invest heavily in the right person, but the expectation is that you use that support to become increasingly capable, commercial and independent.

THE TEST

You do not need to have built a business before.

You do need to look like someone who could.

That means more than saying you are ambitious or entrepreneurial.

It means showing where you have taken ownership, created opportunities, pushed beyond the boundaries of your role or demonstrated the judgement and drive needed to build something for yourself.

If you’ve learned how to advise and suspect there is a much bigger career in you than simply becoming a more senior adviser, this is worth a conversation.

NEXT STEPS

Want to know more? Click apply.

Don't worry if your CV isn't up to date, we can come to that later.

Everyone will get a response.

title: RFP Writer - Wellington Management Company, LLP
description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

The Company

Tracing its roots to the founding of the Wellington Fund in 1928, the original Wellington Management Company was incorporated in 1933. Wellington Management serves an extremely diverse mix of institutional investors located in over 60 countries. Our clients include public funds, central banks, insurance entities, endowments, foundations, mutual fund sponsors, retirement plan sponsors - both defined benefit and defined contribution - and many other types of institutions. Wellington Management does not engage in any business other than managing money on behalf of our clients. Our mission is to exceed the investment objectives and service expectations of our clients worldwide, and by doing so, ensure the viability of the firm. In addition, we seek to be a leader, an innovator, and a symbol of integrity in the investment management business. As a private partnership whose sole business is investment management, our long-term views and interests are aligned with those of our clients. We are committed to attracting a talented and diverse workforce, and to fostering an open, collaborative culture of inclusivity because we believe multiple perspectives lead to more informed investment and business decisions. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome people with diverse life experiences, fresh ideas, and specialized subject-matter expertise.

Overview

The Global RFP Team is seeking an RFP Writer to support the completion of prospect proposals, client questionnaires, and other strategic client deliverables. The team is responsible for producing high-quality RFPs (Requests for Proposals), RFIs (Requests for Information), DDQs (Due Diligence Questionnaires) that support both business development and client servicing efforts.

Through close partnership with product teams, client-facing teams, and subject matter experts across the firm, the RFP Writer plays a critical role in articulating Wellington's investment capabilities to clients and prospects. These deliverables help win new business, meet the complex reporting and due diligence requirements of existing clients, and ensure the firm's investment solutions are represented accurately, clearly, and consistently. The delivery of thoughtful, well-crafted questionnaires is a key component of both the sales process and ongoing client relationship management.

Responsibilities

Writing, coordinating, editing, and proofreading RFPs and RFIs, partnering with subject matter experts, product teams, and client-facing teams across the firm. This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Developing and maintaining content in our content management tool, Loopio, as well as proposing enhancements to existing responses
  • Leveraging firm tools and AI to draft and deliver high-quality questionnaire responses
  • Supporting the development, maintenance, and governance of content used across RFPs, RFIs, and other client-facing materials
  • Support the completion of quantitative aspects of RFPs and RFIs by retrieving, validating, and organizing data from a variety of internal sources using Excel and other firm tools.
  • Building deep cross-functional relationships across the firm, gaining exposure to investment products, client servicing, sales, and content strategy. Build strong foundation for career growth, given the breadth of partnerships and visibility gained through supporting global client and business development initiatives.
Qualifications
  • 1-2+ years of relevant investment industry experience is preferred
  • Strong writing and communication skills with high attention to detail
  • Strong quantitative and technical skills, with the ability to leverage Excel, Python, and other analytical tools to support deliverables and efficiency gains
  • A positive, collegial attitude and a high level of professionalism are essential
  • Individual must be an independent self-starter and a team player able to work on multiple assignments against strict and competing deadlines
  • Experience with content management third party software such as Loopio, Responsive, Rocket Docs, etc. is a plus
Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That's ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds.

title: Sisälogistiikkapäällikkö
description:
Norelco on energia-alan näkemyksellinen uudistaja ja kasvava teknologiakonserni, joka yhdistää vahvan sähkönjakelun osaamisen, korkean laadun ja modernin teknologian innovatiivisiksi tuotteiksi ja palveluiksi. Norelco suunnittelee, valmistaa ja ylläpitää sähkönjakelu- ja automaatioratkaisuja teollisuuden, datakeskusten, uusiutuvan energian, rakentamisen ja infrastruktuurin sekä meri- ja puolustusteollisuuden tarpeisiin. Kokonaisvaltainen asiantuntemuksemme varmistaa luotettavat ja toimivat ratkaisut yhdeltä kumppanilta.



Norelco Groupin liikevaihto on 45 miljoonaa euroa, ja konserni työllistää yli 350 ammattilaista kuudessa toimipisteessä Savonlinnassa, Kuopiossa, Jyväskylässä ja Kirkkonummella. Norelco Oy ja TAS-Power Oy ovat osa Norelco Groupia.



Kasvumme jatkuessa haemme nyt

sisälogistiikkapäällikköä

johtamaan ja kehittämään sisälogistiikkaamme sekä varmistamaan, että tuotannon tarvitsemat materiaalit, komponentit ja työkalut ovat oikeassa paikassa oikeaan aikaan.



Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Sisälogistiikkapäällikkönä vastaat Norelcon sisälogistiikan kokonaisuudesta ja johdat eri toimipisteissä työskentelevää logistiikkatiimiä. Tiimiin kuuluu varastojen, keräilyn, materiaalisiirtojen ja pakkauksen parissa työskenteleviä ammattilaisia. Tehtävässä raportoit Norelcon operatiiviselle johtajalle.

Keskeisenä tavoitteenasi on varmistaa tuotannon häiriötön materiaalivirta. Huolehdit siitä, että komponentit, metalliosat, pientarvikkeet ja muut tuotannon tarvitsemat materiaalit toimitetaan asentajille tuotantosuunnitelman mukaisesti. Ennakoit materiaalipuutteita, reagoit poikkeamiin nopeasti ja kehität toimintatapoja, joilla tuotannon häiriöitä voidaan vähentää.



Vastuullasi ovat muun muassa:

- sisälogistiikan henkilöstön johtaminen ja resurssien suunnittelu
- tuotannon tarvitsemien materiaalien oikea-aikaisen keräilyn ja toimituksen varmistaminen
- varastojen toiminnan, inventointien ja materiaalivirtojen kehittäminen
- pakkauksen, lastauksen ja asiakaskuljetusten koordinointi
- tuotannon logistiikkahäiriöihin reagoiminen ja niiden syiden analysointi
- sisälogistiikan työturvallisuus erityisesti siirroissa, nostoissa ja varastoinnissa
- työvuorojen ja eri toimipisteiden välisten resurssien suunnittelu
- automaatio- ja digitalisointimahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen ja hyödyntäminen.



Tehtävässä teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotannon, oston ja suunnittelun kanssa. Ulkoisiin yhteistyökumppaneihisi kuuluvat muun muassa tavarantoimittajat, kuljetusliikkeet ja asiakkaat.

Roolissa sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa konkreettisesti sisälogistiikan toimintatapoihin, resurssien käyttöön ja tuotannon sujuvuuteen. Onnistumistasi tukevat selkeä tilannekuva, nopea reagointi ja hyvä yhteistyö tuotannon kanssa. Toiminnan tuloksia seurataan muun muassa logistiikkahäiriöiden, toimitusaikataulujen pitävyyden, varaston arvon ja varaston kiertonopeuden avulla.



Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Toivomme sinulta soveltuvaa tekniikan alan, tuotantotalouden tai logistiikan koulutusta. Sinulla on kokemusta tuotannon tai materiaalihallinnon parista ja ymmärrät tuotannonohjauksen tai projektien ohjauksen keskeisiä periaatteita.



Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

- kokemusta tuotanto- tai logistiikkaympäristöstä
- kykyä johtaa henkilöstöä ja viedä uusia toimintatapoja käytäntöön
- ymmärrystä materiaalivirroista ja varastoinnin kokonaisuudesta
- järjestelmällistä, ennakoivaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
- kykyä laatia selkeitä ohjeita ja ylläpitää toimintamalleja
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
- tehtävässä tarvittavaa englannin kielen taitoa esimerkiksi dokumentaation, työkalujen ja toimittajayhteistyön hoitamiseen
- valmiutta käyttää ERP-järjestelmää sekä tavallisia toimisto- ja tekoälytyökaluja.



Arvostamme erityisesti kykyäsi hahmottaa laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja samalla tarttua käytännön poikkeamatilanteisiin. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka haluaa rakentaa pitkäjänteisesti entistä sujuvampaa sisälogistiikkaa ja saada ihmiset työskentelemään yhteisten tavoitteiden mukaisesti.



Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- vastuullisen ja monipuolisen esihenkilötehtävän kasvavassa suomalaisessa teknologiayrityksessä
- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa tuotannon sujuvuuteen ja sisälogistiikan kehitykseen

title: Leader In Training (full-time)
description:
Summary

The Leader in Training (LIT) and Floor Leader position’s primary responsibility is to fulfill our mission statement: “To create the most enjoyable shopping experience possible for our Guests.” The LIT and Floor Leader performs a variety of sales, merchandising and operational tasks assigned by store management (e.g. cashiering, merchandise display and pulls, register procedures, and routine cleaning of facilities). Works directly with the Store Manager and Leadership Team to develop sales, recruit new Teammates and provide leadership.

Compensation & Benefits:

Pay range: $17.13-$22/hr

The estimated range is the budgeted amount for this position. Final offers are based on various factors, including skill set, experience, location, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

For sales positions, Buckle pays a base rate plus 3% commission on sales. The range listed is the estimated base rate plus commission for Teammates in this position.

Full-Time Teammate Benefits:

Health

Your physical well-being matters. We provide health options that empower you to take control of your care and make informed decisions for you and your family.

Medical Coverage Choose between two comprehensive plans. Preventive care is covered at 100%, and all plans include access to virtual care.

Dental and Vision Insurance Preventive and routine dental and vision care to support your everyday health.

Virtual Care 24/7 access to general, behavioral, and dermatology consultations.

Mental Health Resources Through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), teammates have access to free confidential counseling, wellness coaching, and self-care tools.

Wealth

We are committed to helping you build financial security, recognize your contributions, and invest in your future.

401(k) with Company Match Start planning for the future with traditional and Roth options. Teammates may contribute after meeting eligibility requirements. To further support Teammates, Buckle provides discretionary matching contributions to qualifying Teammates.

Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Pre-tax options for qualified medical and dependent care expenses. Buckle contributes to your HSA if enrolled in the high-deductible medical plan.

Performance Bonuses Eligible teammates may earn incentive-based bonuses in recognition of their performance.

Teammate Discount 40% off Buckle products and 25% off Buckle gift cards to support your personal style.

Peace of Mind

We recognize the importance of stability, security, and time to recharge.

Time Off Vacation time is earned on a progressive schedule based on your role and years of service, starting at 80 hours or 120 hours, depending on employment status and prorated for the first partial year. Teammates earn 40 hours of sick time per year (or more where required by law), prorated for the first partial year; up to 80 hours of sick time may be carried over from one year to another with a maximum of 80 hours of sick time per year including carryover. Teammates also receive one floating holiday and up to three days of bereavement leave. Salaried teammates receive one paid volunteer day.

Income Protection Buckle provides company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance, with options to add Teammate-paid supplemental life and disability plans (short term and long term), helping to protect your income if you are unable to work.

Leave of Absence Support Paid and unpaid time away is available for qualifying situations, with guidance from our Benefits Team to help navigate your options. Salaried teammates who meet eligibility requirements are eligible for medical leave pay, which can be used as paid parental leave for qualifying Teammates.

Supplemental Insurance Options Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage is available for added financial protection.

Additional Benefits Legal services, identity theft protection, and pet insurance are available to eligible teammates.

Part-Time Teammate Benefits

We value every teammate and offer meaningful benefits—even for those working fewer hours.

Medical Plan Access Eligible part-time teammates may choose between two comprehensive medical plans. Preventive care is covered at 100%, and all plans include access to virtual care.

401(k) with Company Match Start planning for the future with traditional and Roth options. Teammates may contribute after meeting eligibility requirements. To further support Teammates, Buckle provides discretionary matching contributions to qualifying Teammates.

Mental Health Resources Through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), teammates have access to free confidential counseling, wellness coaching, and self-care tools.

Paid Leave in Applicable States Paid leave accrues where required by law; one hour of leave is accrued for every 30 hours worked.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
This description intends to describe the general nature and level of work performed by Teammates assigned to this job. It is not intended to include all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Sales Generation and Guest Service

  • Greet Guests with a friendly, engaging attitude, and is consistently prepared to provide legendary service to each Guest
  • Answer questions regarding the store and its merchandise
  • Recommend, select, and help locate or obtain merchandise based on Guest needs and desires
  • Anticipate and fulfill Guest’s needs by suggesting additional items and creating a wardrobing experience
  • Demonstrate product utilizing product knowledge and sales education, consistently sharing that knowledge and education with Team
  • Maintain and share knowledge of current sales and promotions, policies regarding payment and exchanges, and security practices
  • Remain consistent on personal sales, as well as looking for opportunities to impact Teammates’ presentations with the Sales Presentation Guide (SPG)
  • Achieve personal sales-per-hour, average sales and total net sales goals set by Store Management
  • Provide legendary service throughout the store in these top four areas: Front 5, sales floor, fitting rooms, and the register area
  • Knowledgeable of all exchange and return procedures for Guests and exhibit the ability to turn into a showmanship opportunity
  • Fill out and effectively use the Sales Presentation Guide (SPG) daily to accomplish goals
  • Meets or above performance standards in all Buckle business builders and guest loyalty including fit appointments, Buckle credit card and guest connect.
  • Investigate and navigate how to expand Guest selection through inventory Manager, advanced product search, iPad apps, etc.
  • Maintain and build good Guest relationships to develop a client based business
  • Lead by example with a high level of showmanship, excellent customer service and attentiveness
  • Recognize and communicate Guest Levels with the Team
  • Passion to ask business driven and showmanship questions often to Manager, Team Leaders and all Teammates
  • Coachable – allows Manager to educate them in their sales presentation
  • Consistently perform leadership actions and maintain high standards, whether or not the Manager is present

Teammate Recruiting, Training and Development

  • Consistently recognize recruiting opportunities by utilizing Jobs & Careers cards, email referrals and Teammate Recommend
  • Develop skills and assist in leading, directing, motivating and educating new Teammates to meet and achieve Buckle’s accountability, shift orientation, Loss Prevention and sales presentation standards on a daily basis
  • Maintain a positive attitude at all times creating a positive floor culture
  • Demonstrate personal dress code to encourage and coach the latest fashion in all Teammates and Team Leaders
  • Participate effectively in daily setup, training, impacting and reviewing while effectively utilizing the Performance Tracker
  • Motivate Teammates to initiate and complete daily tasks
  • Personal passion to demonstrate, coach, and influence results of denim showmanship and denim fit cards through Teammates and Guests
  • Create and develop results in your department and balance all DM actions within your segment as well as completing the mid-week check in
  • Demonstrate leadership actions during segment:
    • Awareness of Guests in the store and ensure they are being helped
    • Demonstrate how to get the Guest involved with product
    • Be vocal and continuously update fellow leader and Team
    • Responsible for getting Guest names
    • Understanding and working guys side/gals side to benefit both Teammates and Guests

Visual Merchandise Management

  • Own and influence product through zone ownership:
    • Product knowledge, placement, passion, preference
    • Weekly Checklist
    • Life cycle of product
    • Track Results
  • Be able to recognize and assign Zones and projects to Teammates daily with a specific learning goal in mind
  • Confirm Teammates are following through with Visual Standards, Visual library and Weekly Visual Checklist throughout their shift with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Ability to execute and demonstrate all new tools and videos that apply to zone ownership and take initiative in knowing and executing zone ownership questions
  • Show aptitude in recognizing merchandising opportunities from freight to floor and life cycle of product, communicating recommendations and solutions to Store Manager
  • Give informational and influential store tours
  • Ensure sales floor is consistently sized and new freight is appropriately displayed

Operations

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, which may include mornings, evenings, and weekends, and the day of/day after Thanksgiving and Christmas, based upon store and business needs
  • Understand and utilize planner including completion of Opening and Closing Checklists
  • Watch for and recognize security risks and thefts, and know how to prevent or handle these situations
  • Follow all Loss Prevention guidelines, including daily bag and purse checks
  • Ability to execute and teach all Point of Sale (“POS”) procedures
  • Appropriately handle calls from Corporate Office
  • Know Buckle guidelines when handling returns and exchanges
  • Maintain positive attitude when dealing with challenging situations that involve Guests or Teammates
  • Understand and execute all policies regarding payments, exchanges and Loss Prevention practices
  • Ability to navigate and execute all tools on the home page
  • Knowledge and ability to give guidance and feedback to all non-sales positions
  • Complete all scheduled shifts and cover shifts when needed
  • Provide feedback to Store Manager and Leadership Team regarding merchandise handling concerns
  • Communicate any policy violations and Teammate or Guest concerns to Store Manager, District Manager, and/or Human Resources in a timely, confidential manner
  • Consistently maintain a clean, organized, and shoppable store to fulfill Buckle’s mission statement
  • Understand and apply the Buckle’s Code of Ethics and all Buckle’s policies, procedures, and handbooks

Supervisory and Leadership

  • Comfortable in in giving and receiving feedback from peers and Management
  • Supportive of Leadership
  • Promote personal and store growth
  • Demonstrate and maintain a professional, mature and stable relationship with all Teammates
  • Fulfill mission statement by performing job duties with a high level of customer service while contributing to a positive team spirit
  • Special projects and other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Education and/or Experience

High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related retail experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Teammate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the Teammate is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance and jump; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The Teammate is occasionally required to sit. Physical ability to lift and maneuver 50lbs throughout the store and backroom. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the Teammate regularly works in a retail store setting. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Buckle is committed to hiring and developing the most qualified Teammates from the available workforce in the communities we serve.

Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Buckle, where employment is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination and retaliation because of veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, national origin or ancestry, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable local, state, or federal law. For state specific information, refer to the State Law Supplements found on the Teammate Center, under Human Resources.

title: Property Litigation Solicitor
description:
Property Litigation Solicitor (1-5 Years PQE)

Tunbridge Wells, Kent | Hybrid Working Available | High-Quality Property Disputes Work

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a Property Litigation Solicitor to join a thriving and highly regarded dispute resolution team in Tunbridge Wells.

This is an ideal role for a Solicitor with between 1-5 years' PQE who is looking to develop their expertise in contentious property matters whilst working alongside two highly experienced Solicitors on a broad range of complex and high-value disputes.

The firm acts for an established client base that includes commercial businesses, property owners, landlords, developers and high-net-worth individuals, providing exposure to interesting and often complex litigation matters.

The Role

You will work within a successful Litigation team handling a diverse range of contentious property matters while benefiting from excellent supervision, mentoring and technical development.

The caseload will include:

  • Commercial landlord and tenant disputes
  • Breach of covenant claims
  • 1954 Act business lease renewals
  • Dilapidations disputes
  • Service charge disputes
  • Forfeiture proceedings
  • Residential possession claims
  • Boundary disputes
  • Easements and rights of way
  • Restrictive covenant disputes
  • Adverse possession claims
  • General property litigation matters
  • Arbitration, mediation and alternative dispute resolution

You will also work closely with the firm's Commercial Property and Residential Conveyancing teams, providing specialist contentious property advice to existing clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Managing a varied caseload of property disputes
  • Advising landlords, tenants, businesses and private individuals
  • Drafting pleadings, witness statements and legal correspondence
  • Representing clients in High Court and County Court proceedings
  • Engaging in mediation, negotiation and ADR processes
  • Providing commercially focused and practical legal advice
  • Building and maintaining strong client relationships
  • Supporting business development activities and networking opportunities
  • Working collaboratively with colleagues across multiple practice areas

About You

To be considered for this opportunity, you will:

  • Be a qualified Solicitor with 1-5 years' PQE
  • Have experience in Property Litigation or broader Civil Litigation with exposure to property disputes
  • Possess strong technical legal knowledge and analytical skills
  • Be capable of managing files with an appropriate level of supervision
  • Demonstrate excellent communication and client care skills
  • Have a commercial and solutions-focused approach
  • Enjoy working as part of a collaborative and supportive team
  • Be interested in developing your profile within the local legal market

What's on Offer?

  • High-quality and varied property litigation work
  • Exposure to complex and high-value disputes
  • Direct mentoring from experienced Litigation Solicitors
  • Hybrid working arrangements
  • Strong pipeline of established work
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Genuine career progression opportunities
  • Supportive and collaborative culture

This is a standout opportunity for a Property Litigation Solicitor seeking high-quality work, excellent supervision and the chance to develop a long-term career within a respected Kent practice.

How to Apply:

  • Online: Apply with your updated CV via the provided link
  • Contact: For immediate consideration, contact Robert Rowland at G2 Legal

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: B1 Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are currently seeking an experienced EASA Part-66 B1 Licensed Aircraft Engineer to join a growing aircraft maintenance operation in South Wales.

Working as part of a skilled engineering team, you will be responsible for carrying out scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities on a range of commercial aircraft, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with regulatory requirements, approved maintenance data and company procedures.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical knowledge, attention to detail and a commitment to delivering the highest standards of safety and quality. You will also support and mentor other team members, helping to maintain a productive and professional working environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Carry out maintenance activities in accordance with approved maintenance data, company procedures and customer requirements.
  • Certify maintenance tasks within the scope of your licence and approvals.
  • Ensure all maintenance documentation is completed accurately and on time.
  • Support, guide and supervise engineers, technicians and mechanics as required.
  • Liaise with management regarding progress, manpower requirements and operational priorities.
  • Complete maintenance activities efficiently whilst maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and compliance.
  • Ensure adherence to EASA Part-145 requirements and industry best practice.
  • Promote effective task control, housekeeping standards and FOD prevention measures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve working practices and operational efficiency.
  • Support aircraft storage, modification programmes, defect rectification, engine removals and other maintenance activities as required.
Aircraft Types Supported

The maintenance operation supports a varied fleet of narrow-body and wide-body commercial aircraft.

Core Fleet
  • Airbus A320ceo
  • Boeing 737NG
Additional Aircraft Types
  • Boeing 737 Classic (737CL)
  • Airbus A330
  • Boeing 757
  • Boeing 767
  • Boeing 777

Engineers with experience across multiple aircraft types will be viewed favourably.

Shifts

5,5,4 shift pattern with 12 hour shifts

Essential Requirements
  • EASA Part-66 B1 Licence.
  • Type ratings including:
    • Airbus A330 (GE CF6, PW4000 and/or Trent 700), and
    • Airbus A320 Family and/or Boeing 737 Family.
  • Recent demonstrable aircraft maintenance experience on relevant aircraft types.
  • Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance procedures, inspection techniques and industry standards.
  • Experience working within a Part-145 maintenance environment.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced maintenance operation.
  • Strong communication, planning and organisational skills.
  • Commitment to safety, compliance and quality standards.
Desirable Experience
  • Dual B1/B2 Licence.
  • Engine Ground Run (EGR) approval.
  • Additional type ratings on B757, B767, B777 or other large commercial aircraft.
  • Experience working on both narrow-body and wide-body fleets.
  • Previous supervision or mentoring experience.
Personal Attributes
  • Safety and quality focused.
  • Reliable and accountable.
  • Team-oriented with a collaborative approach.
  • Flexible and adaptable.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive attitude.
  • Committed to continuous improvement and professional development.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

WORKING HOURS: 37.5 Hours per Week, Monday to Friday


JOB OVERVIEW

The IT Support Engineer / Service Desk Analyst will resolve support requests, keep accurate ticket records and documentation, and support deployment and project tasks. Working with the Service Desk Manager and escalation colleagues, the IT Support Engineer / Service Desk Analyst will help meet service levels while keeping clients informed.

  • Service Levels and Escalation: Prioritise requests, contribute to service targets and escalate issues appropriately to support agreed SLAs and SLOs
  • Deployment and Project Tasks: Take ownership of assigned deployment and project activities through to resolution
  • Hardware and Software Quotations: Scope basic end-user hardware and software requirements, prepare accurate purchasing information, and support procurement, delivery and deployment
  • Technical Documentation: Maintain accurate technical and process documentation for internal use and clients
  • Workload Management: Organise, schedule and prioritise tickets, activities and projects, coordinating with clients where required

  • Motivation to improve knowledge and understanding of new technologies
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • Commitment to professional behaviours including ambition, professionalism, knowledge, integrity and respect
  • Full driving licence and ability to travel between offices and undertake client home visits if required

DESIRABLE

  • Microsoft Certified professional qualifications
  • Knowledge and experience of administering Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, file sharing and printer management
  • Knowledge and experience of administering network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, wireless, VPNs, VLANs, subnets, DHCP and DNS
  • Knowledge and experience of administering backup and recovery technologies
  • Confidence to use initiative and seek instruction or guidance when appropriate
  • Flexible approach to working hours
  • Professional and confident approach, with the ability to respond to challenges calmly


BENEFITS

  • Birthday leave, a paid charity day and enhanced annual leave with service
  • Ongoing training, mentoring and development
  • Defined Contribution pension scheme with a 4% employer contribution for eligible jobholders

You write down what you learned so the next person can solve it on their own. You can walk an engineer through a new laptop setup in the morning and help a craftsman on the production floor get back into their account after lunch. You know when a problem needs to be escalated, and you hand it off with an actionable write-up. You treat your coworkers as internal clients and close what you start.

  • Serve as the primary support contact for employees across Engineering, Sales, Finance, HR, and Production.
  • Configure, deploy, and maintain laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and peripherals.
  • Resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and access issues with a white-glove, customer-focused approach.
  • Manage the ticket queue against defined response and resolution targets, and keep requesters informed along the way.
Troubleshooting & Problem Management:
  • Diagnose root cause rather than clearing the symptom, and escalate with a clear write-up when required.
  • Investigate recurring tickets and propose the permanent fix.
  • Troubleshoot the ERP and partner with the Software Development team on application issues.
  • Support incident response during outages, including occasional after-hours events.

Documentation & Knowledge:

  • This role splits time between office areas and an active manufacturing floor, with some walking, standing, bending, and kneeling to reach equipment. You may need to lift up to 10 pounds regularly, 25 frequently, and 50 occasionally with assistance. Noise levels are typical of light manufacturing.
  • Regularly travel between our Ashley River Campus (ARC - 4500 Leeds) and Cooper River Campus (CRC - 2120 Noisette) to support operations, attend meetings, and ensure seamless communication and collaboration across both locations.

  • Exposure to AWS or Azure cloud services.
  • Beginning scripting in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
  • Familiarity with IIS, SQL, and server-side configuration.
  • Experience with endpoint hardening, conditional access, and SSO integrations.
  • Practical use of AI tools to speed up daily IT work.
  • Support experience in a manufacturing or production environment.

title: Research Director, IT Financial Management
description:
Position Purpose

The ITFM (IT Financial Management) practice helps IT leaders around the world answer a hard question with evidence: how does our technology spend compared to our peers, and where should we improve? As Research Director, you own the delivery of Info-Tech's flagship IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking service - the engagements that put that evidence in front of CIOs and CFOs.

You will provide experience-based benchmarking insight and guidance that helps IT leaders drive measurable results, maintaining an active pulse on the needs of Members located globally and staying current on industry developments so you can deliver exceptional service across calls and benchmark engagements - in collaboration with analysts, Research Directors, and colleagues across the Research Division.

This is a senior, client-facing advisory role. While it is not a formal people-management position, you set the standard the wider ITFM analyst team works to, and your judgment shapes how the benchmarking service itself evolves.

Our promise to you

You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback, and building strong relationships.

What you will do, includes, but not limited to:
Lead ITFM Benchmarking engagements
  • Lead and deliver ITFM’s flagship offering - IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking engagements with analyst support.
  • Act as a trusted guide for C-suite clients in IT Financial Management, sharing insight on how to manage costs better and lessons from their industry on improving IT’s cost-to-value through benchmarking.
  • Improve the benchmarking service through your expertise — new ways of representing data and new opportunities to enhance the insights delivered.
  • Keep a pulse on industry trends and best practices in your areas of expertise, contributing ideas that shape the benchmarking service.
Cross Departmental Collaboration & Support
  • Support Call Advisory, Workshops, and Global Services teams by advising peers on IT Spend and Staff Benchmark research and analysis as needed.
  • Provide subject-matter expertise and feedback to other Research Division teams and to partnering divisions — Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, and others — as needed.
  • Design and build high-quality keynote and other presentations and deliver them successfully as needed.
Practice & Analyst Development
  • Contribute to and help with own benchmarking methodology, mapping standards, and delivery toolsets, working with Research Directors and the Practice Lead.
  • Support automation and data infrastructure initiatives that improve engagement consistency and scalability.
  • Mentor Research Analysts, reviewing their benchmark outputs and client-ready materials and helping them progress toward independent engagement leadership.
  • Make active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analysis, research, and writing workflows, and help bring effective practices to the wider team.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Required
  • Undergraduate degree required (business or technology preferred).
  • Practical experience (5–10+ years) in one or more of: IT Cost Benchmarking, IT Financial Management, or Project Management.
  • Experience in project-driven environments.
  • Presentation and facilitation experience demonstrated through prior client-facing engagements.
  • Eligibility to obtain appropriate work authorization for cross-border engagements within North America.
  • Availability for periodic after-hours work to support APAC-based client engagements.
Strongly Preferred
  • History of gaining and maintaining trusted-advisor status with management; strong working relationships with the C-suite.
  • Experience leading teams, given the advisory nature of the services offered (this is not a formal people-management role).
  • Professional certifications in Finance and Accounting, Project Management, Business Analysis, or other related disciplines.
  • Active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analytical, research, or writing workflows.
Assets
  • MA, MBA, or MSc.
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems as cost data sources (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Dynamics, etc.).
  • Prior experience contributing to cross-departmental initiatives (e.g., Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, Global Services).

Visa Requirement: Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements: Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service APAC clients.

Language Skills: Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Skills & Attributes

  • Client Interaction & Facilitation - Leads calls and benchmark engagements with C-suite Members; facilitates discussion and builds trusted-advisor standing.
  • Benchmarking & Cost Analysis - Deep working knowledge of IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking methodology, cost frameworks, and peer set construction.
  • Project Management - Manages engagement timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across concurrent client benchmarks.
  • Business Development - Identifies and helps develop opportunities to grow the benchmarking service and its value to clients.
  • Executive Writing & Presentation - Produces and delivers polished, executive-ready written analysis, decks, and keynote presentations.
  • AI Productivity Tooling - Practical use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, research, and writing. A working habit, not a credential.
  • Inclusion - Works effectively and respectfully with a globally distributed team and Member base.
  • Knowledge Application & Decision Making - Applies sound problem-solving and judgment in ambiguous, data-light situations.
  • Managing Through Change & Uncertainty - Stays effective and credible as client needs, data, and priorities shift.
  • Dynamic Learning Mindset - Keeps a pulse on industry trends and brings new thinking back into the practice.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration - Reviews and improves analyst work and shares knowledge proactively across the team.
