title: Senior Internal Controller
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Internal Controller supports the deployment, execution, and continuous improvement of the Group Internal Control Framework across assigned regions, entities, and shared service operations.

The role acts as a strong second line of defense partner to Finance and operational teams, ensuring effective governance, risk mitigation, and consistent application of internal control standards across entities, shared services, and outsourced environments.

Role Responsibilities

Internal Controls & Compliance

· Implementation and maintenance of an effective internal control framework across assigned entities and processes, in line with Group standards, including companies that newly acquired

· Ensure controls are properly designed, documented, and embedded within operational workflows (Finance and non-Finance), rather than treated as standalone or compensating controls

· Perform internal control reviews and walkthroughs covering key end-to-end processes such as RTR, PTP, OTC, Master Data, HR, Supply Chain, and other relevant activities

· Monitor compliance with company policies, approval workflows, Delegation of Authorities (DoA), and internal control procedures

· Perform ad hoc duties and special assignments as required by management.

Segregation of Duties (SoD)

· Perform reviews of user access rights and role assignments to identify potential SoD conflicts.

· Coordinate with Finance, IT, HR, GBS, and management teams to remediate SoD issues and strengthen preventive controls.

· Support periodic access reviews and promote awareness of SoD principles across teams.

Internal Control Self-Assessment (ICSA) & Control Evidence

· Lead the end-to-end execution of the ICSA programme for designated entities in accordance with Group requirements, including conducting process walkthroughs, interviewing control owners, collecting and validating supporting evidence, and completing control assessments.

·

· Coordinate and support the annual Internal Control Self-Assessment (ICSA) process for assigned entities and processes.

· Ensure timely completion, quality of responses, and availability of adequate supporting control evidence.

· Review ICSA results, identify control gaps or weaknesses, and support management in defining and tracking remediation action plans.

· Contribute to the maintenance of a structured, consistent, and auditable repository of control documentation and evidence.

Process Optimization & Transformation

· Act as a trusted internal control partner and advisor to management within the assigned scope.

· Provide guidance and hands-on support to reinforce internal control awareness and compliance culture.

· Escalate key risks, control deficiencies, or recurring issues with clear analysis and practical recommendations.

· Work closely with Regional & Country teams, GBS process owners, Group Internal Control, and Internal Audit teams.

· Evolve internal control environment

Stakeholder Management

· Work closely with:

o Regional and country Finance / Operations management

o Other team that required advises from Internal Controller

· Act as a trusted advisor to management teams on internal control, governance, and risk management matters.

Audit & Risk Management:

· Participate in all audit missions within the perimeter and internationally as per Group needs.

· Assess entity-specific risks and recommend local controls to mitigate them.

· Incorporate process audits into the annual audit plan, ensuring all processes are reviewed.

· Conduct risk-based on-site assessments of key suppliers/logistics providers, coordinating with local management and purchasing teams, and report findings for action.

· Escalate key risks, control breaches, or delivery concerns with clear analysis and recommendations.

Key Performance Indicators

· Internal control compliance and maturity scores

· Timely completion of ICSA and closure of audit findings

· Reduction in control deficiencies and operational risk exposure

· Level of standardization and efficiency improvements achieved

· Effectiveness of internal control training and awareness

Requirements

· MBA / Bachelor’s degree in finance & accounting

· Minimum 6 years of internal control or related work experience in an internal control and risk related fields

· Strong understanding of internal control frameworks.

· Solid knowledge of financial processes, risk management, and compliance standards.

· Proven ability to analyse complex processes and recommend practical solutions.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

· Ability to work across diverse cultures and manage responsibilities across multiple countries.

· Advanced skills in ERP systems, data analytics, and Microsoft Excel.

· High integrity and strong ethical judgement.

· Detail-oriented with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

· Proactive, independent, and capable of handling ambiguity.

· Strong project management and change management mindset.

· Excellent command of English (both written and spoken)

Able to travel

title: Senior IP Specialist
description:
ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 10,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Senior IP Specialist is responsible for defining and executing the IP strategy for OrganOx, aligning with our R&D and business objectives.

As OrganOx’s standalone Intellectual Property professional, this role has accountability for the development, protection, maintenance and strategic exploitation of OrganOx's global IP portfolio. The Senior IP Specialist operates with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal internal authority on IP matters and provides input to R&D, commercial, regulatory and business development decisions.

This is an onsite position at OrganOx’s UK office in Oxford, with flexibility.

Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

Major Responsibilities

Reporting to the SVP Business Development & Partnerships, the Senior IP Specialist will take responsibility for:

  • IP strategy development, aligning with R&D and business objectives, including ownership of the IP portfolio and patent filing strategy
  • Promoting an innovation culture by increasing awareness of IP value across the R&D team and establishing processes to increase invention disclosure activity
  • Encouraging regular filing of new invention disclosures to ensure timely capture of new ideas, with responsibility for maintaining a sustainable pipeline of patentable innovations
  • Assessment of the novelty and inventiveness of new invention disclosures, with support from industry standard IP tools
  • Prioritisation of ideas for patent protection, based on technical merit, novelty, inventiveness, strategic alignment and agreed IP budget
  • Management of the drafting and filing of new patent applications, in partnership with external IP counsel
  • Management and maintenance of OrganOx’s existing patent and trademark portfolio, including the tracking of prosecution timelines, renewal deadlines and jurisdictional requirements to ensure continuous IP protection and avoid loss of rights
  • Providing freedom-to-operate guidance to the R&D team during product development, with accountability for identifying and escalating material IP risks that may affect product development and commercialisation
  • Supporting responses to IP challenges and disputes (e.g. oppositions, third-party assertions) in coordination with external counsel
  • Monitoring competitor patent filings and IP activity, providing regular IP landscape reports and recommendations to Senior Leadership
  • Supporting the Business Development department in IP due diligence for licensing and acquisition opportunities, including assessment of portfolio strength, valuation drivers and freedom-to-operate constraints
  • Supporting the IP aspects of external R&D collaborations and agreements, ensuring clarity on ownership, licensing rights and access to improvements
  • Management of the annual IP budget and external patent counsel spend, ensuring disciplined control of prosecution costs, prioritisation of filings and cost-effective use of external counsel
  • Primary internal point of accountability for all patent, trademark and IP-related matters, advising Senior Leadership on strategic IP opportunities and risks
  • Develop, implement and continuously improve IP governance processes, policies, metrics and reporting frameworks
  • Provide regular portfolio performance reporting, including filing activity, portfolio strength, prosecution outcomes, competitor activity, spend against budget and IP risk exposure
  • Adhere to the letter and spirit of OrganOx’s Code of Conduct and all other company policies

Requirements

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in Intellectual Property management within the medical device, biotech or life sciences sector, including responsibility for developing and executing IP strategy
  • Demonstrated specialised experience in independently managing patent drafting, prosecution and portfolio management across major jurisdictions, including Europe & US, with direct responsibility for managing multiple patent groupings and external counsel relationships
  • Strong understanding of patentability assessment, prior art searching, and freedom-to-operate analysis
  • Experience working closely with R&D teams in a product development environment, with ability to translate technical innovation into IP strategy
  • Competent experience managing external patent counsel and coordinating filings through external patent firms, including budget responsibility and evaluation of external counsel performance
  • Demonstrated strong ability to analyse competitor IP landscapes and derive actionable insights for product and filing strategy
  • Proactive in supporting IP aspects of commercial transactions, including licensing, technology evaluation or due diligence
  • Strong analytical and technical interpretation skills
  • Ability to operate at the interface of science, patent law and commercial strategy, translating these interfaces for non-specialist audiences
  • Excellent communication skills, particularly with non-IP specialists
  • High level of attention to detail and deadline management
  • Track record of generating measurable business value through IP activities
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously as the IP subject matter expert, within a dynamically innovative organisation, balancing strategic priorities, legal risk and commercial objectives
  • Experience establishing or improving IP processes, governance frameworks, invention disclosure programs or innovation capture systems would be highly advantageous

Qualifications

  • Degree in a relevant scientific or engineering (STEM) discipline

Benefits

At OrganOx, we value innovation, evidence, integrity, teamwork, respect, and passion. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including healthcare and retirement plans. We support work-life balance and provide opportunities for ongoing professional development.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation race, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Mekaaninen asentaja junakaluston kunnossapitoon – pääkaupunkiseutu
location: Uusimaa, Espoo, Helsinki, Kauniainen, Kerava, Kirkkonummi, Tuusula, Vantaa, Sipoo
description:
Oletko kiinnostunut työskentelemään junakaluston parissa? Haluatko tehdä käytännönläheistä työtä, jossa oma kädenjälkesi auttaa pidentämään junien elinkaarta ja edistämään niiden kestävää käyttöä?

Etsimme mekaanisten asennuksien osaajia työskentelemään junakaluston parissa pääkaupunkiseudulla. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu monipuolisesti mekaanista asennusta ja komponenttien asennusta, telien huoltoa, vikakorjauksia sekä erilaisia viimeistelytöitä. Työssä pääset osaksi junakaluston kunnossapitoa ja elinkaaren pidentämistä.

Työtä tehdään mahdollisesti kahdessa vuorossa aamu- ja iltavuoroissa. Työvuoroista sovitaan etukäteen, mutta toivomme sinulta joustavuutta vuorojen suhteen. Tehtävään valittaville henkilöille tehdään laaja työhöntulotarkastus ennen työn aloittamista.
Työtehtävässä noudatetaan rautatiealan työehtosopimusta.


Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Muutaman vuoden kokemusta mekaanisista asennuksista
  • Metalli- tai konealan koulutusta
  • Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen tuotantolaitoksista
  • Valmius tehtävän edellyttämään laajaan työhöntulotarkastukseen
  • Hyviä kädentaitoja ja itsenäistä työotetta
  • Työturvallisuuskortti- sekä tulityökortti
  • Suomen kielen taitoa

Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta junakaluston tai muun raskaan kaluston huolto- ja asennustöistä
  • Kokemusta komponenttien asennuksesta
  • Teknisen alan koulutus
  • Kokemusta vianetsinnästä ja vikakorjauksista

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 14-17 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa
  • Kattavan perehdytyksen sekä edellytykset, että onnistut työtehtävässä
  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan
  • Työtehtävän mukaiset hyvät työvaatteet ja muut tarvittavat varusteet
  • Luotettavan ja rehdin työnantajan, sekä vakavaraisen asiakasyrityksen
  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisesti eri kohteissa ja eri tehtävissä

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 14.

  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.


Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian! Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt mahdollisimman pian.

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä Emmi Rajalalta emmi.rajala@worker.fi tai numerosta 050 473 0642. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Electronics Repair & Testing Specialist
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

As an Electronics Repair & Testing Specialist, you will help ensure the quality, functionality, and readiness of electronic devices such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, and consoles. This role involves hands-on functional testing, quality checks, basic troubleshooting, software updates, and carrying out or supporting repairs when needed. The position reports directly to the EVS Manager.

This is an on-site position at our warehouse in Hamburg.

In this position, you’ll

  • Perform Functional Testing: Test electronic devices using established processes to assess their functionality, condition, and readiness.
  • Support Troubleshooting & Repairs: Identify potential issues during testing and carry out basic repairs or support repair activities when needed.
  • Ensure Quality Control: Assess the condition, functionality, and performance of verified and repaired devices and confirm they meet quality standards.
  • Perform Software Updates & Resets: Update devices, restore them to factory settings, and ensure compliance with data privacy guidelines.
  • Document Testing & Repair Results: Accurately record test outcomes, repair needs and actions, device condition, and any remaining defects.
  • Support Process Improvements: Support the team in improving testing, evaluation, and repair-related workflows.
  • Diagnose and Repair Devices: Identify hardware and software issues in smartphones, tablets, laptops, and consoles, and, if needed, carry out repairs using established procedures.

About you

  • Hands-on experience in repairing, refurbishing, evaluating, or testing electronic devices such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, consoles, or similar equipment.
  • Knowledge of electronic components, repair tools, testing procedures, and troubleshooting methods.
  • Experience with component replacement, functional testing, device diagnostics, and quality control is an advantage.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on repair quality, testing accuracy, and device functionality.
  • Proactive, flexible, and able to adapt to changing priorities.
  • Willing to learn, improve repair and testing skills, and share knowledge with colleagues.

Work perks

  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport

Working at Vinted

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

If this sounds interesting – you may well be just who we need.

The annual gross salary range for this position is:
€36.600—€43.100 EUR

title: Kirjanpitäjä, Auramo Oy
description:
Haluatko ottaa kokonaisvastuun valmistavan teollisuuden yrityksen kirjanpidosta ja toimia keskeisessä roolissa kansainvälisen konsernin talousraportoinnissa? Etsimme nyt kokenutta kirjanpidon ammattilaista vakituiseen työsuhteeseen osaksi Auramo Oy:n asiantuntevaa hallintotiimiä.

Auramo Oy valmistaa ja myy paperi- ja metsäteollisuuden trukkilisälaitteita. Olemme osa monikansallista Hyster-Yale-konsernia, jonka lisälaitedivisioona Bolzoni Group on Euroopan markkinajohtaja trukkilisälaitteissa. Tarjoamme markkinoiden kattavimman tuotevalikoiman erilaisiin teollisuuden ja logistiikan käyttökohteisiin.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/a119c981-3616-4af8-9341-30cc6df400da/original.png]

Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?

Kirjanpitäjänä vastaat Auramo Oy:n kirjanpidosta kokonaisuudessaan veroilmoituksineen. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät operatiivinen tekeminen, talousraportointi sekä itsenäinen asiantuntijatyö, jossa pääset hyödyntämään vahvaa ammattitaitoasi.

Vastuullasi ovat muun muassa kulujen jaksottaminen kuukausittain oikeille kausille ja muut kirjanpidon yleiset tehtävät, tilien täsmäytykset, ALV- ja veroilmoitukset sekä kuukausittaiset ajot ja raportoinnit. Lisäksi vastaat konserniraportoinnista Italiaan ja Yhdysvaltoihin sekä osallistut liiketoiminnan tulosten läpikäyntiin emoyhtiön kanssa.

Työskentelet lähellä valmistavaa teollisuutta, joten tuotantokustannusten ja varastoarvostusten ymmärtäminen auttaa sinua onnistumaan tehtävässä. Pääset myös heti mukaan tulevaan SAP S/4HANA -järjestelmäuudistukseen.

Kyseessä on vakituinen työsuhde. Kuunvaihteet sekä kvartaali- ja vuositilinpäätösjaksot ovat työn kiireisintä aikaa, jolloin työpäivät voivat ajoittain venyä tiukkojen raportointiaikataulujen varmistamiseksi.

Mitä me etsimme?

Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinulla on vahva käytännön kokemus kirjanpidon kokonaisvastuullisista tehtävistä sekä kyky hoitaa kirjanpito itsenäisesti tilinpäätökseen asti. Ymmärrät kirjanpidon logiikkaa syvällisesti etkä ole riippuvainen järjestelmien automaattisista kirjauksista.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta erityisesti valmistavan teollisuuden toimintaympäristöstä sekä hyvää tuntemusta Suomen kirjanpito- ja verolainsäädännöstä. Hallitset rutiinien lisäksi ALV-käsittelyn, veroilmoitukset, tilinpäätösprosessit sekä erilaiset täsmäytys- ja selvitystehtävät.

Tehtävässä hyödyt myös vahvasta Excel-osaamisesta, sillä raportointikokonaisuuksiin kuuluu useita erilaisia raporttipohjia ja analysointia tukevia laskelmia. Kansainvälisen konserniympäristön vuoksi pystyt työskentelemään sujuvasti myös englanniksi.

Arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta SAP-järjestelmistä, palkanlaskennan perusteista kirjanpidon näkökulmasta, sisäisestä laskennasta sekä kansainvälisestä konserniympäristöstä. Henkilönä olet motivoitunut oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen ja käytännönläheinen ammattilainen, joka viihtyy itsenäisessä roolissa ja tarttuu aktiivisesti myös konsernin puolelta tuleviin uusiin selvityksiin ja tehtäviin.

Miksi meille?

Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääset vastaamaan yhden yhtiön kirjanpidon kokonaisuudesta ja hyödyntämään osaamistasi laaja-alaisesti. Työ tarjoaa sopivassa suhteessa operatiivista tekemistä, asiantuntijavastuuta sekä kansainvälistä yhteistyötä. Pääset työskentelemään lähellä valmistavan teollisuuden arkea, näkemään työsi vaikutukset konkreettisesti sekä tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä niin paikallisen johdon kuin kansainvälisen konsernin kanssa. Auramolla yhdistyvät vakavaraisen kansainvälisen konsernin vakaus ja pienen suomalaisen organisaation ketteryys.

Tarjoamme tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen, vuosittaiset palkantarkistukset ja konsernin tavoite- ja palkitsemisjärjestelmän. Lisäksi käytössäsi ovat lounas- ja liikuntaedut sekä kattava työterveyshuolto.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme lisää. Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 29.10.2026. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Saija Salter, saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].

title: Määräaikainen koulunkäynninohjaaja
description:
Haemme Lopen kunnan perusopetukseen Launosten kouluun koulunkäynninohjaajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 26.10.2026-4.6.2027. Työaika on 32 h/vk työtunteja on sekä koululla että iltapäivätoiminnassa. Määräaikaisuuden perusteena on koulunkäynnin ja oppimisen tuen määräaikaiset järjestelyt.

Haemme vaihtoehtoisesti koulunkäynninohjaajan tutkinnon, lähihoitajan tutkinnon tai työkokemuksella osoitetun pätevyyden omaavaa oma-aloitteista ja yhteistyökykyistä koulunkäynninohjaajaa.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä todistus terveydentilastaan sekä lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Koeaika on kolme (3) kuukautta.

Alkuperäiset tutkintotodistukset pyydetään nähtäväksi haastatteluun kutsuttavilta.

Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen yleisen työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (KVTES) mukaisesti. Kunnassamme on tehty työn vaativuuden arviointi, johon tehtäväkohtainen palkka perustuu.

Lopen kunta käyttää sähköistä rekrytointijärjestelmää, joten hakemus tulee tehdä osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Hakemuksen liitteeksi tutkintotodistukset.

title: Senior Research Investigator
description:
**University Overview**

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

Senior Research Investigator

**Job Profile Title**

Research Investigator, Senior

**Job Description Summary**

This is a position for Senior Research Investigator, with a purpose to investigate the pathogenic mechanisms underlying neurodevelopmental and neuropsychiatric disorders using model systems such as human iPSCs and mouse models. The primary function of this position includes functional characterization of disorder-related genetic variants using cutting-edge molecular, cellular, genetic and genomic approaches, such as single cell genomics, spatial transcriptomics, confocal microscopy and bioinformatics. Other duties include hiPSC differentiation and maintenance, supporting research of multiple lab members, grant applications and manuscripts.

**Job Description**

**Job Responsibilities**

- Mechanistic characterization of hiPSC models using single cell genomics
- Functional characterization of brain organoids and mouse models using spatial transcriptomics
- Bioinformatic analysis of genomic and transcriptomic data
- Confocal microscopic analysis of neuronal connectivity in hiPSC and mouse models
- Differentiation and maintenance of hiPSCs
- Supporting laboratory research of other lab members
- Assistance in preparing grant applications and manuscripts
- Participate in lab meetings, journal club; attend relevant seminars and conferences and other lab duties

**Qualifications**

- Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Philosophy, and 5 to 7 years of postdoctoral experience is required.

**POSITION IS CONTINGENT UPON FUNDING**

title: Housing Stability Worker - Indigenous Housing Specialist 62XXH
description:
Join Our Team

Imagine being part of an organization that adds value to our community, cares about its staff, and creates a supportive workplace environment. Starling Community Services (formerly Lutherwood) is a progressive, not-for-profit health and social service organization that strengthens people's lives by providing mental health, employment, and housing services to more than 22,586 people annually in Waterloo Region and Wellington County.

We need great people like you to help us realize our mission and support communities where everyone experiences mental wellness, opportunities for employment, a place to call home, and a sense of belonging.

Meaningful Work. Real Impact. Amazing People. Learn why our Housing Team loves the work they do.

One full-time permanent Housing Stability Worker - Indigenous Housing Specialist position available, starting on October 26, 2026, Working 37.5 hours per week.

What's in it For You?

  • Job Band H (hourly wages): Min - $30.11, Mid - $32.69, Max - $37.06
  • A positive work culture, inclusive workplace policies, and employee wellness initiatives.
  • Enrollment in a defined pension plan with the Heath Care of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP).
  • Enrollment in our Modular Health and Dental Benefits plan with Sun Life.
  • Access to our Employee and Family Assistance Program which provides free and confidential counselling, resources and services.
  • 3 Weeks paid vacation (accumulated bi-weekly)
  • 15 hours of personal time per year.
  • Paid sick time (accumulated monthly) to a maximum of 300 hours.
  • 11 paid holiday benefits per year plus a floater day.
  • Discounted GRT passes through membership with Travel Wise.
  • Employee Referral Incentive Program.
  • Professional development and tuition reimbursement opportunities.
  • Staff appreciation events.

Your Role

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Provides intensive home-based support to individuals and assists them to develop and execute strategies to promote housing stability.
  • Works in partnership with community agencies to gain resources and supports to maintain basic needs and improve quality of life for individual participants.
  • Engages in creative problem-solving to address individual needs, systemic barriers, and service gaps. Assists in referral and access of services as required.
  • Works in alignment with the Agency’s commitment to equity to further create a sense of belonging at the Agency.
  • The above tasks are representative but not all inclusive.

Your Talents and Experience

  • At least 5 years of demonstrated experience working collaboratively with Indigenous organizations, communities, or populations, with a strong understanding of Indigenous cultures and values.
  • A degree or diploma in social services with relevant experience working with local Indigenous organizations.
  • Experience working in community-based settings with Indigenous populations using a person-centered approach in supportive counselling and case management.
  • Possesses an awareness and understanding of the systemic barriers faced by Indigenous peoples in accessing housing opportunities.
  • This includes understanding the impact of intergenerational trauma, and sound knowledge of the National Commission on Truth and Reconciliation and Jordan’s Principal.
  • Ability to work autonomously and use sound judgment in decision-making is required.
  • Knowledge of the local housing market, Housing First principles, and community services within Waterloo Region.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Reliable transportation is essential for this position.
  • Required to hold a “G” class license and a two-million-dollar liability policy as part of personal car insurance.

If you are community-focused and share our values and commitment to equity, we want you to grow with us. Please submit your application in confidence, no later than 4 pm on October 14, 2026.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you don't have every single requirement and the exact level of experience listed in our description, but the skills and experience needed for the role still resonate with you, please consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and quality; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require any support submitting your application or during the interview process by contacting Human Resources at hr@starlingcs.ca or by calling 519-707-1958 ext. 1247.

Our Commitment to Equity

To better serve the diversity of our community, the agency is dedicated to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for both clients and staff, with particular attention to supporting BIPOC communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ individuals, and other historically marginalized and underrepresented groups. We understand that addressing systemic inequities is crucial to fulfilling our mission and promoting the well-being of the communities we serve.

Our equity strategy is guided by core principles that emphasize celebrating diversity, building strong partnerships, prioritizing client service, and recognizing equity is a shared responsibility.

title: Chief Information Security Officer - CISO (based in Crete)
description:

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
£60,000 GBP

Hybrid WORKING

Location: Glasgow, Scotland - United Kingdom Type: Permanent

A leading global technology and professional services organisation is seeking an experienced Cyber Security Engineer to join its growing Security Engineering function. This is an opportunity for a technically capable security professional to work across complex cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments, helping to protect critical infrastructure, applications and data.

The successful candidate will contribute to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of security solutions while working alongside engineering, cloud and security teams to identify risk, strengthen controls and maintain compliance with recognised security standards.

The Opportunity

The Security Engineering team operates across a broad range of modern technologies and environments, including cloud platforms, on-premises infrastructure and hybrid architectures. The role provides exposure to security tooling covering areas such as security monitoring, incident detection, incident response and threat intelligence.

The Cyber Security Engineer will play a hands-on role in strengthening security across client environments, combining engineering expertise with an understanding of emerging cyber threats and modern security practices.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement and manage cyber security tools, technologies and processes that protect infrastructure, applications and data.
  • Work collaboratively with engineering and security teams to embed security best practices throughout technology environments.
  • Develop automation to improve security operations, including SIEM log ingestion, routing and security tooling.
  • Support firewall and network security management across cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments.
  • Develop, maintain and enhance security policies, standards and procedures.
  • Conduct infrastructure security assessments using recognised methodologies and tooling, including CIS Benchmarks.
  • Contribute to vulnerability management, endpoint security, intrusion detection and prevention capabilities.
  • Support security monitoring and incident response activities within SOC environments.
  • Apply security principles across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, virtualised environments and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Help identify and mitigate emerging security risks, including those associated with AI and modern cloud technologies.
Technical Skills & Experience

The successful Cyber Security Engineer is likely to bring experience across several of the following areas:
  • Strong understanding of cyber security and platform engineering principles.
  • Networking and cloud security across modern technology environments.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, virtualisation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Strong Linux or WSL experience, with software development or scripting capability.
  • Practical experience with SIEM and log management platforms, including technologies such as:
  • Splunk
  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • Cribl
  • ELK
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Scripting or programming skills using Python, Bash and/or PowerShell.
  • Understanding of IDS/IPS, vulnerability management and endpoint security.
  • Experience working within or alongside Security Operations Centre (SOC) teams.
  • Knowledge of AI security and AI hardening techniques.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as:
  • Terraform
  • CloudFormation
  • Bicep

title: Operations Designer, Operations Design Team
description:
Amazon's Global Engineering Services (GES) is seeking an experienced Operations Designer to join the International Operations Design Team (ODT). This individual will be responsible for leading composite design delivery for a portfolio of fulfillment center projects within the EMEA network.

The Operations Designer owns the end-to-end design collaboration process within their assigned portfolio (defined by building type or technical capability), ensuring high quality of deliverables, standards applicability and quantities compliance of composites. They participate actively from Concept Design phase (REVO) through As-built, identifying challenges and influencing their resolution before composite initiation.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in warehouse/logistics design using BIM and CAD tools, with a detail-oriented and data-driven mindset. They will possess problem-solving skills and knowledge of operations processes, design dependencies and execution for construction and fit-out environments. The role requires an 80% tactical / 20% strategic focus, with the designer addressing innovation (clash detection) and value engineering opportunities while supporting cost and speed-to-serve objectives.

The role will be based in Poland, with travel expected for up to 50% of the time depending on the project portfolio

Key job responsibilities
You will lead the full design coordination lifecycle for a portfolio of fulfillment center projects, managing architectural, mechanical handling equipment, and mechanical/electrical/plumbing models with vendors to deliver detailed design packages on time and within specification

You will coordinate warehouse layout designs — from complex machinery placement to floor markings — collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to identify requirements and resolve design challenges from concept through as-built phases

You will assess and communicate project design status to relevant stakeholders and forums, fostering collaboration across programs to address inconsistencies and deliver consistent execution across all sites in your portfolio

You will support field teams by providing layout designs that solve on-site challenges, while tracking the resolution of design issues and facilitating timely design reviews to meet regulatory compliance

You will contribute to the standard design library and drive continuous improvement activities, identifying opportunities to enhance quality and efficiency across the design process

title: Plant Protection Craftsman
description:
About Us
At Monrovia we are dedicated to creating a more beautiful world by selecting and growing plants of superior quality. We know that creating a beautiful garden or landscape is about connecting to the beauty of nature. We use our hearts, minds, and hands to nurture plants for all types of landscapes. Our passion for plants, use of natural processes, and our years of experience result in plants that enable consumers to achieve a landscape of exceptional beauty and share in the joy that comes from creating healthy living spaces.
About the Role:
The Plant Protection Applicator will treat problems as directed in a safe, effective, and efficient manner. As a Plant Protection Applicator, this individual will use their knowledge and skills to mix pesticides and apply them as well as use other pest control methods. The Plant Protection Applicator will work with the Plant Protection Coach(es) and growing area craftsmen to communicate applications being done in their areas. The Plant Protection Applicator will fill out work orders daily so necessary reporting may be completed on time.
Employment Status: Full time
Shift: 7:30 am to 4:00 pm ( schedule varries depending on season and business needs)
Compensation: Hourly based on experience
What You'll Do
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:
You will...
  1. Follow company guidelines and label directions concerning chemical mixing, applying, reporting, & disposal of pesticide containers
  2. Connect hoses and nozzles selected according to equipment and application requirements. Lift, push, and swing spray guns, and hoses to direct spray over designated areas.
  3. Operate tractor and spraying equipment in a safe and effective manner.
  4. Place flags for spray applications and conduct other field tasks as needed.
  5. Conduct proper housekeeping of chemical storage area & facilities.
  6. Perform basic routine maintenance of application equipment.
  7. Wear, properly clean, and store personal protective equipment
  8. Perform other assigned tasks as directed by Coach.
Who you are
You…
  • Self-motivated, works and communicates well with other team members and teams, to keep them safe.
  • Ability to follow written work orders and verbal instructions from your coach with minimal supervision.
  • Capable of reading and comprehending basic safety information from pesticide labels according to Federal and State regulations.
  • Ability to properly measure & mix pesticides, which requires some basic math skills.
  • Plant identification is important but can be learned using plant labels.
  • Physically capable of wearing respirator and proper safety equipment, which generally requires being clean shaven. Successfully complete doctor’s physical assessment to use a respirator.
  • Yearly cholinesterase testing (if cholinesterase inhibitors are being used) (optional in some states).
Benefits at Monrovia
  • When you participate in our 401(k) plan, you’ll get a company match of up to 4%.
  • You will be eligible to participate in medical, dental, vision and life insurance.
  • You’ll be able to purchase Monrovia plants for your own garden at 20% off wholesale prices.
  • You'll earn paid vacation
Monrovia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with all applicable Georgia labor laws, including E- Verify. We are committed to maintaining a workplace that is safe, inclusive, and free from harassment or discrimination.

title: Construction Coordinator Intern (Electrical)
description:
Position Title: Construction Coordinator (Electrical Intern) - Summer of 2027

Position Location: Buffalo, New York area (Candidates do not need to currently reside in the Buffalo, New York area)


Position Schedule: The anticipated work schedule is Monday through Friday, generally from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., with lunch provided on-site. All approved business travel, lodging, and project-related living expenses will be covered for the duration of the assignment. To help maintain work-life balance, interns will have the opportunity to travel home every other weekend, subject to project schedules and manager approval.


Job Summary

The Construction Coordinator Intern (Electrical) will support the contractor and/or owner's representative throughout all phases of a mission-critical construction project. Working alongside experienced construction professionals, you'll gain hands-on exposure to project planning, field coordination, quality assurance, scheduling, safety, and project delivery while helping ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.


Throughout the internship, you'll assist with tracking project progress, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients. From pre-construction planning through project turnover and closeout, you'll develop practical experience supporting reporting, risk management, issue resolution, and day-to-day construction operations.


This is a structured learning opportunity designed for individuals beginning their careers in construction management. You'll work under the guidance of experienced professionals, receive mentorship, and build the technical and professional skills needed to succeed in the construction industry while learning DLB Associates' processes, standards, and best practices.


The Construction Coordinator Intern (Electrical) is expected to communicate professionally and collaborate effectively with project teams while supporting DLB Associates' commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and exceptional client service.


Essential Functions

  • Assist project teams with contract administration and coordination meetings.
  • Support document tracking, including submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
  • Help monitor project schedules and budgets using company tools and templates.
  • Assist in preparing reports and presentations summarizing project progress and key metrics.
  • Support field teams in verifying installations meet design and quality expectations.
  • Help document construction activities through photos, logs, and progress summaries.
  • Assist in collecting and organizing closeout documentation.
  • Learn about risk management, safety, and quality assurance practices on active job sites.
  • Prepare visual materials and reports for internal and client-facing updates.
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute to discussions on project improvements.
  • Maintain professional communication and collaboration with team members and contractors.
  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.


Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned


Position Requirements (BEGINNER level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of fundamental construction and project management principles, including scheduling, budgeting, coordination practices, and the materials, methods, and tools used in commercial or mission-critical facilities.
  • Ability to learn commissioning processes for electrical, mechanical, and controls systems in mission-critical environments.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to learn construction management software such as Procore.
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management.
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements.
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with onsite and remote team members.
  • Ability to analyze complex information and develop plans to address identified issues.


Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:


  • Frequently manipulating small parts/tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through data center and outdoor environments (heat, cold, precipitation), including navigating tight spaces, accessing areas via stairs or ladders, and occasionally working in overhead or under-equipment positions.
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.


Travel Requirements

  • Must have a valid driver’s license
  • Assigned to a Data Center project near Buffalo, New York and required to be on-site there Monday through Friday, generally from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
  • Interns will be permitted to travel home every other weekend, subject to project schedules and management approval.
  • Travel up to 25% to other priority project locations
  • You will be issued a corporate American Express card to cover project-related travel expenses, including airfare, lodging, meals, and other approved costs.
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business needs.


CERTIFICATIONS & SAFETY

Ability to achieve NFPA 70E and/or OSHA training as required; strict adherence to HSE/LOTO policies.


Education / Experience

In pursuit of a bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or related discipline.

OR

One year of hands‑on install/testing/validation/troubleshooting of mechanical, controls, and/or electrical infrastructure.


CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.


DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.


Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​


​NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

title: Pääsuunnittelija
description:

- Suunnitteluprojektien tekninen ohjaus, seuranta ja valvonta - Vaatimusten määrittely, hallinta ja toteutumisen varmistaminen - Projektin työn rakenteen (WBS) muodostaminen ja ylläpito (JIRA) - Suunnittelutehtävien määrittely ja jakaminen suunnittelutiimeille - 3D-mekaniikkasuunnittelun ja PDM-rakenteiden hallinta - Suunnitteluratkaisujen ohjaus ja hyväksyntä projektivaatimusten mukaisesti - Yhteistyö ja koordinointi asiakkaiden sekä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa - Projektien etenemisen seuranta, raportointi ja aikatauluissa pysymisen varmistaminen

- Kokemus mekaniikkasuunnittelusta sekä soveltuva tekninen koulutus (insinööri/DI) - Kokemusta suunnitteluprojektien teknisestä johtamisesta - Vahva 3D-suunnitteluosaaminen (CAD) ja ymmärrys PDM-rakenteista - Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä luovaa ongelmanratkaisutaitoa pitkäjänteisellä otteella - Sujuva suomen ja hyvä englannin kielen taito

We’re on the hunt for a Senior Hardware Design Engineer.

Delivering all three business area capabilities in Geointelligence, Robotics & Space Operations, and Satellite Systems, our UK team provides support to our European-based customers while specializing in the development of advanced space sensors for exploration missions as well as space-based communication technology. As our presence grows overseas, so does our need for new ambitious team players to help us advance our place in the Universe and beyond.

  • Detailed circuit design including schematic capture, component selection and electronic simulation

  • Playing an active role in the leadership of the team

Required Skills and Qualifications

    • 10+ years’ experience in a hardware product design role, in the Space or an equivalent High reliability sector
    • Experience in the design and manufacture of complex circuits and multi-layer (10+) HDI PCBs for high reliability applications
    • Experience of circuit and PCB design and simulation tools
    • Knowledge of power supply design and layout techniques
    • Knowledge of high speed digital design and Serdes interconnects
    • Specialist knowledge in any of the following areas would be advantageous:
      • Knowledge of LEO/GEO communications payloads
    • High reliability design and analysis (Space, Military, Automotive, etc)
      • RF design and validation
    • Electronic circuitry radiation effects and mitigation techniques
    • DC/DC power supply design
    • Knowledge of environmental, thermal, safety and EMI/EMC standards
    • Practical use of scripting languages Tcl/Python/Perl etc

      We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are constantly looking for others to join #TeamMDA to ignite new and innovative approaches to problem-solving that push us forward to improve life on and above Earth. If you’re excited to expand our place in space and driven to inspire the next generation, we’ll take you there.

title: Sisälogistiikan työnjohtaja Europress Group Oy:lle
description:
Onko sinulla kokemusta logistiikan työnjohtotehtävistä ja halua kehittää toimintaa entistä sujuvammaksi? Haluaisitko päästä rakentamaan uutta tiimiä ja vaikuttamaan sisälogistiikan toimintatapoihin kasvavassa ja kansainvälisessä yrityksessä?

Etsimme nyt asiakkaallemme Europress Group Oy:lle sisälogistiikan työnjohtajaa Keravalle vakituiseen ja kokopäiväiseen työsuhteeseen.

Europress Group Oy on kansainvälinen kiertotalouden teknologiayhtiö, joka rakentaa puhtaampaa ja resurssiviisaampaa tulevaisuutta yhdistämällä datan, teknologian ja toimialaosaamisen. Yritys auttaa asiakkaitaan vähentämään jätehuollon hukkaa, pienentämään päästöjä ja hyödyntämään materiaalejaan entistä tehokkaammin. Europressin ratkaisujen ytimessä ovat älykkäät jätepuristimet, paalaimet ja digitaaliset palvelut, joiden avulla materiaalivirroista tehdään hallittavampia, tehokkaampia ja vastuullisempia. Yrityksen tuotteet valmistetaan Keravan tehtaalla, ja Suomessa Europress työllistää noin 150 alan ammattilaista.

Työpäiväsi

Sisälogistiikan työnjohtajana vastaat Europressin uuden sisälogistiikkatiimin päivittäisestä johtamisesta, töiden organisoinnista sekä toiminnan kehittämisestä. Pääset kehittämään tiimisi osaamista, yhteistyötä ja toimintatapoja sekä huolehtimaan sujuvasta arjesta, työnjaosta ja työvuorosuunnittelusta. Tehtävässäsi varmistat myös, että tuotannon tarvitsemat materiaalit ovat oikeassa paikassa oikeaan aikaan.

Työssäsi pääset kehittämään sisälogistiikan prosesseja ja materiaalivirtoja kokonaisvaltaisesti aina saapuvan tavaran vastaanotosta varastointiin, keräilyyn, sisäisiin kuljetuksiin ja lähtevien toimitusten lastaamiseen asti. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotannon, hankinnan, suunnittelun ja huollon kanssa sekä osallistut turvallisuuden, laadun ja tehokkuuden jatkuvaan parantamiseen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös varaston päivittäisiin työtehtäviin ja esimerkiksi trukilla tehtäviin materiaalisiirtoihin.

Kyseessä on uusi tehtävä, jossa sinulla on erinomainen mahdollisuus vaikuttaa sisälogistiikan tulevaisuuteen ja rakentaa toimivia käytäntöjä yhdessä tiimisi kanssa. Pääset myös osallistumaan uuden toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän kehittämiseen ja testaamiseen. Tehtävä tarjoaa paljon vastuuta, mutta myös vapautta kehittää toimintaa omien näkemystesi ja osaamisesi pohjalta.

Työ on pääsääntöisesti lähityötä ja sitä tehdään päivävuorossa arkipäivisin. Tehtävä edellyttää läsnäoloa tuotannon ja tiimin arjessa, jossa yhteistyö ja nopea reagointi ovat tärkeässä roolissa.

Arvostamme

* Aikaisempaa kokemusta logistiikan, varaston tai tuotantoympäristön työnjohtotehtävistä
* Soveltuvaa koulutusta esimerkiksi logistiikan, tuotannon tai teknisen alan parista (esim. AMK, insinööri tai vastaava)
* Kokemusta logistiikkaprosessien ja toimintatapojen kehittämisestä
* Hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia sekä kokemusta toiminnanohjausjärjestelmistä (ERP)
* Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja esihenkilötaitoja sekä kykyä johtaa ja motivoida tiimiä
* Trukinajotaitoa ja valmiutta osallistua tarvittaessa käytännön varastotyöhön
* Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
* Oma-aloitteista, ratkaisukeskeistä ja kehitysmyönteistä työskentelyotetta

Tarjoamme sinulle

Europress Group Oy tarjoaa sinulle vakituisen ja kokopäiväisen työsuhteen sekä erinomaisen mahdollisuuden päästä kehittämään sisälogistiikan toimintaa uudessa ja vastuullisessa työnjohtajan roolissa. Pääset osaksi kasvavaa ja kansainvälistä yritystä, jossa sinulla on aidosti mahdollisuus vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön, tiimisi toimintatapoihin ja koko tehtaan materiaalivirtojen sujuvuuteen. Europressin vahvat kasvutavoitteet tarjoavat myös kiinnostavia mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisesi kehittämiseen ja uralla etenemiseen.

Saat tehtävääsi kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka aikana tutustut sisälogistiikan toimintaan, eri osastoihin ja tärkeimpiin yhteistyökumppaneihisi. Tukenasi ovat osaava tiimisi sekä kokeneet kollegat ja esihenkilöt. Mukavan työyhteisön lisäksi Europress tarjoaa monipuoliset henkilöstöedut, kuten kattavan työterveyshuollon, lounasedun sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietuja sekä tehtäväkohtaisen bonuksen.

Palkka: 4 000–4 800 €/kk, joka määritellään osaamisen ja aikaisemman kokemuksen perusteella.

Hakuprosessi

Olisiko Europress Group Oy juuri sinun tuleva työpaikkasi? Lähetäthän hakemuksesi suoraan kotisivujemme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajalla, ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä! Työsuhde solmitaan suoraan Europress Group Oy kanssa, ja työn aloitusajankohdasta sovitaan valittavan henkilön kanssa.

Jäikö kysyttävää?

HR Team Leader Nelli Heikkinen
nelli.heikkinen@workpower.fi
044 747 7005

title: Product Operations
description:
Tenengroup is a global, data-driven, end-to-end e-commerce leader, offering a diverse range of personalized and on-demand products. From jewelry to lifestyle goods, our portfolio of brands serves customers around the world. Powered by our in-house built e-commerce platform, we deliver exceptional shopping experiences and continue to drive innovation in the e-commerce industry.

Role Overview

We are seeking a hands-on, self-driven Product Operations Specialist to join our Product team, reporting to the Director of Product. This is an ownership role. You will be directly accountable for the operational health of the product organization — its processes, systems, and cross-functional coordination. You'll regularly get exposure to new tools and domains — and we expect you to embrace that, not shy away from it. If you wait to be told what to do, this isn't the role for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own product team operations end-to-end: intake, sprint ops, and release management.
  • Actively contribute to internal operational systems and platforms — propose improvements, participate in builds, and help shape how the team works.
  • Coordinate across Product, R&D, Marketing, and CX. Surface misalignments early. Resolve what you can before escalating.
  • Track action items, blockers, and risks across squads. Keep things moving.
  • Maintain clear, accurate product documentation — status reports, roadmap updates, process guides.
  • Spot inefficiencies. Fix them. Measure whether the fix worked.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate your own work — research, documentation, analysis, automation. Be curious about what's possible.
  • Help teammates when you see a gap — even when it's not in your scope.

Requirements

  • 1–2 years of experience in Product Operations, Project Management, or a similar operational role in tech or e-commerce.
  • Proven self-learner — you've picked up tools and domains on your own and can show it.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools in your daily work and can demonstrate how they make you more effective.
  • High ownership and accountability. "Not my job" isn't in your vocabulary.
  • Strong organizational skills. You manage multiple workstreams without being managed yourself.
  • Experience with project management tools (Monday.com, Jira, Confluence, or similar).
  • Clear, effective communication — written and verbal.
  • Comfortable in a multi-brand, multi-squad environment with constant context-switching.
  • Process-minded. You notice what's broken before someone tells you.
  • Familiar with agile workflows, sprint cycles, and backlog management.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in e-commerce or D2C environments.
  • Familiarity with analytics tools (GA4, Tableau, or similar).
  • Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation workflows.
  • Technical curiosity — you don't write code, but you understand how engineering teams work.
  • Experience using AI for workflow automation, content generation, or process optimization

--------

If you're a hands-on operator who owns outcomes, learns fast, and believes making the people around you more effective is part of the job — we'd love to hear from you. Join Tenengroup and help power exceptional e-commerce experiences for millions of users worldwide.

title: Operations Data Analyst
description:
ABOUT 49North

49North is a Canadian defence company delivering secure, multi-domain C4ISR capabilities that provide decision advantage in complex and contested environments. A wholly-owned subsidiary of MDA Space, building on more than five decades of trusted Canadian defence delivery, 49North operates as a sovereign Canadian provider of mission-critical C4ISR systems, bringing disciplined prime-contractor execution to defence and security programs.

Visit 49North | An MDA Space Company.

49North is rooted in the execution of large, complex, and mission-critical programs developed within 49NORTH. This legacy reflects a record of delivery where engineering rigour, operational reliability, and national trust are non-negotiable.

49North Defence strengthens Canada’s sovereign defence capability by delivering integrated mission systems and multi-domain C4ISR integration, enabling trusted Canadian and coalition operations, assured interoperability, and sustained readiness.

Role:

The role of Operations Data Analyst reports to the Director, Mission Assurance and resides within the Administration function of the larger Programs & Operations Team of 49North, an MDA Space business. As an Operations Data Analyst, you will work with business stakeholders to realize business intelligence through structured data analysis, processing and visualization. This role also includes Process Specialist responsibilities, you will work with process stakeholders to define, realize (implement), deploy and maintain in-scope processes as well as administrate supporting systems, notably the 49North Business Process System (BPS). As an ISO 9001 certified Quality System and plans to implement Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), you will help continuously improve select enterprise systems to meet local needs and assist in the deployment of OneMDA Corporate improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities:

Responsibilities of the Operations Data Analyst includes those associated with continual improvement as a Process Specialist. In terms of data analysis, two aspects are considered: business intelligence initiation and business intelligence realization.

Business Intelligence Initiation

Works with Business Leadership and performs the following:

  • Identifies the means to quantitatively or qualitatively support assessment of key business objectives and their corresponding Critical Success Factors through identification of Key Performance Indicators and associated metrics
  • Creates plans describing the bringing together of data sources, working with Corporate stakeholders (e.g. IT) as necessary

Business Intelligence Realization

  • Identifies and assesses data sources for suitability and takes actions to remediate data quality and integrity as necessary
  • Connects data sources in a way that enables collective analysis
  • Develops dashboards, reports and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to performance
  • Performs analyses identifying trends, patterns, anomalies and opportunities for improvement
  • Provides and/or presents evidence-based data interpretations and recommendations

In terms of continual improvement, two aspects are considered: facilitating implementation and change initiatives and administrating supporting systems.

Implementation and Change Initiatives Facilitation

Sources of improvement efforts can include ongoing activities (e.g. maintaining the BPS), local business initiatives (e.g. implementing CMMI), and enabling the deployment of Corporate-sponsored OneMDA initiatives.

  • Collaborates with leaders and subject matter experts to understand business challenges and information needs
  • Administrates the identification, prioritization and effort reporting of process improvement initiatives
  • Assesses processes (e.g. preforms value stream mapping), including creating as-is and to-be depictions of process, to identify and eliminate inefficiencies, waste, and ineffectiveness
  • Facilitates discovery activities working with process stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Creates/revises process descriptions (e.g. procedures) and associated process artifacts (e.g. forms, templates) and training materials

Supporting Systems Administration

  • Establishes and maintains the process improvement roadmap reflecting the priorities of Operational Excellence and, as applicable, upgrades to the content of the BPS
  • Maintains the BPS through the evaluation of process Change Requests (CRs) and administration of Change Control Board (CCB) meetings with Process Owners
  • Participates in the review of Lessons Learned reports to identify potential opportunities for improvement (OFIs)
  • Leads the disposition of OFI records
  • Serves as the local MS SharePoint administrator and maintains the BPS infrastructure and associated instructional information on use and administration of the BPS
  • Performs process change impact assessments for proposed or planned changes
  • Establishes and maintains a process improvement performance dashboard and periodically reports on process improvement performance

Requirements (experience/skills)

  • A two- or three-year accredited diploma or certificate program in data analysis
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the definition, implementation, maintenance and administration of business processes
  • Working knowledge of and administrator-level hands-on experience with Power BI
  • Experience with database management systems and related query language, notably SQL
  • Microsoft SharePoint site-level administrator experience including HTML and Java scripting capabilities
  • Experience with a structured change implementation methodology as applied to business processes is required. Experience in process value-stream mapping is considered an asset
  • Willingness to extend one’s own technical capabilities through learning
  • Experience working within a quality management system or an ISO- or CMMI-certified workplace is considered an asset
  • Experience working with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g. Infor LN) is considered an asset
  • History of taking the initiative while diplomatically keeping leadership stakeholders informed along the way
  • Strong interpersonal skills, particularly in the areas of peer collaboration and teamwork; comfortable interfacing with the senior management team and able to ‘sell’ improvement initiatives
  • Proven communication skills with an ability to present to multiple stakeholder groups and achieve their buy-in for improvement initiatives

We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are constantly looking for others to join 49North to ignite new and innovative approaches to problem-solving that push us forward.

Comments/Special Considerations:

title: Principal Backend Engineer
description:
Role - Principal Backend Engineer

Salary - £80,000 – £95,000

Location - Manchester

Work Pattern - Hybrid


The Role


We’re looking for an experienced Principal Backend Engineer to join a growing engineering team working on a new, high-performance payments platform.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll remain heavily involved in software development while providing technical leadership across architecture, engineering standards, code quality and best practices.

You’ll work closely with senior engineers and other technical disciplines, taking ownership of features from design through to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing, building and shipping high-quality backend features.
  • Working with asynchronous and event-driven systems.
  • Providing technical guidance and mentoring to other engineers.
  • Making key architectural and technical decisions.
  • Writing clean, secure, well-tested and maintainable code.
  • Reviewing code and helping establish engineering standards.
  • Building and maintaining automated tests and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Integrating third-party services and APIs.
  • Working with cloud and platform engineers to build highly reliable systems.
  • Using AI coding tools as part of your day-to-day development.
  • Supporting the wider engineering team in adopting AI-assisted development effectively.
  • Taking ownership of features throughout the full software development lifecycle.


The Essentials


  • Strong commercial experience with Java, Kotlin or Scala.
  • Proven experience designing and building backend/distributed systems.
  • Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous architectures.
  • Strong database experience, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB or Cosmos DB.
  • Experience integrating third-party services and APIs.
  • Strong understanding of testing, version control, CI/CD and secure coding practices.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to technical standards.
  • Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy and ownership.
  • Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar.


The Desirables


  • Experience designing, building or maintaining payment platforms.
  • Experience building platforms from the ground up.
  • Experience working within regulated or high-trust environments.
  • Cloud-native development across AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Docker, Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards and best practices.


What's on offer


  • Extensive holiday allowance + Bank Holidays.
  • Hybrid working from a Manchester office.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Structured career development and ongoing learning support.
  • The opportunity to have significant influence over architecture, engineering standards and technical direction.

title: Talous- ja kiinteistövälitysasiantuntija
description:
Talous- ja kiinteistövälitysasiantuntija

ProAgria Etelä-Suomi etsii talous- ja kiinteistövälitysasiantuntijaa vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiään Etelä-Suomen alueella.

Haluatko hyödyntää talouden ja kiinteistönvälityksen osaamistasi tehtävässä, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan asiakkaidesi tulevaisuuteen? Tässä roolissa työskentelet maatilojen ja maaseutuyritysten talouden, omistajuuden ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisen sekä kiinteistövälityksen parissa.

Monipuolinen asiantuntijarooli

Toimit asiakkaiden pitkäjänteisenä kumppanina erilaisissa talouden ja omistajuuden muutostilanteissa. Työssä yhdistyvät talousosaaminen, verotus, talouden suunnittelu ja kiinteistönvälitys.

Tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- maatilojen sukupolvenvaihdokset ja osakeyhtiöittämiset

- maa- ja metsätalouden verotus ja verosuunnittelu

- talousneuvonta, talouslaskelmat ja investointien kannattavuuslaskenta

- perunkirjoihin ja muihin perheoikeudellisiin kysymyksiin liittyvä asiantuntijatyö

- kiinteistönvälitystoimeksiannot ja kiinteistöarviot

- maa- ja metsätalousomaisuuden kauppoihin liittyvä asiantuntijatyö.

Roolissa yhdistyvät talouden, juridiikan ja omistajuuden näkökulmat, ja tavoitteenasi on auttaa asiakkaita löytämään kestäviä ja taloudellisesti kannattavia ratkaisuja. Kiinteistövälitys kohdistuu maa- ja metsätalouden asiakkuuksiin.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme analyyttista ja asiakaslähtöistä asiantuntijaa, joka pystyy ottamaan vastuuta laajoista kokonaisuuksista ja rakentamaan luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita.

Sinulla on:

- LKV-tutkinto, joka on tehtävässä edellytys

- vahva talousosaaminen esimerkiksi kirjanpidon, verotuksen tai talousneuvonnan parista

- ymmärrystä maatalouden ja maaseutuyritysten toimintaympäristöstä tai vahva motivaatio oppia sitä

- hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja asiakastyötaidot

- analyyttinen, tarkka ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä toimia yhteistyössä eri asiantuntijoiden kanssa.

Aiempi kokemus neuvontatyöstä ja neuvo-oikeudet ovat eduksi. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, ruotsin ja englannin osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.

Joustava työ

Työskentelet joustavasti hybridi- ja etätyömallissa. Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määrättyä toimipaikkaa, mutta se edellyttää valmiutta liikkua ProAgria Etelä-Suomen toiminta-alueella ja käydä esimerkiksi kiinteistökohteissa.

Pääset osaksi kokenutta, noin 20 asiantuntijan ryhmää, jossa saat sekä kollegoiden tuen että mahdollisuuden ottaa itsenäistä vastuuta omista asiakkuuksistasi ja kehittää omaa työtäsi.

Mitä ProAgria tarjoaa?

ProAgriassa saat mahdollisuuden yhdistää vahvan asiantuntijuutesi merkitykselliseen asiakastyöhön. Työssä pääset rakentamaan pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti maatilojen ja maaseutuyritysten taloudelliseen kestävyyteen ja tulevaisuuden ratkaisuihin.

Tarjoamme vakaan ja asiantuntevan työyhteisön, joustavat työskentelymahdollisuudet sekä monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa on tilaa kehittyä ja kasvattaa omaa asiantuntijuutta.



Kiinnostuitko?

Jos olet kokenut talouden ja kiinteistönvälityksen osaaja ja haluat tehtävän, jossa yhdistyvät asiantuntijuus, itsenäinen vastuu ja pitkäjänteinen asiakastyö, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian.

Käynnistämme potentiaalisten kandidaattien haastattelut jo prosessin aikana.





ProAgria – maatalouden ja maaseudun yritystoiminnan asiantuntija

Meidän ProAgria

Me proagrialaiset olemme maatalouden ja maaseudun yritystoiminnan asiantuntijoita. Tuomme ratkaisuja muuttuviin tilanteisiin. Meitä on 600 ja toimimme kaikkialla Suomessa kahdeksassa alueellisessa ProAgria keskuksessa ja Keskusten Liitossa.

Teemme merkityksellistä työtä maaseudun yrittäjien kumppanina. Olemme edelläkävijöitä maatila- ja maaseutuyritysten toiminnan kehittämisessä ja tarjoamme palveluja johtamiseen, talouteen, kotieläin- ja kasvintuotantoon.

Liity joukkoomme rakentamaan yhdessä maatalouden ja maaseudun kannattavaa ja elinvoimaista tulevaisuutta.
