title: Senior Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs Engineer
description:
Your new company


You will be joining a growing UK medical device manufacturer based in the Swindon area. The organisation develops and supplies products that improve the everyday lives of patients undergoing chronic and complex medical treatment. Operating within a highly regulated environment, the business is continuing to invest in its manufacturing capabilities, product portfolio and international growth.


Your new role

As Senior Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs Engineer, you will strengthen the company's Quality and Regulatory function while working closely with Manufacturing, Operations, R&D, Product and Marketing teams.

This is a broad, hands-on position where you will take ownership of quality improvement activities, non-conformances, CAPA, root-cause investigations, risk management, complaint handling and process improvement. You will also support design controls, new product introduction, supplier quality, change control and the maintenance and remediation of Technical Files and Design History Files.

You will be regularly present within the manufacturing environment, investigating issues at source and ensuring the Quality Management System supports safe, compliant and effective operations.


What you'll need to succeed

You will have:

  • Previous Quality Engineering experience within medical devices or another highly regulated manufacturing environment
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 13485 and medical device quality systems
  • Experience managing non-conformances, CAPA and root-cause investigations
  • Knowledge of quality tools such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA and structured problem-solving
  • Experience supporting manufacturing process controls, change control and continuous improvement
  • Strong technical documentation skills, including SOPs, work instructions and process-flow documentation
  • Good knowledge of UK MDR and EU MDR, particularly Technical File generation, maintenance or remediation
  • A relevant engineering, scientific or technical qualification

Experience with ISO 14971, design controls, process validation, complaint handling, supplier quality or internal auditing would be advantageous.


What you'll get in return

You will receive a competitive salary or contract rate, dependent on your experience, alongside the opportunity to join a growing medical device business at an important stage of its development.

This is an excellent opportunity to take on a varied and influential position that combines Quality Engineering, Regulatory Affairs and manufacturing improvement. You will have the opportunity to work across the full product lifecycle, improve established processes and make a visible contribution to quality performance and regulatory compliance.

This is a full-time role requiring regular on-site presence in the Swindon area due to its close involvement with manufacturing operations.


What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: CNC-koneistaja, Satakunta
location: Satakunta, Eura, Harjavalta, Huittinen, Kokemäki, Nakkila, Pori, Ulvila
description:
CNC-KONEISTAJA

Oletko metallialan ammattilainen, joka viihtyy monipuolisten koneistustöiden parissa?

Haluatko työskennellä pitkäaikaisessa työsuhteessa vakavaraisessa yrityksessä, jossa valmistetaan suuria ja teknisesti haastavia tuotteita teollisuuden tarpeisiin?

Haemme asiakkaallemme CNC-koneistajaa raskaan konepajateollisuuden tehtäviin Satakuntaan. Yritys valmistaa suurikokoisia tuotteita teollisuuteen, ja työssä pääset koneistamaan yksilöllisiä kappaleita. Tehtävä vaatii teknistä osaamista, piirustusten lukutaitoa sekä kykyä soveltaa osaamista vaihtelevissa työtilanteissa.

Työskentelet Mazak CNC-sorvilla, jossa on pyörivät työkalut, mahdollistaen sorvauksen lisäksi myös porauksen, kierteityksen ja jyrsinnän samalla koneella. Työ tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi monipuolisen koneistuksen parissa.

Työtehtävät

  • Metallikappaleiden CNC-sorvaus Mazak-koneella
  • Poraus-, kierteitys- ja jyrsintätyöt pyörivien työkalujen avulla
  • CNC-ohjelmien käyttö sekä ohjelmien muokkaaminen
  • Työkalujen vaihdot, asetusten tekeminen ja koneen käyttöön liittyvät valmistelut
  • Kappaleiden mittaus ja laadunvarmistus piirustusten mukaisesti
  • Koneen päivittäinen huolto ja kunnossapitoon liittyvät tehtävät

Tarjoamme

  • Pitkäaikaisen ja kokoaikaisen 40 h/vko työsuhteen vakaassa ja arvostetussa yrityksessä
  • Monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät raskaan konepajateollisuuden parissa
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää CNC-osaamistasi ja ohjelmointitaitojasi
  • Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön sekä perehdytyksen tehtävään
  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

Palkkaus tehtävässä määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan, asettuen metallialan osaajalle ilman varsinaista CNC-kokemusta arviolta noin 15–18 €/h ja kokeneelle CNC-koneistajalle noin 18–22 €/h välille.

Odotamme

  • Kokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta tai vahvaa metallialan taustaa
  • Teknisten piirustusten lukutaitoa
  • Kykyä työskennellä tarkasti ja huolellisesti
  • Oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta
  • Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kahdessa vuorossa

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

Responsible for ensuring the quality of Rest products & services by designing, executing, and managing comprehensive test plans and test reports.   • Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, working closely with developers & vendors to ensure timely resolution and conduct defect triages with the wider delivery team members as required.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, and project managers, to align testing activities with project goals and timelines.

  • Tertiary qualifications in technology.
  • Formal QA certification/s relevant to the role.

Required experience, understanding or credentials including:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Test Analyst.

  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, intelligent agents and other LLM-based services.
  • Experience carrying out Test Planning, stakeholder management.
  • Knowledge of testing principles, methods, tools and technologies, including plans, scenarios, strategies and related procedures
  • Experience designing and developing Test Plans and Test Cases with minimal Requirements and Design documents.
  • Working knowledge of test automation frameworks and its implementation
  • Ability to work autonomously and act as the point of contact on projects where required.

  • Ability to multi-task
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Ability to work at a productive pace and follow instructions

Education and Experience

Certifications, Skills and Abilities

title: Gastroenterologian osastonylilääkäri, Kemi
description:
Pohjoisessa työ ja elämä kulkevat samaa latua. Lapin hyvinvointialueella tulet osaksi tiivistä työyhteisöä, jossa hommat hoidetaan titteleihin katsomatta ja yhteen hiileen puhaltaen. Lapin upea luonto, ainutlaatuiset maisemat ja mahdollisuudet urakehitykseen antavat elämään huippuhetkiä. Me annamme tilaa ja tukea, jotta sinä voit kulkea itsesi näköisen polun.

Lapin hyvinvointialue hakee gastroenterologian osastonylilääkäriä vakituiseen virkasuhteeseen Länsi-Pohjan sairaalaan. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Saat ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden johtaa ja kehittää gastroenterologiaa pohjoisen sairaalassamme!

Sisätautien poliklinikalla on erinomainen moniammatillinen tiimi. Poliklinikalla on lisäksi mukavat ja modernit tilat sekä laitteet, mm. Fibroscan. Länsi-Pohjan sairaalassa toimii yhteinen infuusiopoliklinikka. Käytössämme on yhteinen moderni skopiayksikkö. Yhteistyö gastrokirurgien kanssa on mutkatonta. Sisätautien poliklinikalla on edustus jokaisella suppealla erikoisalalla ja konsultaatiot onnistuvat nopeasti ja helposti. Yhteishenki on erinomainen.

Osa-aikaisuus tai muut erityistoiveet otetaan huomioon. Työnkuvaa voi halutessaan muokata myös osittaiseen sisätautiosastosijoitukseen. Koulutuksiin osallistuminen on itsestäänselvyys ja toivottavaa. Halutessasi saat osallistua Lapin keskussairaalan sisätautien takapäivystysrinkiin.

Kelpoisuusehtona on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) 4 §:n mukainen laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissä sekä gastroenterologian erikoislääkärin pätevyys tai sisätautien erikoislääkärin, jolla on gastroenterologian erikoisosaamista. Aikaisempi johtamiskokemus katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme lisäksi hyviä yhteistyötaitoja sekä kykyä ja halua toimia osana moniammatillista työyhteisöä.

Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Lääkärisopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa. Tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Henkilöstön rokotussuojan osalta noudatamme työn ja tartuntatautilain edellyttämää rokotussuojaa.

title: Account Director, Renewals & Growth
description:
Own the Relationship. Drive the Growth.
About the Role
The Account Director owns a portfolio of existing Info-Tech Research Group member accounts and is accountable for one thing above all: growing the value of that portfolio through renewal, upsell, and cross-sell. You are not prospecting cold; you are deepening relationships with leaders who already trust Info-Tech, uncovering where our research, diagnostics, advisory services, software, and experts can solve their next problem.
This is a consultative, commercially minded account management role. You will retain more than 85% of your portfolio and grow it to 120% of prior-year contract value by understanding each member's priorities deeply enough to know what they need before they ask.
Why Join Info-Tech Research Group?
  • Robust onboarding and training: designed to give you the product knowledge, practical skills, tools, and confidence to succeed in the role.
  • Ongoing coaching and support: from experienced sales and account leaders as you apply your learning, strengthen your capabilities, and build momentum.
  • Clear career growth: opportunities to take on new challenges and pursue advancement as the business continues to expand.
  • A collaborative culture: where team members share knowledge, support one another, and celebrate individual and collective wins.
  • Meaningful client relationships: the opportunity to build lasting partnerships with member organizations and help them address real business challenges and impact individual careers.
  • The scale of a global research and advisory firm: the broader resources, career paths, and internal expertise that come with being part of Info-Tech Research Group.
What Do We Offer?
Compensation & Rewards
  • Competitive compensation with strong earning potential and uncapped commissions.
  • President's Club recognition, awards, and trips.
  • RRSP matching.
Health & Time Off
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Generous time off, summer hours, and soft-close days.
Growth & Recognition
  • Employee recognition, career development, and financial support for professional training.
Culture & Perks
  • “Buy a Book” program, pet-friendly offices, on-site gym, virtual yoga, rooftop patio, company fun days, and more.
What You Will Do
  • Own and grow your portfolio. Manage a defined book of existing member accounts with a relentless focus on renewal and expansion.
  • Find the next right offer. Continuously map each member's priorities and stakeholders to identify concrete cross-sell and upsell opportunities across our research, diagnostics, advisory, and software offerings.
  • Build account plans that convert. Develop and execute strategic account plans that tie member engagement directly to renewal and growth targets.
  • Lead the renewal conversation early. Get ahead of contract cycles, surface risk before it becomes churn, and build the business case for expansion well before the renewal date.
  • Run a disciplined member cadence. Maintain a consistent rhythm of proactive outreach, account reviews, and follow-up across your portfolio.
  • Connect members to real expertise. Translate complex member needs into clear next steps and route them to the right internal resource or subject-matter expert.
  • Keep the data honest. Maintain accurate, current account, activity, pipeline, and forecast information in the CRM; your numbers should tell the true story of your portfolio.
  • Work the goals, not just the activity. Track progress against retention, growth, and activity targets, and apply coaching and feedback to keep improving.
What You Bring
  • Three or more years of B2B account management, client success, relationship management, or consultative sales experience, with a track record of retaining and growing client relationships.
  • Experience owning a portfolio, territory, or book of business against clear renewal and growth targets.
  • Strong discovery and active-listening skills: you ask the questions that surface the next opportunity, not just the ones that confirm satisfaction.
  • The ability to translate complex information into a clear, commercially relevant conversation.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and follow-through across a varied and competing set of accounts.
  • Comfort working in a CRM and keeping account information accurate and current.
  • A collaborative approach and the judgment to bring in internal experts when it will move the account forward.
  • Post-secondary education or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
How You Will Succeed
  • You build trust through curiosity, responsiveness, and reliable follow-through.
  • You balance genuine client-service instincts with commercial awareness: you see growth opportunities without ever feeling transactional.
  • You turn member feedback and business needs into clear, actionable next steps.
  • You manage your time independently and stay focused across a varied portfolio.
  • You take ownership of your goals, monitor your own progress, and raise risks early rather than let them surface at renewal.
  • You stay open to coaching and feedback, and you keep developing.
  • You bring sound judgment, resilience, and a solutions-first mindset to every conversation.
A Remote Role That Keeps You Connected
This particular role can be performed remotely from within Canada. Remote does not mean working alone. You will be part of an engaged sales team with regular opportunities to collaborate, learn, share ideas, and connect with colleagues and leaders across the business.
For employees who enjoy an office environment or want occasional in-person connection, our London and Toronto offices are available as an optional place to work. You can benefit from the flexibility of remote work while still having access to the energy, relationships, and resources of an office when it works for you.
We hold company-wide in-person training once a month in Toronto and London, and employees located within 120 km of either office are expected to attend in person.
Our Interview Process
From initial screening through to the final round, every interview is conducted by a member of our Talent Acquisition or leadership team. You can engage in genuine conversation, ask questions, and learn about the role, team, and Info-Tech Research Group.
We do not use AI interviewers or automated screening bots to conduct interviews. We believe hiring is personal, and every candidate deserves the opportunity to connect directly with the people they may ultimately work with.
Ready to Grow What's Already Working?
If you want a role where success is measured in renewed and expanded relationships, not cold pipeline, and where coaching, structure, and real career growth come standard, we would like to hear from you. Apply to join Info-Tech Research Group and take ownership of a portfolio built to grow.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodation
Info-Tech Research Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. To that end, upon request, ITRG will ensure, to the extent possible, that accommodation be made available to applicants throughout the recruitment and hiring process.

title: Director, Product & Brand
description:
Position:

Director, Product & Brand

Department:

Product & Brand

Location:

Vancouver, Head Office (Hybrid - minimum 2 days a week)

Reports to:

VP, Operations

Type:

Full Time, Permanent

Salary:

125k to 170K CAD

JOB OVERVIEW:

INDOCHINO's Director, Product & Brand owns what the company makes and how it shows up, from the mill board to the final post. The Director sets product and brand direction and builds and maintains relationships with fabric mills and production partners across Europe and Asia. These relationships are central to the development and sourcing of INDOCHINO's menswear fabrics, while overseeing the product range and leading the creative team through the launch to market.

Reporting to the VP, Operations, the Director leads a team of five across sourcing, buying, creative and design, and brand and social media, and holds final approval on the look, sound and feel of the brand on every activation. The role operates as Creative Director across the full creative pipeline and owns an AI-first production model, in which all INDOCHINO photography is AI generated.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Brand guardianship: set and enforce the brand standard across positioning, voice, typography, color, logo system and tier architecture, with final approval on all creative across campaign, ecommerce, retail, email, social and print.
  • Product knowledge: author product knowledge and fabric education for the retail network, translating mill, construction and graduation detail into training the floor can sell from.
  • Global sourcing and mill development: select fabrics at market and directly with European and Asian vendors, negotiate cost, minimums and lead times, and hold quality and construction standards.
  • Social media and online communities: own social strategy across the INDOCHINO accounts with final approval on every post, and control the brand voice across online communities, from comments and forums to creators and user-generated content, so INDOCHINO is represented the right way.
  • AI and creative technology: build and maintain the in-house AI Brand Brain, codifying brand, product and image production standards into tools the team briefs and executes from and set AI imaging standards for external contractors.
  • Look, sound and feel on every activation: make sure every activation, from showroom window to inbox to feed, reads as one brand, and author the Brand Book, Product Playbook and brand standards hub.
  • Assortment and range architecture: own the full assortment across custom and off-the-rack, building a clear tier ladder from Studio to Black Label and seasonal ranges developed against a single brand platform.
  • Buying and assortment planning: build data-informed buys with Planning, Supply Chain and Finance, balancing newness and SKU efficiency against sell-through, markdown exposure and margin.
  • Product development and roadmap: lead development with the production team, including full canvas, soft shoulder and soft tailoring, and own the roadmap across suiting, shirting, accessories and collections, back scheduled from production lead times.
  • Creative direction: direct seasonal campaigns from strategic platform and brief through model casting, image direction, art direction and copy, carrying the line through every channel.
  • Team leadership: lead and develop five direct reports across sourcing, buying, creative and design, and brand and social media, plus external studios and contractors.
  • Retail presentation and environment: define showroom presentation, fabric merchandising, windows, fixtures, environmental design and signature scent to lift conversion and sell-through.
  • Cross-functional partnership: partner with Retail, Marketing, ecommerce, Finance and IT on launches, presentation and systems, and represent product and brand to leadership and partners.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in luxury, premium, or tailored menswear, including experience in spanning product, buying, sourcing, operations and creative direction.
  • Extensive international experience working directly with fabric mills and production partners across Europe and Asia, from selecting fabric at market through sampling, costing and bulk production.
  • In-depth knowledge of fiber compositions and blends, Super ratings, yarn counts, twist, weights, weaves and finishes, alongside expert knowledge of tailored garment construction, and how each performs in the finished garment and on the sales floor.
  • Proven category buying at scale, with full accountability for budget, supply chain, procurement and margin.
  • A strong aesthetic point of view, with hands-on art direction and copywriting held to a precise brand standard.
  • Fluency in AI systems and creative technology, and the ability to turn standards into tools others execute from.
  • Operational rigour in project and change management (PRINCE2 or equivalent), systems integration (Salesforce, Shopify) and budgeting.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, and aligning cross-functional partners across retail, ecommerce, finance and creative.
  • Seasonal international travel to visit vendors and partners across Asia and Europe.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or equivalent.

title: AI-First Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Join Sport Alliance and shape the data foundation behind Magicline and Finion, used by thousands of fitness businesses and more than 10 million members. You'll own the modelling layer that powers analytics, operations and AI across the business.

You'll join an AI-first data team where LLMs and internal tools are part of how we work. Whether you're an experienced Analytics or Data Engineer or a strong mid-level engineer ready for more ownership, we'd love to hear from you.


Your position in our team

  • Own the full journey from raw data to business impact: from ingestion and dbt models on AWS to the insights, metrics and AI use cases that run on top of them across thousands of studios.

  • Design clean, scalable and reliable data models that both people and AI systems can confidently build on.

  • Make data quality part of the architecture through testing, documentation, lineage and governance.

  • Partner with Data Engineering on ingestion and pipelines to ensure your models are built on fresh, dependable data.

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering and Finance to turn ambiguous business questions into useful, maintainable data products.

  • Build with AI at the core: use AI-assisted tooling in your daily workflow, and make our data AI-ready (clear semantics, documentation, lineage) so agents and ML models can use it reliably.

  • Grow into financial reporting for Finion Capital, working alongside experienced finance specialists.


Your profile

  • 3+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering or a similar role, ideally with a strong focus on data warehousing.

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt and a cloud data warehouse.

  • A solid understanding of data modelling concepts such as dimensional modelling, slowly changing dimensions and incremental patterns — or the motivation to deepen that expertise quickly.

  • Practical Python skills for data work.

  • Confidence working with AI-assisted tools, paired with the judgment to review, validate and improve their output.

  • A systematic approach to debugging complex data issues and solving them at the root cause.

  • English at C1 level or above, both written and spoken.

  • Most importantly: the curiosity and ownership mindset to improve how data is modelled, trusted and used across the business.

Nice to have

  • Experience with financial, payments or regulated reporting data.

  • German language skills.


Your salary
  • We offer a salary range of EUR 72,000 – EUR 82,000 per year.
  • Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

Your benefits with us
  • 30 Days Annual Leave with a 5-day workweek– enjoy extra paid time off to rest, recharge, and balance your work and personal life
  • Flexible Work Model – 100% mobile work within Germany
  • Fitness & Well-being (Choose 1 of 2): Stay active your way! Choose either our free Move Republic Program to earn points for rewards, OR join EGYM Wellpass for just a €20/month co-pay to access a massive network of gyms, pools, and studios (we cover the rest!)
  • Access to Udemy – boost your skills with thousands of high-quality online courses
  • Deutschland Ticket Subsidy – commute affordably – we cover part of your ticket cost
  • Company Pension Scheme (bAV) – receive an above-average employer contribution in Germany or Austria
  • Flexible Working Hours – adjust your schedule to fit your lifestyle
  • Employee Discounts – access top deals in Germany and Austria via our benefits portal

title: Store Auditor
description:
OVERVIEW:

Working within the Company’s Retail Finance Team, the Retail Store Auditor is responsible for working with retail sites to ensure accurate daily recording of financial information through the PDI system, balancing to electronic sales records, undertaking research where discrepancies occur and reconciling various transactions to the general ledger. The position is in-office in Ottawa.

Reporting into the Accounting Manager, the Retail Store Auditor will be a key member of our retail Finance Team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

                • Validating and auditing site paperwork submissions, daily.
                • Responding to retailer and customer requests and inquiries.
                • Reviewing, entering and reconciling merchandise invoices and credits.
                • Analyzing and rectifying reporting discrepancies with the store retailers.
                • Obtaining and filing site documentation as required.
                • Restoring data and files in instances of loss due to system error.
                • Reconciling site method of payment, daily.
                • Collecting and importing data files in the ERP system
                • Assisting in the balancing of the general ledger for method of payment clearing accounts.
                • Processing retailer charges and credits for miscellaneous expenses.

title: Regulation Counsel
description:
The Law Society of Alberta (“Law Society”) regulates the legal profession in the public interest.

In alignment with the Law Society’s vision, mission, and strategic plan, the Regulation team is committed to promoting and enforcing a high standard of professional conduct and ensuring that lawyers within the Law Society’s jurisdiction practice in accordance with the Legal Profession Act, the Rules of the Law Society (“Rules”), and the Code of Conduct. Regulation departments actively support the Law Society’s mission to be a model regulator, including protecting the public interest and preserving the fundamental principles of justice.

As a key member of the Regulation team, Regulation Counsel will be assigned work from any regulation department, according to organizational priorities. Initially, this current position will work primarily with the Conduct team, reporting to the Manager, Conduct and Membership Legal Services.

Essential attributes of the position include flexibility and excellent communication, time management, sound ethical judgement and analytical skills and the ability to work collaboratively across multiple Law Society departments.

Key Responsibilities:

As a member of the Regulation team, you will address legal issues from any regulatory department, as assigned. Work assignments may vary over time and will include responsibilities drawn from the following list:

  • Addressing complex legal issues and making decisions that impact the careers of lawyers
  • On Conduct files:
    • Applying legal analysis and judgment to evaluate the conduct of the lawyer as it relates to the Legal Profession Act, the Rules and/or the Code of Conduct.
    • As necessary, either preparing a dismissal letter to explain the decision to dismiss to the complainant, or preparing a memorandum to the Conduct Committee outlining the basis for the legal opinion that the threshold test has been met and recommending next steps in the discipline process;
    • Presenting legal opinion and recommendations to Conduct Committee Panels, answering any questions, and providing legal advice regarding potential actions; and
    • Preparing for and attending Single Bencher hearings, Resignation hearings, and other applications/hearings that arise during the complaints process, such as urgent interim suspension applications.
  • On Membership files: as a delegate of the Executive Director, making determinations and writing decisions regarding student-at-law applications, principal suitability and eligibility, enrolment, labour mobility, status changes, reinstatements, foreign legal consultants, professional corporation permits and licensing of limited liability partnerships.
  • On Custodianship files: attending Court to obtain Custodianship Orders and Discharge Orders, managing active custodianship files and providing advice to the appointed Custodian, supporting activities related to the Law Society’s collection of custodianship costs, and providing legal advice on requests for closed files and file destruction.
  • Providing support and advice to the Trust Safety department on matters of regulatory compliance with trust safety Rules and processes.
  • Appearing at all levels of Court on matters including, but not limited to, production orders, custodianship orders and discharge orders.
  • Providing support for issues related to the unauthorized practice of law, including drafting of relevant pleadings and attendance in Court.
  • Completing compliance reporting under Fair Registration Practices Act, the Labour Mobility Act, and other reporting requirements as they arise.
  • Assessing risk and developing risk management strategies on regulatory files, seeking input from other departments as necessary to ensure a coordinated Law Society response.
  • Assisting with policy work on guidelines, protocols and rules that relate to the complaints process.
  • Completing other file work and projects as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Law degree and call to the Bar, required.
  • Member of, or eligible for, membership with the Law Society, required.
  • 5+ years of experience in private practice with significant client exposure in broad areas of law. A background in litigation is considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated advanced written and oral communication skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a dynamic team.
  • Ability to develop legal strategy and objectives.
  • High degree of professional ethics and integrity.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills. Demonstrated ability to deal effectively with lawyers, members of the public and others interacting with the Law Society; maintaining a confident, professional, calm and respectful demeanor even in complicated, demanding, and difficult situations.
  • Ability to prioritize workloads, work under pressure, and adhere to strict deadlines.
  • Effective computer literacy, including using databases and applying data stewardship practices.
  • Interested in and capable of growing to meet additional challenges that may be added to this position over time.
  • Some travel and offsite work may be required.

Additional Information

All inquiries and applications will be handled with the highest level of confidentiality.

The Law Society is partnering with Caldwell on this search. Interested applicants should inquire directly with Meaghan Loughry at mloughry@caldwell.com.

title: Work Focused Psychotherapist
description:
Position Summary
Homewood Health™ is looking for therapists able to provide work focused cognitive behavioral and other psychotherapy treatment for employees who have left work and are in receipt of short-term and long-term disability. The ideal candidate will have a strong mental health background and experience in providing psychotherapy, particularly CBT and CPT. Candidates should consider themselves functionally focused; believe in the value of work and share a view that work is compatible with less than perfect health.

We are currently looking to hire therapists across Nova Scotia to work with clients in their geographical area. This is an independent contractor role, and does not guarantee any specific number of referrals or hours.

What you'll be doing
• Conduct weekly one-on-one therapy sessions following the standardized procedures
• Build an understanding of the factors influencing client recovery
• Identify medical and non-medical issues that are contributing to a client’s decreased work capacity
• Improve the client’s ability to manage issues causing decreased work capacity
• Provide treatment to assist and support the client to resume work function
• Use behavioral activation strategies along with CBT, Motivational Interviewing and problem-solving oriented therapies directed at improving clients functioning to optimize participation and performance in life and work
• Communicate regularly with Homewood Health clinical staff via standardized reporting and weekly written documentation

What we're looking for
· A minimum of a Master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology or related field
· Registration and authorization to practice Psychotherapy in your province of practice
· 3 to 5 years or more of return to work focused clinical counselling experience
· Access to your own office space to see clients in the province of Nova Scotia
· Proficiency and experience using CBT techniques
· Experience in RTW counseling for clients on short-term/ long-term disability, and/or WSIB claims. This should include RTW facilitation and/or work focused treatment
· Professional liability insurance coverage of $2,000,000 or as otherwise determined by Homewood Health™
· Proficiency to provide counselling services in either English or French is required
· Counselling proficiency in additional languages is a strong asset
· Ability to use Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook)

Why work with us
We are driven by our values and are passionate about improving lives. We offer competitive wages and professional development opportunities, along with opportunities to engage with a community of clinicians from a variety of professional backgrounds across Canada who are part of our community of practice. Join us and work along-side highly motivated people who are collaborative and focused on delivering seamless services and programs to our clients and customers.

Join us at Homewood Health™ and be part of a diverse team helping Canadians live healthier, more productive and fulfilling lives.

Quilter plc is a leading wealth management business, helping to enable brighter financial futures for every generation.

At Quilter we never stand still. You will act as the day-to-day owner of API delivery, creating clarity for delivery teams and ensuring work progresses in line with agreed priorities, standards and expected outcomes.

  • Work with stakeholders to gather, clarify and prioritise requirements.
  • Ensure delivery teams understand priorities, objectives and expected outcomes.
  • Support planning, refinement and prioritisation activities.
  • Balance stakeholder demand against capacity, dependencies and strategic priorities.
  • Work closely with Architecture, Security, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, resilient and high-quality API capabilities.

  • Monitor delivery progress and manage risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Use feedback, usage data and stakeholder insight to improve products and services.
  • Promote API reuse and adoption across internal and external consumers.

You will enjoy working closely with teams to turn strategy into practical outcomes and will be comfortable managing priorities across multiple stakeholders and competing demands. You will be customer-focused, delivery-oriented and motivated by delivering measurable business value.

My client is looking for a hands-on Vulnerability Management Lead to take ownership of vulnerability identification, prioritisation and remediation across a large IT estate.

The business is preparing for Cyber Essentials Plus and requires someone who can use Rapid7 to identify vulnerabilities, analyse findings and create a clear remediation plan for infrastructure engineers to execute across multiple sites.

Essential Skills from the Vulnerability Management Lead:

  • Strong Vulnerability Management / Vulnerability Remediation experience.
  • Hands-on Rapid7 / InsightVM experience.
  • Strong vulnerability scanning, assessment and remediation knowledge.
  • Experience producing and interpreting Rapid7 reports.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint/software vulnerabilities and patching.
  • Experience creating remediation processes and technical remediation plans.
  • Experience working with infrastructure/engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of Cyber Essentials / Cyber Essentials Plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Hands-on "doer" rather than purely governance-focused.

Key Responsibilities of the Vulnerability Management Lead:

  • Use Rapid7 to run, analyse and report on vulnerability scans.
  • Identify, validate and prioritise vulnerabilities based on risk/severity.
  • Produce actionable vulnerability and remediation reports.
  • Map vulnerabilities to affected devices, applications and sites.
  • Develop and maintain a structured vulnerability remediation process.
  • Create remediation plans and technical actions for engineering teams.
  • Coordinate remediation across multiple sites/endpoints.
  • Track remediation through to closure and re-scan to validate fixes.
  • Identify issues such as vulnerable/unsupported software, outdated versions, missing patches and insecure configurations.
  • Support Cyber Essentials Plus audit readiness and remediation.
  • Improve vulnerability management processes and reporting.

The Vulnerability Management Lead is required to work remote with potential travel between the South West and South East of England.

title: Service Desk Coordinator / Scheduler
description:
Service Desk Coordinator / Scheduler

Location: StourbridgeSalary: £28,500 per annum Job Type: Permanent, Full-time

We are recruiting for a Service Desk Coordinator / Scheduler to join an established and successful facilities management business based in Stourbridge.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in scheduling engineers, coordinating maintenance works or working within a busy service helpdesk.

The role involves managing the day-to-day workload of field-based engineers, ensuring jobs are allocated efficiently, customers are kept updated and work is completed within agreed timescales.

The Role

Working closely with engineers, subcontractors and the wider service team, your responsibilities will include:

  • Scheduling and dispatching engineers to planned and reactive maintenance jobs
  • Logging breakdowns and allocating work to the appropriate engineers
  • Coordinating planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive works
  • Monitoring job progress and ensuring SLA and KPI deadlines are met
  • Raising purchase orders and arranging materials for engineers
  • Liaising with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain quotations
  • Preparing quotations and updating job records
  • Keeping internal systems and customer portals up to date
  • Communicating with engineers, subcontractors and colleagues to resolve scheduling issues
  • Supporting the wider service desk with general administration and reporting
  • Participating in a paid out-of-hours callout rota
About You

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience working as a Service Desk Coordinator, Scheduler, Service Coordinator, Maintenance Coordinator, Helpdesk Coordinator or Engineer Planner.

Ideally, you will have:

  • Previous experience scheduling engineers, technicians or field-based service teams
  • Experience coordinating reactive maintenance, service calls or planned works
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple jobs simultaneously
  • Good communication skills when dealing with engineers, subcontractors and customers
  • Confidence using scheduling systems, job management software and Microsoft Office
  • An understanding of working to service deadlines and customer expectations

Experience within facilities management, building maintenance, HVAC, fire and security, mechanical and electrical services or a similar field service environment would be particularly relevant.

Experience using Job Logic would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
  • Salary of £28,500 per annum
  • Permanent position with an established business
  • Additional payment for participation in the out-of-hours rota
  • Varied role within a busy and supportive service team
  • Opportunity to develop your experience within the facilities management sector

If you have experience coordinating engineers or scheduling field service work and are looking for your next opportunity in Stourbridge, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

Apply today with your CV for further information.

title: Recreation Therapist
description:
Join the Heart of Excellence – Recreation Therapist Opportunity

About Us:

Intercare is an accredited, Alberta-based company providing health and life enrichment services in continuing care centers since 1992. Our mission is to maintain dignity, offer choice, and support growth to those we serve.

Proudly known as The Heart of Excellence, we are committed to delivering high-quality continuing care with compassion and respect. At Intercare, we deeply value our employees whose dedication drives our success. We are equally committed to providing a safe, healthy, and rewarding work environment.

Join our team and make a meaningful difference!

Who Should Apply?

If you’re passionate about providing compassionate care, enjoy working closely with seniors, and take pride in creating a safe and supportive environment, this could be a great fit for you. We’d love to hear from you!

Position Details:

Position Title: Recreation Therapist

Position Type: Multiple Positions Available – Permanent Full Time 1.0 FTE

Location: Kingsland Terrace

Hours of Work: 0730 am - 0330 pm

Union Status: Out of Scope

NOTE: This unique role will also support certain office-related duties such as UKG management, invoicing, purchase orders (PO), and payroll processing.

Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary education in Recreational Therapy from an Accredited School is required.
  • Minimum of two years’ work experience relevant to Continuing Care Services is required.
  • Preference given to applicants with work experience related to cognitively impaired persons and their families.
  • Ability to read, write, and comprehend the English language.
  • Mentally and physically able to perform duties as outlined.
  • Demonstrates effective communication, problem solving and organizational skills.
  • Ability to function as an effective team member with other Staff, Residents, Families and the Public.
  • Demonstrates concern and interest

Competencies:

1. Leadership: Guides individuals and groups towards the vision, while maintaining group cohesiveness, motivation, commitment and effectiveness. Leadership is flexible and sensitive to the changing needs of the organization, and health care environment;

2. Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing;

3. Lifelong Learning: Committed to continuous learning and promoting the value of learning for self and others;

4. Emotional intelligence: Demonstrates high emotional intelligence in interactions and decision-making;

5. Stakeholder Focus: Responsive to the needs of the stakeholders and customers. Actively promote positive relations.

6. Leadership & Influence: Motivates, engages, inspires others to perform at their best;

7. Coaching & Mentoring: Mentors, coaches, and supports leaders, managers, and front-line staff;

8. Environmental Focus: Sensitive to political and other external environmental issues and their impact on health care.

9. Conceptual Skills: Identifies and analyses situations and problems such that viable solutions are found. Approaches tasks and problems such that total systems and strategies are taken into account;

10. Results Management: Manages human, capital, financial and information resources so that organizational objectives are achieved;

11. Compliance Focus: Promotes compliance with accreditation standards and ethical and legal requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

A. Program Planning, Quality & Resource Management

  • Ensure the implementation and monitoring of specific activities and programs to support continual quality improvement, risk management, and occupational health and safety within the department.
  • Assist in the preparation and review of departmental budgets and ensure operations remain within available material and human resources.
  • Recommend and implement changes to improve departmental efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Participate in evaluating services provided by the Therapeutic Services Department.

B. Resident Programming & Therapeutic Services

  • Responsible for the provision of individual and group recreation programs based on the assessed needs of the current resident population.
  • Works with the Interdisciplinary Therapeutic Services team to develop meaningful site-wide programs.
  • Programs may include, but are not limited to the following:
  • Re-motivation therapy
  • Reminiscing therapy
  • Social communication
  • Music therapy
  • Validation therapy
  • Sensory/cognitive stimulation
  • Reality orientation
  • Other therapeutic programs

C. Professional Practice & Clinical Responsibilities

  • Adhere to professional standards of practice.
  • Complete InterRAI MDS assessment elements as appropriate for the discipline.
  • Participate in the review of triggered CAPS and the development of resident care plans consistent with the Collaborative Care Model.

D. Leadership, Supervision, and Program Management

  • Ensure staff for whom there is direct responsibility receive written performance appraisals as per corporate policy and collective agreements.
  • Participate in the review of position descriptions at a minimum of every three years and whenever necessary to reflect their role and the role of the staff they supervise.
  • Ensure departmental adherence to and understanding of collective agreements, in consultation with the Clinical Team Leader/Director of Care.
  • Assist in the development of departmental and corporate goals, objectives, policies, and procedures, as required.

E. Coaching, Delegation & Professional Growth

  • Serve as a mentor and facilitator to individuals within the department, directing them toward independent practice and decision‑making within a teamwork framework.
  • Ensure the provision of an environment supportive of the advancement of knowledge and the integration of that knowledge into practice to promote quality service delivery.

F. Quality Improvement, Risk Management & Operational Oversight

  • Ensure implementation and monitoring of specific activities and programs to address continual quality improvement, risk management, and occupational health and safety within the department.
  • ·Assist in the preparation and review of departmental budgets and ensure the department operates within the material and human resources available.

G. Documentation, Consultation & Community Resources

  • Documents care, programs, and interactions as required on the Resident’s health care record.
  • Maintains an awareness of community resource/services and facilitates access to such services, as required by site residents.

H. Education, Student Supervision & Staff Orientation

  • Liaise with educational facilities and act as a preceptor to provide opportunities for approved student placements.
  • Facilitate student placements as appropriate.
  • ·Participate in the orientation of new staff, as required

I. Equipment & Supply Management

  • Maintains equipment and supply inventory.
  • Responsible for ensuring recreational supplies and equipment are maintained in safe working condition.
  • Facilitates repairs as required.

J. Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Demonstrates respect to all customers, by working with them in a calm, courteous manner.
  • Accepts responsibility for the performance results of their work teams and works in partnership with individuals and groups of employees (teams) to improve services for our customers.
  • Participate in project teams, committees, and meetings, as required.

K. Professional Accountability

  • Perform all duties in accordance with the written policies and procedures of the Corporation, the facility, and the Therapeutic Services Department.
  • Accept responsibility for one’s own performance and actively seek learning opportunities to meet or exceed performance expectations.
  • Keeps current on issues, practices and new trends related to geriatrics and the practice of recreation therapy.
  • Participates in self‑assessment of educational needs.

L. Health & Safety

  • Understand and adhere to all organizational health and safety responsibilities as outlined in the corporate Health and Safety policy.
  • Performs all duties in a safe and efficient manner and maintains the work area in a clean, orderly and safe condition.
  • Reports unsafe, hazardous working conditions and/or any equipment malfunctions to the appropriate person/department.
  • Participate in required health and safety training and initiatives to maintain compliance and promote workplace safety.
  • Understand and adheres to fire responsibilities as outlined in the Corporate Fire Response Manual.

M. Other Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What We Offer:

  • A healthy work-life balance.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • A respectful, inclusive, and positive work environment.
  • A collaborative, values-driven culture committed to quality care.
  • ·Company-sponsored events and staff recognition.
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Engineer - Welding
description:

  • Prepare, supervise, and evaluate procedure qualification testing to ensure compliance with customer and Code(s) requirements; incorporate requirements into test protocols and create or modify welding documents to ensure compliance.

  • Exercise strong conflict and problem-solving skills and apply appropriate resolutions.
  • Handle sensitive information in a confidential manner.
  • Identify opportunities for continual process improvements in performing essential job functions and meeting realistic business requirements.

title: ML Engineer - Infrastructure
description:
About Flexion

At Flexion, we are building the autonomy stack for humanoid robots. Our mission is to drive the transition from fragile prototypes to real-world deployments of humanoids. We were founded by leading scientists in robot reinforcement learning (ex-Nvidia, ex-ETH Zürich) and backed by leading international VC firms. In just months, we went from our first line of code to deploying real humanoid capabilities with our customers, leveraging simulation and reinforcement learning. Today, we are rapidly expanding the capabilities of our autonomy stack, our customer base, and our team.

The role

We are looking for an experienced ML engineer to join Flexion’s experienced infrastructure team and take ownership of Flexion’s GPU compute platforms. This is a senior, on-site role with significant scope.

At Flexion, we are building the brain for humanoid robots, which involves training foundation models with vast amounts of data on large GPU clusters. You will own the design, bring-up, operation and optimization of performant clusters. You will work with AI engineers to help them optimize their training speed and hardware utilization. You will also influence strategic compute planning and contribute to new tools and platforms for iterating on our AI models efficiently. This will put you at the heart of Flexion’s AI development and allow you to directly impact the execution of our ambitious roadmap. You will closely collaborate with the company’s leadership, engineers of the infrastructure team and AI engineers across the company.

Key responsibilities

  • Architect, run and continuously improve existing and future cloud-based GPU clusters. Select the best frameworks and tooling to run our clusters efficiently. Work on cluster provisioning, job schedulers and monitoring systems.
  • Help AI engineers optimize their training workloads and maximize hardware utilization using profilers, contributing to our core ML libraries.
  • Contribute to short- and long-term GPU compute strategies in collaboration with our AI engineering teams and help execute on them.
  • Optimize capacity and cost by exploring multi-cloud strategies and evaluating trade-offs.
  • Raise the bar on engineering practices, including testing, code quality, documentation, and system reliability.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Software Engineering (or equivalent practical experience) plus significant industry experience.
  • Hands-on experience with the training or inference of large models (billions of parameters) on distributed multi-node GPU hardware. This can include bringing up and running the cluster, writing and optimizing training/inference code, building ML pipelines, etc.
  • Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of PyTorch.
  • Deep understanding of distributed training concepts (DDP, FSDP, NCCL).
  • Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure or neoclouds) or large-scale on-premises GPU infrastructure.
  • Experience with job scheduling and orchestration tools: Slurm and/or Kubernetes/KubeRay.

Nice-to-haves

  • Familiarity with profilers (e.g., PyTorch Profiler, Dynolog, HTA, Nsight).
  • Experience with high-performance or parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre).
  • Experience provisioning compute on multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management (Terraform, Ansible).

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Joining a leading robotics team & exposure to never-done-before research
  • Energetic, collaborative culture with a bias for action and regular community events

Zurich

  • Enhanced pension plan
  • Relocation & permit sponsorship
  • Enhanced holiday & paid leave perks
  • Central Zürich office with top-tier robotics testing facilities and infrastructure

San Franciso

  • 401(k) with company contributions
  • Health, dental & vision coverage with the flexibility to choose your own plan
  • Open PTO policy & paid company holidays

title: Sisätautien erikoislääkäri, Kemi
description:
Pohjoisessa työ ja elämä kulkevat samaa latua. Lapin hyvinvointialueella tulet osaksi tiivistä työyhteisöä, jossa hommat hoidetaan titteleihin katsomatta ja yhteen hiileen puhaltaen. Lapin upea luonto, ainutlaatuiset maisemat ja mahdollisuudet urakehitykseen antavat elämään huippuhetkiä. Me annamme tilaa ja tukea, jotta sinä voit kulkea itsesi näköisen polun.

Lapin hyvinvointialue hakee sisätautien erikoislääkäriä vakituiseen virkasuhteeseen Länsi-Pohjan sairaalaan. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan

Haemme sisätautilääkäriä joukkoomme kehittämään toimintaa ja työskentelemään suunnitteilla olevalla Akuuttiosastolla. Uusi osasto aloittaa toimintansa 1.2.2026. Työnkuvaa voidaan muokata osittain polikliiniseksi vastaanottotyöksi. Sisätautien poliklinikalle meille jää moniammatillinen tiimi, johon kuuluvat edustus jokaiselta suppealta sisätautien erikoisalalta ja kokeneet hoitajat. Konsultaatiot onnistuvat nopeasti ja helposti. Yhteishenki on erinomainen.

Erikoislääkärin virkaan tuleva voi halutessaan osallistua vapaamuotoiseen sisätautien takapäivystysrinkiin Lapin keskussairaalassa. Osa-aikaisuus ja muut erityistoiveet otetaan huomioon. Työnkuvaa saa muokata myös osittaiseen sisätautiosastosijoitukseen ja soveltuvin osin etätyöskentelyyn. Koulutuksiin osallistuminen on itsestäänselvyys ja myös toivottavaa.

Kelpoisuusehtona on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) 4 §:n mukainen laillistus tai lupa toimia lääkärin tehtävissäsekä sisätautien erikoislääkärin pätevyys.

Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Lääkärisopimuksen mukaisesti. Tehtävässä noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa. Tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Henkilöstön rokotussuojan osalta noudatamme työn ja tartuntatautilain edellyttämää rokotussuojaa.

Tule meille huippuhommiin hakemalla tehtävään Kuntarekry-palvelussa 22.10.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä!

title: Principal Data Scientist - Aristocrat
description:
Are you ready to join a world-class team and make a significant impact on the gaming industry? At Aristocrat, we aim to bring happiness to life through the power of play. We seek a Principal Data Scientist to help us reach our ambitious goals. You will have a vital role in enhancing gameplay, boosting player engagement, and improving business outcomes with your advanced data expertise. This opportunity allows you to work on innovative projects, collaborate with diverse teams, and guide critical initiatives that will develop the future of our leading games.
What You'll Do

  • Lead high-impact data science initiatives end-to-end, including problem framing, methodology selection, experiment development, implementation partnership, and impact measurement.
  • Build and deliver machine learning and reinforcement learning solutions to improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and operational outcomes.
  • Lead the modeling framework for complex systems, guaranteeing comprehensive evaluation and monitoring of causal inference, uplift modeling, sequential decisioning, bandits/reinforcement learning, and forecasting.
  • Partner with game teams to define success metrics, guardrails, and decision frameworks, translating analytical results into actionable product and operational actions.
  • Define and uphold engineering standards and guidelines for model development, including validation, uncertainty, reproducibility, and bias/quality checks.
  • Drive scalable experimentation with A/B and Multi-armed bandit testing frameworks, power analysis, variance reduction, and online-offline alignment.
  • Work together with Data Engineering, MLOps, and Game Tech teams to guarantee dependable data foundations, feature accessibility, and model deployment pathways.
  • Build internal data products to improve the speed and quality of decision-making, such as AB-test calculators, decision tools, and automated insights.
  • Provide technical leadership through building and code reviews, mentoring, and coaching, improving the standard of data science craft across the organization.
  • Serve as a reliable collaborator throughout the organization, promoting data-informed decision-making and enabling business units to embrace data products.
  • Translate complex analytical insights into actionable recommendations, presenting them to senior leadership to inform critical business decisions and encourage collaborators.
What We Are Seeking
  • Education: PhD or MSc in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience in practice.
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional data science experience. You have delivered at least 3 data or ML products from problem definition to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in clustering, predictive modeling, reinforcement learning, and Bayesian statistics.
  • Hands-on experience in software engineering, MLOps, and deploying machine learning models at scale.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, and familiarity with big data technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark) and/or cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Industry knowledge: Experience in gaming or digital entertainment is a strong plus.

This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.

Compensation Philosophy
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Hallintosihteeri
description:
Nykyisen hallintosihteerimme eläköityessä, haemme hallintosihteeriä 1.1.2027 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan Siikaisten kunnan tekniselle osastolle.
Hallintosihteerin tehtäviin kuuluu mm. ostolaskujen käsittelyä, teknisen toimen laskutusta, rakennusvalvonnan toimistotehtäviä, vesilaitoksen laskutusta ja liittymäsopimusten ylläpitoa sekä näiden lisäksi palkkahallinnon tehtäviä teknisen toimen ja keskushallinnon osalta.

Edellytämme soveltuvaa toisen asteen ammatillista koulutusta tai ammatillista tutkintoa sekä sujuvaa kirjallista ja suullista suomen kielen taitoa.
Eduksi luetaan tradenomin tutkinto. Koska työtehtävä sisältää myös palkanlaskennan tehtäviä, luemme eduksi osaamisen ja kokemuksen palkanlaskennan tehtävistä sekä kunnallisten työ- ja virkaehtosopimusten tuntemuksen.
Arvostamme kirjanpitotaitoa, arvonlisävero-osaamista, asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta, joustavuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja tiimityöskentelytaitoja. Lisäksi odotamme kykyä työskennellä ajoittain hektisessä työympäristössä sekä kykyä priorisoida oma ajankäyttö eri työtehtävien kesken.
Alussa on työtehtäviin perehdytystä tammi-maaliskuun ajan nykyisen hallintosihteerin opastuksella.
Tehtävässä on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.
Liitä opinto- ja työkokemustodistukset hakemukseen. Liitteiden määrä on rajoitettu, mutta yhteen liitteeseen voi sisältyä useita dokumentteja.
Ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan.
Työpaikalla on liukuva työaika ja osittainen etätyömahdollisuus 1 pvä/vko.

title: Security Analyst
description:
At Sunbit, we're building financial technology that puts people first. By combining intelligent decisioning with a personalized, transparent approach, we help consumers access the payment options that are right for them while empowering merchants to build stronger customer relationships.

Engineering is at the heart of how we make that happen. We build scalable distributed systems, cloud-native services, intelligent data platforms, and AI-powered solutions that enable real-time financial decisions at scale. By leveraging modern engineering practices and integrating AI into both our products and development workflows, we solve complex technical challenges, accelerate innovation, and continuously improve the way we build software. Every service, model, and architectural decision we make directly impacts our products, our customers, and the future of financial technology.

About the Role

We're hiring our first Security Analyst to join Sunbit's newly formed Security Operations (SecOps) team, reporting directly to the SecOps Team Lead. SecOps is the single point of contact and accountability for all security operational pipelines at Sunbit — we orchestrate, track, and ensure completion of security work across the organization, partnering with Engineering, IT, GRC, and application teams who execute the hands-on technical work.

This is a ground-floor opportunity: you will help build the pipelines, playbooks, dashboards, and automations that power security operations at Sunbit. Our mandate is to cover a broad security domain with a lean team — that is only achievable through aggressive automation, streamlined workflows, and self-service capabilities.


What You'll Do

Daily Operations

• Triage security alerts and classify them per our severity framework

• Monitor dashboards for tool health, alert volume, and anomalies

• Run ad hoc reviews and checks

• Document incidents and maintain incident timelines


Pipeline Tracking & Follow-Up

• Assign remediation tasks to domain owners via Jira and track them to closure

• Track SLA compliance, send reminders, and escalate overdue items

• Maintain pipeline status dashboards and generate status reports

• Escalate blockers and non-responsive owners to the Team Lead


Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Implement automations designed with the Team Lead — scan-to-ticket pipelines, alert enrichment, evidence collection, notification workflows

• Identify repetitive manual tasks and propose automation ideas

• Maintain and update runbooks and playbooks



Requirements

Understanding of common security threats, vulnerabilities, and controls

• Experience with SIEM platforms or alert triage workflows

• Comfort with Jira (or similar) for managing work items end-to-end

• Clear written communication for status reports and cross-functional follow-ups

• Basic understanding of cloud environments (GCP, AWS)


Nice to Have

• Security certification (CompTIA Security+ or similar)

• Familiarity with specific tools (CrowdStrike, Okta, n8n, etc)

• Experience building dashboards

• Experience with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Tines, SOAR)

• Hands-on cloud security experience

• Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, IT, or GRC teams


Why This Role Is Different

• Hire #1 on a new team - real influence on how SecOps is built at Sunbit

• Broad exposure across monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, identity, compliance, and security reviews

• Automation-first culture - your work directly reduces manual toil

• Direct mentorship from the SecOps Team Lead with a clear growth path as the team scales



Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

We’ve been made aware of fraudsters impersonating Sunbit employees during the hiring process. Please note that all official communication will come from an @ email address, through our applicant tracking platform @sunbit.comeet-notifications.com or directly via LinkedIn. We will never ask for your age, Social Security number, bank account details, payment of any kind, or other unrelated personal information during the application process. Our hiring process always includes interviews, either by phone, zoom, or in person, before any offer is made. If something feels suspicious, please contact us at HR to confirm. We ask that you contact HR only about potential instances of fraud. HR does not reach our recruiting team directly. Your application directly through the posting is the best way to ensure that your candidacy is reviewed by our team. Due to the volume of applications, we will not respond to nor forward emails about your candidacy that are sent to HR directly, and your email about your application will be deleted from our systems.

title: Freight Coordinator (Part-Time)
description:
Summary

The Freight Coordinator position’s primary responsibility is to fulfill our mission statement, “to create the most enjoyable shopping experience possible for our Guests.” Additionally, the Freight Coordinator performs a variety of operational tasks assigned by store management (e.g. receiving and unpacking of daily shipments, shipping merchandise, backroom maintenance, and routine cleaning of facilities).

Compensation & Benefits:

Pay range: $14-$16/hr

The estimated range is the budgeted amount for this position. Final offers are based on various factors, including skill set, experience, location, qualifications and other job-related reasons.

Full-Time Teammate Benefits:

Health

Your physical well-being matters. We provide health options that empower you to take control of your care and make informed decisions for you and your family.

Medical Coverage Choose between two comprehensive plans. Preventive care is covered at 100%, and all plans include access to virtual care.

Dental and Vision Insurance Preventive and routine dental and vision care to support your everyday health.

Virtual Care 24/7 access to general, behavioral, and dermatology consultations.

Mental Health Resources Through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), teammates have access to free confidential counseling, wellness coaching, and self-care tools.

Wealth

We are committed to helping you build financial security, recognize your contributions, and invest in your future.

401(k) with Company Match Start planning for the future with traditional and Roth options. Teammates may contribute after meeting eligibility requirements. To further support Teammates, Buckle provides discretionary matching contributions to qualifying Teammates.

Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Pre-tax options for qualified medical and dependent care expenses. Buckle contributes to your HSA if enrolled in the high-deductible medical plan.

Performance Bonuses Eligible teammates may earn incentive-based bonuses in recognition of their performance.

Teammate Discount 40% off Buckle products and 25% off Buckle gift cards to support your personal style.

Peace of Mind

We recognize the importance of stability, security, and time to recharge.

Time Off Vacation time is earned on a progressive schedule based on your role and years of service, starting at 80 hours or 120 hours, depending on employment status and prorated for the first partial year. Teammates earn 40 hours of sick time per year (or more where required by law), prorated for the first partial year; up to 80 hours of sick time may be carried over from one year to another with a maximum of 80 hours of sick time per year including carryover. Teammates also receive one floating holiday and up to three days of bereavement leave. Salaried teammates receive one paid volunteer day.

Income Protection Buckle provides company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance, with options to add Teammate-paid supplemental life and disability plans (short term and long term), helping to protect your income if you are unable to work.

Leave of Absence Support Paid and unpaid time away is available for qualifying situations, with guidance from our Benefits Team to help navigate your options. Salaried teammates who meet eligibility requirements are eligible for medical leave pay, which can be used as paid parental leave for qualifying Teammates.

Supplemental Insurance Options Accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage is available for added financial protection.

Additional Benefits Legal services, identity theft protection, and pet insurance are available to eligible teammates.

Part-Time Teammate Benefits

We value every teammate and offer meaningful benefits—even for those working fewer hours.

Teammate Discount 40% off Buckle products and 25% off Buckle gift cards to support your personal style.

Medical Plan Access Eligible part-time teammates may choose between two comprehensive medical plans. Preventive care is covered at 100%, and all plans include access to virtual care.

401(k) with Company Match Start planning for the future with traditional and Roth options. Teammates may contribute after meeting eligibility requirements. To further support Teammates, Buckle provides discretionary matching contributions to qualifying Teammates.

Mental Health Resources Through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), teammates have access to free confidential counseling, wellness coaching, and self-care tools.

Paid Leave in Applicable States Paid leave accrues where required by law; one hour of leave is accrued for every 30 hours worked.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
This description intends to describe the general nature and level of work performed by Teammates assigned to this job. It is not intended to include all duties, responsibilities and qualifications. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Sales Generation and Guest Service

  • Compare and verify merchandise invoices to items received to ensure that shipments are correct
  • Send any alterations, layaways, or special orders to Guests via FedEx
  • Check accuracy of freight packing slips and transfer slips
  • Double-check that all transfers have been processed through the register and that items match what you are shipping out
  • When shipping items to Guests and other stores, must fold items and place in appropriate sized box for proper presentation of product when unpacked

Visual Merchandise Management

  • Remove any pins and plastic from merchandise shipped in
  • Place Sensormatic tags on each garment in the designated place
  • Hang and fold merchandise to be put on the sales floor and steam when necessary
  • Assist on projects on floor when necessary

Operations

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, which may include mornings, evenings, and weekends, and the day of/day after Thanksgiving and Christmas, based upon store and business needs
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of Point of Sale (“POS”) software
  • Receive freight boxes and store transfers through register
  • Send discrepancies in store mail and file non-errors for 30 days
  • Maintain all shipment-related paperwork
  • Watch for and recognize security risks and thefts, and know how to prevent or handle these situations
  • Make FedEx labels for all packages being sent out and sort packages by required shipment transit time (expedited shipping or regular ground shipping)
  • Send in recalls and Return to Vendors (RTVs) on a weekly basis
  • Keep supplies in stock and organized (e.g. boxes, transfer bags, printer paper, hangers, sensors, etc.)
  • Organize fixtures and shelving
  • Engage in activities that support a neat, clean, and organized work area.
  • Maintain daily work filed and in order
  • Communicate any policy violations to Store Manager, District Manager, and/or Human Resources in a timely, confidential manner
  • Provide feedback to Store Manager, Assistant Manager, and Floor Leaders regarding merchandise handling concerns
  • Understand and apply the Buckle’s Code of Ethics and all Buckle’s policies, procedures, and handbooks.
  • Fulfill mission statement by performing job duties with a high level of customer service while contributing to a positive team spirit.
  • Special projects and other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Education and/or Experience

No prior experience or training.

Additional Requirements

Due to the nature of the job, must be 18 years of age or older.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Teammate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the Teammate is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance and jump; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The Teammate is occasionally required to sit. Physical ability to lift and maneuver 50 lbs throughout the store and backroom. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the Teammate regularly works in a retail store setting. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Buckle is committed to hiring and developing the most qualified Teammates from the available workforce in the communities we serve.

Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Buckle, where employment is based upon personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination and retaliation because of veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, national origin or ancestry, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation, and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable local, state, or federal law. For state specific information, refer to the Teammate Center.
