title: Technical Writer
description:
Salary: Permanent, Full-Time role

Who are we?

Standards Australia (SA) is the peak standards development organisation in Australia, with a rich history that dates back to 1922. Currently, we are undergoing a significant transformation and growth phase. In recent years, our workforce has doubled, and we now proudly employ over 200 professionals dedicated to helping shape Australia’s future and fulfilling our mission of empowering communities.

Our organisation brings experts together to create national and international standards that serve as essential guidelines for products and services, ultimately benefiting the Australian community. Our vision is to be a global leader in providing trusted solutions that improve life today and tomorrow.

About the role

You will support the development and drafting of Standards and related documents across a wide range of subject areas, while also work closely with stakeholders to determine the clearest and most logical way to present technical content for greatest reader comprehension.

What you’ll do
  • Develop content for draft Australian Standards and other documents across all project stages
  • Have accountability for the working draft
  • Develop drafts in consultation with technical experts
  • Interpret verbal and written technical content to draft in a way that is appropriate for the intended audience
  • Ensure that the structure, content and language is in line with Standards Australia’s Guides, Procedures and House Style
  • Address any feedback provided by Standards Australia Publishing Services team
  • Lead the Drafting Team in the review and resolution of Public Comments on the working draft
  • Collaborate with committee members to facilitate discussions and manage technical issues
  • Work effectively with Standards Australia Project Managers and Publishing Services team to develop high-quality documents and escalate unresolved issues
  • Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timeframes and scope parameters as per Standards Australia’s project management methodology
  • Develop the drafting schedule in consultation with the Project Manager the Technical Writer
About you
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications and/or relevant applied experience
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in technical writing, with experience and understanding of technical writing processes & principles
  • Experience managing conflict and delivering customer excellence
  • Experience facilitating meetings
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities
Culture & Benefits

Standards Australia is proud to have been awarded the prestigious Employer of Choice Award for two consecutive years, 2023 and 2024. This recognition highlights our commitment to creating an exceptional workplace and fostering a culture of excellence. Our iCARE values form the basis of all we do - Integrity, Courage, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence.

We offer a range of People Perks that support flexibility, wellbeing, career growth, and recognition - helping you thrive at work and beyond.

What's next?

If Standards Australia sounds like the place for you, please submit your CV and Cover Letter outlining your experience and suitability for this role.

Eligible applicants must be Australian Citizens, Permanent Residents or have legal rights to work in Australia. Shortlisted applicants will be contacted within 15 business days of their application.

At Standards Australia, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to fostering a working environment that values diversity, inclusion, and belonging. Our mission is to empower our communities, and in doing so, we strive to create an organisation that genuinely reflects and respects the diversity of the communities we serve; putting people at the heart of all we do. We welcome applications from people of all cultural and linguistic groups, people of all ages and genders, people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander background, people with a disability, and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Should you need any adjustments to be made to our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@standards.org.au

title: Hankintainsinööri
description:
Haemme Eltel Networks Oy:lle

HANKINTAINSINÖÖRIÄ

tukemaan sähköasemaprojekteja Voimansiirto & Renewables -liiketoimintayksikköön

Työskentelypaikkasi voi sijaita missä tahansa Eltelin toimipisteistä ympäri Suomen. Tehtävä edellyttää satunnaista matkustamista. Työsuhde on vakituinen, ja aloitusajankohdasta sovitaan yhdessä.

Minkälaisesta työstä on kyse?

Hankintainsinöörinä vastaat projektien operatiivisista hankinnoista ja tuet hankintapäällikköä tilaus-toimitusketjun hallinnassa. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä projektipäälliköiden, tarjouslaskennan, myynnin sekä toimittajien ja alihankkijoiden kanssa.

Roolissasi varmistat, että projektien hankinnat toteutuvat kustannustehokkaasti, laadukkaasti ja oikea-aikaisesti projektien aikataulut ja asiakastarpeet huomioiden. Osallistut hankintasuunnitelmien laatimiseen ja toteutumisen seurantaan sekä toimitusketjun riskien hallintaan.

Keskeisiä työtehtäviäsi ovat:

· Operatiivinen osto projekteille ja tilaus-toimitusketjun valvonta

· Tarjouspyyntöjen laadinta ja tarjouksien kilpailuttaminen

· Maanrakennus- ja sähköasennuskyselyissä tukeminen ja kilpailutus sekä sopimusneuvotteluihin osallistuminen

· Tarjouspyyntöjen laatimisen avustaminen sekä asennuskyselyn tekeminen

· Toimittajaverkoston ylläpitäminen ja uusien toimittajien kartoittaminen

· Toimittajien laadunvalvonta ja reklamaatiot

· Hankinta- ja asennussopimusten laatimisten tukeminen

· Tilausten seuranta ja seurantapalavereihin osallistuminen

Vastuullisuus on tärkeä osa hankintatoimintaamme. Työssäsi huomioit ESG-näkökulmat ja varmistat osaltasi, että hankintaketjumme toimii Eltelin vastuullisuusperiaatteiden mukaisesti.

Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kasvattaa vastuuta osaamisesi kehittyessä. Halutessasi voit myöhemmässä vaiheessa osallistua esimerkiksi tehdaskokeisiin ja ottaa laajempaa vastuuta hankintojen ja toimittajayhteistyön kehittämisestä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Tehtävässä menestyäksesi sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva tekninen korkeakoulututkinto tai työn kautta hankittu kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä. Arvostamme erityisesti sähköasema- ja sähkövoimatekniikan tuntemusta. Aiempi kokemus sähköasemaprojekteista, projektihankinnoista tai teknisten tuotteiden ja palveluiden kilpailuttamisesta katsotaan eduksi.

Lisäksi odotamme sinulta:

* hyviä neuvottelu- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
* taloudellista ajattelukykyä ja kustannustietoista työotetta
* asiakaslähtöistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä toimintatapaa
* ymmärrystä turvallisuuden ja laadun merkityksestä projektitoiminnassa
* kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana projektitiimiä
* aktiivista, oma-aloitteista ja positiivista työotetta
* halua oppia, kehittyä ja ottaa lisää vastuuta
* riittävää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.

Etsimme ennen kaikkea yhteistyökykyistä ja kehittymishaluista osaajaa, joka haluaa rakentaa vahvaa ammattitaitoa hankinnan ja sähköasemaprojektien parissa.

Kannustamme hakemaan tehtävään, vaikka kokemuksesi ei vielä vastaisi kaikkia toiveitamme. Meille tärkeää on myös motivaatiosi kehittyä, oppia uutta ja kasvaa alan ammattilaisena.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tekninen hankinta, sähköasemaprojektit ja monipuolinen yhteistyö projektien eri osapuolten kanssa kiinnostavat sinua, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Rekrytointi hoidetaan yhteistyössä Nordrec Henkilöstöpalvelujen kanssa. Lähetä hakemuksesi Nordrecin nettisivujen tai LinkedIn Easy Apply toiminnon kautta viimeistään 31.10.2026

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Nordrecilta Helen Vesik 040 167 8094

Miksi sinun kannattaisi hakea töihin Eltelille?

Ammattilaisemme kuvaavat meitä joustavaksi työpaikaksi, josta löytyy laajasti osaamista, erilaisia työtehtäviä sekä vapautta ja vastuuta sopivassa suhteessa. Toimimme arvojemme ohjaamina aina ammattitaitoisesti, yhdessä vahvemmin, elämästä välittäen ja uusia mahdollisuuksia luoden. Palkkaus määräytyy tehtävän valittavan henkilön osaamisen mukaan.

Eltelillä tarjoamme:

Ympärillesi aina ammattitaitoisen porukan – Eltelillä et ole asioiden kanssa yksin, sillä takanasi on kattava ja hyvin yhteen pelaava joukko ammattilaisia. Tämä osaava ja toimitusvarma porukka on meille ylpeyden aihe – siksi pystymme suoriutumaan isoistakin hankekokonaisuuksista menestyksekkäästi. Katsomme asioita avoimin mielin ja olemme uteliaita löytämään uusia tapoja tehdä työmme entistä paremmin.

Tukea työhösi ja toimivat järjestelmät – Saat työhösi nykyaikaiset välineet, toimivat ohjelmistot sekä järjestelmätuen. Tukitoiminnot ja hyvät roolitukset läpi Eltelin varmistavat, että pakka pysyy kasassa ja sinä voit onnistua omassa tehtävässäsi.

Työyhteisön, jossa välitetään ja tehdään yhdessä vahvemmin – Ryhmähenki ja kollegoiden tuki saavat Eltelin henkilöstökyselyissä aina korkeat pisteet. Huolehdimme toisistamme, noudatamme turvallisuusohjeita ja varmistamme, että kaikki palaavat joka päivä töistä kotiin turvallisesti. title: Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs Engineer
description:
Your new company
An established and growing organisation operating within the Medical Device and Healthcare sector. With a strong commitment to quality, compliance and innovation, the business develops and manufactures products that have a direct impact on patient outcomes. As the organisation continues to expand its manufacturing capabilities and product portfolio, it is seeking an experienced quality professional to support both operational excellence and regulatory compliance.

Your new role
As the Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs Engineer, you will play a key role in supporting manufacturing operations, quality systems and product life cycle activities. Working closely with Quality, Operations, Manufacturing, Product Development and Supply Chain teams, you will lead investigations, CAPAs, non-conformances, complaint handling and root cause analysis activities.You will also support change controls, supplier quality, risk management, validation activities and continuous improvement initiatives, while contributing to technical documentation and regulatory compliance activities. This is a hands-on role that requires regular engagement with manufacturing teams to identify issues at source and implement practical, effective solutions.
What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

  • Experience within Medical Devices, Diagnostics or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 13485 and Quality Management Systems.
  • Experience managing CAPAs, non-conformances, complaints and root cause investigations.
  • Knowledge of quality tools such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone and FMEA.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing quality and process improvement initiatives.
  • Exposure to supplier quality, change control and risk management activities.
  • Strong documentation and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with Technical Documentation, ISO 14971, UK MDR, EU MDR, Design Controls or validation activities would be advantageous.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.


Please note: sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application.

What you'll get in return

  • The opportunity to join a growing and innovative organisation within the Medical Device sector.
  • A varied role with exposure across Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing and Product Development.
  • The chance to influence quality improvements across the business.
  • A collaborative environment with direct access to senior stakeholders.
  • Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a strong backend and data orientation, a business-oriented mindset, and hands-on experience with agentic AI development to join the IVIX R&D team.

You will design, build, and maintain data-intensive applications and backend systems, working primarily with Python and technologies such as Spark and Kafka, alongside data technologies including MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Redis, and Apache Iceberg.

Our systems process large volumes of complex data and are deployed both on-premises and as a SaaS offering on Kubernetes.

About the company

IVIX is the first AI-powered solution designed specifically to address a $20 trillion problem: illuminating the global shadow economy.

IVIX leverages Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) and advanced technologies to reveal illicit business activity around the world, empowering governments in their mission to fight financial crime and close the tax gap.

Our platform combines AI technologies - including deep neural networks, large language models, and predictive modeling, with advanced data analytics to rapidly identify large-scale illicit business activity and help government authorities combat financial crime in the digital age.

Led by experts in security, technology, tax, and financial crime, and advised by a diverse team of former IRS commissioners, IVIX works with dozens of state and federal government agencies globally.


About the postion

  • Develop and maintain backend services and data-intensive systems by key stakeholders, both internally and externally.
  • Design and implement scalable solutions for complex problems involving large volumes of data.
  • Evolve our engineering and architecture to support the growing scale of users, features, and data.
  • Take ownership of features and systems - from understanding the business problems to planning and technical design and through development and post-deployment.
  • Design, build, and maintain APIs and integrations between services.
  • Write and maintain automated tests.
  • Be accountable for data quality on produced data sets and insights on those data sets.
  • Work closely with Product and other engineering teams.
  • Contribute to shared libraries, infrastructure, and engineering best practices.
  • Use agentic capabilities to enhance velocity and impact on our SDLC.

Tech Stack

  • Backend: Python , Data: MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Neo4j, Kafka
  • Data pipelines - Spark, Iceberg
  • Data Orchestration: Apache Airflow
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript- Add here that this is not needed for the role
  • Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions
  • Deployment: On-premises and SaaS



Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on backend development and data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, data pipelines and data modeling.
  • Experience designing and building REST APIs.
  • Experience developing and maintaining high-scale, data-intensive systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Product engineer by nature - understanding the business problem before implementing solutions.
  • Self-driven, proactive, and collaborative, with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • BSc. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field - an advantage.

title: Member Relationship Representative
description:
From Here. All In. For you.

We're a financial services co-operative with expansive reach across North Central BC, Vancouver Island, and the Gulf Islands, and we’ve got an exciting opportunity for you. Integris, a division of Coastal Community Credit, is collecting general applications for future openings in our Member Experience Centre as a Member Relationship Representative. If your background matches an upcoming opportunity, you will be contacted.

We are seeking an experienced candidate; however, we remain open to training the right candidate who demonstrates strong potential but does not yet meet all requirements. This is a remote role where physical presence in Prince George and surrounding area is preferred.

What’s the role?

MRR's are often the first impression of Integris for our members that reach out via phone, text, or website. For these reasons, the MRR position is incredibly important to Integris’ success. It’s not just about handling the money and finances of our members; it’s about doing so while providing stellar service – the Integris Experience. Our MRR's are highly organized, personable, and patient. Those qualities, as well as being expedient, accurate, and friendly, are basic characteristics required for success in the MRR role.

This full-time position requires an open schedule from Monday to Saturday.

Your duties will include:

  • Deliver exceptional member service by addressing inquiries, completing routine non-cash transactions, and resolving member issues independently or through appropriate referrals.
  • Provide accurate information on credit union products and services, including deposit accounts, internet banking, and basic investments, while identifying referral opportunities to other departments.
  • Perform clerical and administrative tasks to support branch operations, such as processing reports, maintaining member accounts, and assisting with post-dated term renewals.
  • Foster strong member relationships by understanding their individual needs and providing personalized assistance and guidance.
  • Contribute as a proactive team member, supporting colleagues and ensuring a high standard of service delivery.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What are we looking for?

Ideally, you are a flexible, collaborative team player with:

  • Advanced knowledge of credit union banking systems and core applications such as T24, Verafin, Central1, and Signority.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with online/mobile banking processes, email money transfers, and ATM transactions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to resolve conflicts effectively and build positive member relationships.
  • Strong understanding of credit union products, including specialty investments (e.g., RRSPs, RRIFs, RESPs), and the ability to identify opportunities to enhance member experiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail and accuracy.

What do we offer?

Salary Range: $21.99 - $26.96 per hour

Total Rewards:

  • Employer paid pension plan.
  • Generous paid time off options to foster work-life-family balance
  • Extended health & dental benefits
  • Vision Care
  • Short-term and Long-term disability insurance

Who are we?

Integris is a division of Coastal Community Credit Union, together:

  • We’re 100% member-owned, with all decisions made locally—right here in BC.
  • We’re a growing organization with $5.6 billion in assets under management.
  • We offer banking, insurance (including ICBC Autoplan), financial planning, and group benefits to over 110,000 members in North Central BC, Vancouver Island, the Gulf Islands.
  • We believe in making meaningful contributions to the communities we call home through grants, education awards, sponsorships, and fundraising.

At Integris, a division of Coastal Community Credit Union, we believe in making life better for our members, our neighbours and the communities we call home. We believe that strong communities are built by people who care – and that’s exactly who we are looking for.

From Here. All In. For You. Is more than just a tagline. It’s our commitment to showing up, lending a hand, building meaningful relationships and creating opportunities that help our communities thrive.

Here’s How We Do It: We put people first. We invest in our communities. We work together to create positive change. Whether we’re helping a family reach their financial goals, supporting a local business, or volunteering at community events, we’re driven by a shared purpose – to make a difference where it matters most.

We’re looking for people who care deeply about their community and believe great service starts with genuine relationships. If you’re passionate about making a difference, building meaningful connections and helping communities thrive, you’ll feel right at home here.

Being a member of Integris means being part of something bigger than yourself. It may feel different than other places you’ve worked – and that’s because here, different is how it’s done.

title: Operations Controller
description:

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Operations Controller will play a key leadership role in ensuring the effective and efficient delivery of our day-to-day financial operations. This position will lead payroll, accounts payable, collections, working capital, operational cash flow, and support for accounts receivable, with a strong focus on operational efficiency, financial controls, service excellence, and business partnership.

Working closely with our Corporate Controller, who oversees accounting policies, consolidated financial reporting, and the month-end and year-end close processes, the Operations Controller will bring a practical, business-focused approach to the organization’s financial operations.

This is an opportunity for a finance leader who enjoys being close to the business and making a tangible impact. The successful candidate will thrive in a complex, multi-company and multi-location environment and will build strong, collaborative relationships with Operational Directors, General Managers, and teams across the organization.

We are looking for someone who combines strong financial expertise with leadership, sound judgment, operational curiosity, and a solutions-oriented mindset — someone who can improve processes, strengthen controls, develop people, and help our operational teams succeed.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead payroll, accounts payable, collections, support accounts receivable, and related finance operations.
  • Lead and develop the Payroll Supervisor and AP/AR Supervisor.
  • Provide complete and timely operational finance information, reconciliations, and supporting schedules to the Corporate Controller for financial reporting and the month-end and year-end close.
  • Partner with Operational Directors, General Managers on contract and project planning, work-in-progress reviews, forecasting, and operational performance.
  • Monitor working capital, cash flow, aged receivables, holdbacks, and collection risks.
  • Oversee centralized payroll for hourly, salaried, seasonal, unionized, and non-union employees across multiple companies and jurisdictions.
  • Ensure operational finance activities comply with internal policies, delegated approval authorities, collective agreements, applicable legislation, and established control procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve finance processes, controls, reporting, and service delivery.
  • Establish meaningful performance measures for payroll, AP, AR, collections, and working capital.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop employees, creating opportunities for growth and preparing team members to take on broader responsibilities.
  • Build a capable, accountable, collaborative, and high-performing finance operations team.

What You Bring:

  • CPA designation
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field.
  • At least 8–10 years of progressive finance experience, including leadership responsibility.
  • Strong experience in payroll, AP, AR, collections, working capital, and financial controls.
  • Experience in highway maintenance, construction, infrastructure, transportation, utilities, field services, or another contract-based industry is preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple companies, locations, and operating teams.
  • Knowledge of project accounting, work in progress, forecasting, and cost analysis.
  • Experience with unionized payroll, collective agreements, ERP systems, and process improvement is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop employees for broader responsibilities and career growth.
  • Strong business judgment, analytical capabilities, communication skills, and a practical leadership style.

title: Koulunkäynninohjaaja, määräaikainen, Kartanon koulu
description:
Tule tekemään kanssamme tulevaisuuden Järvenpäätä! Rakennamme sujuvaa arkea 1 600 ammattilaisen voimin. Täällä kaikilla on mahdollisuus oppia ja kehittää omaa työtään. Me Järvenpäässä innostumme valmentavasta työotteesta, yhteisöohjautuvuudesta, oppimisen mahdollisuuksista sekä joustavasta työkulttuurista.

Oletko vuorovaikutustaitoinen kasvatuksen ja ohjauksen osaaja, jolla on positiivinen työote?
Haluatko olla osana oppilaan koulupäivää tukea antaen ja yhdessä onnistumisista riemuiten?

Haemme osa-aikaista (82,35 %) KOULUNKÄYNNINOHJAAJAA Järvenpään kaupungille Kartanon kouluun. Viikkotyöaika on 31 h 30 min.
Tässä tehtävässä pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä oppilaiden koulupolun tukena. Työ on monipuolista ja palkitsevaa, sillä se yhdistää oppilaiden ohjaamisen sekä heidän hyvinvointinsa edistämisen.

Kartanon koulu on noin 900 oppilaan yhtenäiskoulu. Koulussamme on yleisopetuksen ryhmiä, erityisen tuen pienryhmiä sekä perusopetukseen valmistavan opetuksen ryhmiä. Koulu tarjoaa myös liikunta- ja musiikkipainotteista opetusta vuosiluokilla 7–9.

Kartanon koulu on monikulttuurinen ja yhteisöllinen työpaikka, jossa jokaisen henkilökunnan jäsenen työpanos nähdään tärkeänä osana koulun toimintaa.

Miksi tulisit meille Järvenpäähän?

Kartanon koulu on tiivis yhteisö, jossa autamme uusia työntekijöitä pääsemään osaksi työyhteisöä ja olemme valmiita oppimaan myös toisiltamme. Koulun arvojen mukaisesti pidämme tärkeinä arvostavaa kohtaamista, turvallisuutta ja hyvinvointia. Tervetuloa mukaan osaavaan joukkoomme!

Tarjoamme tueksesi toimivat resurssit, yhteistyön mahdollisuudet ja osaavan työyhteisön, jotta voit keskittyä oppilaiden parhaaseen mahdolliseen tukemiseen.

Oheisesta linkistä pääset tutustumaan, millaista kulttuuria me Järvenpäässä toteutamme ja tavoittelemmehttps://www.jarvenpaa.fi/itseohjautuvuus

Mitä odotamme Sinulta

Tehtävän menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa, sillä työskentelykieli on suomi.

Odotamme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä yhtenäiskoulun monipuolisessa toimintaympäristössä kaikenikäisten lasten ja nuorten kanssa. Arvostamme joustavuutta, ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä kykyä kohdata erilaiset oppilaat myönteisesti, kannustavasti ja kunnioittavasti. Toivomme, että toimit samalla arvostavalla tavalla myös työyhteisön jäsenenä.

Katsomme eduksi kiinnostuksen työskennellä myös koulun iltapäiväkerhossa.

title: CNC-koneistaja, sorvi
description:
Etsimme Ylöjärvelle CNC-koneistajaa, joka viihtyy sorvin ääressä. Etsimme kaveria, joka haluaa työskennellä monipuolisten, pääosin nosturilla käsiteltävien kappaleiden parissa. Työssä käytetään nykyaikaisia pyörivillä työkaluilla sekä tukilaakerilla varustettuja sorveja, joissa ohjauksena on Fanuc. Työsuhde on vakituinen sekä kokoaikainen päivätyö. Aloituspalkkaus tehtävässä on osaamisesi mukainen n. 16–22 €/h.

Koneistettavat kappaleet ovat tyypillisesti laippoja, akseleita ja muita yksittäis- tai pieneräkappaleita. Työ sopii sinulle, jos pidät vaihtelevasta valmistuksesta, osaat soveltaa osaamistasi erilaisiin kappaleisiin ja arvostat hyvää työyhteisöä.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu:

- CNC-sorvien käyttö Fanuc-ohjauksella

- asetusten tekeminen, työkiertojen hienosäätö ja mittaukset

- laadunvarmistus ja mittatarkkuuden seuraaminen

- työn suunnittelu ja toteutus itsenäisesti, yhteistyössä muun tuotannon kanssa

Odotamme sinulta:

- WinCam- ja/tai Fanuc-ohjelmointikokemusta tai vastaavaa CNC-ohjausosaamista

- osaamista CNC-sorvauksesta, joko pidempi työkokemus tai hyvä tekninen pohja ja vahva oppimishalu

- kykyä työskennellä omatoimisesti ja ottaa vastuuta omasta tuotannosta

- tarkkuutta, huolellisuutta ja kiinnostusta laadukkaaseen lopputulokseen

- joustavaa ja yhteistyökykyistä asennetta

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat koneistustehtävät, et sorvaa vain yhtä ja samaa kappaletta

- kunnollisen perehdytyksen ja osaavan tiimin tuen

- siistit, nykyaikaiset tuotantotilat ja modernit työvälineet

- kilpailukykyisen ansiotason sekä teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaiset edut

- kattavat työterveys- ja hyvinvointipalvelut

Hakeminen

Aloitusajankohta on sovittavissa ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta.

title: CNC-koneistaja, Satakunta
location: Eura, Harjavalta, Huittinen, Kokemäki, Nakkila, Pori, Ulvila, Finland
description:
CNC-KONEISTAJA

Oletko metallialan ammattilainen, joka viihtyy monipuolisten koneistustöiden parissa?

Haluatko työskennellä pitkäaikaisessa työsuhteessa vakavaraisessa yrityksessä, jossa valmistetaan suuria ja teknisesti haastavia tuotteita teollisuuden tarpeisiin?

Haemme asiakkaallemme CNC-koneistajaa raskaan konepajateollisuuden tehtäviin Satakuntaan. Yritys valmistaa suurikokoisia tuotteita teollisuuteen, ja työssä pääset koneistamaan yksilöllisiä kappaleita. Tehtävä vaatii teknistä osaamista, piirustusten lukutaitoa sekä kykyä soveltaa osaamista vaihtelevissa työtilanteissa.

Työskentelet Mazak CNC-sorvilla, jossa on pyörivät työkalut, mahdollistaen sorvauksen lisäksi myös porauksen, kierteityksen ja jyrsinnän samalla koneella. Työ tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi monipuolisen koneistuksen parissa.

Työtehtävät

* Metallikappaleiden CNC-sorvaus Mazak-koneella
* Poraus-, kierteitys- ja jyrsintätyöt pyörivien työkalujen avulla
* CNC-ohjelmien käyttö sekä ohjelmien muokkaaminen
* Työkalujen vaihdot, asetusten tekeminen ja koneen käyttöön liittyvät valmistelut
* Kappaleiden mittaus ja laadunvarmistus piirustusten mukaisesti
* Koneen päivittäinen huolto ja kunnossapitoon liittyvät tehtävät

Tarjoamme

* Pitkäaikaisen ja kokoaikaisen 40 h/vko työsuhteen vakaassa ja arvostetussa yrityksessä
* Monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät raskaan konepajateollisuuden parissa
* Mahdollisuuden kehittää CNC-osaamistasi ja ohjelmointitaitojasi
* Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön sekä perehdytyksen tehtävään
* Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan

Palkkaus tehtävässä määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan, asettuen metallialan osaajalle ilman varsinaista CNC-kokemusta arviolta noin 15–18 €/h ja kokeneelle CNC-koneistajalle noin 18–22 €/h välille.

Odotamme

* Kokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta tai vahvaa metallialan taustaa
* Teknisten piirustusten lukutaitoa
* Kykyä työskennellä tarkasti ja huolellisesti
* Oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta
* Mahdollisuutta työskennellä kahdessa vuorossa

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Ilonalle p. 050 3589561 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Instructional Facilitators | Hynes-LSU, Hynes-Parkview
description:
Are you an experienced educator who builds strong relationships, brings out the best in other teachers, and keeps great instruction at the center of every conversation?

Hynes Charter School Corporation (HCSC) is seeking 2 Instructional Facilitators (one for each campus) to join our community. We are looking for instructional leaders who combine exceptional interpersonal and coaching skills with a laser focus on effective instructional practices. The ideal candidates know how to build trust, develop meaningful relationships with teachers, and provide feedback and support that lead to professional growth and stronger student outcomes. For the Parkview position, the candidate should demonstrate expertise and experience in the middle-level grades and content.

Anticipated Start: December 1, 2026

About Us

HCSC provides an environment where teachers, leaders, and students thrive. Here, you will experience a warm, joyful, and collaborative environment with a family of colleagues. You will have a voice in key instructional and cultural practices, and you will be provided with the structures and autonomy needed to do what you do best - improve student outcomes.

We are especially proud of:

  • Our Legacy of Success
    • Recognized by the Louisiana State Department of Education as an “A” school in Exemplary Performance and Growth, Equity Honors, and Top Gains
    • #1 performing non-selective admissions school in New Orleans
    • Highest student enrollment demand in New Orleans
  • Our Family-like Culture - 100% of teachers recommend working at Hynes, saying they:
    • Experience the importance and support of meaningful family engagement
    • Feel a sense of belonging
  • The Balance between Instructional Structure and Collaboration for all Educators
    • Participate in professional learning communities to enhance collaboration, build supportive relationships, and further your professional development
    • Deliver Tier 1 curriculum while encouraging the use of your own expertise, creativity, and knowledge to positively impact your students’ achievement
    • Benefit from a 90-minute daily planning period, providing dedicated time to prepare lessons, assess student progress, and collaborate with colleagues—helping you stay organized and maintain a healthy work-life balance
About Hynes-LSU

Hynes-LSU was formed with a corporate partnership with the University of New Orleans. It is a slow-growing campus that will serve students in Kindergarten to eighth grade by 2027. In 2026-2027, Hynes-UNO will open the four middle school classrooms (7th grade). Hynes-LSU is located in a new State-of-the-Art building on LSUNO's campus (1901 Leon C Simon Drive) next to Ben Franklin High School.

About Hynes-Parkview

HCSC has been operating Hynes-Parkview in the Gentilly Woods neighborhood since August 2021. Hynes-Parkview is a successful replicated model of the Hynes-Lakeview and Hynes-UNO and has demonstrated a 140% growth on the LEAP Assessment Index in the past two years.

About You

At Hynes, instructional leadership is rooted in relationships, trust, organization, and a shared commitment to excellent teaching. You understand that effective coaching begins with strong relationships and that meaningful feedback, collaboration, and support can help teachers strengthen their practice and improve student outcomes.

You are also highly organized and an exceptional manager of your time. You are comfortable balancing multiple priorities, teachers, and instructional needs while planning strategically, following through consistently, and keeping important work moving forward. You work alongside teachers and school leaders to build teacher capacity, strengthen instructional practices, and ensure that every student benefits from high-quality, engaging instruction.

In this role, you will

  • Facilitate Professional Learning Communities by planning, preparing, and leading professional development for staff.
  • Support teachers in developing a strong understanding of Tier 1 curriculum and varied assessments.
  • Provide direction and coordination to support consistent implementation of curriculum across HCSC campuses.
  • Assist teachers with instructional resources, materials, tools, software, and classroom technologies to support instruction and planning.
  • Support teachers and administrators in analyzing and using data to set goals and improve instruction.
  • Assist teachers with lesson planning and pacing, differentiated instruction, and the selection of best practices to meet students’ needs.
  • Support administrators in coordinating instructional initiatives and achieving school-wide goals.
  • Observe classroom instruction and provide meaningful, actionable feedback that contributes to teacher professional growth and student success.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher; Master's degree preferred.
  • Valid Louisiana Teaching Certificate, Type A, B, C, Level 2, 3; EDL preferred.
  • Minimum five years of classroom experience required, with a record of successfully impacting student achievement.
  • School leadership experience
  • NIET, SOR, Math Numeracy certification preferred.

Benefits and Salary

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Enrollment to the Teacher Retirement System of Louisiana – TRSL (20.95% of the salary)
  • Enrollment in a short-term and long-term disability insurance programs
  • Enrollment in a life insurance plan
  • Health, dental, vision, and other voluntary benefits (Hynes covers 85% of the employee coverage)
  • 10 days of annual personal time off

Commitment to Equal Opportunity Employment

Hynes Charter School is committed to providing equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

title: Senior Program Manager - (ASIC and technology development)
description:
ABOUT MDA SPACE

Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and Geointelligence pioneer with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and infrastructure. The global MDA Space team of more than 4,400 space experts has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.

For more information, visit .

Our Sat Connect IC business unit, a division of our Satellite Systems business, is a leading provider of ASICs, software, multibeam electronically steered antennas, and complete systems for communication satellites, as well as ground and airborne terminals. With locations in Israel, the UK, and the US, we are a technology leader in satellite communication.

Role:

The Senior Program Manager will lead complex ASIC and technology development programs from concept through design, validation, qualification, production and customer delivery. The role is responsible for overall program execution, ensuring delivery against technical, schedule, cost, quality and customer requirements. The role requires strong leadership of multidisciplinary R&D teams and effective management of customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment and accountability across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Finance, Supply Chain and other supporting functions
  • Proactively manage program risks, opportunities, dependencies and critical decisions, ensuring timely mitigation and escalation
  • Provide clear program visibility to senior management and customers through structured reporting, performance tracking and regular program reviews

Responsibilities / Tasks:

  • Lead end-to-end execution of complex ASIC and technology development programs, ensuring delivery against scope, schedule, cost and quality objectives
  • Develop and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, resources, budgets and key performance indicators
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Systems, VLSI. HW, SW, Validation, RF, Operations, Quality and Supply Chain
  • Manage program risks, opportunities, dependencies and critical issues, driving mitigation and timely escalation
  • Monitor program performance using schedule, financial and Earned Value metrics, and drive corrective actions where required
  • Lead customer and stakeholder communication, including program reviews, progress meetings and resolution of key issues
  • Work closely with relevant functions to ensure effective management of suppliers, subcontractors and external development partners, and alignment with overall program commitments
  • Coordinate technical and program milestones, including design reviews, tape-out, qualification, production readiness and customer delivery
  • Provide regular program reporting, including weekly program updates, bi-weekly reviews, Monthly Program Reviews (MPRs), financial forecasts, risks and key decisions
  • Drive effective decision-making, accountability and collaboration across geographically distributed and multidisciplinary teams

Minimum Required Qualifications:

  • BSc/MSc in Engineering or related technical discipline; MBA is an advantage
  • 10+ years of program management experience, with a proven track record delivering complex ASIC, semiconductor, HW/SW or technology programs
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary R&D and product development programs through design, qualification and production
  • Strong understanding of ASIC/VLSI and HW/SW development lifecycles
  • Experience with program planning, budgeting, risk management, Earned Value Management and customer management
  • Experience with ESA programs and familiarity with ESA standards and processes is highly desirable
  • Background in Space/Satellite, Aerospace, Semiconductor or Networking industries is an advantage
  • Strong leadership, communication, organizational, problem-solving and escalation-management skills
  • Ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams in a demanding environment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines

** Relocation may be provided for the succesful candidate, if required **

title: Residential Supervisor
description:
Who We Are Looking For:

Are you the Residential Supervisor we have been looking for? In this position, you will be able to convey your passion for helping others by leading a dynamic clinical team and bring an energetic and positive approach while working with our students!

The Walden Street School is a residential treatment setting for adolescents that specializes in trauma informed care. Walden provides 24-hour comprehensive care including a school on site, a full clinical staff, nursing staff, and direct care staff.

Compensation

The pay range for this position is $22.50 to $33.00 per hour. The listed range reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for this role at the time of posting the position. The actual compensation an employee is offered may vary based on several factors such as experience, education, licensure, certifications and qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

Due to the nature of our work and the youth who are depending on us, there are times where overtime may be mandated.

JRI Provides The Training So That:

title: Sivutoiminen tuntiopettaja (puolan kieli)
description:
Salon kaupungin perusopetuksessa on avoinna sivutoimisen tuntiopettajan määräaikainen virkasuhteinen tehtävä (puolan kieli) 4.6.2027 saakka, aloitus mahdollisimman pian, sopimuksen mukaan.

Kyseessä on perusopetuksen yhteinen oman äidinkielen sivutoimisen tuntiopettajan määräaikainen virkasuhteinen tehtävä. Lukuvuonna 2026-2027 opetusta on Uskelan koulussa 2 h/vko.

Työhösi kuuluu puolan kielen opettaminen ja oppilaiden oppimisen arviointi. Lisäksi työssäsi saat kehittää omaa oppiainettasi.

Olemme luotettava ja vakaa työnantaja. Meille henkilöstön hyvinvointi on sydämen asia. Mielenkiintoisen työn lisäksi tarjoamme työntekijöillemme henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia ja jaksamista.

Etuina tarjoamme muun muassa:
- koulutusmahdollisuuksia
- maksuttomia ohjattuja liikuntaryhmiä
- ruokailun edulliseen henkilökuntahintaan

Koulutusmyönteisenä työnantajana tarjoamme monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen kehittämiseen. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Tehtävässä edellytetään säädöksien mukaista peruskoulun opettajan kelpoisuutta.

Eduksi luetaan kokemus erilaisten toimintamallien toteuttamisesta oppilaiden oppimisen tukemiseksi, kokemus kielitietoisesta opetuksesta sekä positiivisesta pedagogiikasta.

Tämän lisäksi arvostamme joustavuutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja ryhmänhallintataitoja.

Työn kautta sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä osaksi työyhteisöä, joka pyrkii mahdollistamaan oppilaille ja opiskelijoille hyvät edellytykset oppimiseen.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on OVTES:n mukainen.

Virkasuhde täytetään ehdollisena, kunnes valittu on esittänyt valitsevalle viranomaiselle hyväksyttävän todistuksen terveydentilastaan sekä lain 504/2002 (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä) mukaisen rekisteriotteen 30 päivän kuluessa valitsemispäätöksen tiedoksisaannista.

Palvelussuhteessa noudatetaan koeaikaa, joka on enintään puolet määräaikaisen palvelussuhteen kestosta.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rehtori Konsta Kapanen, Uskelan koulu (puh. 044 778 4550, konsta.kapanen@edu.salo.fi) ajalla 9.10., 12.10. ja 20.-22.10.

Jos tarvitset apua hakemuksen jättämiseen, ota yhteys rekrytointiyksikköön rekrytointi@salo.fi.

Mahdollinen paperihakemus lähetetään osoitteeseen Salon kaupunki / kirjaamo, PL 77, 24101 SALO. Kuoreen merkintä Hakemus / haettava tehtävä. Myös paperihakemukset tallennetaan Kuntarekry- järjestelmään. Hakemuksia ei palauteta.

Haku tehtävään päättyy 22.10.2026 klo 12. Haastatteluja voidaan tehdä jo hakuaikana.

title: On-Site Critical Incident Counsellor

title: Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs Engineer (QARA)

title: Primary Care Dietitian
description:
PRIMARY CARE DIETITIAN

Status: Regular full-time (1.0 FTE)

Reporting To: Registered Dietitian & Kinesiologist Supervisor

Date Available: Negotiable

Shift Pattern: Days

Hours of Work: 7.75 hours per day, 38.75 hours per week

Program: Prevention and Promotion

Classification: Dietitian

Exempt/Non-Exempt: Non-Exempt

Salary Range: $40.29 - $53.56 per hour

Closing Date: October 16, 2026

About Us

Mosaic Primary Care Network (PCN) provides a wide range of primary health care services in the northeast and southeast Calgary communities in partnership with a group of family doctors. Our talented interdisciplinary health care teams work together to provide services that best support patient needs.

We want YOU to bring your expertise to our growing team as we continue to develop solutions to meet the needs of our local community. If you have initiative, are resourceful, engage easily in teamwork, and most importantly, want to make a difference in healthcare, we want to hear from you!

Position Summary

The Primary Care Dietitian works within a team-based environment in Mosaic PCN clinics and physician offices. The primary purpose of the role is to provide nutritional expertise to address the needs of patients experiencing nutrition-related conditions/diseases. The Primary Care Dietitian strives to improve health through nutrition strategies consistent with population health promotion. The focus is on achieving outcomes to meet the Mosaic PCN objectives.

The Primary Care Dietitian assesses, plans, implements, and evaluates appropriate and optimal nutritional care with the goal to improve nutritional and health status. The role consults with patients both one on one and in group settings.

Key Responsibilities

Assessment

  • Assesses the nutritional status of individuals, families, and communities through screening, data collection, ongoing monitoring, and reassessment.

Intervention

  • Educates individuals, families, and communities to assist in applying nutrition principles to improve overall health status using motivational interviewing and behavioural change management.
  • Provides clinical services using a patient centred approach in both one to one and group settings.
  • Identifies priorities, target dates, and strategies, together with the patients, which contribute to individualized treatment plans and goals.
  • Evaluates the extent to which outcomes have been achieved and recommends alternative treatments as necessary.
  • Consults directly with family physicians and provides referring physicians with concise verbal or written feedback in a timely manner.
  • Develops and delivers nutrition education and health promotion programs targeting populations of concern.

Inter-professional Collaboration

  • Works collaboratively with the multidisciplinary team to assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patients’ needs to ensure they receive appropriate and optimal care.
  • Mentors colleagues and dietetic interns in areas of expertise and seeks mentorship to achieve full potential in professional development.

Documentation

  • Documents all phases of patient care in the appropriate Electronic Medical Record (EMR) to maintain accurate and timely records, as well as recording the details of clinical interactions in MPCN evaluation systems.

Community Engagement

  • Participates in community activities within the Mosaic PCN catchment area, including health fairs, conferences, and other community events to promote Mosaic programs and services.

Professional Development

  • Identifies and works to achieve own professional development needs which support goals set in performance reviews.

Population Health Programming

  • Participates in and informs the ongoing operation, planning, and evaluation of community-based population health programs.

Other responsibilities as required.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required Education & Licenses

  • Bachelors’ degree in nutrition.
  • Licensed within the College of Dietitians of Alberta (CDA).

Required Experience

  • A minimum of one (1) to three (3) years of relevant experience, ideally in public health, health promotion or community-based nutrition.
  • Experience working with ethnically diverse, vulnerable, and high risk populations.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability in planning, developing, implementing, and evaluating nutrition strategies that is consistent with population health promotion.
  • Knowledge of nutrition recommendations and concepts.
  • Effective communication skills both verbally and written in English.
  • Computer knowledge literacy including MS Office and Outlook/Calendar management.
  • Sound judgment and ability to develop collaborative working relationships.
  • Self-directed, flexible, and displays initiative.
  • Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

Assets

  • Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE) certificate.
  • International Board-Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) certificate.
  • Pediatric counseling experience.

    Competencies

    The Core Competencies listed below are identified by Mosaic PCN leadership and should be demonstrated by all employees across the organization:

    Practice Communication Excellence (Communication)

    • Plan and deliver oral and written communications respectfully and tactfully to make an impact and persuade an intended audience.

    Build Community-Feeling (Teamwork)

    • Able to share due credit with coworkers, display enthusiasm, and team spirit and promote a friendly group working environment.

    Advocate for Patient/Client (Patient/Client-Centricity)

    • Able to demonstrate a high level of patient/client service delivery in a respectful and caring manner.

    Understand Values of Change (Adaptability)

    • Openness to different and new ways of doing things; willingness to modify one’s preferred way of doing things with a positive attitude.

    Embrace Culture and Diversity (Cultural Competency)

    • Developing positive attitudes towards diverse populations; gaining knowledge of different life practices and world views.

    Act with Professionalism (Personal Effectiveness)

    • Takes personal responsibility for the quality and timeless or work and achieves results with little oversight.

    Working Conditions

    • Occasional evening and weekend hours required.
    • Ability to travel on public transportation or valid drivers license with access to own car in good repair is required.

    OHS & PRIVACY

    • Adhere to Mosaic PCN's Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) policies and procedures.
    • Manage information in accordance with legislation and internal policies.
    • Maintain the confidentiality, privacy, and security of information and access it only as authorized work purposes.

    Why Mosaic PCN

    We provide a competitive benefits package for eligible employees including: comprehensive health and dental coverage, Health Spending Account (HSA) / Wellness Account (WA), a group RRSP matching program, professional development opportunities, generous vacation and other paid time off, and more!

    Conditions of Employment

    Successful applicants must provide proof of qualifications and a current police information check (PIC) at the applicant’s expense. The results of the PIC may alter or revoke any offer made by Mosaic PCN.

    We would like to thank all applicants for their interest and resumes. Please note, only those candidates chosen to proceed through the selection process will be contacted. No phone calls or emails please.

    If you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by emailing HR@mosaicpcn.ca

    This position is part of the bargaining unit covered by a collective agreement with Health Sciences Association of Alberta (HSAA).

- Ainutlaatuisen tilaisuuden liittyä dynaamiseen ja vakavaraiseen korkeakouluyhteisöömme

----------------------------------------------

title: Project Manager - Goodman Masson
description:
• Project Manager - 6 month contract - £400-500/day Outside IR35

We are seeking an immediately available (or on short notice) experienced Project Manager to join a global organisation in London on a 6-month Outside IR35 contract.

This is a fast-paced, hands-on role delivering critical technical initiatives across several workstreams including web migration, security remediation, and identity management. Operating in a lean delivery team (approx. 10 people), you will take full end-to-end ownership - combining strong project governance (60–70%) with hands-on Business Analysis (30–40%) to keep complex technical workstreams moving forward without reliance on a large PMO setup.

Core Responsibilities
• Lead a controlled "lift-and-shift" migration of the public site from Salesforce Experience Cloud to Drupal, keeping strict control over scope and managing business expectations.
• Support the Head of IT and internal engineers on key security projects, including Joiners/Movers/Leavers process automation, Identity Management, DNS, and Microsoft Sentinel.
• Collaborate with existing PMs on Single Sign-On (SSO) delivery and take on additional emerging tech and data projects as needed.
• Elicit requirements, build process maps, write clear user stories, and define acceptance criteria for core deliverables.
• Maintain strict project controls (plans, RAID logs, status reports) and actively challenge scope creep to keep projects on time and on budget.


Key Requirements
• Demonstrable track record managing digital platform or website migrations (experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud, Drupal, or complex CMS platforms is highly desirable).
• Proven experience acting as both PM and BA on technical projects—comfortable writing user stories, mapping requirements, and documenting technical workflows.
• Strong baseline technical literacy (security/identity management awareness, DNS, cloud/web setups) allowing you to challenge assumptions, control scope, and manage technical stakeholders effectively.
• Self-starter who takes personal accountability ("I drove this") and can scale delivery frameworks up or down in lean, fast-moving environments without rigid PMO support.

title: Senior Product Assurance Engineer
description:
Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space (TSX:MDA) is a trusted mission
partner to the global space industry. A robotics, satellite systems and Geointelligence pioneer
with a 55-year+ story of world firsts and more than 450 missions, MDA Space is a global leader
in communications satellites, Earth and space observation, and space exploration and
infrastructure.

The MDA Space team of more than 3,000 space experts in Canada, the US and
the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an
achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence
and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. For those who dream big and push
boundaries on the ground and in the stars to change the world for the better, we’ll take you there.
Are you ready to launch the next stage of your career in the new space economy? We would love
to hear from you!

We’re on the hunt for a Senior Product Assurance Engineer at our
Harwell/Stevenage/Harwell offices.

MDA Space’s international footprint in the UK creates opportunities to work with some of the
most exciting space industrial players in the country. Delivering all three business area
capabilities in Geointelligence, Robotics & Space Operations, and Satellite Systems, our UK
team provides support to our European-based customers while specializing in the development of
advanced space sensors for exploration missions as well as space-based communication
technology. As our presence grows overseas, so does our need for new ambitious team players to
help us advance our place in the Universe and beyond.

As a Product Assurance Engineer, you will be responsible for the product assurance activities for
designed and manufactured or procured electronic units and subsystems. You will develop, apply
and maintain quality evaluation and control protocols for products in line with customer
requirements. You will be working closely with the hardware and software project teams,
suppliers and customers. The role may require national and international travels at a short notice.

Responsibilities:
• Manage Product Assurance work packages throughout the project lifecycle and across
multiple projects.
• Prepare project-specific Product Assurance Plans and verify compliance throughout the
entire supply chain.
• Lead EEE parts, materials and processes assurance activities including review against
technical requirements, authoring qualification plans, and generation of relevant
documentation.
• Lead design, manufacturing, assembly, integration and test reviews, providing critical
inputs as required.
• Chair design reviews and customer/supplier reviews such as EQSR, PDR, SRR, CDR,
MRR, TRB, etc.
• Participate in customer and supplier design and development reviews.
• Prepare End Item Data Pack (EIDP) and PA documentation such as QSL, CIL and CIDL.
• Lead non-conformances/critical items/change control processes including NRBs, FRB,
and CCBs.
• Review of processes, drawings, procedures, test data, and inspection records to
specifications.
• Support in-house Quality Management System activities and initiatives including internal
audits, lessons learned process, and continuous improvement.
• Act as a focal point for all quality and product assurance activities of customers, suppliers
and subcontractors.
• Promote a quality culture and best practices across throughout the organisation.
• Mentor junior QA and PA Engineers
• Assist the Business Development team in preparing proposals.
Suitable candidates will ideally have the following attributes:
Qualifications and Experience

Essential
• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in relevant engineering field.
• 5+ years of experience in the delivery of Product Assurance work packages on
ESA/NASA and Commercial programs.
• Proven experience in electronic, electromechanical and optical systems design,
manufacture, assembly and test.
• Experience in the following disciplines: EEE Parts, Materials and Processes, Radiation
Hardness Assurance, RAMS.
• Full project lifecycle experience in ESA/NASA missions from mission definition to
disposal.
• Experience writing technical documents.
• Proven experience of working with European Space Agency standards particularly
ECSS-Q-ST-10, ECSS-Q-ST-60 and ECSS-Q-ST-70 family of standards.
• Experience with quality management systems such as ISO 9001, AS 9100 and their
implementation.
• Proven experience with root cause analysis and problem solving techniques and tools.

Desirable
• Experience in supplier quality management.
• Experience of working with industry standards such as NASA, IPC, JEDEC, and MIL
STD.
• Knowledge in any of the following would be advantageous:
o Satellite systems and payloads
o Robotics and optical subsystems
o Ground support equipment
o Electronic units (digital communications hardware, PCB, Integrated circuits, etc)
o Manufacturing processes e.g. soldering, coating, bonding, plating, etc.
o Harness design and fabrication methods
Core Competencies
• Problem solver and self-starter with great attention to detail
• Customer satisfaction focused
• Adaptability and flexibility in an agile environment
• A team player, willing to get stuck in and collaborate wherever is needed
• Agile, flexible and able to work across a geographically-distributed teams
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including a demonstrated ability to
interact effectively with customers, management, and peers.

We’re a dream team of purpose-driven, collaborative and passionate people, and we are
constantly looking for others to join #TeamMDA to ignite new and innovative approaches to
problem-solving that push us forward to improve life on and above Earth. If you’re excited to
expand our place in space and driven to inspire the next generation, we’ll take you there.
We have entered a new era of exploration and development, and MDA Space welcomes all who
yearn to suit up and be part of it. An equal opportunity employer prizing diversity, integrity and
collaboration, we are committed to growing MDA Space’s leadership in this next golden age.

Comments/Special Considerations:
We are required to conduct a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) screening in which
we will check your:
• Right to work: To confirm that you are entitled to take up the position as well as check
your nationality and immigration status
• Identity: Full ID check
• Criminal records: Basic Disclosure
• Employment history check: Confirmation of past three years of employment (minimum)
history/activity
• Reference checks

Benefits statement:
MDA Space provides competitive compensation and benefits packages for its employees at all
locations. As a team member of MDA, you and your qualified dependents are eligible to
participate in a benefit plan that ensures a comprehensive level of protection through competitive
health care including; private healthcare, disability income protection, life insurance, pension
plan; and an employee assistance program. We also have a Hybrid work model in place, for a
better work/life balance.

Equal opportunity statement:
MDA Space is an equal opportunity employer prizing diversity and inclusion. We are committed
to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity. If you require
assistance and/or reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the
recruiting process, please feel free to notify us.
Accommodations

MDA Space is proud to provide accommodation(s) during the recruitment process. Should you
require any accommodations, please indicate this on your application/cover letter and we will
work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

title: Dietitian
description:
Dietitian (Southwood Care Centre)

Intercare Corp Group Inc.

Calgary, Alberta.

Are you a dedicated and compassionate Dietitian who is looking to make a difference in the lives of our Long-Term Care residents by providing quality care, read on! This job may be for you!

Come Join the Heart of Excellence!

Company Overview:

Intercare is a fully accredited Alberta based company providing health and life enrichment services in continuing care centers since 1992. Our purpose is to maintain dignity, offer choice and support growth to those we serve. Here at Intercare, our employees drive the success of our organization through the implementation of our core values. Without the dedication and commitment of our employees, Intercare would not have grown into a leader in the continuing care sector. That’s why we make every effort as an organization to provide our valued employees a safe, healthy, and rewarding work environment.

Location: Southwood Care Centre

Position Type: Part-time Temporary (0.8 FTE)

Hours of Work: 8:00 am to 4:15 pm (flexibility required)

This line is temporary until approximately October 1, 2027

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor's Degree or equivalent and a graduate of an approved dietetic internship.
  2. Registered Dietitian with current membership in the Canadian Dietetic Association and Alberta Registered Dietitians Association.
  3. A minimum of three years' experience in Dietetics, preferably within a long-term care facility.
  4. Ability to work independently.
  5. Demonstrates concern and interest in providing quality care and service for residents.
  6. Mentally and physically able to perform duties as outlined.
  7. Ability to function as an effective team member with other staff, residents, families, and the public.
  8. Ability to read, write and comprehend the English language.

Competencies:

  1. Leadership: Guides individuals and groups towards the vision, while maintaining group cohesiveness, motivation, commitment and effectiveness. Leadership is flexible and sensitive to the changing needs of the organization, and health care environment;
  2. Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing;
  3. Lifelong Learning: Committed to continuous learning and promoting the value of learning for self and others;
  4. Emotional intelligence: Demonstrates high emotional intelligence in interactions and decision-making;
  5. Stakeholder Focus: Responsive to the needs of the stakeholders and customers. Actively promote positive relations.
  6. Leadership & Influence: Motivates, engages, inspires others to perform at their best;
  7. Coaching & Mentoring: Mentors, coaches, and supports leaders, managers, and front-line staff;
  8. Environmental Focus: Sensitive to political and other external environmental issues and their impact on health care.
  9. Conceptual Skills: Identifies and analyses situations and problems such that viable solutions are found. Approaches tasks and problems such that total systems and strategies are taken into account;
  10. Results Management: Manages human, capital, financial and information resources so that organizational objectives are achieved;
  11. Compliance Focus: Promotes compliance with accreditation standards and ethical and legal requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Food Service Program Delivery & Nutritional Care

  • Responsible for the provision of food service programs based on the assessed needs of the current customer population. Services shall include, but are not limited to:
  • Nutritional assessments and care plans
  • Therapeutic diets
  • Nourishments (special and routine)
  • Five‑week cyclical menu planning
  • Ethnic foods
  • Nutritional counseling
  • Education programs

2. Assessment, Documentation, and Care Planning

  • Complete InterRAI MDS assessment elements as appropriate for the discipline.
  • Participate in the review of triggered of RAPS and development of the resident care plan consistent with the Collaborative Care Model.
  • Documents assessments, interventions, and evaluations/outcomes as required on the resident’s health care record.

3. Quality Assurance, Consultation, & Community Resources

  • Evaluates the services provided by the Food Services Department, including but not limited to:
  • Efficiency of the meal service and delivery
  • Quality of food provided
  • Maintains an awareness of community resource/services and facilitates access to such services as required by facility customers.
  • Functions as a consultant within all Intercare facilities as required.

4. Education & Organizational Participation

  • Works with Education Services in planning, organizing, and implementing in‑service education for Food Service staff.
  • Participates in project teams, committees, and meetings as required and is responsible for reading minutes and memorandums provided to their team

5. Teamwork & Collaboration

  • Demonstrates respect to all customers, by working with them in a calm, courteous manner.
  • Cooperates and willingly assists other staff and facility customers.
  • Performs all duties in accordance with the written policies and procedures of the Employer, the facility and the Therapeutic Services Department.
  • Accepts responsibility for the performance results of their work teams and works in partnership with individuals and groups of employees (teams) to improve services for our customers.
  • Demonstrates effective team behaviors by:
  • Identifying opportunities for improvement and suggesting workable solutions
  • Supporting colleagues to foster individual and team success
  • Maintaining open-minded, patient, and positive communication
  • Choosing a positive growth-oriented attitude by viewing challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.
  • Remain flexible and in a constant state of readiness to help solve issues
  • Keeping communication open, constructive, and respectful
  • Coaching others to support their performance success
  • Contributing to a positive team environment by maintaining a good sense of humor.

6. Professional Practice & Development

  • Demonstrates professional conduct and accountability in all interactions.
  • Adheres to professional standards of practice.
  • Accepts responsibility for individual work performance and actively seeks and participates in learning opportunities to achieve or exceed performance expectations.
  • Participates in and presents at seminars and educational programs.
  • Keeps current on issues, practices and new trends in the food service industry and geriatric nutrition.
  • Participates in self‑assessment of educational needs.

7. Health & Safety

  • Understand and adhere to all organizational health and safety responsibilities as outlined in the corporate Health and Safety policy.
  • Performs all duties in a safe and efficient manner and maintains the work area in a clean, orderly and safe condition.
  • Reports unsafe, hazardous working conditions and/or any equipment malfunctions to the appropriate person/department.
  • Participate in required health and safety training and initiatives to maintain compliance and promote workplace safety.
  • Understand and adheres to fire responsibilities as outlined in the Corporate Fire Response Manual.

8. Other Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What We Offer:

  • A healthy work-life balance.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.
  • A respectful, inclusive, and positive work environment.
  • A collaborative, values-driven culture committed to quality care.
  • Company-sponsored events and staff recognition.
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

Respect | Compassion | Commitment | Service | Ethics
