title: Data Analyst (Claims)
description:
ABOUT US:

Design made simple for the modern home. Our passion lies in furniture and design, and it is the fuel that drives our business. We are a family-run company and aim to maintain this as we continue to rapidly grow. We’re entrepreneurial. We challenge the status quo, aren’t afraid to try new ideas, and we leverage our agile structure to make smart decisions and find new opportunities.

We’re a people-first company and what we do wouldn’t be possible without our customers. For this reason, we like to say that our collections are always customer curated. Join our flexible work culture and team of creative and passionate individuals.

Reporting directly to the Manager, Product Development & Sourcing, the Data Analyst (Claims) will turn claims, returns, and customer feedback data into clear, actionable insights that help our Quality team identify and resolve product issues. As Moe’s first dedicated data analyst, this role will also help shape how claims data is collected, analyzed, and reported by improving data feeds, building recurring reports and dashboards, and developing repeatable processes and SOPs.

This is a full-time, hybrid/remote role, with Vancouver, BC preferred. The Data Analyst (Claims) will work closely with Quality (QC), the Resolutions Team, Product Development, the Asia Office, and the Moe’s, Sundays, and Hetta brand teams.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Claims data consolidation and analysis

  • Gather raw claims, returns and damage data from all sources (SAP, Resolutions Team logs, customer data, brand channels) into one clean, consistent dataset
  • Clean, standardize and categorize claims by product, SKU, vendor, defect type, channel and region
  • Identify trends, recurring defects and root-cause signals across Sundays, Hetta and Moe's
  • Summarize the top issues for QC with clear evidence (volume, cost, affected SKUs and vendors) so they can investigate and resolve

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work with the Resolutions Team and Customer Data to understand how claims are captured and coded
  • Partner with QC to track issues from detection through corrective action and confirm whether fixes reduce claims
  • Share findings with Product Development, Sourcing and brand teams to inform vendor and product decisions

Data feed improvement

  • Map current claims data sources and flows, and document gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies
  • Recommend improvements to data capture, such as standard defect codes, required fields and photo or SKU linkage
  • Help set data quality standards and check that they are followed

Reporting and SOPs

  • Build and maintain recurring claims reports and dashboards (e.g. weekly top issues, monthly trends by vendor and SKU)
  • Write SOPs for data collection, cleaning, analysis and reporting so the process is repeatable
  • Respond to ad hoc data requests from leadership and partner teams

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • 2–4 years in a data or business analyst role, ideally in retail, e-commerce, furniture or consumer products
  • Advanced Excel: Power Query, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, data cleaning
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
  • Experience pulling and working with data from SAP or another ERP
  • Comfortable working with data from multiple sources and making it reliable
  • Able to turn analysis into a clear, short story for non-technical teams
  • Self-directed and organized; comfortable being the first person in a role and building processes from scratch
  • Strong written communication, including documenting processes and SOPs, proficient with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT).

Nice to have

  • Experience with claims, returns, warranty or quality data
  • Familiarity with product quality, sourcing or vendor management
  • Experience working with teams across time zones (North America and Asia)
  • Degree in business, statistics, data analytics or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in the furniture, fashion, or consumer goods industry is a plus

What success looks like in year one

  • QC gets a regular, trusted summary of top claims issues instead of pulling data by hand
  • All claims sources are mapped, and a single consolidated claims dataset is in use
  • Recurring claims dashboards are live and used by QC, Resolutions and brand teams
  • SOPs cover the full claims data process, so reporting continues if the analyst is away
  • Fixes driven by the analysis show a measurable drop in claims for the targeted SKUs or vendors

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive salary plus bonus.
  • Comprehensive benefits plan (health, dental, vision) with enhanced coverage for mental health resources.
  • Three weeks of vacation in your first year.
  • Casual and open office with views of downtown Vancouver and the North Shore mountains.
  • Stocked kitchen with snacks, fresh fruit, coffee, and tea.
  • Ergonomic workstations with sit-stand desks.
  • Free electric vehicle charging at our head office.
  • Generous product discounts for yourself, friends, and family.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Office gym and free weekly spin classes at Ride Cycle Club (locations in Vancouver and Toronto).

The salary range for this role is currently budgeted at $60,000 - $70,000 annually.

We appreciate hearing from all candidates, however, only those under consideration will be contacted. Moe’s is proud to be an equal opportunity employer who is committed to inclusive hiring practices

title: Field Scheduler - SK
description:
ABOUT HY-TECH

Hy-Tech Drilling is an innovative, capable, and accountable diamond drilling partner for the leading mining companies in the Americas and Europe, enabling our clients to reach critical minerals more quickly with less environmental impact. This supports a global transition to a more sustainable future. We seek win/win/win solutions for our people, our customers, and the communities we support.

Established in 1991, Hy-Tech has grown to a fleet of 60 drills operating throughout Canada, USA, Chile, and Europe. We take pride in the success we’ve had working with our clients to develop innovative solutions for their project challenges and believe in our team’s strength and effectiveness in tackling challenges that may arise.

THE JOB

Hy-Tech is adding a Field Scheduler to our growing team. The Field Scheduler is responsible for developing and managing crew schedules that meet operational requirements across Hy-Tech Drilling sites. This role ensures that assignment of employees to job sites by evaluating project demands, employee skill sets, and logistical considerations, including travel and accommodations. We are looking to add an ambitious, well-rounded individual to carry out the following key responsibilities:

  • Build relationships with employees and Foremen to understand how to best assign staff to jobs that match their skill set, individual experience, and team requirements.
  • Build a schedule to meet project needs following established procedures and client requirements.
  • Attend pre-job meetings to understand job requirements and build protocols to meet client expectations.

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we.  We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

GCIS protects Fidelity International by reducing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and enabling trusted digital services. This team provides the evidence, insight and control effectiveness view that helps GCIS and the business understand where cyber risk is changing, where controls are working, and where action or investment is needed most.

**About your role**

You will lead Cyber Effectiveness and Insights for GCIS, creating a clear, evidence-based view of cyber posture, control effectiveness, maturity and risk across the firm. This is a first-line leadership role with broad accountability for cyber measurement and reporting, security data, control testing, maturity assessment, benchmarking, cyber risk quantification, and executive insight. title: Sr Process Trainer/ Backup PTL.
description:
Job Title: Senior Operations Trainer - Shift

Reporting to: Production Training Excellence Lead

Location: Kitimat

There’s never been a better time to be working with LNG Canada.

We are Canada’s first large-scale LNG export facility. With Phase 1 now operating, we’ve moved from project to business—and are preparing for a potential Phase 2 that could double our size and help Canada become a top-five global LNG exporter.

We are committed to safety, compliance, and top-quartile performance, while building a high-performance culture powered by people like you. Our made-in-B.C. LNG is lower carbon, responsibly produced, and proudly delivered to the world.

This is your chance to shape history—working with a diverse team of experienced professionals and mentors in an environment that challenges and supports you.

With gratitude and respect, LNG Canada acknowledges our facility operates in the traditional territory of the Haisla Nation, and we honour the First Nations across our business footprint and shipping route.

We foster a safe, respectful workplace where speaking up is encouraged, and we continuously strive to improve together. Protecting our people, community, and operations is our top priority.

We are proud to be a catalyst for Canada’s new energy sector, setting the benchmark for economically, environmentally, and socially responsible LNG production.

Our Purpose

  • Provide a secure supply of LNG at scale;

Connect Canadian natural gas to global markets.

Our Vision

  • LNG Canada is a world class asset, Canada is a Top 5 global LNG producer;

Help Canada diversify its export market.

Our Values

  • Lead with Honesty
  • Nurture our People
  • Grow our Business
  • Connect with Purpose

Come join the team making Canadian history!

About the Role

Reporting to the Production Training Excellence Lead, the Shift Trainer strengthens shift capability for safe, stable, and reliable LNG plant operations. With Phase 1 beyond commissioning, the role now focuses on sustaining competence, reinforcing operating discipline, supporting targeted refresher training, and converting operational learning into practical improvements for shift crews.

To succeed with us at LNG Canada, we need your enthusiasm to:

Lead with Honesty: We act with integrity and courage, even when it is difficult.

  • Communicate openly, clearly, and respectfully in all situations.
  • Speak up when something doesn’t feel right, including safety or ethical concerns.
  • Take accountability for decisions and actions, and do the right thing for people and the business.

Nurture Our People: We create an environment where people feel supported, respected, and empowered to grow.

  • Support the development of others through feedback, coaching, and collaboration.
  • Build trusting relationships grounded in respect and inclusion.
  • Assume positive intent and approach differences with empathy and fairness.

Grow Our Business: We focus our energy on work that delivers meaningful, long‑term value.

  • Prioritize what matters most and use time and resources effectively.
  • Set clear goals, follow through on commitments, and deliver results.
  • Look for opportunities to improve how we work and how we perform.

Connect with Purpose: We build strong connections and understand the impact of our work.

  • Listen to, understand and value diverse perspectives.
  • Foster inclusive, collaborative relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Align daily work with LNG Canada’s purpose, values, and broader impact.

You will use your expertise to:

  • Deliver technical learning interventions that address defined shift performance needs in LNG operations.
  • Keep field, panel, and shift leadership training programs current with approved procedures and operating experience.
  • Support technician progression by assessing readiness, documenting gaps, and recommending clear closure actions to line supervision.
  • Reinforce operating discipline through procedure use, safe work practices, control-of-work expectations, and strong shift handover behaviors.
  • Convert abnormal situations and plant events into scenario-based practice that strengthens operator response.
  • Use fit-for-purpose planning, stakeholder engagement, and change management to support training delivery without unnecessary disruption to production work.

        Shift Training Delivery & Coaching

        • Deliver classroom, field, simulator, and on-shift coaching for Production Technicians and Panel Technicians.
        • Facilitate refresher sessions focused on normal operation, transient conditions, and emergency response interfaces.
        • Coordinate training with shift schedules to support learning while minimizing impact on safe and reliable production.
        • Coach operators on situational awareness, communication, shift handover, and field verification practices.
        • Help Production Team Leads and Production Supervisors select the right training response when assurance results indicate shift performance gaps.

              Competence Assurance & Records Management

              • Track training completion, competence assessment status, progression milestones, refresher validity, and required recertification.
              • Maintain accurate learning records (CLMS/UKG) and provide timely reporting on progress, gaps, overdue requirements, and training effectiveness.
              • Conduct or support field and panel competence assessments in line with approved capability requirements.
              • Assign gap-closure options such as supervised practice, reassessment, or targeted refresher training based on the assessed need.
              • Verify that personnel assigned to designated operational duties have the required training and assessment status.

                Support Safe and Reliable Plant Operations

                • Provide practical training support for operational risk controls, safe isolations, permit-to-work interfaces, critical task execution, field rounds, and alarm or abnormal situation response.
                • Support shift teams in applying approved operating procedures, standing instructions, temporary operating instructions, and management of change requirements.
                • Capture lessons from stabilization, trips, near misses, and deviations so they inform future refresher priorities.
                • Work with Operations, HSSE, Maintenance, Engineering, and Asset teams to ensure training reflects current plant conditions and reliable operating requirements.
                • Act as a credible field and panel coach who reinforces LNG Canada values, safe behaviors, and disciplined execution.
                • Provide operational cover for Production team Lead where necessary

                    Training Content, Systems & Continuous Improvement

                    • Develop, maintain, and update unit awareness training, capability assessment packs, refresher content, simulator scenarios, field coaching guides, and assessment tools.
                    • Validate training material against current procedures, operating limits, and equipment configuration before use.
                    • Analyze training metrics and assessment outcomes to identify trends that require program changes.
                    • Support digital learning, learning management system updates, training dashboards, and knowledge management practices.
                    • Promote consistent learning standards across shift crews to reduce variation and strengthen reliable operating performance.

                        Operational Learning & Culture

                        • Design learning interventions from incident learnings, audit findings, and field observations where a training response is required.
                        • Diagnose whether a performance issue is driven by knowledge, skill, procedure clarity, practice opportunity, or behavioral reinforcement.
                        • Promote a learning culture where operators are encouraged to ask questions, share experience, and demonstrate competence through Know It, Own It, Show It behaviors.
                        • Provide structured feedback to the Production Training Excellence Lead on emerging training risks, resource constraints, and capability priorities.
                        • Perform other duties as assigned in support of safe, compliant, and reliable operations.

                          To be successful, you will have:

                          • A minimum of 10 years of relevant LNG, oil and gas, petrochemical, or complex process plant operations experience, including field and/or panel operating exposure.
                          • Demonstrated experience training, coaching, mentoring, and assessing frontline operations personnel in a shift-based barrier management environment.
                          • Strong understanding of LNG plant systems, safe operating envelopes, control-of-work interfaces, process safety barriers, and reliable operations practices.
                          • Ability to develop and deliver fit-for-purpose learning material, refresher training, practical assessments, and scenario-based coaching for adult learners.
                          • Strong facilitation, technical writing, communication, stakeholder management, and performance feedback skills.
                          • Experience using learning records, assurance data, and performance trends to manage compliance and improve training quality.

                                This role requires that you:

                                • Be legally entitled to work in Canada (i.e., by way of Canadian citizenship, permanent residency, or valid work permit)
                                • Live in the beautiful District of Stikine (Kitimat/Terrace). For applicants located outside of the region, you are encouraged to explore what Kitimat has to offer in terms of lifestyle including schooling, local amenities, outdoor adventure, and housing, to ensure Kitimat is where you would like to call your new home.
                                • Are willing to comply with LNGC’s drug-free and harassment-free work environment and comply with all safety policies and procedures.
                                • Undergo a pre-placement medical assessment of your fitness for duty, and Pre-Site Access testing for alcohol and specified drugs.
                                • Know that this role may be expected to be on call on a rotational basis during the year and/or during site specific situations.
                                • Valid Driver’s license
                                • Ability to climb staircases
                                • 12 hour shift role – may need some flexibility in schedule as per needs of business

                                We Offer:

                                • A comprehensive LNG Canada relocation package (if required)
                                • A full suite of benefits including a flexible medical and health plan.
                                • A defined contribution pension plan with a matching program
                                • A competitive vacation offering to ensure a work life balance.
                                • See more information about Kitimat

                                About Us:

                                LNG Canada is a joint venture of five global energy leaders—Shell, PETRONAS, Mitsubishi Corporation, PetroChina, and KOGAS—bringing decades of LNG expertise to Canada.

                                As the largest private-sector investment in Canadian history, LNG Canada is a long-life asset with a 40-year export license. Phase 1 includes two processing units (“trains”) with a combined capacity of 14 million tonnes per annum (mtpa).

                                Together with our partners, we are exploring a potential Phase 2 expansion that would deliver more lower-carbon LNG to global markets, support Canada’s ambition to be a top-five LNG exporter, and generate lasting benefits for B.C. communities and the Canadian economy.

                                Our guiding North Star is to safely and responsibly create and deliver value. We focus on safety, compliance, performance, and scale, while building a high-performance culture. Partnerships with governments, local communities, and First Nations are central to our success and will continue to shape our journey.

                                At LNG Canada, we hire for character and train for skill. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive workforce that reflects the communities where we live and work. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply—this is your chance to join a supportive, collaborative organization with bold ambition and help us build a thriving business.

title: Executive Counsellor (Trusted Advisor to CIOs & Technology Leaders) | Singapore & APAC
description:
The Role

Info-Tech Research Group is looking for an Executive Counsellor to join our Executive Services team in Singapore, advising, coaching, mentoring, and delivering strategic insights to IT Leaders across Singapore and the broader Asia region. The role exists to help CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and senior technology executives improve outcomes through better decision-making, risk mitigation, and thoughtful guidance as they navigate complex business, technology, and leadership challenges on the path to personal and professional excellence.

The successful candidate will bring demonstrated experience as a CIO, CTO, or senior technology executive, gained across IT, consulting, and/or research and advisory careers, and will be comfortable operating at CEO, COO, CFO, and board level.

Who We Are

Info-Tech Research Group is one of the world's fastest-growing IT research and advisory companies, serving over 30,000 IT professionals. We produce unbiased, highly relevant research that helps CIOs and IT leaders make strategic, timely, and well-informed decisions. Our mission is to help IT leaders and their teams successfully deliver critical technology projects and systematically improve their core processes and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Executive Services exclusively to a portfolio of approximately 25–30 member accounts annually, as assigned
  • Facilitate high-value executive conversations that provide mentorship, challenge conventional thinking, and improve member decision-making.
  • Provide confidential executive advising, coaching, and peer mentorship to members, both in-person and virtually.
  • Evaluate members' needs and work with them to set objectives and develop a strategy or work plan within the terms of the membership agreement
  • Provide proactive thought leadership and new ideas not “asked for” on behalf of the client's membership
  • Participate in regular communication, support, and account planning with Sales Leadership and Account Directors
  • Leverage Info-Tech Research Group and third-party assets to deliver on membership commitments
  • Diagnose member value expectations and pain points, and connect members with the appropriate Info-Tech Research Group product solutions
  • Provide statistical and summary reports reflecting service KPIs, continuous improvement, and progress against strategic and operational goals
  • Embrace Info-Tech Research Group's culture of continuous learning through ongoing self and industry development

Experience and Selection Criteria

  • Must hold valid rights to work in Singapore
  • Minimum of 20 years of senior IT leadership experience, including a proven track record advising, coaching, mentoring, and serving as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders and executive teams through strategic, organizational, and leadership challenges.
  • Proven track record working directly with CEOs, COOs, CFOs, and executive boards on strategic and operational decisions
  • Experience based in Singapore is required; experience across Southeast Asia or the broader Asia Pacific region is a strong plus
  • Strong people relationship management skills, with experience leading and managing experienced team members, operational and systems development, business writing, financial budgeting, and management reporting
  • In-depth understanding of executive management roles, organizational politics, human behaviour, and predictive scenarios relevant to IT leadership
  • Ability to coordinate complex service delivery models and respond to the diverse needs of multiple stakeholders
  • Exceptional customer service focus, high professionalism, and adherence to ethical principles of conduct
  • Strong verbal, written, facilitation, and presentation skills; a self-starter with strong communication and organizational skills
  • Commitment to Info-Tech Research Group's core values as a trusted executive advisor
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed but not expected

Info-Tech Research Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. To that end, upon request, ITRG will ensure, to the extent possible, that accommodation be made available to applicants throughout the recruitment and hiring process.

title: Child and Youth Counsellor II, Benjamin Road - 6276G
description:
Join Our Team
Imagine being part of an organization that adds value to our community, cares about its staff, and creates a supportive workplace environment. Starling Community Services (formerly Lutherwood) is a progressive, not-for-profit health and social service organization that strengthens people's lives by providing mental health, employment, and housing services to more than 22,586 people annually in Waterloo Region and Wellington County.

We need great people like you to help us realize our mission and support communities where everyone experiences mental wellness, opportunities for employment, a place to call home, and a sense of belonging.

One full-time contract Child and Youth Counsellor II, Benjamin Road, position available, starting on November 09, 2026, and ending on August 31, 2027. Working 37.5 hours per week.

*Day Senior school program - Mon-Fri 8:00 am - 4:00 pm.

What’s In It for You?

  • Job Band G (hourly wages): Min - $27.97, Mid - $30.30, Max - $34.20
  • A positive work culture, inclusive workplace policies, and employee wellness initiatives.
  • Eligible to join the HOOPP defined pension plan on a voluntary basis.
  • Access to our Employee and Family Assistance Program which provides free and confidential counselling, resources and services.
  • 3 Weeks paid vacation (accumulated bi-weekly).
  • 15 hours of personal time per year.
  • Paid sick time (accumulated monthly) to a maximum of 300 hours.
  • 11 paid holiday benefits per year plus a floater day.
  • Discounted GRT passes through membership with Travel Wise.
  • Employee Referral Incentive Program.
  • Professional development and tuition reimbursement opportunities.
  • Staff appreciation events.

Your Role:

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Supervises, monitors, supports and coaches clients throughout the treatment and academic components of their program.
  • Works in partnership with multidisciplinary teams, to facilitate safe and goal-focused programs for clients.
  • Works intentionally from an anti-racist, anti-oppressive and equity perspective to further create a sense of belonging at the Agency.
  • Supports the sustainability of Social emotional learning.

  • Counsel and support clients through all components of the program using therapeutic techniques such as Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), both in individual and group settings.

  • Assesses, develops, and implements plans of care goals and objectives with individual clients, ensuring continuity and integration of treatment, care or custody.

  • Actively participate in care planning meetings, liaise with families and community partners, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure comprehensive client support.

  • Collects information, records and maintains client files and updates client and shift data. Communicates information regarding medication with Nurse.
  • Monitors group budgets and coordinates with the Program Supervisor for additional financial requirements.
  • Monitors the security of the facility and ensures the safety of the community in alignment with the service mandate.
  • The above tasks are representative but not all inclusive.

Your Talents and Experience:

  • A relevant degree or diploma in child and youth work or related discipline with a minimum of one year working in a milieu setting as a Child and Youth Worker.
  • Case management experience is an asset.
  • Needs to have experience working with youth.
  • Demonstrated ability to relate to youth with warmth and understanding and setting consistent appropriate limits.
  • Highly developed professional, verbal and written skills, with a demonstrated ability to deal with a diverse range of people.
  • Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team while still demonstrating strong decision-making capabilities.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the capability of multi-tasking to meet various timelines are essential.
  • Alignment with the Agency's commitment to anti racism and anti-oppression.
  • Passionate, aware, and willing to learn about antiracism, anti-oppression and equity.
  • Required to hold a “G” class license.
  • First Aid Certificate, CPR, and CIT training.

If you are community-focused and share our values and commitment to equity, we want you to grow with us. Please submit your application in confidence, no later than 4 pm on October 13, 2026.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you don't have every single requirement and the exact level of experience listed in our description, but the skills and experience needed for the role still resonate with you, please consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and quality; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require any support submitting your application or during the interview process by contacting Human Resources at hr@starlingcs.ca or by calling 519-707-1958 ext. 1247.

Our Commitment to Equity:

To better serve the diversity of our community, the agency is dedicated to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for both clients and staff, with particular attention to supporting BIPOC communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ individuals, and other historically marginalized and underrepresented groups. We understand that addressing systemic inequities is crucial to fulfilling our mission and promoting the well-being of the communities we serve.

Our equity strategy is guided by core principles that emphasize celebrating diversity, building strong partnerships, prioritizing client service, and recognizing equity is a shared responsibility.

title: People & Culture Coordinator
description:
Kraken Robotics is currently recruiting for a People & Culture Coordinator to join our Blackbushe, United Kingdom Office.


The People & Culture Coordinator provides administrative and coordination support across core People & Culture programs and employee lifecycle activities. Reporting to the People & Culture Business Partner, this role supports onboarding, recruitment coordination, employee documentation, HR systems, payroll and benefits administration, compliance tracking, and employee engagement activities. The Coordinator helps ensure People & Culture processes are organized, accurate, timely, and consistently delivered, while escalating more complex employee relations, policy, or advisory matters to the Business Partner or appropriate People & Culture team member.



ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Culture & Employee Experience Support

  • Coordinate employee engagement, recognition, wellness, and culture-related activities under the guidance of the People & Culture Business Partner.
  • Support onboarding and offboarding activities by preparing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating required employee communications.
  • Respond to routine employee inquiries regarding People & Culture programs, processes, and documentation, escalating matters when required.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and support a consistent, positive employee experience across administrative touchpoints.

Compliance & HR Administration

  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee files, HR systems data, and People & Culture documentation.
  • Support compliance tracking, reporting, audits, and required administrative submissions.
  • Assist with the communication and administration of company policies, procedures, and People & Culture programs.
  • Escalate complex compliance, policy, or employee relations matters to the People & Culture Business Partner.

Employee Relations & Workplace Support

  • Provide first-level administrative support for employee inquiries, workplace processes, and People & Culture programs.
  • Support the People & Culture Business Partner with documentation, scheduling, note-taking, and follow-up related to employee matters.
  • Promote respectful workplace practices and help ensure employee concerns are directed to the appropriate People & Culture resource.

Probation Management

  • Carry out and record employee and line manager check-in conversations throughout the probationary period, ensuring agreed actions, feedback, and follow-up requirements are accurately documented.

Absence Management

  • Coordinate the administration and tracking of employee absences, including sick leave, statutory leave, disability-related leave, and other approved time away from work.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential absence records in HRIS and ensure supporting documentation is received, filed, and monitored in accordance with company requirements.
  • Provide employees and managers with routine information on absence reporting procedures, documentation requirements, and available leave programs.
  • Support return-to-work coordination, follow-up activities, and communication with payroll, benefits providers, and relevant People & Culture team members.
  • Escalate complex, prolonged, accommodation-related, or sensitive absence matters to the People & Culture Business Partner.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience in Human Resources, People & Culture, administration, or a related support role.
  • Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, maintain accurate records, and follow established processes.
  • Experience supporting recruitment coordination, onboarding, HR administration, payroll or benefits administration, and employee documentation.
  • Working knowledge of HR systems, employee records management, confidentiality requirements, and basic employment standards.
  • Strong attention to detail, communication skills, discretion, and customer-service orientation.
  • Ability to work independently on routine tasks while seeking guidance on more complex matters.

title: Nuohooja Kokkola
description:
Etsimme valmiita nuohoojan ammattitutkinnon omaavia tai nuohoojan ammattitutkinnosta kiinnostuneita nuohoojia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Kokkolan alueelle.

Tietoa Nokikaveri Oy:stä:

Nokikaveri Oy on paljon enemmän kuin vain valtakunnallinen nuohouspalvelu.

Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme työllistää nuohoojia ympäri Suomen ja olla samalla alamme digitalisoijia ja uudistajia. Sitoudumme tarjoamaan erinomaisen kokemuksen kaikille asiakkaillemme ja työntekijöillemme – ja olemme siinä tunnustetusti myös onnistuneet.

Olemme sitä mieltä, että nuohousalan toimintaa tulee kehittää ja rakentaa uudelleen nykyisen lainsäädännön pohjalta, ja olemmekin luoneet toimialalle kokonaan uudenlaisen palvelun. Tuloksena on nuohouspalvelu, joka on paitsi siisti ja laadukas, myös räätälöity vastaamaan asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin mahdollisimman tehokkaasti.



Tietoa roolista:

Nokikaveri Oy tarjoaa sinulle työauton, jolla voit aloittaa työpäivän suoraan kotoa niin halutessasi. Ajojärjestelijä suunnittelee ja järjestää asiakasreitit sinulle

etukäteen, joten työpäiväsi koostuu pelkästään nuohoustyöstä, johon olet kouluttautunut. Toimistomme vastaa muista töistä kuten laskutuksesta sekä nuohoustodistuksista, joka tarkoittaa, että voit keskittyä täysin ydinosaamiseesi.

Tarjoamme sinulle työtä tasaisesti läpi vuoden ja voit itse vaikuttaa työmäärääsi. Ajanvarauspalvelumme varaa kalenteriisi nuohouskohteet.

Olemme kehittäneet nuohousalalle oman järjestelmän mikä tekee työstäsi mukavampaa ja helpompaa. Vastaanotat ja merkitset työsi valmiiksi omalla tabletilla. Pystyt myös hyvin vaikuttamaan omiin työaikoihisi, joka mahdollistaa hyvin perhe-ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamisen työn kanssa.

Panostamme työntekijöidemme viihtyvyyteen ja olemme vakuuttaneet työntekijät kattavalla vakuutuksella mahdollisten työtapaturmien osalta. Nuohoojiemme mediaani-ansiot yrityksessämme ovat 3450€/kk sisältäen laskutusprovisiot ja työpäivistä maksettavat puolipäivärahat. Ahkeralla työllä on mahdollisuus päästä 4000,00€-5000,00€/kk ansiotuloihin.



Perehdytys tapahtuu Pirkkalassa, jolloin tutustut Nokikaveri Oy:n toimintakulttuuriin ja arvoihin. Samalla saat työssä tarvittavat varusteet sekä auton käyttöösi.




Nokikaveri Oy

Nokikaveri on Suomen suurin ja nopeimmin kasvava nuohousalan edelläkävijä, joka on digitalisoinut perinteisen toimialan ainutlaatuisella, teknologiavetoisella toimintamallilla. Yritys on muuttunut muutamassa vuodessa valtakunnalliseksi kasvuyritykseksi, jonka menestyksen ytimessä on itse kehitetty digitaalinen ohjausjärjestelmä ja tehokas logistiikka.

Meillä työntekijät eivät ole vain osa yritystä, vaan koko toiminnan tärkein voimavara. Panostamme moderniin työympäristöön, toimiviin työkaluihin, reiluun tekemisen kulttuuriin ja siihen, että töihin on aidosti mukava tulla — yhdessä tekeminen, hyvä huumori ja jatkuva kehittyminen näkyvät Nokikaverilla joka päivä.

Puhelin: 0458408771 Sähköposti: kristian.salo@nokikaveri.fi Sijainti: Myllyhaantie 6 D3 Nokikaveri on valtakunnallinen nuohouspalvelu, joka työllistää alueellasi pitkään toimineita nuohoojia.

Nokikaveri tulee kutsustanne nuohoamaan horminne kerran tai voitte sopia Nokikaveria huolehtimaan vuosittain toistuvista käynneistä. Hoitosopimuksella vastuu nuohousten muistamisesta palaa nuohoojalle, eikä lain edellyttämät määräajat pääse ylittymään.

Nuohous sisältää tulisijojen ja hormien nuohouksen ja kunnon tarkistamisen, sekä tuhkien poiston. Tarjoamme nuohouspalveluiden lisäksi myös tarvitsemasi lisäpalvelut. Nokikaveri noudattaa nuohoamisessa aina Nuohousalan Keskusliiton nuohoustyöohjetta.

title: Strategic Customer Engagements, Americas
description:
At AWS, the Global Deal Strategy and Programs (GDSP) team drives cloud adoption and business growth through innovative pricing strategies. The organization comprises two specialized teams: Strategic Customer Engagements, which guide transformative deals with industry leaders, and Private Pricing Programs & Experiences, which scales and optimizes pricing solutions across our diverse customer base. Within GDSP, you will develop deep expertise in cloud economics, hone your strategic thinking, and directly impact AWS's market leadership while working with emerging technologies and global clients.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a member for the Strategic Customer Engagements (SCE) team. SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial and public sector customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities. SCE engages directly with customers and AWS leadership to drive cloud initiatives that will accelerate growth, increase efficiency, and unlock new business capabilities.

By collaborating closely with our field sales teams, SCE Deal Specialist’s at AWS leverage their expertise in deal structuring, negotiating private pricing that drives sustainable growth and value for both our customers and AWS, and strategic methodologies to navigate customer pain points, gain credibility, and effectively partner with the sales organization. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS (Americas/EMEA/APJ), and to establish AWS as their key cloud technology provider. These opportunities range across industry verticals, such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, Energy, Healthcare Life Sciences, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Public Sector, and customer size (from start-ups to enterprise customers). These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE global deal team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders. We are a dynamic team passionate about managing transformational deals.

As a Deal Specialist you will partner with AWS Service teams to develop commercial business models. You will inspire and influence AWS customers, field sales executives, and other internal stakeholders to empower our customers to address business challenges and develop innovative solutions. As a Deal Specialist you will create actionable strategies, develop and shape opportunities, and lead large, complex, or highly competitive deal engagements through negotiations and closure. This highly visible role will own alignment with C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and enable private pricing, go-to-market, pan-Amazon, and other strategic relationships.

Key job responsibilities
• Act as trusted advisor and thought leader in the development of commercial strategy and deals: partner in the execution of the deal sales cycle for strategic commercial opportunities.
• Partner closely with AWS Service teams to understand services and pricing: create frameworks that impact customer outcomes.
• Inspire and influence key internal stakeholders, experts, and other indirect resources to remove barriers and achieve desired business outcomes
• Advise and construct commercial deal terms: understand the competitive landscape and provide deal guidance
• Facilitate alignment and effective AWS communication with internal and external stakeholders to resolve conflict and encourage develop productive interactions
• Cultivate best practices through analysis and reporting in support of continuous improvements

Valvomotoiminnan ja kohteiden turvallisuuden kehittäminen yhteistyössä kohdehenkilöstön ja tilapalveluiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa.
Valvomohenkilöstön perehdyttäminen ja toiminnan ohjeistuksen ylläpitäminen.
Ulkopuolisen vartiointihenkilökunnan ohjaaminen.

Viranomais- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyö häiriö- ja hätätilanteissa.

title: IT Support Specialist - US
description:
We are seeking a client-focused, service-driven IT Support Specialist to strengthen employee productivity, system reliability, and secure technology adoption across the Greenstone Meats. This role serves as a trusted first point of contact for technical support while owning day-to-day issue resolution, onboarding readiness, endpoint support, and accurate IT documentation.

Key Responsibilities

  • User Support: Provide responsive technical support through chat, email, and in-person channels for office and remote employees, ensuring issues are resolved or escalated with clear communication.
  • Endpoint & Software Setup: Configure, deploy, and maintain laptops, monitors, peripherals, mobile devices, handheld devices, and software licenses to ensure employees are productive from day one.
  • Access Management: Manage employee onboarding and offboarding by provisioning, modifying, and deactivating accounts in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, and related IT systems.
  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve network, Wi-Fi, VPN, printer, endpoint, and operating system and software applications issues efficiently to maintain service continuity.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate internal knowledge base articles, step-by-step guides, and FAQs to improve consistency, repeatability, and self-service support.
  • Asset Governance: Maintain reliable inventory records for hardware, software, and assigned devices to support lifecycle management, accountability, and audit readiness.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 1–3 years of experience in an IT Help Desk or Technical Support role.
  • Strong familiarity with Windows endpoints, Android devices, and on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Experience with cloud productivity and business platforms, including Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.
  • Strong knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and Wi-Fi troubleshooting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical team members with patience and clarity.
  • Familiarity with endpoint management and MDM tools, including Microsoft Intune.
  • Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft Certified Professional are considered an asset.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay: $25.00 to $32.00 per hour
  • Retirement: 401(k) company contribution
  • Health & Wellness: 100% company-paid Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life Insurance, and Short/Long Term Disability benefits

For information about the company, go to https://greenstonemeats.com/

Only qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.

Greenstone Meats is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, ethnic or national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, pregnancy, leave status, disability, veteran status, genetic information and/or any other characteristic or status protected by national, federal, state or local law.

Greenstone Meats is committed to providing an accessible and barrier-free environment. Accommodations are available on request for candidates throughout the selection process. Please contact Human Resources if accommodation is required.

title: Mittauspäällikkö
description:
Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa sujuvaa ja laadukasta infraa?

Haemme mittauspäällikköä Pohjois-Suomen alueen datakeskushankkeisiin vastaamaan työmaan mittauksista, mittausaineistojen hallinnasta sekä tukemaan hankkeen onnistunutta toteutusta.

Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?

Etsimme datakeskushankkeillemme mittauspäällikköä, joka vastaa työmaan mittaustoiminnan johtamisesta, koordinoinnista ja laadunvarmistuksesta koko hankkeen ajan. Toimit osana monialaista projektiorganisaatiota ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä suunnittelijoiden, tuotannon johdon, työnjohdon ja aliurakoitsijoiden kanssa.

Vastaat siitä, että mittaustoiminta tukee projektin turvallista, laadukasta ja aikataulun mukaista toteutusta.

Tehtävässäsi vastaat muun muassa:

- mittaustoiminnan suunnittelusta, koordinoinnista ja laadunvarmistuksesta



- tietomallien hyödyntämisestä tuotannon ja mittaustoiminnan tukena



- tietomallien laadun ja mittauskelpoisuuden varmistamisesta tuotannon tarpeisiin



- toteuma ja laatuaineiston tuottamisesta sekä sen dokumentoinnista



- mittausosaston ohjaamisesta sekä yhteistyöstä tuotannon, suunnittelijoiden ja aliurakoitsijoiden kanssa



- mittaustoiminnan kehittämisestä


Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä merkittävässä tietomallipohjaisessa infrahankkeessa nykyaikaisilla työkaluilla ja osaavan tiimin tuella. Pääset vaikuttamaan mittaus- ja mallinnusprosessien kehitykseen sekä kasvamaan ja kehittymään alan huippuosaajana.

Työsuhde on vakituinen, ja työskentelet pääosin datakeskushankkeellamme Pohjois-Suomessa. Tehtävä edellyttää matkustusvalmiutta sekä aktiivista liikkumista projektikohteiden välillä. Mikäli työskentelet toiselta paikkakunnalta käsin projektikohteessa, korvaamme työstä aiheutuvat matkakulut, päivärahat ja majoituskustannukset yrityksen matkustuskäytäntöjen mukaisesti.

Kurkkaa ilmoituksen alla olevilta videoilta, mitä kollegasi kertovat työstä Destialla
[Tutustu Destian palveluihin verkkosivuilla](https://destia.fi/palvelut/)

Miten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?

Rakennamme Destian menestyksen yrityskulttuurin ja ihmisten varaan, ja siksi odotamme ensisijaisesti, että haluat sitoutua yhteisiin arvoihimme: rehdisti, yhdessä, uudistuen ja menestyen.

Tehtävässä onnistut, kun sinulla on:

- vahvaa kokemusta tietomallipohjaisesta infrarakentamisesta



- kokemusta työmaan mittaustoiminnan johtamisesta, koordinoinnista ja laadunvarmistuksesta



- hyvää osaamista tietomallien hyödyntämisestä tuotannon ja mittaustoiminnan tukena



- sujuvaa osaamista digitaalisista työkaluista, kuten 3D Win, Infrakit, Vektor.io ja Trimble Connect



- kokemusta mittausjärjestelmistä ja mittauslaitteista



- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


Lisäksi onnistut tehtävässä, jos työskentelet itsenäisesti, ratkot ongelmia käytännönläheisesti ja haluat kehittää toimintatapoja. Toimit luontevasti osana monialaista projektiorganisaatiota ja sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot. Tehtävä edellyttää matkustusvalmiutta tarvittaessa.

Lupaamme, että Destialla

Destialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia. Kehitämme jatkuvasti mittauspuolen tekemistämme ja käytössämme on monipuolisesti eri teknologiaa. Kollegasi ovat kokeneita alan ammattilaisia, jotka sparraavat mielellään.

Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Meille tärkeintä on, että nämä lupaukset näkyvät myös destialaisten omissa kokemuksissa joka päivä. [Lue lisää vastuullisuudesta ja tavastamme toimia nettisivuiltamme](https://destia.fi/tietoa-meista/vastuullisuus/).

Kiinnostuksesi herättyä toimi näin

Lisätietoja tehtävästä: rekrytointi@destia.fi.

Hae meille työkaveriksi työpaikkailmoituksen kohdasta "Hae tähän työpaikkaan", ja kerro vapaamuotoisesti osaamisestasi ja toiveistasi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen muodossa. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Olethan nopea, sillä haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa. Esihenkilön lisäksi saatat tavata haastattelussa myös mahdollisia tulevia työkavereita. Pyydämme lisäksi jokaiselta hakeneelta palautetta kehittääksemme toimintaamme jatkuvasti!

Odottelemme hakemustasi!


Destia Oy

Destia on suurin infra-alan palveluita Suomessa tuottava yhtiö ja osa kansainvälistä Colas-konsernia. Luomme hyvän yhteiskunnan perustaa suunnittelemalla, rakentamalla ja ylläpitämällä huomisen liikenne- ja energiainfraa. Teemme sen noin 1 900 destialaisen ainutlaatuisella infran tajulla. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli noin 790 miljoonaa euroa. [www.destia.fi](http://www.destia.fi/)

Sähköposti: rekrytointi@destia.fi Sijainti: Pohjois-Pohjanmaa

title: Senior Production Test Engineer
description:
IONATE is a deep tech scale-up building the hardware and software backbone for smart grids. Our mission is to transform power systems - from grids and microgrids to renewables and data centres - unlocking the massive potential in this under-innovated sector that touches every aspect of our modern lives.

We are now looking for a Senior Production Test Engineer to join our Operations team. You will create the production-test capability needed as the Hybrid Intelligent Transformer (HIT) moves from engineering builds into safe, repeatable manufacture at London and external manufacturing partners. You will own the production-test strategy, test methods, equipment, software, safe operating controls, test records and the test elements of manufacturing transfer, working across Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality. This is a genuinely hands-on role. You should be happy working directly with high-power hardware, instruments, test rigs, software and technicians in the manufacturing and test area, solving problems at the equipment level. You will develop and implement production-test changes through the approved engineering change process.

What you will do:

  • Create the production-test strategy. Own the production-test strategy by translating approved product requirements, design-verification evidence and known failure modes into test coverage, methods, sequences and proposed production limits, together with the records and release evidence required for each unit.
  • Work directly on early units. Work closely with the Engineering team on production test set up and execute tests, support initial power-up and integration, capture abnormal behaviour, diagnose failures and feed practical learning back into product design, manufacturing processes and test coverage.
  • Design and commission test systems. Specify, develop, integrate and validate test fixtures, harnesses, instrumentation, data-acquisition hardware, interlocks, software interfaces and operator controls that are safe, repeatable, maintainable and appropriate for production use.
  • Engineer safe test operations. Define safe test methods for high-energy and high-voltage equipment, including access control, isolation, grounding, lockout and tagout, interlocks, emergency response, pre-test checks and clear operator competence requirements.
  • Automate test execution and data capture. Develop or configure test software, scripts and interfaces that guide operators, reduce manual error, record results against the correct serialised unit and produce clear pass, fail and diagnostic evidence.
  • Support fault diagnosis and corrective action. Use schematics, waveforms, logs, measurements and structured problem solving to isolate test failures and distinguish product defects from test-system faults. Work with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality on containment and corrective action.
  • Control test configuration and effectivity. Maintain approved test methods, software versions, fixtures, limits and calibration status. Implement test changes through the controlled change process and apply each change at a defined product serial number, lot, date or build stage with an auditable as-tested record.
  • Optimise test performance and capacity. Measure test cycle time, first-pass yield, repeat tests, false failures, equipment utilisation and downtime. Improve test coverage, diagnostic value, reliability and throughput as demand grows.
  • Transfer the test capability. Own the transfer of production-test specifications, equipment requirements, validation evidence, maintenance and calibration instructions, training and acceptance criteria to the UK contract manufacturer, with a scalable package for a future high-volume contract manufacturer.
  • Contribute to PFMEA. Participate in developing and maintaining process FMEAs, ensuring that identified process risks, failure modes and required controls are translated into appropriate in-process and end-of-line production-test coverage, methods and acceptance criteria

Requirements

What you will need:

  • A genuine preference for hands-on test work. You enjoy working directly with products, instruments, fixtures, test software and technicians. You are comfortable setting up equipment, taking measurements, modifying test rigs and troubleshooting faults in the test area.
  • Relevant production-test experience. Practical experience developing, commissioning or supporting production tests for complex electromechanical, electrical, power-electronic or similarly demanding hardware.
  • Electrical fault-finding capability. The ability to interpret electrical schematics, specifications, interface definitions, waveforms and logs, then use structured measurements to isolate faults safely and efficiently.
  • Test-system engineering. Experience selecting and integrating instruments, sensors, switching, data acquisition, fixtures, harnesses, interlocks and operator interfaces into reliable production-test equipment.
  • Test software and data. Experience developing automated test sequences, scripts or applications, with robust result capture, serial-number traceability, version control and clear diagnostic output.
  • Software & Tools: Proficiency with automated test software (like LabVIEW), measurement instrumentation (multimeters, oscilloscopes), and manufacturing systems (ERP/MES like SAP).
  • Safety discipline. Practical knowledge of electrical safety, risk assessment, isolation, grounding, lockout and tagout, interlocks and safe systems of work for energised or high-energy test environments.
  • Controlled documentation and change. The ability to create clear test specifications, procedures, validation reports, maintenance instructions and training materials, and to manage test configuration, software versions, calibration and effectivity.
  • Relevant technical foundation. A degree, apprenticeship or equivalent practical experience in electrical, electronic, power electronics, control, mechatronic, test or systems engineering, together with clear communication skills and the flexibility to support UK suppliers and manufacturing partners when required.

It would be useful to have:

  • High-power product experience. Production-test experience involving power electronics, high-voltage equipment, transformers, grid equipment, energy infrastructure or another high-energy product environment.
  • New-product and low-volume test. Experience creating a production-test process while product design, firmware, test coverage and manufacturing methods are still maturing.
  • Automation and software tools. Experience with platforms such as LabVIEW, Python, C#, PLCs, automated test frameworks, databases, APIs, hardware-in-the-loop systems or comparable test technologies.
  • Factory acceptance testing. Experience developing or executing factory acceptance tests, customer-witnessed tests, formal release evidence or site acceptance support for complex equipment.
  • CEM test transfer. Experience duplicating, validating and supporting test equipment and methods at a contract manufacturer, including training, calibration, spares, maintenance and remote fault support.

Benefits

  • Employee Option Plan: You get equity in IONATE, so as we succeed so do you.
  • Private Medical & Dental Insurance: From day one, we provide you with full, comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa. You also have the option to add any dependents to your cover. Please ask us for more details.
  • Company pension: a flexible, and sustainable pension product to help you plan for your future.
  • Career Development: It’s important to us that you have the opportunity for ongoing professional development and career growth. You will receive an annual budget for professional development and work with your team to set and reach goals every year.
  • Flexible working schedules: You will have the flexibility for occasional work-from-home arrangements. Talk to us at the application stage about this.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme: Low carbon travel is important for everyone, so we have in place a cycle scheme to help you purchase a bicycle.
  • Slow travel: We believe in a low carbon future, so if you wish to travel by a lower carbon method – but it takes much longer than flying - we will give you an extra 2 slow travel days per year.

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description:
Data Analytics Engineer

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to lead the migration, optimization, and secure operation of our log ingestion and observability pipelines. The role emphasizes secure data delivery, advanced SIEM coverage, Splunk expertise, data reduction strategies, and robust load balancing and high availability for log infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End SIEM Pipeline Management & Optimization

Lead the migration of log sources from Splunk ingestion to Cribl Stream/Edge pipelines, ensuring load-balanced, fault-tolerant delivery and processing of security and IT logs.

Architect and manage scalable, resilient pipelines—including design, implementation, and operation of load balancing solutions (e.g., Cribl worker groups, external load balancers, or syslog load distribution) for high ingest volumes.

Analyze, tune and securely onboard all log sources (firewalls, EDR, cloud, authentication, proxies, etc.)—covering parsing, filtering, and data reduction techniques to minimize Splunk ingest/storage costs without sacrificing security coverage.

Develop and maintain Cribl and Splunk configurations, including advanced transformations, field normalization, masking, and enrichment for security analytics.

Ensure optimal distribution of logging workload across Cribl worker nodes and Splunk indexers to prevent bottlenecks, data loss, or single points of failure.

Security Event Visibility and SOC Enablement

Collaborate with SOC, IR, and threat detection teams to ensure all security logs reach the SIEM efficiently and reliably, and logs are tuned for actionable detection.

Actively monitor, test, and remediate pipeline balancing and ingestion health to maximize uptime and forensic visibility.

Respond to and resolve SIEM and pipeline issues that impact security, detection, or compliance visibility.

Governance, Compliance & Documentation

Apply and document security policies for log routing, load balancing, event retention, and integrity—ensuring pipeline architecture meets audit, legal, and privacy requirements.

Track and report ingest reduction, Splunk cost savings, pipeline health, and event loss/drop rates across the load-balanced infrastructure.

Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of log flows, pipeline topology, load balancing strategies, and operational procedures.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Extensive hands-on experience with Splunk SIEM engineering (indexers, search heads, clustering, forwarders, CIM, performance/load optimization).

2+ years with Cribl Stream/Edge, including deployment and tuning of distributed, load-balanced pipelines.

Deep understanding of machine data transport (syslog, HEC, TCP, UDP), log balancing strategies (syslog balancers, DNS round-robin, Cribl worker groups, etc.), and high-availability logging environments.

Proven expertise onboarding, parsing, and tuning security log sources (firewalls, cloud, EDR/XDR, IAM, authentication, and networking) for best possible coverage and SOC/IR support.

Advanced Splunk SPL, data model, event parsing, and alert tuning skills; practical SIEM optimization experience.

Scripting/automation ability (Python, shell/CLI, or similar) for pipeline management and validation.

Strong troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational dashboard skills for both pipeline and SIEM health.

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on experience designing and operating clustered/HA Cribl and Splunk deployments (worker groups, clustered indexers, resilient data forwarders, etc.).

Splunk ES or Cribl certifications.

Key Success Metrics

No loss of security data or alert coverage during/after pipeline migration and optimization.

Documented, measurable reductions in Splunk ingest volume and operational/storage cost.

Consistently balanced log throughput and minimal risk of bottlenecks or overloads—pipeline health and reliability metrics maintained above SLA.

Well-documented, adaptable pipeline and load balancing architecture

title: MIG/MAG-hitsaaja – Kangasala
description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista MIG/MAG-hitsaajaa Kangasalle kokoaikaiseen työhön. Tehtävässä hitsaat mustaa terästä ja pääset työskentelemään isojen, teollisuuteen valmistettavien kone- ja runkorakenteiden parissa.

Etsimme ennen kaikkea käytännön hitsausosaajaa, jolla on jo kokemusta MIG/MAG-hitsauksesta ja varma ote pitkien, suorien saumojen tekemiseen. Tässä työssä hyvä hitsausjälki ratkaisee.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Pääasiallinen tehtäväsi on mustan teräksen MIG/MAG-hitsaus. Hitsattavien materiaalien vahvuudet ovat pääasiassa noin 3–15 mm, ja työssä valmistetaan muun muassa suurikokoisia koneiden pohja- ja runkorakenteita teollisuuden tarpeisiin.

Työssä korostuvat erityisesti pitkien ja suorien saumojen hallinta, tasainen hitsausjälki sekä kyky työskennellä tehokkaasti suurempien kappaleiden parissa.

Kyseessä on käytännönläheinen konepajatyö, jossa pääset näkemään konkreettisesti oman työsi jäljen osana suuria ja kiinnostavia teollisuuden kokonaisuuksia.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Edellytämme sinulta aikaisempaa kokemusta MIG/MAG-hitsauksesta. Sinulla tulisi olla riittävä käytännön hitsaustaito, jotta pystyt työskentelemään tehtävässä itsenäisesti perehdytyksen jälkeen.

Tehtävässä tarvitset:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta MIG/MAG-hitsauksesta

* kokemusta mustan teräksen hitsaamisesta

* taitoa hitsata 3–15 mm materiaalivahvuuksia

* varmaa otetta pitkien ja suorien saumojen hitsaamiseen

* huolellista ja laadukasta työskentelyotetta

* riittävää suomen kielen taitoa työohjeiden ymmärtämiseen ja turvalliseen työskentelyyn.

Levyseppähitsaajan tai muu soveltuva metallialan koulutus antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan, mutta käytännön hitsausosaaminen ja aikaisempi kokemus ovat tehtävässä tärkeimmässä roolissa.

MILLAISTA TYÖ ON KÄYTÄNNÖSSÄ?

Työskentelet perinteisessä konepajaympäristössä, jossa valmistetaan suuria rakenteita teollisuuden tarpeisiin.

Työtä tehdään lähtökohtaisesti päivävuorossa maanantaista perjantaihin klo 7.00–15.30, yhteensä 40 tuntia viikossa. Tehtävässä tulee kuitenkin olla valmius vuorotyöhön tuotannon tarpeiden mukaan.

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

Tarjoamme pitkäaikaisen työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään hitsausosaamistasi kiinnostavien ja suurikokoisten teollisuuden tuotteiden valmistuksessa.

Palkkaus on osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen noin 15–18 €/h.

Työpaikka sijaitsee Kangasalan Lentolassa, ja alueelle pääsee myös julkisilla kulkuvälineillä.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos MIG/MAG-hitsaus on sinulle tuttua, pitkän ja suoran sauman tekeminen onnistuu varmasti ja haluat päästä työskentelemään isojen teollisuuden rakenteiden parissa, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Sopivan osaajan löydyttyä etenemme rekrytoinnissa nopeasti.

Jos sinulle heräsi kysymyksiä, voit olla suoraan yhteydessä:

Jenna Vuorinen
p. 0401603159
jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi [jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi]

WORKNOW OY TYÖNANTAJANA

* Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi

* Pidämme sinut ajan tasalla koko prosessin ajan

* Lakisääteistä kattavampi työterveys alusta alkaen

* Luotettava työnantaja – asiat hoidetaan kuten sovitaan

Meille tärkeintä on, että löydät työn, jossa viihdyt ja onnistut.

title: Diamond Driller - USA Citizens and Residents Only
description:
ABOUT HY-TECH

Hy-Tech Drilling USA is an innovative, capable, and accountable diamond drilling partner for the leading mining companies in the Americas and Europe, enabling our clients to reach critical minerals more quickly with less environmental impact. This supports a global transition to a more sustainable future. We seek win/win/win solutions for our people, our customers, and the communities we support.

Established in 1991, Hy-Tech has grown to a fleet of 60 drills operating throughout Canada, USA, Chile, and Europe. We take pride in the success we’ve had working with our clients to develop innovative solutions for their project challenges and believe in our team’s strength and effectiveness in tackling challenges that may arise.

THE JOB

Reporting to the Foreman, the Driller sets up and operates drilling equipment in a safe and efficient manner to maximize core recovery. Daily responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Supervising the Driller’s Helper by being a safety leader; sets expectations for safety and quality standards.
  • Ensuring the safety of themselves, their Driller’s Helper and other crew on site.
  • Ensuring the organization and cleanliness of the drill and drill site location.
  • Being responsible for the set-up, repair & maintenance, and safe operation of all drilling-related equipment.
  • Communication with the Foreman and Geologist on a daily basis.

THE PERKS

  • Competitive hourly wage.
  • Increased salary through meter-based bonuses.
  • Comprehensive 100% Employer Paid Base Plan Benefits.
  • Employer-matched 401K Program.
  • PTO and Holiday Pay.
  • Flights, Accommodations and Meals provided for.
  • Paid travel days.
  • On the job training: Earn qualifications to operate equipment from industry leading professionals.
  • Being a part of a dynamic, driven team that has a priority and focus towards career development.

THE SETTING

You’ll work on drill sites for mineral exploration across USA, where your “office” could be the rugged mountains of Alaska, or anywhere across the Lower 48. Wherever you may be, you’ll experience unique terrain many people never get a chance to see.

THE SCHEDULE

Work hard and have quality time off. The typical field-operations schedule is 4 weeks on and 2 weeks off. Scheduled days off leave plenty of time for travel or other pursuits. You will alternate between day shift and night shift each time you get sent out on a job. Field-operation roles require 12-hour workdays while living in a man camp environment. title: Product Coordinator
description:

We are a family-run company and aim to maintain this as we continue to rapidly grow. We’re entrepreneurial. We challenge the status quo, aren’t afraid to try new ideas, and we leverage our agile structure to make smart decisions and find new opportunities.

We’re a people-first company and what we do wouldn’t be possible without our customers. For this reason, we like to say that our collections are always customer curated. Join our flexible work culture and team of creative and passionate individuals.

Reporting directly to the Product Development and Sourcing Manager, the Product Co-ordinator is the steward of product data at Moe’s Home Collection, ensuring every SKU moves from development to market with complete, accurate, and consistent information. Working across Product Development, Sourcing, Quality, PO, Sales, and National Accounts, this role validates product data against the Go-To-Market (GTM) calendar, resolves discrepancies at the source, and delivers reliable information to internal teams and external partners.

The ideal candidate is highly data-oriented and takes pride in accuracy. You’re exceptionally organized, comfortable managing a high volume of detail across multiple seasons and deadlines, and proactive about identifying and resolving inconsistencies to keep product information structured, traceable, and on time.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Process and conduct final reviews of TOF and Product Data forms, securing Product Developer sign-off and ensuring information is complete and accurate.
  • Own the accuracy and ongoing maintenance of Line Sheet and website product information.
  • Review product diagrams and assembly instructions for accuracy and timely completion in alignment with the GTM calendar.
  • Own swatch TOFs, coding, and data accuracy, including securing seasonal swatches from factories and supporting National Accounts with buyer swatch requirements.
  • Oversee the swatch and material library, ensuring materials are properly maintained, organized, and rotated.
  • Support the Product Development team with marketplace research and cost analysis in alignment with the GTM calendar.
  • Work within Qarma to maintain accurate seasonal SKU information.
  • Support the development and execution of seasonal product plans through accurate data consolidation.
  • Coordinate product-related activities and deliverables according to established timelines and the GTM calendar.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Moe’s brand and visual guidelines, applying them consistently across product information and materials.
  • Manage multiple requests, priorities, and deadlines effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Take on additional responsibilities as assigned by the direct manager.

Note: This job description is not exhaustive and may be adjusted based on evolving business needs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proven experience in sample tracking, product operations, product coordination, or a related role.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, conditional formatting, data validation, and cleaning and reconciling large datasets.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and confidence working with digital tools and systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.
  • Solutions-oriented problem solver with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of detailed information across multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Multilingual communication skills are considered an asset, with Mandarin, Cantonese, or Vietnamese preferred.
  • Experience in the furniture, fashion, or consumer goods industry is considered an asset.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive salary plus bonus.
  • Comprehensive benefits plan (health, dental, vision) with enhanced coverage for mental health resources.
  • Three weeks of vacation in your first year.
  • Casual and open office with views of downtown Vancouver and the North Shore mountains.
  • Stocked kitchen with snacks, fresh fruit, coffee, and tea.

description:
